# nbo-png-operaciones-espec-front

Código fuente de producción y configuraciones. Captura local: 28/10/2026.

Paquete: operation-spec-management. Se incluyen 331 archivos: 290 de TypeScript/JavaScript y 41 de estilos, recursos de texto, documentación y configuración.

Cada sección identifica la ruta original y conserva su contenido completo, salvo credenciales literales ocultadas en configuraciones. El código TypeScript/JavaScript se conserva sin cambios. Incluye componentes, páginas, hooks, servicios, tipos, rutas, estado, estilos, SVG, package.json, configuración de compilación y despliegue disponible.

Se excluyen tests y su configuración, dependencias instaladas, lockfiles, salidas generadas, cachés, metadatos de Git, instrucciones de agentes y recursos binarios. Los datos mock ubicados en el código de producción se conservan porque pueden ser consumidos por la aplicación.

Valores de credenciales ocultados: 0. Referencias a variables de entorno conservadas.

## Módulos

- AssignmentValidationPage
- BeneficiariesPage
- CompensationsPage
- ConciliationPage
- FolioDetailPage
- FoliosPage
- OperationDetailPage
- OperationsPage
- ReportSubmodule
- TransactionsBankPage

````markdown
# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react/README.md) uses [Babel](https://babeljs.io/) for Fast Refresh
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/) for Fast Refresh

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type aware lint rules:

- Configure the top-level `parserOptions` property like this:

```js
export default tseslint.config({
  languageOptions: {
    // other options...
    parserOptions: {
      project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
      tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname
    }
  }
})
```

- Replace `tseslint.configs.recommended` to `tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked` or `tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked`
- Optionally add `...tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked`
- Install [eslint-plugin-react](https://github.com/jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react) and update the config:

```js
// eslint.config.js
import react from 'eslint-plugin-react'

export default tseslint.config({
  // Set the react version
  settings: { react: { version: '18.3' } },
  plugins: {
    // Add the react plugin
    react
  },
  rules: {
    // other rules...
    // Enable its recommended rules
    ...react.configs.recommended.rules,
    ...react.configs['jsx-runtime'].rules
  }
})
```

````

## nginx/default.conf.template

```
server {
    listen       80;
    listen  [::]:80;
    server_name  localhost;

    #access_log  /var/log/nginx/host.access.log  main;

    # ====================================
    # COMPRESIÓN GZIP
    # ====================================
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_proxied any;
    gzip_comp_level 6;
    gzip_types
        text/plain
        text/css
        text/xml
        text/javascript
        application/json
        application/javascript
        application/x-javascript
        application/xml
        application/xml+rss
        application/xhtml+xml
        application/x-font-ttf
        application/x-font-opentype
        application/vnd.ms-fontobject
        image/svg+xml;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_disable "msie6";

    # ====================================
    # ARCHIVOS ESTÁTICOS CON HASH (assets/)
    # Cache agresivo (1 año)
    # ====================================
    location /assets/ {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable";

        # CORS (si es necesario para Module Federation)
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, OPTIONS' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type' always;

        # Si el archivo no existe, retorna 404 (no redirigir a index.html)
        try_files $uri =404;        
    }

    # ====================================
    # index.html y remoteEntry.js
    # NO cachear (deben validarse siempre)
    # ====================================
    location = /index.html {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        add_header Cache-Control "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate";
        add_header Pragma "no-cache";
        add_header Expires "0";

        # CORS
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
    }

    location = /assets/remoteEntry.js {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        
        # Cache corto para remoteEntry (5 minutos)
        # Permite actualizaciones rápidas pero evita descargas constantes
        add_header Cache-Control "public, max-age=300, must-revalidate";
        
        # CORS (CRÍTICO para Module Federation)
        # add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' '*' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' 'GET, OPTIONS' always;
        add_header 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers' 'Authorization, Content-Type' always;
    }

    location / {
        root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index  index.html index.htm;
        try_files $uri /index.html;
    }

    error_page  404              /404.html;

    # redirect server error pages to the static page /50x.html
    #
    error_page   500 502 503 504  /50x.html;
    location = /50x.html {
        root   /usr/share/nginx/html;
    }

    # proxy the PHP scripts to Apache listening on 127.0.0.1:80
    #
    #location ~ \.php$ {
    #    proxy_pass   http://127.0.0.1;
    #}

    # pass the PHP scripts to FastCGI server listening on 127.0.0.1:9000
    #
    #location ~ \.php$ {
    #    root           html;
    #    fastcgi_pass   127.0.0.1:9000;
    #    fastcgi_index  index.php;
    #    fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME  /scripts$fastcgi_script_name;
    #    include        fastcgi_params;
    #}

    # deny access to .htaccess files, if Apache's document root
    # concurs with nginx's one
    #
    #location ~ /\.ht {
    #    deny  all;
    #}
}
```

## src/App.tsx

```tsx
import { useContext } from 'react'

import {
  AlertMui,
  ModalAlert,
  ModalContent,
  Spinner
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import './App.css'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from './contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import Router from './routes/router'

function App() {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  return (
    <>
      <Router />
      {context?.globalStatus.loading && <Spinner />}
      {context?.globalStatus.modalContent.show && (
        <ModalContent {...context.globalStatus.modalContent.props} />
      )}
      {context?.globalStatus.modalAlert.show && (
        <ModalAlert {...context.globalStatus.modalAlert.props} />
      )}
      {context?.globalStatus.toast.show && (
        <AlertMui
          open={context.globalStatus.toast.show}
          message={context.globalStatus.toast.text}
          severity={context.globalStatus.toast.variant}
          onClose={context.clearToast}
        />
      )}
    </>
  )
}

export default App

```

## src/ErrorBoundary.tsx

```tsx
import { Component, ErrorInfo, ReactNode } from 'react'

import { STRINGS } from './helpers/strings'

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean
}

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode
}

class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    super(props)
    this.state = { hasError: false }
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    console.log('Derived Error', error)
    return { hasError: true }
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo): void {
    console.log('Error: ', error)
    console.log('Error Info: ', errorInfo)
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <h1>{STRINGS.ERROR.BOUNDARY_TITLE}</h1>
    }

    return this.props.children
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary

```

## src/components/BuySellComponent/BuySellComponent.tsx

```tsx
interface Props {
  booleanBuy: boolean
  valueBuy?: string
  booleanSell: boolean
  valueSell?: string
  participantId?: string
  type?: boolean | string
}

export const BuySellComponent = ({
  booleanBuy,
  booleanSell,
  valueBuy,
  valueSell,
  type
}: Props) => {
  if (type === 'compra') valueSell = '-'
  if (type === 'venta') valueBuy = '-'

  return (
    <>
      {valueBuy || valueSell ? (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col justify-center">
          <p className="text-[#1DE495]">
            C{' '}
            <span className="text-[#3D3D3D]">
              {valueBuy && String(valueBuy)}
            </span>
          </p>
          <p className="text-[#B22A09]">
            V{' '}
            <span className="text-[#3D3D3D]">
              {valueSell && String(valueSell)}
            </span>
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col justify-center">
          {booleanBuy && <p className="text-[#1DE495]">C&nbsp;</p>}
          {booleanSell && <p className="text-[#B22A09]">V&nbsp;</p>}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

```

```tsx
import Checkbox from '@mui/material/Checkbox'
import FormControlLabel from '@mui/material/FormControlLabel'
import { styled } from '@mui/material/styles'
import { useState } from 'react'

interface Props {
  check: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<{
      show: boolean
      accept: boolean
    }>
  >
}

const RedCheckbox = styled(Checkbox)({
  color: 'red',
  '&.Mui-checked': {
    color: 'red'
  },
  '&.MuiCheckbox-root': {
    '&:not(.Mui-checked)': {
      color: 'red'
    }
  }
})

export const CheckComponent = ({ check }: Props) => {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState(false)

  const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setChecked(event.target.checked)
    check({ show: true, accept: !event.target.checked })
  }

  return (
    <FormControlLabel
      control={<RedCheckbox checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} />}
      label="Cuento con los soportes necesarios para editar esta asignación"
    />
  )
}

```

```tsx
import iconLeft from '../../assets/icons/icon-left.svg'
import iconRight from '../../assets/icons/icon-right.svg'

interface Props {
  dateIn: string
  dateOut: string
  type: string
}

export const ComplianceComponent = ({ dateIn, dateOut, type }: Props) => {
  return (
    <>
      {(dateIn && type === 'REPO') || type === 'CONTADO' ? (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>
            <img src={iconRight} alt="in" className="h-5 w-8" />
          </span>
          <span>{dateIn}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {dateOut && type === 'REPO' ? (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>
            <img src={iconLeft} alt="out" className="icon-red h-5 w-8" />
          </span>
          <span>{dateOut}</span>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </>
  )
}
```

```tsx
interface Props {
  value: string
}

export const DepositoryComponent = ({ value }: Props) => {
  switch (value) {
    case '1':
      return 'DVL'
    case '2':
      return 'DCV/BIC'
    case '3':
      return 'CUD'
    case '4':
      return 'Banco Comercial'
    case '5':
      return 'CAVALI'
    case '6':
      return 'DCV CHILE'
    default:
      return value
  }
}
```

## src/components/FiltersComponent/FiltersComponent.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, FilterSelect } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { useFilter } from './Hooks/useFilter'
import { FILTER_STRINGS } from './filterStrings'

interface Props {
  setUrlFilter: (value: string) => void
  sidePanel: (value: boolean) => void
  setClearFilters: (value: boolean) => void
}

export const FiltersComponent: React.FC<Props> = ({
  setUrlFilter,
  sidePanel,
  setClearFilters
}) => {
  const {
    selectedFilters,
    selectOptions,
    handleSelectChanged,
    handleClearFilters,
    handleCreateUrl
  } = useFilter(setUrlFilter, sidePanel, setClearFilters)

  return (
    <>
      <FilterSelect
        label={FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.COUNTRY}
        options={selectOptions.country}
        onChange={handleSelectChanged}
        value={selectedFilters[FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.COUNTRY] || ''}
      />
      <FilterSelect
        label={FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.TYPE}
        options={selectOptions.type}
        onChange={handleSelectChanged}
        value={selectedFilters[FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.TYPE] || ''}
      />
      <FilterSelect
        label={FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.STATUS}
        options={selectOptions.status}
        onChange={handleSelectChanged}
        value={selectedFilters[FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_LABELS.STATUS] || ''}
      />
      <div className="mt-6 flex w-full justify-end gap-4">
        <Button
          name={FILTER_STRINGS.BUTTON_NAMES.CLEAR_FILTERS}
          type="button"
          variant="secondary"
          onClick={handleClearFilters}
          disabled={Object.keys(selectedFilters).length === 0}
        />
        <Button
          name={FILTER_STRINGS.BUTTON_NAMES.APPLY_FILTERS}
          type="button"
          onClick={handleCreateUrl}
        />
      </div>
    </>
```

```typescript
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

import { getSelects } from '../../../services'
import { FILTER_STRINGS } from '../filterStrings'

export const useFilter = (
  setUrlFilter: (url: string) => void,
  sidePanel: (clear: boolean) => void,
  setClearFilters: (clear: boolean) => void
) => {
  const [selectedFilters, setSelectedFilters] = useState<{
    [key: string]: string
  }>({})
  const [selectOptions, setSelectOptions] = useState<{
    [key: string]: { label: string; value: string }[]
  }>({
    country: [],
    type: [],
    status: []
  })
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(
    FILTER_STRINGS.LOCAL_STORAGE_USERNAME
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    const getSelectOptions = async () => {
      try {
        const [countryOptions, typeOptions, statusOptions] = await Promise.all([
          getSelects(client_user, FILTER_STRINGS.GET_SELECT_OPTIONS.COUNTRY),
          getSelects(client_user, FILTER_STRINGS.GET_SELECT_OPTIONS.TYPE),
          getSelects(client_user, FILTER_STRINGS.GET_SELECT_OPTIONS.STATUS)
        ])
        setSelectOptions({
          country: countryOptions,
          type: typeOptions,
          status: statusOptions
        })
      } catch {
        console.error(FILTER_STRINGS.GET_SELECT_OPTIONS.ERROR_MESSAGE)
      }
    }

    getSelectOptions()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href)
    const params = new URLSearchParams(currentUrl.search)
    if (params.size > 0) {
      const filterMapping: { [key: string]: string } =
        FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_MAPPING_TO_STRING
      const savedFilters: { [key: string]: string } = {}
      params.forEach((value, key) => {
        savedFilters[filterMapping[key]] = value
      })
      setSelectedFilters(savedFilters)
    }
  }, [])

  const handleSelectChanged = (label: string, value: string) => {
    setSelectedFilters((prevFilters) => ({
      ...prevFilters,
      [label]: value
    }))
  }

  const handleClearFilters = () => {
    window.history.pushState({}, '', window.location.pathname)
    setSelectedFilters({})
  }

  const handleCreateUrl = () => {
    const filterMapping: { [key: string]: string } =
      FILTER_STRINGS.FILTER_MAPPING_TO_ID
    const queryString = Object.entries(selectedFilters)
      .map(([key, value]) => `&${filterMapping[key] || key}=${value}`)
      .join('')
    setUrlFilter(queryString)

    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href)
    currentUrl.search = queryString.replace(/^&/, '')

    window.history.pushState({}, '', currentUrl.toString())
    setClearFilters(true)
    sidePanel(false)
  }

  return {
    selectedFilters,
    selectOptions,
    handleSelectChanged,
    handleClearFilters,
    handleCreateUrl
  }
}

```

```tsx
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField'
import React, { useState } from 'react'

interface Props {
  value: any
  label?: string
  placeholder?: string
  field: string
  setValue: (field: string, value: string) => void
  disabled?: boolean
  executeOnBlur?: boolean
  error?: {
    message: string
    field: string
  }
}

export const InputCreateComponent = ({
  value,
  placeholder,
  field,
  setValue,
  label,
  disabled = false,
  executeOnBlur = false,
  error
}: Props) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value)

  const handleKeyPress = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'Tab') {
      setValue(field, inputValue)
    }
  }

  const handleBlur = () => {
    if (executeOnBlur) {
      setValue(field, inputValue)
    }
  }

  return (
    <TextField
      sx={{
        '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
          '& fieldset': {
            borderColor: 'gray'
          },
          '&:hover fieldset': {
            borderColor: 'gray'
          },
          '&.Mui-focused fieldset': {
            borderColor: 'gray'
          },
          backgroundColor: 'transparent'
        },
        '& .MuiInputLabel-root': {
          color: 'gray'
        },
        '& .MuiInputLabel-root.Mui-focused': {
          color: 'gray'
        },
        '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
          color: 'inherit',
          backgroundColor: 'transparent'
        }
      }}
      label={label}
      type="text"
      placeholder={placeholder}
      value={inputValue}
      onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
      onBlur={handleBlur}
      variant="outlined"
      disabled={disabled}
      style={{ width: '240px' }}
      error={error?.field === field}
    />
  )
}

```

```tsx
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField'
import { styled } from '@mui/material/styles'
import React, { useContext, useState } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'

interface Props {
  value: any
  fraction: number
  field: string
  setValue: (fraction: number, field: string, value: string) => void
}

const RedTextField = styled(TextField)<{ error: boolean }>(({ error }) => ({
  '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {
    '& fieldset': {
      borderColor: error ? 'red' : 'grey'
    },
    '&:hover fieldset': {
      borderColor: error ? 'red' : 'grey'
    },
    '&.Mui-focused fieldset': {
      borderColor: error ? 'red' : 'grey'
    },
    height: '30px', // Ajustamos la altura del contenedor
    display: 'flex',
    alignItems: 'center' // Centramos verticalmente
  },
  '& .MuiOutlinedInput-input': {
    padding: '5px', // Ajustamos el padding interno
    height: '20px', // Ajustamos la altura del input
    boxSizing: 'border-box', // Aseguramos que el tamaño del input sea correcto
    '&:focus': {
      outlineColor: error ? 'red' : 'grey'
    }
  }
}))

export const InputEditComponent = ({
  value,
  fraction,
  field,
  setValue
}: Props) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(value)

  const handleKeyPress = (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'Tab') {
      setValue(fraction, field, inputValue)
    }
  }

  const handleStopPropagation = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation()
  }

  const hasError =
    context?.fieldErrors?.field === field &&
    Number(context.fieldErrors.fraction) === fraction

  return (
    <RedTextField
      type="text"
      value={inputValue}
      onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
      variant="outlined"
      style={{ width: '100%' }}
      error={hasError}
      onClick={handleStopPropagation}
    />
  )
}
```

## src/components/NewSettlementComponent/NewSettlementComponent.tsx

```tsx
import TextField from '@mui/material/TextField'
import axios from 'axios'
import { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../helpers'
import { InvestorBankAccount } from '../../models'
import { BankAccount, SettlementDtoModel } from '../../models/Dtos'
import { ValidationData } from '../../models/validations/ValidationData.model'
import { accountValidation } from '../../services'
import { InputCreateComponent } from '../InputCreateCompronent'
import { SelectCreateComponent } from '../SelectCreateComponent'

interface Props {
  tradeId: number
  side: number
  sendNewSettlement: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any>>
  getSettlementNextFraction: () => number
  validationData: ValidationData
  setSaveNewSettlementButton: () => void
}

export const NewSettlementComponent = ({
  tradeId,
  side,
  sendNewSettlement,
  getSettlementNextFraction,
  validationData,
  setSaveNewSettlementButton
}: Props) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [newSettlement, setNewSettlement] = useState<SettlementDtoModel>()
  const [folioEditSelect, setFolioEditSelect] = useState<
    { value: string; label: string }[]
  >([])
  const [fieldValues, setFieldValues] = useState<
    { field: string; value: string }[]
  >([])
  const [error, setError] = useState({
    message: '',
    field: ''
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (error.message) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setError({ message: '', field: '' })
      }, 5000)
      return () => clearTimeout(timer)
    }
  }, [error])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (newSettlement) {
      sendNewSettlement(newSettlement)
    }
  }, [newSettlement])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fieldValues.length === 4) {
      setSaveNewSettlementButton()
    }
  }, [fieldValues])

  const AccountValidate = async (account: string) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const accountData = await accountValidation(account, tradeId, side)
      if (accountData) {
        const updatedFolioEditSelect = accountData.investorBankAccounts.map(
          (account: InvestorBankAccount) => ({
            value: account.id.toString(),
            label: `${account.accountNumber} | ${account.bankName}`
          })
        )
        setFolioEditSelect(updatedFolioEditSelect)
        setNewSettlement({
          fraction: getSettlementNextFraction(),
          tradeId: tradeId,
          fiduciarySpecialist: accountData?.fiduciarySpecialist,
          reference: '',
          valtax: 19,
          side: {
            id: side
          },
          investor: {
            identificationType: {
              description:
                accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.identificationType
                  ?.description
            },
            documentNumber:
              accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.documentNumber,
            firstName: accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.firstName
          },
          investorAccount: {
            id: accountData?.investorAccount?.id,
            accountNumber: accountData?.investorAccount?.accountNumber
          },
          sourceQuoteType: {
            id: accountData?.sourceQuoteType?.id,
            description: accountData?.sourceQuoteType?.description
          },
          directDepositor: {
            id: Number(accountData.investorAccount.depository.id),
            code: '',
            name: ''
          }
        })
      }
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error validando la cuenta',
        variant: 'error',
        message: message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const updateFieldValue = (field: string, value: string) => {
    setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      [field]: value
    }))
  }

  const setValue = (field: string, value: string) => {
    if (!value) {
      setError({ message: 'El valor no puede estar vacío.', field: field })
      return
    }
    if (field === 'fractionQuantity') {
      if (Number(value) > validationData.quantityAvailable) {
        setError({
          message:
            'La cantidad total de acciones de la fraccion es mayor que la cantidad total de acciones de la operación.',
          field: field
        })
        return
      }
    }
    if (field === 'investorAccount.accountNumber') {
      AccountValidate(value)
    } else {
      updateFieldValue(field, value)
    }

    setFieldValues((prevState) => {
      const existingField = prevState.find((item) => item.field === field)
      if (existingField) {
        return prevState.map((item) =>
          item.field === field ? { ...item, value } : item
        )
      } else {
        return [...prevState, { field, value }]
      }
    })
  }

  const updateBankAccount = (data: BankAccount) => {
    setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      bankAccount: data
    }))
    const bank = {
      field: 'bank',
      value: data.bankAccount?.toString()
    }
    setFieldValues((prevState) => {
      const existingField = prevState.find((item) => item.field === bank.field)
      if (existingField) {
        return prevState.map((item) =>
          item.field === bank.field
            ? { ...item, value: bank.value ?? '' }
            : item
        )
      } else {
        return [...prevState, { ...bank, value: bank.value ?? '' }]
      }
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="new-settlement-component w-full">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col md:w-1/2">
          <div className="mb-4 w-3/4">
            <InputCreateComponent
              label="Cuenta"
              value=""
              field="investorAccount.accountNumber"
              setValue={setValue}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 w-3/4">
            <TextField
              label="Cuenta Liquidación"
              value={newSettlement?.bankAccount?.bankAccount}
              type="text"
              style={{ width: '240px' }}
              disabled
              slotProps={{
                inputLabel: {
                  shrink: !!newSettlement?.bankAccount?.bankAccount
                }
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 w-3/4">
            <InputCreateComponent
              label="Cantidad de la fracción"
              value={newSettlement?.fractionQuantity}
              field="fractionQuantity"
              setValue={setValue}
              executeOnBlur
              error={error}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col md:w-1/2">
          <div className="mb-4 w-3/4">
            <SelectCreateComponent
              label="Banco Liquidador"
              value={newSettlement?.bankAccount?.id}
              options={folioEditSelect}
              updateInvestorBankAccount={updateBankAccount}
              disabled={folioEditSelect.length === 0}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 w-3/4">
            <InputCreateComponent
              label="Porcentaje de comisión"
              value={newSettlement?.commissionPercentage}
              field="commissionPercentage"
              setValue={setValue}
              executeOnBlur={true}
              error={error}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: 'red' }}>{error.message}</div>
    </div>
  )
}

```

```tsx
import { FormControl, InputLabel } from '@mui/material'
import MenuItem from '@mui/material/MenuItem'
import Select, { SelectChangeEvent } from '@mui/material/Select'
import React, { useState } from 'react'

import { BankAccount } from '../../models'

interface Props {
  value: any
  options: { value: string; label: string }[]
  updateInvestorBankAccount: (bankAccount: BankAccount) => void
  disabled?: boolean
  label: string
}

export const SelectCreateComponent = ({
  value,
  options,
  updateInvestorBankAccount,
  disabled = false,
  label
}: Props) => {
  const [selectedValue, setSelectedValue] = useState(value)

  const handleChange = (event: SelectChangeEvent<any>) => {
    const newValue = event.target.value
    setSelectedValue(newValue)
    const selectedOption = options.find(
      (option) => option.value === event.target.value
    )
    const newLabel = selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : ''
    const [bankAccount, bankName] = newLabel.split(' | ')
    updateInvestorBankAccount({
      id: parseInt(newValue),
      bankAccount: bankAccount,
      bank: {
        id: parseInt(newValue),
        bankName: bankName
      }
    })
  }

  const handleStopPropagation = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation()
  }

  return (
    <FormControl>
      <InputLabel id="demo-simple-select-readonly-label">{label}</InputLabel>
      <Select
        labelId="demo-simple-select-readonly-label"
        id="demo-simple-select-readonly"
        label={label}
        value={selectedValue}
        onChange={handleChange}
        onClick={handleStopPropagation}
        style={{ width: '240px' }}
        disabled={disabled}
      >
        {options.map((option) => (
          <MenuItem key={option.value} value={option.value}>
            {option.label}
          </MenuItem>
        ))}
      </Select>
    </FormControl>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react'

import { InvestorBankAccount } from '../../models'

interface Props {
  width: string
  value: any
  id: number
  options: { value: string; label: string }[]

    fraction: number,
    bankAccount: InvestorBankAccount
  ) => void

  width,
  value,
  id,
  options,
  updateInvestorBankAccount
}: Props) => {

  const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const newValue = event.target.value
    setSelectedValue(newValue)

    const newLabel = selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : ''
    const [bankAccount, bankName] = newLabel.split(' | ')
    updateInvestorBankAccount(id, {
      id: parseInt(newValue),
      accountNumber: bankAccount,

  const handleStopPropagation = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
    event.stopPropagation()

  return (
    <select
      style={{ width, minHeight: '40px' }}
      value={selectedValue}
      onChange={handleChange}
```

```tsx
import React, { createContext, useState, ReactNode } from 'react'

import { ModalAlertProps, ModalContentProps } from '../Declares/declares'

interface ModalContent {
  show: boolean
  props: ModalContentProps
}

interface ModalAlertContent {
  show: boolean
  props: ModalAlertProps
}
interface ToastContent {
  show: boolean
  text: string
  variant: string
}

interface AlertContent {
  status: string
}
interface GlobalStatus {
  loading: boolean
  modalAlert: ModalAlertContent
  toast: ToastContent
  alert: AlertContent
  modalContent: ModalContent
}
interface GlobalContextType {
  globalStatus: GlobalStatus
  fractions: any[]
  fieldErrors: {
    message: string
    field: string
    fraction: string
  }
  setEditFractions: (fractions: any[]) => void
  setLoading: (loading: boolean) => void
  setAlertMui: (alert: AlertContent) => void
  setModalAlert: (props: ModalAlertProps) => void
  setToast: (toast: ToastContent) => void
  clearModalAlert: () => void
  clearToast: () => void
  setErrorInputField: (field: string, message: string, id?: string) => void
  clearErrorInputField: () => void
  setModalContent: (props: ModalContentProps) => void
  clearModalContent: () => void
}

export const GlobalStatusContext = createContext<GlobalContextType | undefined>(
  undefined
)
export const GlobalStatusProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({
  children
}) => {
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({
    fraction: '',
    message: '',
    field: ''
  })
  const [fractions, setEditFractions] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [globalStatus, setGlobalStatus] = useState<GlobalStatus>({
    loading: false,
    modalAlert: {
      show: false,
      props: {
        title: ''
      }
    },
    alert: {
      status: ''
    },
    toast: {
      show: false,
      text: '',
      variant: ''
    },
    modalContent: {
      show: false,
      props: {
        children: undefined,
        handleClose: () => {},
        handleAccept: () => {}
      }
    }
  })

  const setModalContent = (props: ModalContentProps) => {
    const originalHandleClose = props.handleClose
    props.handleClose = () => {
      clearModalContent()
      if (originalHandleClose) {
        originalHandleClose()
      }
    }
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      modalContent: {
        show: true,
        props
      }
    }))
  }

  const clearModalContent = () => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      modalContent: {
        show: false,
        props: {
          children: undefined,
          handleClose: () => {},
          handleAccept: () => {}
        }
      }
    }))
  }

  const setErrorInputField = (
    field: string,
    message: string,
    fraction?: string
  ) => {
    if (fraction == undefined) fraction = ''
    setFieldErrors({ message, field, fraction })
  }

  const clearErrorInputField = () => {
    setFieldErrors({ message: '', field: '', fraction: '' })
  }

  const clearToast = () => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      toast: {
        show: false,
        text: '',
        onClose: () => {},
        variant: ''
      }
    }))
  }

  const setToast = (toast: ToastContent) => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      toast: {
        ...prevStatus.toast,
        ...toast
      }
    }))
  }

  const setAlertMui = (alert: AlertContent) => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      alert: {
        ...prevStatus.alert,
        ...alert
      }
    }))
  }

  const clearModalAlert = () => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      modalAlert: {
        show: false,
        props: {
          title: ''
        }
      }
    }))
  }

  const setModalAlert = (props: ModalAlertProps) => {
    const originalHandleClose = props.handleCancel
    if (props.textCancel != 'hidden') {
      props.handleCancel = () => {
        clearModalAlert()
        if (originalHandleClose) {
          originalHandleClose()
        }
      }
    }
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      modalAlert: {
        show: true,
        props
      }
    }))
  }

  const setLoading = (loading: boolean) => {
    setGlobalStatus((prevStatus) => ({
      ...prevStatus,
      loading: loading
    }))
  }

  const value = React.useMemo(
    () => ({
      globalStatus,
      fractions,
      fieldErrors,
      setEditFractions,
      setLoading,
      setModalAlert,
      setToast,
      setAlertMui,
      clearModalAlert,
      clearToast,
      setErrorInputField,
      clearErrorInputField,
      setModalContent,
      clearModalContent
    }),
    [globalStatus]
  )

  return (
    <GlobalStatusContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </GlobalStatusContext.Provider>
  )
}
```

## src/helpers/folioFullfillment.ts

```typescript
/**
 * Function to determine if a menu option should be disabled based on the menu ID and selected rows
 * @param params - Object containing the menu id, all rows, and selected rows
 * @returns boolean - true if the option should be disabled, false otherwise
 */
interface DisabledItemsMenuParams {
  id: string
  rows: any[]
  selectedRows: (string | number)[]
}

export const disabledItemsMenu = (params: DisabledItemsMenuParams): boolean => {
  const { id, rows, selectedRows } = params

  // Base case: if no menu ID is provided, disable the option
  if (!id) return true

  /**
   * Helper function to check if any selected row is not from Colombia
   * @returns true if any row is not from Colombia (which will disable the button)
   */
  const validateCountryColombia = (): boolean => {
    if (selectedRows.length === 0) return true

    // Find selected row objects
    const selectedRowObjects = rows.filter((row) => {
      const rowId = row.id ?? row.specialTradeId
      return selectedRows.includes(rowId)
    })

    // Check if any selected row is not from Colombia
    // If any row is not from Colombia, the button should be disabled
    return selectedRowObjects.some((row) => {
      const countryName = row?.country?.name?.toLowerCase() ?? ''
      return countryName !== 'colombia'
    })
  }

  // Validate based on menu ID
  switch (id) {
    case 'envio-liquidacion-deposito': {
      // Option should be disabled if no rows are selected
      if (selectedRows.length === 0) return true
      return false
    }

    case 'envio-asignacion-deposito': {
      // Option should be disabled if no rows are selected
      if (selectedRows.length === 0) return true

      // Add any additional row-by-row validation here if needed
      return true
    }

    case 'desbloqueo-repique': {
      // Option should be disabled if no rows are selected
      if (selectedRows.length === 0) return true

      // Find selected row objects
      const selectedRowObjects = rows.filter((row) => {
        const rowId = row.id ?? row.specialTradeId
        return selectedRows.includes(rowId)
      })

      // Check if any selected row on depository attribute have DCV Chile
      // If any row meets these conditions, the button should be disabled
      return selectedRowObjects.some((row) => {
        const depositoryDesc = row?.depository?.description?.toLowerCase() ?? ''

        return depositoryDesc === 'dcv chile'
      })
    }

    case 'pago-vendedor': {
      // Use the common function to validate if country is Colombia
      return validateCountryColombia()
    }

    case 'recaudo-comprador': {
      // Use the common function to validate if country is Colombia
      return validateCountryColombia()
    }

    case 'incumplimiento': {
      // Button is disabled if no rows are selected
      if (selectedRows.length === 0) return true

      const selectedRowObjects = rows.filter((row) => {
        const rowId = row.id ?? row.specialTradeId
        return selectedRows.includes(rowId)
      })

      // If even one row has "Cancelada" status, the button should be disabled
      return selectedRowObjects.some((row) => {
        const settlementStatus =
          row?.settlementStatus?.description?.toLowerCase().trim() ===
          'cancelada'
        const regularStatus =
          row?.status?.description?.toLowerCase().trim() === 'cancelada'

        return settlementStatus || regularStatus
      })
    }

    default:
      // Default case: if no specific validation is defined, don't disable
      return false
  }
}
```

## src/helpers/formattedNumber.ts

```typescript
export const formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator = (
  number: number | undefined,
  addDollarSign: boolean = false,
  includeDecimals: boolean = true
) => {
  if (typeof number !== 'number' || isNaN(number)) return '--'
  const roundedNumber = includeDecimals ? number.toFixed(2) : number.toFixed(0)
  const [integerPart, decimalPart] = roundedNumber.split('.')
  const formattedIntegerPart = integerPart.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')
  const formattedNumber =
    includeDecimals && decimalPart
      ? `${formattedIntegerPart},${decimalPart}`
      : formattedIntegerPart
  return addDollarSign ? `$${formattedNumber}` : formattedNumber
}
```

## src/helpers/generateCSVReport.ts

```typescript
import { format } from 'date-fns'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from './formattedNumber'

type GenerateTxtReport = {
  data: any
  name?: string
  setProgress: (progress: number) => void
}

export const generateCSVReport = async ({
  data,
  name,
  setProgress
}: GenerateTxtReport) => {
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username') ?? 'unknown_user'

  try {
    let reports: string[] = []

    const dataArray = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data]
    const totalRecords = dataArray.length

    const now = new Date()
    const fechaDeGeneracion = format(now, 'yyyy-MM-dd').replace(/[-_.]/g, '')

    const headers = [
      'Operacion especial',
      'Forma de pago',
      'Fecha conciliacion',
      'Codigo operacion',
      'Estado',
      'Transaccion cantidad banco',
      'Transaccion Cantidad nuBO',
      'Transaccion Diferencia',
      'Debito nuBO (cantidad)',
      'Debito banco (cantidad)',
      'Debito Diferencia (cantidad)',
      'Debito nuBO (monto)',
      'Debito banco (monto)',
      'Debito Diferencia (monto)',
      'Credito nuBO (cantidad)',
      'Credito banco (cantidad)',
      'Credito Diferencia (cantidad)',
      'Credito nuBO (monto)',
      'Credito banco (monto)',
      'Credito Diferencia (monto)',
      'Saldo anterior nuBo',
      'Saldo anterior banco',
      'Saldo de diferencia anterior',
      'Saldo final nuBo',
      'Saldo final banco',
      'Saldo de diferencia final',
      'Cantidad diferencias'
    ].join(',')

    reports.push(headers)

    for (let i = 0; i < totalRecords; i++) {
      const item = dataArray[i]

      const formattedLine = [
        String(item.specialTradeName ?? '').padStart(5, ' '),
        String(item.paymentTypeName ?? '').padStart(5, ' '),
        new Date(item.conciliationTime)
          .toLocaleDateString('es-ES')
          .replace(/\//g, '-')
          .padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.codeOperation ?? '').padStart(25, ' '),
        String(item.status?.detail ?? '').padStart(30, ' '),
        String(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
            item.transactionsNuboQuantity,
            false,
            true
          ) ?? ''
        ).padStart(10, ' '),
        String(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
            item.transactionsBankQuantity,
            false,
            false
          ) ?? ''
        ).padStart(10, ' '),
        String(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
            item.transactionsDifferenceQuantity,
            false,
            false
          ) ?? ''
        ).padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitNuboQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitBankQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitDifferenceQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitNuboAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitBankAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.debitDifferenceAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditNuboQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditBankQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditDifferenceQuantity ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditNuboAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditBankAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.creditDifferenceAmount ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balancePreviousNubo ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balancePreviousBank ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balanceDifferencePrevious ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balanceFinalNubo ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balanceFinalBank ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.balanceDifferenceFinal ?? '').padStart(10, ' '),
        String(item.quantityDifferencesTotal ?? '').padStart(5, ' ')
      ].join(',')

      reports.push(formattedLine)

      setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / totalRecords) * 100))
    }

    const finalContent = reports.join('\n')

    const nameEntity = (name ?? 'default_name').replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    const fileName = `${fechaDeGeneracion}_${nameEntity}.csv`

    const blob = new Blob([finalContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)

    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = url
    link.download = `${fileName}_${client_user}.csv`
    document.body.appendChild(link)
    link.click()

    document.body.removeChild(link)
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)

    setProgress(100)
  } catch {
    console.error('Error generating CSV file')
  }
}
```

## src/helpers/utilities.ts

```typescript
import axios from 'axios'

import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../pages'

type TimeLike = {
  hour?: number
  minute?: number
  second?: number
  nano?: number
}

export const getParamUrl = (param: string): string | null => {
  return new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get(param)
}

export const formatClientDatetime = (): string => {
  const date = new Date()
  const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000
  const localDate = new Date(date.getTime() - offset)
  return localDate.toISOString().split('.')[0]
}

export const formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator = (
  number: number,
  addDollarSign: boolean = false
) => {
  if (number === null || number === undefined) return number
  const [integerPart, decimalPart] = number.toString().split('.')
  const formattedIntegerPart = integerPart.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')
  const formattedNumber = decimalPart
    ? `${formattedIntegerPart},${decimalPart}`
    : formattedIntegerPart
  return addDollarSign ? `$${formattedNumber}` : formattedNumber
}

export const formatNumberWithTwoDecimals = (
  number: string,
  addThousandSeparators: boolean = false
): string => {
  if (number === null || number === undefined) return number
  number = number.replace(/\./g, ',')
  const points = number.split(',')
  if (points.length === 0) number = '0,00'
  if (points.length > 2) {
    const integerPart = points.slice(0, points.length - 1).join('')
    const decimalPart = points[points.length - 1]
    number = `${integerPart},${decimalPart}`
  }
  let [integerPart, decimalPart] = number.split(',')
  decimalPart = decimalPart ? decimalPart.slice(0, 2) : '00'
  integerPart = addThousandSeparators
    ? integerPart.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')
    : integerPart
  return addThousandSeparators
    ? `${integerPart},${decimalPart}`
    : `${integerPart}.${decimalPart}`
}

export const checkNullValue = (value: any): any => {
  return value === null || value === undefined || value === '' ? '-' : value
}

export const getErrorMessage = (key: string): string => {
  const errorMessages: { [key: string]: string } = {
    UNAUTHORIZED: 'Por favor inicia sesión de nuevo.',
    SPECIAL_TRADE_NOT_FOUND: 'Special Trade no encontrado',
    ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: 'La cuenta no existe',
    CLIENT_OPERATION_SPECIAL_RULES_ERROR:
      'Ocurrió un error inesperado en las Reglas Especiales de Operación',
    CLIENT_OPERATION_SPECIAL_FRACTIONATION_ERROR:
      'Ocurrió un error inesperado en el Fraccionamiento Especial de Operación',
    CLIENT_OPERATION_SPECIAL_CALCULATION_ERROR:
      'Ocurrió un error inesperado en el Cálculo Especial de Operación',
    NUMBER_FRACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: 'Número de fracciones no permitido',
    FRACTION_QUANTITY_NOT_ALLOWED: 'Total de fracciónCantidad no permitido',
    INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_NOT_EXIST_IN_DEPOSITORY:
      'La cuenta de título no existe en el depósito',
    BANK_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: 'Se requiere la cuenta bancaria',
    FRACTION_TOTAL_QUANTITY_NOT_CORRESPOND_QUANTITY_TRADE:
      'El número total de acciones en las fracciones no corresponde al número total de acciones de la operación',
    FRACTION_TOTAL_QUANTITY_EXCEED_QUANTITY_TRADE:
      'La suma de las cantidades de las fracciones excede la cantidad de la operación',
    PARTICIPANT_ACCOUNT_OR_INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED:
      'Se requiere la cuenta del participante o la cuenta del inversor',
    COMMISSION_NOT_CORRESPOND_TO_OWN_POSITION_POINT_ORIGIN:
      'La comisión no corresponde a la posición propia de origen',
    OWN_POSITION_NOT_CORRESPOND_TO_ORIGIN:
      'Los datos de asignación no corresponden al origen de la Posición Propia',
    THIRD_PARTIES_COLLECTIVE_PORTFOLIOS_NOT_CORRESPOND_TO_ORIGIN:
      'Los datos de asignación no corresponden al origen de Terceros/Portafolios Colectivos',
    FRACTIONATION_PENDING_APPROVED_ERROR:
      'No se puede realizar la corrección porque hay una solicitud pendiente de aprobar'
  }
  return errorMessages[key] || 'Ocurrió un error desconocido.'
}

export const getCommonHeaders = async () => {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')
  const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()

  return {
    client_datetime: client_datetime,
    client_user: client_user,
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
  }
}

export const checkParticipant = (
  participantId: string,
  valueBuy: string,
  valueSell: string
) => {
  if (participantId === valueBuy && participantId === valueSell) {
    return true
  } else if (participantId === valueBuy) {
    return FOLIOS_STRINGS.CHECK_PARTICIPANT.BUY
  } else if (participantId === valueSell) {
    return FOLIOS_STRINGS.CHECK_PARTICIPANT.SELL
  } else {
    return false
  }
}

export const errorManagment = (error: any) => {
  let message = 'Error desconocido'
  if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
    message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
    if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
      message = 'Error en el servidor.'
  }
  return message
}

export const formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator2 = (
  number: number | undefined,
  addDollarSign: boolean = false,
  includeDecimals: boolean = true
) => {
  if (typeof number !== 'number' || isNaN(number)) return '--'
  const roundedNumber = includeDecimals ? number.toFixed(2) : number.toFixed(0)
  const [integerPart, decimalPart] = roundedNumber.split('.')
  const formattedIntegerPart = integerPart.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')
  const formattedNumber =
    includeDecimals && decimalPart
      ? `${formattedIntegerPart},${decimalPart}`
      : formattedIntegerPart
  return addDollarSign
    ? `$${formattedNumber}`
    : formattedNumber.replace(',00', '')
}

export const formatTimeHHmm = (t?: TimeLike | null): string => {
  if (!t || !Number.isFinite(t.hour) || !Number.isFinite(t.minute))
    return '--:--'
  const { hour, minute } = t
  if (hour! < 0 || hour! > 23 || minute! < 0 || minute! > 59) return '--:--'
  const hh = String(hour).padStart(2, '0')
  const mm = String(minute).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${hh}:${mm}`
}
```

```typescript
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver'
import Papa from 'papaparse'

import { Settlement } from '../models/settlement.model'

export const generateCsvReport = (data: Settlement[], fileName: string) => {
  const transformedData = data.map((item) => {
    const transformedItem: {
      [key: string]: any
    } = {}
    for (const key in item) {
      const value = item[key as keyof Settlement]
      if (
        (key === 'country' ||
          key === 'currency' ||
          key === 'participantSell' ||
          key === 'participantBuy') &&
        typeof value === 'object' &&
        value !== null
      ) {
        transformedItem[key] =
          (
            value as {
              name: string
            }
          ).name || ''
      } else {
        transformedItem[key] = value
      }
    }
    return transformedItem
  })

  const csv = Papa.unparse(transformedData, { delimiter: '\t', header: false })
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })

  const date = new Date()
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const year = date.getFullYear()
  const formattedDate = `${day}-${month}-${year}`

  saveAs(blob, `${fileName}-${formattedDate}.csv`)
}
```

```typescript
              }
```

## src/hooks/generateExcelReport.ts

```typescript
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx'

export const generateExcelReport = (
  data: any[],
  columns: any[],
  fileName: string
) => {
  const limitedData = data.slice(0, 3000)

  const tableColumns = columns.map((col) => ({
    header: col.header,
    dataKey: col.dataKey
  }))

  const tableRows = limitedData.map((row) => {
    const rowData: { [key: string]: any } = {}
    tableColumns.forEach((col) => {
      const keys = col.dataKey.split('.')
      let value = row
      keys.forEach((key: string | number) => {
        value = value ? value[key] : null
      })
      rowData[col.dataKey] = value
    })
    return rowData
  })

  const worksheetData = [
    tableColumns.map((col) => col.header),
    ...tableRows.map((row) => tableColumns.map((col) => row[col.dataKey]))
  ]
  const worksheet = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(worksheetData)

  const headerStyle = {
    font: { bold: true },
    fill: { fgColor: { rgb: 'FFFF00' } },
    alignment: { horizontal: 'center' }
  }

  tableColumns.forEach((_col, index) => {
    const cellAddress = XLSX.utils.encode_cell({ c: index, r: 0 })
    if (!worksheet[cellAddress]) worksheet[cellAddress] = {}
    worksheet[cellAddress].s = headerStyle
  })

  const columnWidths = columns.map((col) => ({ wch: col.width || 20 }))
  worksheet['!cols'] = columnWidths

  worksheet['!autofilter'] = {
    ref: `A1:${String.fromCharCode(65 + tableColumns.length - 1)}${tableRows.length + 1}`
  }

  const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new()
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, 'Operaciones')

  const date = new Date()
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const year = date.getFullYear()
  const formattedDate = `${day}-${month}-${year}`

  XLSX.writeFile(workbook, `${fileName}_${formattedDate}.xlsx`)
}
```

```typescript
import JSZip from 'jszip'

type GenerateTxtReport = {
  data: any
  name?: string
  setProgress: (progress: number) => void
}

export const generateTxtReport = async ({
  data,
  name,
  setProgress
}: GenerateTxtReport) => {
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username') ?? 'unknown_user'

  try {
    const zip = new JSZip()
    let reports: string[] = []

    const dataArray = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data]
    const totalRecords = dataArray.length // Total de registros para el cálculo del progreso

    const now = new Date()
    const fechaDeGeneracion = now
      .toLocaleDateString('es-ES')
      .replace(/\//g, '-')

    for (let i = 0; i < totalRecords; i++) {
      const item = dataArray[i]

      const {
        side,
        fraction,
        commissionPercentage,
        commissionAmount,
        brokerageService,
        netAmount,
        fractionVolume,
        valTaxAmount,
        latePenality,
        netValTax,
        outFlowTurnoverValue,
        returnTurnoverValue,
        fractionQuantity
      } = item?.settlement || {}

      const {
        matchDate,
        matchId,
        clearingDate,
        marketType,
        businessType,
        depository,
        daysToSettlement,
        price,
        currency,
        type,
        tradingSystem,
        repurchaseRate
      } = item?.trade || {}

      const {
        fullName = '',
        identificationType,
        documentNumber,
        taxStatus,
        address
      } = item?.investor || {}

      const { userName, securityTitle, participantBuy, participantSell } =
        item || {}

      let participipantCurrent
      if (participantBuy) {
        participipantCurrent = participantBuy
      }
      if (participantSell) {
        participipantCurrent = participantSell
      }

      const formattedLine = [
        String(side?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 6)
          .padStart(6, ' '), // longitud 6
        String(matchDate ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 8)
          .padStart(8, ' '), // longitud 8
        String((matchDate ?? '') + (matchId ?? ''))
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 18)
          .padStart(18, ' '), // longitud 18
        String(fraction?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 6)
          .padStart(6, ' '), // longitud 6
        String(clearingDate ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 8)
          .padStart(8, ' '), // longitud 8
        String(securityTitle?.mnemonic ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 12)
          .padStart(12, ' '), // longitud 12
        String(securityTitle?.equityCode ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 33)
          .padStart(33, ' '), // longitud 33
        String(fullName ?? '')
          .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 44)
          .padStart(44, ' '), // longitud 44
        String(identificationType?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .padStart(3, ' '), // longitud 3
        String(documentNumber ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 15)
          .padStart(15, ' '), // longitud 15
        String(address ?? '')
          .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 50)
          .padStart(50, ' '), // longitud 50
        String(taxStatus?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 12)
          .padStart(12, ' '), // longitud 12
        String(participipantCurrent?.name ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 35)
          .padStart(35, ' '), // longitud 35
        String(participipantCurrent?.identificationType?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .padStart(10, ' '), // longitud 10
        String(participipantCurrent?.documentNumber ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 15)
          .padStart(15, ' '), // longitud 15
        String(userName ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 44)
          .padStart(44, ' '), // longitud 44
        String(participipantCurrent?.taxStatus?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 12)
          .padStart(12, ' '), // longitud 12
        String(type?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 17)
          .padStart(17, ' '), // longitud 17
        String(participipantCurrent?.code ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .padStart(5, ' '), // longitud 5
        String(businessType?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 15)
          .padStart(15, ' '), // longitud 15
        String(marketType?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 10)
          .padStart(10, ' '), // longitud 10
        String(tradingSystem?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 11)
          .padStart(11, ' '), // longitud 11
        String(depository?.description ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 10)
          .padStart(10, ' '), // longitud 10
        String(daysToSettlement?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 6)
          .padStart(6, ' '), // longitud 6
        String(outFlowTurnoverValue?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(returnTurnoverValue?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 1)
          .padStart(1, ' '), // longitud 1
        String(repurchaseRate?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 9)
          .padStart(9, ' '), // longitud 9
        String(fractionQuantity?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(price?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(fractionVolume?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(currency?.code ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.\s]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 3)
          .padStart(3, ' '), // longitud 3
        String(commissionPercentage?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 8)
          .padStart(8, ' '), // longitud 8
        String(commissionAmount?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(brokerageService?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(netAmount?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(valTaxAmount?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(latePenality?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        String(netValTax?.toString() ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 25)
          .padStart(25, ' '), // longitud 25
        ''.padStart(200, ' '), // longitud 200
        String(fechaDeGeneracion ?? '')
          .replace(/[-_.]/g, '')
          .substring(0, 8)
          .padStart(8, ' ') // longitud 8
      ].join('')

      reports.push(formattedLine)

      // 🟢 Actualizar progreso
      setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / totalRecords) * 100))
    }

    const finalContent = reports.join('\n')

    const nameEntity = (name ?? 'default_name').replace(/\s+/g, '_')

    const fileName = `${nameEntity}_${fechaDeGeneracion}_${client_user}.txt`

    zip.file(fileName, finalContent)

    const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' })

    const zipUrl = URL.createObjectURL(zipBlob)

    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = zipUrl
    link.download = `${nameEntity}_${fechaDeGeneracion}_${client_user}.zip`
    document.body.appendChild(link)
    link.click()

    document.body.removeChild(link)
    URL.revokeObjectURL(zipUrl)

    // 🔵 Finaliza en 100%
    setProgress(100)

    setTimeout(() => {
      setProgress(0)
    }, 2000)
  } catch {
    console.error('Error generating ZIP file')
  }
}
```

## src/hooks/webSocket.ts

```typescript
import { Client } from '@stomp/stompjs'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import SockJS from 'sockjs-client'

const useWebSocket = (path: string, topic: string) => {
  const [mensaje, setMensaje] = useState('')
  const [connected, setConnected] = useState(false)
  const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')

  useEffect(() => {
    const client = new Client({
      brokerURL: `${path}`,
      connectHeaders: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
      },
      // debug: function (str) {
      //   console.log(str);
      // },
      onConnect: () => {
        setConnected(true)

        client.subscribe(topic, (message) => {
          setMensaje(message.body)
        })
      },
      onDisconnect: () => {
        setConnected(false)
      },

      webSocketFactory: () => new SockJS(`${path}`),
      reconnectDelay: 5000,
      heartbeatIncoming: 4000,
      heartbeatOutgoing: 4000
    })

    client.activate()

    return () => {
      client.deactivate()
    }
  }, [path, topic, token])

  return { mensaje, connected }
}

export default useWebSocket

```

```tsx
import { setupScheduleInterceptor } from 'remoteShell/mf-scheduleInterceptor'

import App from './App.tsx'
import ErrorBoundary from './ErrorBoundary.tsx'
import { GlobalStatusProvider } from './contex/GlobalStatusContext.tsx'

setupScheduleInterceptor?.()
const Main = () => (
  <ErrorBoundary>
    <GlobalStatusProvider>
      <App />
    </GlobalStatusProvider>
  </ErrorBoundary>
)

export default Main
```

```typescript
export interface TransactionsPayloadModel {
  bankTransactionId?: number
  bankSequence: string
  nuboSequence: string
  transactionAmount: number
  transactionDateTime: string
  observation: string
  accountOutput: string
  accountInput: string
  specialTradeId: number
  participantId: number
  paymentTypeId: number
}

export const getEmptyTransactionsPayloadModel =
  (): TransactionsPayloadModel => ({
    bankSequence: '',
    nuboSequence: '',
    transactionAmount: 0,
    transactionDateTime: '',
    observation: '',
    accountOutput: '',
    accountInput: '',
    specialTradeId: -1,
    participantId: -1,
    paymentTypeId: -1
  })

// Settlement Bank Transaction Tracking

/**
 * Represents a bank transaction entity with core identification information.
 * Used in transaction tracking views and history displays.
 */
export interface BankTransaction {
  /** Database primary key identifier, null for new transactions */
  id: number | null
  /** Unique business sequence number assigned by NUBO system */
  nuboSequence: string
  /** ISO date-time string when the transaction was registered in the system */
  transactionDateTime: string
}

/**
 * Props for the SettlementBankTransactionTracking component.
 * Used to display transaction history and status changes.
 */
export interface SettlementBankTransactionTrackingProps {
  /** The bank transaction entity being tracked/displayed */
  bankTransaction: BankTransaction
  /** Callback to close the tracking modal and update parent component state */
  handleClose: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<{
      show: boolean
      bankTransaction: BankTransaction
    }>
  >
}

/**
 * Represents a single history record for a settlement bank transaction.
 * Each record tracks a status change or event in the transaction lifecycle.
 * Used to populate the transaction history table in tracking views.
 */
export interface SettlementBankTransactionTrackingHistory {
  /** Unique identifier for this history record */
  id: number
  /** Reference to the parent bank transaction ID */
  bankTransactionId: number
  /** ISO date-time string when this status/event occurred - displayed in date and time columns */
  dateTime: string
  /** Current transaction status information */
  status: {
    /** Status code identifier */
    id: number
    /** Human-readable status description (e.g., "REGISTRADA", "EN PROCESO") displayed in Estado column */
    description: string
    /** Classification category for grouping statuses */
    category: string
  }
  /** Transaction type information */
  transactionType: {
    /** Transaction type identifier */
    id: number
    /** Human-readable type description (e.g., "PAGO", "COBRO") displayed in Tipo de movimiento column */
    description: string
    /** Classification category */
    category: string
  }
  /** Additional explanation text about this status change displayed in Detalle column */
  details: string
  /** Reference identifier to associated file, if any, displayed in Archivo column */
  fileConsecutive: string
}
```

## src/pages/AssignmentValidationPage/AssignmentValidationPage.tsx

```tsx
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  Button,
  ContentWrapper,
  ModalAlert,
  NewTable,
  Spinner
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SelectDeclineComponent } from '../../components'
import { useAssignmentTable } from './Hooks'
import { useAssignmentModal } from './Hooks/useAssignmentModal'
import { ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS } from './assignmentValidationStrings'

export const AssignmentValidationPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const {
    modal,
    handleToogleModal,
    modalApprove,
    modalDecline,
    handleInputContent,
    tradeId,
    sideId,
    isLoading
  } = useAssignmentModal()
  const { columns, setDataRemote, rows } = useAssignmentTable()
  let titleSuffix = ''
  if (Number(sideId) === 1) {
    titleSuffix = ' compra '
  } else if (Number(sideId) === 2) {
    titleSuffix = ' venta '
  }
  const title =
    ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.CONTENT_WRAPPER_TILE.TITLE1 +
    titleSuffix +
    ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.CONTENT_WRAPPER_TILE.TITLE2

  if (isLoading) return <Spinner />

  return (
    <ContentWrapper
      title={title}
      className="mb-[62px] mt-14 flex flex-col"
      actionBack={() => navigate(ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.ROOT)}
    >
      <NewTable
        columns={columns}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
        rows={rows}
        endpoint={`/fractionation-pending/validate-assignments/trade/${tradeId}/side/${sideId}`}
        axiosInstanceKey="httpOperationsSpec"
        provisionalId="fraction"
      />
      <div className="mt-4 flex w-full justify-end space-x-2">
        <Button
          name="Rechazar Corrección"
          variant="secondary"
          onClick={() => modalDecline()}
        />
        <Button name="Aceptar Corrección" onClick={() => modalApprove()} />
      </div>
      {modal.toogle && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modal.title}
          variant={modal.variant}
          message={modal.message}
          textSuccess={modal.textSuccess}
          textCancel="Volver"
          onClick={modal.onClick}
          handleCancel={() => handleToogleModal(false)}
          orientation="horizontal"
        >
          {modal.content.select && (
            <SelectDeclineComponent modal={modal} update={handleInputContent} />
          )}
        </ModalAlert>
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}

```

## src/pages/AssignmentValidationPage/Hooks/useAssignmentModal.ts

```typescript
import { useContext, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useLocation, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { approveAssignments, rejectAssignments } from '../../../services'

interface AssignmentModal {
  toogle: boolean
  title: string
  message: string
  content: {
    select: boolean
    input: boolean
    value?: string
  }
  variant?: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning'
  onClick?: () => void
  textSuccess?: string
}

export const useAssignmentModal = () => {
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<AssignmentModal>({
    toogle: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    content: { select: false, input: false },
    variant: 'warning'
  })
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState<{ status: string } | null>(null)
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const { participantId, id, status, country } = infoUserNubo
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const handleToogleModal = (value?: boolean) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      toogle: value ?? !prevState.toogle
    }))
  }
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const location = useLocation()
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
  const tradeId = urlParams.get('tradeId')
  const sideId = urlParams.get('sideId')
  const handleInputContent = (value: boolean) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      content: { ...prevState.content, input: value }
    }))
  }

  const handleValueContent = (value: string) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      content: { ...prevState.content, value: value }
    }))
  }

  const approveRequest = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true)
      await approveAssignments(tradeId, sideId)
      GenerateLogs(client_user!, {
        actionType: ` Aprobación de correción ${tradeId}`,
        actionDestination: 'Validacion de asignación',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
      handleToogleModal(false)
      navigate(
        `/operation-spec-management/operation-detail/folios/folio-detail/beneficiaries?tradeId=${tradeId}&sideId=${sideId}`
      )
      context?.setAlertMui({
        status: 'approved'
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error approving request:', error)
      setModal({
        toogle: true,
        title: 'Ocurrió un error inesperado',
        message:
          'Vuelve a intentarlo, si el error persiste comunícate a xxxxxx@nuamx.com o 55555555',
        variant: 'error',
        textSuccess: 'Reintentar',
        content: { select: false, input: false },
        onClick: () =>
          setModal((prevState) => ({ ...prevState, toogle: false }))
      })
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const declineRequest = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true)
      await rejectAssignments(tradeId, sideId)
      GenerateLogs(client_user!, {
        actionType: ` Rechazo de correción ${tradeId}`,
        actionDestination: 'Validacion de asignación',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
      handleToogleModal(false)
      navigate(
        `/operation-spec-management/operation-detail/folios/folio-detail/beneficiaries?tradeId=${tradeId}&sideId=${sideId}`
      )
      context?.setAlertMui({
        status: 'rejected'
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error approving request:', error)
      setModal({
        toogle: true,
        title: 'Ocurrió un error inesperado',
        message:
          'Vuelve a intentarlo, si el error persiste comunícate a xxxxxx@nuamx.com o 55555555',
        variant: 'error',
        textSuccess: 'Reintentar',
        content: { select: false, input: false },
        onClick: () =>
          setModal((prevState) => ({ ...prevState, toogle: false }))
      })
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const modalApprove = () => {
    setModal({
      toogle: true,
      title: '¿Estas seguro de aprobar la solicitud?',
      message:
        'Las correcciones serán aprobadas y será posible descargar un nuevo comprobante.',
      textSuccess: 'Aprobar Corrección',
      content: {
        select: false,
        input: false
      },
      onClick: () => {
        approveRequest()
      }
    })
  }
  const modalDecline = () => {
    setModal({
      toogle: true,
      title: '¿Estas seguro de rechazar la solicitud?',
      message:
        'Las correcciones serán rechazadas y esta volverá al estado anterior de la solicitud de corrección.',
      textSuccess: 'Rechazar Corrección',
      content: { select: true, input: false },
      onClick: () => {
        declineRequest()
      }
    })
  }

  return {
    modal,
    handleToogleModal,
    modalApprove,
    modalDecline,
    handleInputContent,
    handleValueContent,
    tradeId,
    sideId,
    approveRequest,
    rejectAssignments,
    alert,
    setAlert,
    isLoading
  }
}

```
