```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { useState } from 'react'

import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator
} from '../../../helpers'
import { ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS } from '../assignmentValidationStrings'

export const useAssignmentTable = () => {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([])

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const columns: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      width: 50,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.LABEL
    },
    {
      width: 200,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.IDENTIFICATION_TYPE.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.IDENTIFICATION_TYPE.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { identificationType: string; identificationTypeUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{
            color: row?.identificationTypeUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit'
          }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.identificationType)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 150,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.DOCUMENT_NUMBER.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.DOCUMENT_NUMBER.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { documentNumber: string; documentNumberUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.documentNumberUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.documentNumber)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 200,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.NAME.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.NAME.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { investorName: string; investorNameUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.investorNameUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.investorName)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { investorAccount: string; investorAccountUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.investorAccountUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.investorAccount)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.FIDUCIARY_SPECIALIST.FIELD,
      headerName:
        ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.FIDUCIARY_SPECIALIST.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { fiduciarySpecialist: number } }) => (
        <div className="m-auto flex h-full items-center">
          <div
            className={`flex h-8 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-[4px_20px_4px_4px] border border-transparent px-3 text-sm font-bold ${row?.fiduciarySpecialist ? 'bg-[#9DF4D9]' : 'bg-[#CCCCCC]'}`}
          >
            {row?.fiduciarySpecialist ? 'Sí' : 'No'}{' '}
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.BANK_ACCOUNT.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.BANK_ACCOUNT.LABEL,

        row
      }: {
        row: { bankAccount: string; bankAccountUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.bankAccountUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.bankAccount)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,

      }: {

    {

      }) => (

      }) => (
        <span
          style={{
            color: row?.fractionQuantityUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit'
          }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.fractionQuantity)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.COMMISSION_AMOUNT.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.COMMISSION_AMOUNT.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { commissionAmount: number; commissionAmountUpdate: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.commissionAmountUpdate ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(
            formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.commissionAmount)
          )}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.TAX_AMOUNT.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.TAX_AMOUNT.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { valTaxAmount: number; valTaxAmountUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.valTaxAmountUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(
            formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.valTaxAmount)
          )}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.NET_AMOUNT.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.NET_AMOUNT.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { netAmount: number; netAmountUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span style={{ color: row?.netAmountUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}>
          {checkNullValue(formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.netAmount))}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_ID.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_ID.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { custodianId: string; custodianIdUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.custodianIdUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.custodianId)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_NAME.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_NAME.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { custodianName: string; custodianNameUpdated: boolean }
      }) => (
        <span
          style={{ color: row?.custodianNameUpdated ? '#ff411c' : 'inherit' }}
        >
          {checkNullValue(row?.custodianName)}
        </span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 100,
      field: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.BLOQUINGS_STATUS.FIELD,
      headerName: ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION_STRINGS.TABLE.BLOQUINGS_STATUS.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { bloquingStatus: string } }) =>
        checkNullValue(row?.bloquingStatus)
    }
  ]
  return { columns, rows, setDataRemote }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/AddFraction.tsx

```tsx
import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '@/helpers'
import {
  getCategoryTypes,
  validateCudAccount
} from '@/services/specialSettlement/addFraction'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { MuiSelect, InputBasic } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { getUserInfo } from '@/shared/utils/getInfoUser'

import { SettlementDataInfo } from '../../components'
import { getAccount, getAccountFolio } from '../../services'
import NumericInputField from '../../shared/components/NumericInputField'
import { StateModalAlert } from '../FolioDetailPage'
import { ErrorResponse } from '../FolioDetailPage/FolioDetailPage'

interface AddFractionProps {
  rowAcomulated: number
  tradeIdNumber: number | undefined
  setPushMessage: (arg: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast: (isVisible: boolean) => void
  setBtnSaveModal: (isVisible: boolean) => void
  setNewAddFraction: (newAddFraction: any) => void
  currentFraction?: number
  settlement: (SettlementDataInfo | undefined)[]
  isFolioDetail?: boolean
  bankAccountRequired?: boolean
  currentQuantity?: string
  currentSide?: number
  skipDuplicateValidation?: boolean // nuevo: permite saltar validación de duplicados (modo inline)
  folioDetail?: any
  setNewInlineFraction?: (newFraction: any) => void // nuevo para modo inline,
  country?: string | null | undefined
  changeModalAlert?: (state: StateModalAlert | null) => void
  setBtnSaveModalOriginal?: any
}

export const AddFraction = ({
  rowAcomulated,
  tradeIdNumber,
  setPushMessage,
  setViewToast,
  setBtnSaveModal,
  setNewAddFraction,
  currentFraction,
  settlement,
  isFolioDetail,
  // bankAccountRequired,
  currentQuantity,
  currentSide,
  skipDuplicateValidation = false,
  folioDetail,
  setNewInlineFraction,
  country,
  changeModalAlert,
  setBtnSaveModalOriginal
}: AddFractionProps) => {
  const [newFraction, setNewFraction] = useState({
    accountNumber: '',
    bankName: '',
    bankAccountNumber: '',
    commissionPercentage: 0,
    fractionPercentage: (100 - rowAcomulated).toString(),
    origen: '',
    origenDescription: '',
    finalBeneficiaryAccount: '', // agregado
    settlementAccountNumber: '', // nuevo
    settlementAccountValidated: false, // nuevo
    effectiveAccountData: undefined, // nuevo
    clearingEntity: '' // nuevo
  })
  const [newFractionFolio, setNewFractionFolio] = useState({
    accountNumber: '',
    bankName: '',
    bankAccountNumber: '',
    commissionPercentage: 0,
    fractionQuantity: String(currentQuantity).replace(/[.]/g, ''),
    reference: '',
    origen: '',
    origenDescription: '',
    finalBeneficiaryAccount: '', // agregado
    settlementAccountNumber: '', // nuevo
    settlementAccountValidated: false, // nuevo
    effectiveAccountData: undefined, // nuevo
    clearingEntity: '' // nuevo
  })
  const [account, setAccount] = useState<any>(null)
  const [_Bank, setBank] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [borderError, setBorderError] = useState(false)
  const [selectedLabel, setSelectedLabel] = useState<string>('')
  const [validateInfo, setValidateInfo] = useState(false)
  const [lastFetchedAccount, setLastFetchedAccount] = useState<string>('')
  const [origenOptions, setOrigenOptions] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [originSelected, setOriginSelected] = useState<string>('')
  const [fractionQuantityError, setFractionQuantityError] = useState(false)
  const [hasErrors, setHasErrors] = useState(false)

  const { userType } = useSelector(getUserInfo)
  // NEW: settlement account requirement flag
  const isColombiaCountry = country?.toUpperCase()?.includes('COLOMBIA')

  // Load origen options when component mounts
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadOrigenOptions = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getCategoryTypes('ORIGEN PUNTA')
        if (userType === 'EXTERNAL' && folioDetail?.trade?.originType) {
          const { id, description } = folioDetail.trade.originType
          data.push({ id, description, value: id })
        }
        const formattedOptions = data.map((item: any) => ({
          id: String(item.id),
          name: item.description,
          value: String(item.id)
        }))
        setOrigenOptions(formattedOptions)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading origen options:', error)
      }
    }

    loadOrigenOptions()
  }, [])
  const newAccount = newFractionFolio.accountNumber
  const validateAccount = useCallback(
    (account: string, executeModal?: boolean) => {
      const accountExistPreviousFractions = settlement.some(
        (fraction) => fraction?.accountNumber === account
      )
      if (accountExistPreviousFractions && executeModal) {
        changeModalAlert?.({
          title: 'Error de validación',
          message: 'La cuenta títulos ya existe en las fracciones agregadas.',
          open: true,
          variant: 'error',
          textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
          onClick: () => {
            setBtnSaveModal(false)
            changeModalAlert?.(null)
          }
        })
      }
      return accountExistPreviousFractions
    },
    [settlement, newAccount, changeModalAlert, setBtnSaveModal]
  )
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFolioDetail) {
      // Nueva regla:
      // 1. Debe existir cuenta títulos
      // 2. Debe existir cuenta efectivo
      // 3. Cantidad numérica y <= currentQuantity
      // 4. Debe haberse validado la cuenta (validateInfo) salvo que skipDuplicateValidation=true
      const maxQuantity = Number(
        String(currentQuantity || '0').replace(/[.]/g, '')
      )
      const hasAccountNumber = !!newFractionFolio.accountNumber
      // UPDATED: settlement account only required for COLOMBIA
      const hasSettlementAccount = isColombiaCountry
        ? !!newFractionFolio.settlementAccountNumber
        : true
      const quantityNumber = Number(newFractionFolio.fractionQuantity)
      const quantityValid = !!quantityNumber && quantityNumber <= maxQuantity
      const resultAccount = validateAccount(newFractionFolio.accountNumber)
      const canEnable =
        hasAccountNumber && hasSettlementAccount && quantityValid && !hasErrors

      if (canEnable && !resultAccount) {
        setBtnSaveModal(true)
        setNewAddFraction(newFractionFolio)
        pushCurrentFraction()
      } else {
        setBtnSaveModal(false)
      }
    } else {
      // Lógica original para porcentaje (sin cambios)
      const allFieldsFilled = Object.values(newFraction).every(
        (value) => value !== ''
      )
      if (
        allFieldsFilled &&
        Number(newFraction.fractionPercentage) + Number(rowAcomulated) <= 100
      ) {
        setBtnSaveModal(allFieldsFilled)
        setNewAddFraction(newFraction)
        pushCurrentFraction()
      } else {
        setBtnSaveModal(false)
      }
    }
  }, [
    newFraction,
    newFractionFolio,
    validateInfo,
    skipDuplicateValidation,
    currentQuantity,
    rowAcomulated,
    isColombiaCountry
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedLabel) {
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          bankAccount: selectedLabel
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          bankAccount: selectedLabel
        }))
      }
    }
  }, [selectedLabel])

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const { value, name } = e.target

    if (name === 'reference') {
      const sanitized = value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 20)
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          reference: sanitized
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev: any) => ({
          ...prev,
          reference: sanitized
        }))
      }
      pushCurrentFraction()
      return
    }

    if (name === 'accountNumber') {
      setSelectedLabel('')
      setBank([])
      setBorderError(false)
      setLastFetchedAccount('')

      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [name]: value,
          bankName: '',
          bankAccountNumber: '',
          bankAccountId: '',
          bankAccount: ''
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [name]: value,
          bankName: '',
          bankAccountNumber: '',
          bankAccountId: '',
          bankAccount: ''
        }))
      }
      validateAccount(value, true)
      return
    }

    if (name === 'settlementAccountNumber') {
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountNumber: value,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountNumber: value,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      }

      pushCurrentFraction()
      return
    }

    if (name === 'fractionQuantity' && isFolioDetail) {
      const numericValue = value.replace(/[^\d]/g, '') // Solo números
      const maxQuantity = Number(String(currentQuantity).replace(/[.]/g, ''))
      const enteredQuantity = Number(numericValue)

      if (enteredQuantity > maxQuantity) {
        setPushMessage({
          message: `La cantidad no puede ser mayor a ${formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
            maxQuantity
          )}`,
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
        return // No actualizar el estado
      }

      setNewFractionFolio({
        ...newFractionFolio,
        [name]: numericValue
      })
      pushCurrentFraction()
      return
    }

    if (name === 'commissionPercentage' || name === 'fractionPercentage') {
      const numericValue = parseFloat(value.replace('%', ''))
      if (numericValue <= 100 && isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio({
          ...newFractionFolio,
          [name]: Number(numericValue)
        })
      } else {
        setNewFraction({
          ...newFraction,
          [name]: Number(numericValue) // Eliminar el símbolo '%' antes de guardar el valor
        })
      }
    } else {
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio({
          ...newFractionFolio,
          [name]: value
        })
      } else {
        setNewFraction({
          ...newFraction,
          [name]: value
        })
      }
      pushCurrentFraction()
    }
  }

  const canFetch = (acct: string) =>
    acct.length > 0 && acct !== lastFetchedAccount

  const validateOriginVsAccount = (
    originIdStr: string | undefined,
    accountData: any,
    setPushMessage: (arg: { message: string; variant: string }) => void,
    setViewToast: (v: boolean) => void,
    setValidateInfo: (v: boolean) => void
  ) => {
    if (!originIdStr || !accountData?.originType) {
      setValidateInfo(false)
      return
    }

    const optionId = Number(originIdStr)
    const origin = accountData.originType

    const isPosicionPropiaOrigin =
      origin.id === OWNER_POSITION_ID ||
      origin.description?.toUpperCase() === 'POSICIÓN PROPIA'

    const isPosicionPropiaOption = optionId === OWNER_POSITION_ID

    const isInvalidOriginCombination =
      isPosicionPropiaOrigin !== isPosicionPropiaOption

    if (isInvalidOriginCombination) {
      const originString = isPosicionPropiaOption
        ? 'Posición Propia'
        : 'Terceros / Carteras Colectivas'

      setPushMessage({
        message: `Los datos de asignación no corresponden con el origen ${originString}.`,
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)
      setValidateInfo(false)
      return
    }

    if (isPosicionPropiaOption && accountData?.participant?.id != null) {
      const accountParticipantId =
        accountData?.participant?.id ??
        accountData?.investor?.id ??
        accountData?.participantAccount?.participant?.id ??
        accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.id ??
        null

      if (
        accountParticipantId &&
        accountParticipantId !== accountData?.participant?.id
      ) {
        setPushMessage({
          message:
            'La cuenta títulos seleccionada no corresponde con el participante de la operación para origen Posición Propia.',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
        setValidateInfo(false)
        return
      }
    }

    setValidateInfo(true)
  }

  const fetchAccountInfo = async (accountValue: string) => {
    if (!canFetch(accountValue)) return
    let accountExists = false
    if (!skipDuplicateValidation) {
      accountExists = settlement.some(
        (row: any) =>
          row?.accountNumber === accountValue ||
          row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber === accountValue ||
          row?.participantAccount?.accountNumber === accountValue
      )
    }
    if (accountExists) {
      setBorderError(true)
      setPushMessage({ message: 'Cuenta títulos ya existe', variant: 'error' })
      setViewToast(true)
      return
    }
    try {
      setBorderError(false)
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        const data = await getAccountFolio({
          tradeId: tradeIdNumber,
          numberAccount: newFractionFolio.accountNumber,
          sideId: Number(currentSide),
          originId: newFractionFolio?.origen
            ? Number(newFractionFolio.origen)
            : undefined
        })
        const participantData = data?.participantAccount
          ? data.participantAccount.participant
          : data?.investorAccount?.investor
        const nameFromPerson =
          [participantData?.firstName, participantData?.lastName]
            .filter(Boolean)
            .join(' ') || undefined

        const displayName =
          participantData?.shortName ??
          nameFromPerson ??
          participantData?.companyName
        const finalBeneficiaryAccount = [
          participantData?.identificationType?.code,
          participantData?.documentNumber,
          displayName
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
        const accountFromApi = data?.participantAccount ?? data?.investorAccount
        setAccount(accountFromApi)
        if (data.participantAccount === null) {
          setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            investorAccountId: data?.investorAccount?.investor?.id,
            directDepositorId: data?.investorAccount?.depository?.id,
            fiduciarySpecialist: data?.fiduciarySpecialist,
            sourceQuoteTypeId: data?.sourceQuoteType?.id,
            specialTradeId: tradeIdNumber,
            allData: data,
            sideId: currentSide,
            valtax: 19,
            fraction:
              (currentFraction ?? -1) >= 0 ? (currentFraction ?? 0) + 1 : 1,
            finalBeneficiaryAccount // set
          }))
          setBank(data.investorBankAccounts)
        } else {
          setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            participantAccountId: data?.participantAccount?.participant?.id,
            directDepositorId: data?.participantAccount?.depository?.id,
            fiduciarySpecialist: data?.fiduciarySpecialist,
            sourceQuoteTypeId: data?.sourceQuoteType?.id,
            specialTradeId: tradeIdNumber,
            allData: data,
            sideId: currentSide,
            valtax: 19,
            fraction:
              (currentFraction ?? -1) >= 0 ? (currentFraction ?? 0) + 1 : 1,
            finalBeneficiaryAccount // set
          }))
          setBank(data.participantBankAccounts)
        }
        const currentOriginId = newFractionFolio.origen
        validateOriginVsAccount(
          currentOriginId,
          accountFromApi,
          setPushMessage,
          setViewToast,
          setValidateInfo
        )
        pushCurrentFraction()
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          bankAccountNumber: '',
          bankAccountId: '',
          bankAccount: '',
          bankName: ''
        }))
        setBank([])
        const data = await getAccount({
          specialTradeId: tradeIdNumber,
          numberAccount: accountValue
        })
        const accountFromApi = data?.investorAccount
        setAccount(accountFromApi)
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          investorAccountId: data.investorAccount.id,
          identificationType: data.investorAccount.investor.identificationType,
          documentNumber: data.investorAccount.investor?.documentNumber,
          firstName: data.investorAccount.investor.firstName,
          lastName: data.investorAccount.investor.lastName,
          side: '1',
          fraction:
            (currentFraction ?? -1) >= 0 ? (currentFraction ?? 0) + 1 : null,
          specialTradeId: tradeIdNumber
        }))
        setBank(data.investorBankAccounts)
        const currentOriginId = newFraction.origen
        validateOriginVsAccount(
          currentOriginId,
          accountFromApi,
          setPushMessage,
          setViewToast,
          setValidateInfo
        )
        pushCurrentFraction()
      }
      setLastFetchedAccount(accountValue)
      setHasErrors?.(false)
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse
      setBorderError(true)
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          allData: null,
          finalBeneficiaryAccount: ''
        }))
      }
      setValidateInfo(false)
      if (err?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND') {
        setPushMessage({
          message: 'Cuenta títulos no existe en el depósito',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
      } else if (
        err?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND'
      ) {
        setPushMessage({
          message:
            'No se encuentra la cuenta títulos con el origen de la operación',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
        setBtnSaveModal?.(true)
        setBtnSaveModalOriginal?.(true)
        setHasErrors?.(true)
      } else {
        setPushMessage({
          message: 'Error consultando la cuenta',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
      }
    }
  }

  const handleKeyPress = async (
    event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'Tab') {
      const accountValue = isFolioDetail
        ? newFractionFolio.accountNumber
        : newFraction.accountNumber
      if (accountValue) await fetchAccountInfo(accountValue)
    }
  }

  const handleBlur = async () => {
    const accountValue = isFolioDetail
      ? newFractionFolio.accountNumber
      : newFraction.accountNumber
    if (accountValue) await fetchAccountInfo(accountValue)
  }

  const handleCommissionKeyDown = (
    e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    // Evita ingresar comas que puedan romper el parseo posterior
    if (e.key === ',') {
      e.preventDefault()
    }
  }

  // Preload and lock origen when userType === 'EXTERNAL'
  useEffect(() => {
    if (userType === 'EXTERNAL' && folioDetail?.trade?.originType) {
      const { id, description } = folioDetail.trade.originType
      const idStr = String(id)
      setOrigenOptions((prev) => {
        const exists = prev.some((o) => o.id === idStr)
        return exists
          ? prev
          : [...prev, { id: idStr, name: description, value: idStr }]
      })
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          origen: idStr,
          origenDescription: description
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          origen: idStr,
          origenDescription: description
        }))
      }
      setOriginSelected(idStr)
    }
  }, [userType, folioDetail, isFolioDetail])

  const validateSettlementAccount = async () => {
    const rawValue = isFolioDetail
      ? newFractionFolio.settlementAccountNumber
      : newFraction.settlementAccountNumber

    if (!rawValue) {
      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      }
      pushCurrentFraction()
      return
    }

    try {
      const resp = await validateCudAccount({
        tradeId: tradeIdNumber,
        sideId: Number(currentSide),
        accountNumber: rawValue,
        pageNumber: 0,
        pageSize: 1
      })

      const list = Array.isArray(resp?.content) ? resp.content : []
      const match =
        list.find((item: any) => item.bank_account === rawValue) ?? list[0]

      if (!match) {
        setPushMessage({
          message: 'Cuenta efectivo no existe o no es válida',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)

        if (isFolioDetail) {
          setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            settlementAccountValidated: false,
            effectiveAccountData: undefined,
            clearingEntity: ''
          }))
        } else {
          setNewFraction((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            settlementAccountValidated: false,
            effectiveAccountData: undefined,
            clearingEntity: ''
          }))
        }
        pushCurrentFraction()
        return
      }

      const participantDoc = match.participant?.documentNumber || ''

      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountNumber: match.bank_account,
          settlementAccountValidated: true,
          effectiveAccountData: match,
          clearingEntity: participantDoc
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountNumber: match.bank_account,
          settlementAccountValidated: true,
          effectiveAccountData: match,
          clearingEntity: participantDoc
        }))
      }
      pushCurrentFraction()
    } catch {
      setPushMessage({
        message: 'Error consultando la cuenta efectivo',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)

      if (isFolioDetail) {
        setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      } else {
        setNewFraction((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          settlementAccountValidated: false,
          effectiveAccountData: undefined,
          clearingEntity: ''
        }))
      }
      pushCurrentFraction()
    }
  }

  const OWNER_POSITION_ID = 121

  const onOrigenChange = (option: string) => {
    if (userType === 'EXTERNAL') return
    const selectedOrigen = origenOptions.find((item) => item.id === option)
    if (isFolioDetail) {
      setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        origen: option,
        origenDescription: selectedOrigen?.name
      }))
    } else {
      setNewFraction((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        origen: option,
        origenDescription: selectedOrigen?.name
      }))
    }
    validateOriginVsAccount(
      option,
      account,
      setPushMessage,
      setViewToast,
      setValidateInfo
    )

    setOriginSelected(option)
    pushCurrentFraction() // NUEVO: forzar push al cambiar origen
  }

  // Empuja el estado actual de la fracción hacia el padre inmediatamente
  const pushCurrentFraction = () => {
    if (isFolioDetail) {
      if (setNewInlineFraction) {
        setNewInlineFraction(newFractionFolio)
      }
    } else {
      if (setNewInlineFraction) {
        setNewInlineFraction(newFraction)
      }
    }
  }

  const handleSettlementAccountKeyDown = (
    e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Tab') {
      validateSettlementAccount()
    }
  }

  const handleSettlementAccountBlur = () => {
    validateSettlementAccount()
  }

  // Handler NUMERIC para fractionQuantity (usado por NumericInputField)
  const handleFractionQuantityNumericChange = (val: number | null) => {
    const maxQuantity = Number(
      String(currentQuantity || '0').replace(/[.]/g, '')
    )
    if (val !== null && maxQuantity && val > maxQuantity) {
      setPushMessage({
        message: `La cantidad no puede ser mayor a ${formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
          maxQuantity
        )}`,
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)
      setFractionQuantityError(true)
      setBtnSaveModal(false)
      return
    }
    setBtnSaveModal(true)

    setFractionQuantityError(false)
    setNewFractionFolio((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      fractionQuantity: val === null ? '' : String(val)
    }))
    pushCurrentFraction()
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isFolioDetail) {
      if (setNewInlineFraction) {
        setNewInlineFraction(newFractionFolio)
      }
    } else {
      if (setNewInlineFraction) {
        setNewInlineFraction(newFraction)
      }
    }
  }, [newFraction, newFractionFolio])
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full grid-cols-2 gap-[32px]">
      {/* <InputBasic
                field="accountNumber"
                id="Cuenta"
                label="Cuenta"
                value={!isFolioDetail ? newFraction?.accountNumber : newFractionFolio?.accountNumber}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="h-[40px]"
                onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
                error={borderError}
                required={true}
                type='number'
                onBlur={handleBlur}
            />
            <div className="flex justify-end items-end w-full">
                <MuiSelect
                    placeholder="Selecciona Banco Liquidador"
                    options={options}
                    onChange={onChange}
                    className="w-[260px]"
                    disabled={Bank?.length === 0}
                    setSelectedLabel={setSelectedLabel}
                />
            </div>
            <InputBasic
                field="settlementAccount"
                id="Banco Liquidador"
                label="Banco Liquidador"
                value={!isFolioDetail ? newFraction.bankAccountNumber : newFractionFolio.bankAccountNumber}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="h-[40px]"
                disabled={true}
            />
            <InputBasic
                field="commissionPercentage"
                id="Porcentaje de comisión"
                label="Porcentaje de comisión"
                value={`${Number(!isFolioDetail ? newFraction.commissionPercentage : newFractionFolio.commissionPercentage)}%`} // Mostrar el símbolo '%' en la visualización
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="h-[40px]"
                required={true}
            /> */}

      {/* NEW SECCTION */}
      {isFolioDetail ? (
        <InputBasic
          field={'reference'}
          id="Reference"
          label="Referencia"
          value={`${newFractionFolio.reference}`}
          onChange={handleChange}
          className="h-[40px]"
          // validation handled in handleChange
        />
      ) : null}

      <div className="flex w-full items-end justify-end">
        <MuiSelect
          placeholder="Origen"
          options={origenOptions}
          onChange={onOrigenChange}
          className="w-[260px]"
          disabled={userType === 'EXTERNAL' || origenOptions?.length === 0}
          value={originSelected}
        />
      </div>
      <InputBasic
        field="accountNumber"
        id="accountNumber"
        label="Cuenta títulos"
        value={
          !isFolioDetail
            ? newFraction?.accountNumber
            : newFractionFolio?.accountNumber
        }
        onChange={handleChange}
        className="h-[40px]"
        onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
        error={borderError}
        required={true}
        type="number"
        onBlur={handleBlur}
      />
      <InputBasic
        field="finalBeneficiaryAccount"
        id="Beneficiario final"
        label="Beneficiario final"
        value={
          isFolioDetail
            ? newFractionFolio.finalBeneficiaryAccount
            : newFraction.finalBeneficiaryAccount
        }
        onChange={handleChange}
        className="h-[40px]"
        disabled={true}
      />
      {isColombiaCountry && (
        <>
          <InputBasic
            field="settlementAccountNumber"
            id="Cuenta efectivo"
            label="Cuenta efectivo"
            value={
              isFolioDetail
                ? newFractionFolio.settlementAccountNumber
                : newFraction.settlementAccountNumber
            }
            onChange={handleChange}
            className="h-[40px]"
            required={isColombiaCountry}
            error={
              isColombiaCountry
                ? isFolioDetail
                  ? !newFractionFolio.settlementAccountValidated &&
                    !!newFractionFolio.settlementAccountNumber
                  : !newFraction.settlementAccountValidated &&
                    !!newFraction.settlementAccountNumber
                : false
            }
            onKeyDown={handleSettlementAccountKeyDown}
            onBlur={handleSettlementAccountBlur}
          />
          <InputBasic
            field="clearingEntity"
            id="Entidad compensadora"
            label="Entidad compensadora"
            value={
              !isFolioDetail
                ? newFraction.clearingEntity
                : newFractionFolio.clearingEntity
            }
            onChange={handleChange}
            className="h-[40px]"
            disabled={true}
          />
        </>
      )}
      {isFolioDetail ? (
        <>
          <NumericInputField
            id={currentFraction ?? 0}
            field="fractionQuantity"
            label="Cantidad"
            value={
              newFractionFolio?.fractionQuantity === ''
                ? null
                : Number(newFractionFolio.fractionQuantity)
            }
            onChange={handleFractionQuantityNumericChange}
            onCommit={(_id, _field, value) => {
              // reutiliza mismo handler en commit (Enter/Tab/blur)
              handleFractionQuantityNumericChange(value)
            }}
            error={fractionQuantityError}
            placeholder="Digite la cantidad"
          />
          {/* <InputBasic
                            field={"reference"}
                            id="Reference"
                            label="Reference"
                            value={`${newFractionFolio.reference}`}
                            onChange={handleChange}
                            className="h-[40px]"
                        /> */}
        </>
      ) : (
        <InputBasic
          field={'fractionPercentage'}
          id="Porcentaje de fracción"
          label="Porcentaje de fracción"
          value={`${Number(newFraction.fractionPercentage)}%`}
          onChange={handleChange}
          className="h-[40px]"
          onKeyDown={handleCommissionKeyDown}
        />
      )}
      <InputBasic
        field="commissionPercentage"
        id="Porcentaje de comisión"
        label="Porcentaje de comisión"
        value={`${Number(
          !isFolioDetail
            ? newFraction.commissionPercentage
            : newFractionFolio.commissionPercentage
        )}%`} // Mostrar el símbolo '%' en la visualización
        onChange={handleChange}
        className="h-[40px]"
        required={true}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/BeneficiariesPage.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  AlertMui,
  ContentWrapper,
  ModalAlert,
  ModalContent,
  NewTable
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { CheckComponent } from '../../components'
import { ButtonStatus } from '../../models'
import { useFolioDetail, useFolioDetailFetch } from '../FolioDetailPage'
import {
  useBeneficiariesTableEdit,
  useBeneficiariesFetch,
  useBeneficiariesModal,
  useBeneficiariesStates,
  useBeneficiariesTable,
  useValidateModal
} from './hooks'
import { useBeneficiaries } from './hooks/useBeneficiaries'
import { useBeneficiariesEdit } from './hooks/useBeneficiariesEdit'

export const BeneficiariesPage = () => {
  const [modalConfirm, setModalConfirm] = useState(false)
  const [modalIntro, setModalIntro] = useState({ show: true, accept: true })
  const [modalTransferCustodian, setModalTransferCustodian] = useState(false)
  const [selectedCustodian, setSelectedCustodian] = useState<string>('')
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<any>([])
  const [folioBeneficiaries, setFolioBeneficiaries] = useState<any[]>([])

  const location = useLocation()
  const {
    newAddFraction,
    directDepositor,
    amount,
    commissionAmount,
    netAmount,
    transferValue,
    valTax,
    valTaxAmount
  } = location.state ?? {}

  let paramsNewSettlement

  if (newAddFraction) {
    paramsNewSettlement = {
      id: 1,
      tradeIdNumber: newAddFraction.tradeIdNumber,
      side: { id: newAddFraction.sideId },
      investorAccountId: newAddFraction.investorAccountId,
      participantAccountId: newAddFraction.participantAccountId,
      bankAccountId: newAddFraction.bankAccountId,
      fiduciarySpecialist: newAddFraction.fiduciarySpecialist,
      sourceQuoteTypeId: newAddFraction.sourceQuoteTypeId,
      sourceQuoteType: newAddFraction?.allData?.sourceQuoteType,
      reference: newAddFraction.reference,
      fractionQuantity: newAddFraction.fractionQuantity,
      commissionPercentage: (
        newAddFraction?.commissionPercentage ?? 0
      ).toString(),
      accountNumber: newAddFraction.accountNumber,
      valTax,
      fraction: newAddFraction.fraction,
      countryId: newAddFraction.allData?.investorAccount?.investor?.country?.id,
      investor: newAddFraction.allData?.investorAccount?.investor,
      investorAccount: newAddFraction.allData?.investorAccount,
      participantAccount: newAddFraction.allData?.participantAccount,
      bankAccount: {
        bankAccount: newAddFraction?.bankAccountNumber,
        id: newAddFraction.bankAccountId,
        bank: { bankName: newAddFraction?.bankAccount }
      },
      directDepositor,
      amount,
      commissionAmount,
      netAmount,
      transferValue,
      valTaxAmount
    }
  }

  const { context, client_user, participantId, navigate } = useBeneficiaries()

  const { folioDetail, directDepositorData } = useFolioDetailFetch({
    client_user
  })

  const { assignmentEdit, sideIdNumber, formError, setErrorForm } =
    useBeneficiariesStates()

  const {
    headerActionsLeft,
    // headerActionsRight,
    btnAceptText,
    description,
    textModalConfirm,
    columnsModules
  } = useFolioDetail({
    participantId,
    setSelectedCustodian,
    setModalTransferCustodian,
    selectedCustodian,
    thereAreSelected
  })

  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, _dataTable: []) => {}

  const handleAcceptTransferCustodian = () => {
    setModalTransferCustodian(false)
    setModalConfirm(true)
  }

  const {
    typePayment,
    quantityAvailable,
    editSettlement,
    // editSettlementSelect,
    fractionIds,
    setSettlementValue,
    // setSettlementBank,
    addSettlementRecord,
    getSettlementNextFraction,
    removeSelectedFractions
  } = useBeneficiariesEdit(
    folioDetail,
    sideIdNumber,
    setFolioBeneficiaries,
    client_user,
    folioDetail?.trade.country.id ?? 0,
    folioDetail?.trade.localCurrencyPrice ?? 0,
    thereAreSelected,
    setErrorForm,
    paramsNewSettlement,
    newAddFraction
  )

  const { modal, handleToogleModal, showModalNewSettlement } =
    useBeneficiariesModal(
      typePayment,
      quantityAvailable,
      directDepositorData,
      folioDetail?.trade.id ?? 0,
      sideIdNumber,
      getSettlementNextFraction,
      editSettlement,
      addSettlementRecord,
      formError,
      setErrorForm
    )

  const tradeId = folioDetail?.trade?.id ?? 0
  const { updateFractionsBeneficiaries } = useBeneficiariesFetch(
    // navigate,
    tradeId,
    client_user,
    editSettlement,
    sideIdNumber,
    folioDetail,
    setFolioBeneficiaries,
    newAddFraction,
    () => {}
  )

  const sendNewSettlementTotable = () => {
    handleToogleModal()
  }

  const { editAssignmentEditColumns, headerActionsLeftAssignmentEdit } =
    useBeneficiariesTableEdit(
      quantityAvailable,
      formError,
      editSettlement,
      setSettlementValue,
      // setSettlementBank,
      // editSettlementSelect,
      removeSelectedFractions,
      showModalNewSettlement,
      thereAreSelected,
      tradeId,
      sideIdNumber,
      setSettlementValue
    )

  const { assignmentColumns } = useBeneficiariesTable(
    removeSelectedFractions,
    showModalNewSettlement,
    thereAreSelected
  )

  const { showModalUpdateFractions } = useValidateModal(
    updateFractionsBeneficiaries,
    assignmentColumns,
    editSettlement,
    fractionIds
  )

  let alertMessage = ''
  if (context?.globalStatus.alert.status === 'rejected') {
    alertMessage = 'Modificación rechazada.'
  } else if (context?.globalStatus.alert.status === 'approved') {
    alertMessage = 'Modificación aprobada.'
  }

  const buttonStatus: ButtonStatus = {
    viewEditSettlemnt: false,
    addSettlemnt: false,
    saveNewSettlement: false,
    sendEditFractions: false
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper
      title={`Beneficiarios de ${sideIdNumber === 1 ? 'Compra' : 'Venta'}`}
      className="mb-[62px] mt-14 flex flex-col"
      actionBack={() => navigate(-1)}
    >
      <NewTable
        customToolbar={
          assignmentEdit
            ? headerActionsLeftAssignmentEdit()
            : headerActionsLeft()
        }
        provisionalId="fraction"
        columns={assignmentEdit ? editAssignmentEditColumns : assignmentColumns}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
        rows={assignmentEdit ? editSettlement : folioBeneficiaries}
        setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
        rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
      />
      {assignmentEdit && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex w-full justify-end space-x-2">
          <Button
            variant="text"
            className="text-[#181818]"
            onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
          >
            Cancelar
          </Button>
          <DefaultComponents.Tooltip
            title="La cantidad total de acciones en las fracciones, no corresponde con la cantidad total de acciones de la operación"
            placement="top"
          >
            <Button
              disabled={
                (newAddFraction === undefined && fractionIds.length === 0) ||
                quantityAvailable > 0
              }
              className={`text-[#FFFFFF] ${(newAddFraction === undefined && fractionIds.length === 0) || quantityAvailable > 0 ? 'bg-gray-500' : 'bg-[#FF4201]'}`}
              onClick={
                newAddFraction === undefined
                  ? showModalUpdateFractions
                  : updateFractionsBeneficiaries
              }
            >
              Guardar
            </Button>
          </DefaultComponents.Tooltip>
        </div>
      )}

      {modalIntro.show && newAddFraction === undefined && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Deseas hacer una corrección?"
          message="Las correcciones generarán un cobro de $XXXX más iva y generarán un nuevo comprobante."
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="aceptar y corregir"
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={() => setModalIntro({ show: false, accept: true })}
          disabled={modalIntro.accept}
          handleCancel={() => {
            setModalIntro({ show: false, accept: true })
            navigate(-1)
          }}
        >
          <CheckComponent check={setModalIntro} />
        </ModalAlert>
      )}

      {modal.toogle && (
        <ModalContent
          title={modal.title}
          description={modal.message}
          handleAccept={() =>
            modal.content.select
              ? sendNewSettlementTotable()
              : updateFractionsBeneficiaries()
          }
          handleClose={() => handleToogleModal()}
          className={modal.content.value}
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText={modal.content.select ? 'Guardar' : 'Guardar corrección'}
          btnDisabled={
            modal.content.select ? buttonStatus.saveNewSettlement : false
          }
          iconClose={false}
        >
          {modal.content.input && (
            <NewTable
              provisionalId="fraction"
              columns={assignmentColumns}
              rows={editSettlement?.filter((settlement) =>
                fractionIds.includes(settlement.fraction)
              )}
              setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
              rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
            />
          )}
        </ModalContent>
      )}

      {modalConfirm && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={textModalConfirm}
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess={btnAceptText}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={() => {}}
          handleCancel={() => setModalConfirm(false)}
        ></ModalAlert>
      )}
      {modalTransferCustodian && (
        <ModalContent
          title={selectedCustodian}
          description={description}
          handleClose={setModalTransferCustodian}
          handleAccept={handleAcceptTransferCustodian}
          className="w-full max-w-[1140px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText={btnAceptText}
        >
          <NewTable
            customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
            columns={columnsModules}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
            rows={folioBeneficiaries}
            setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}

      {!modal.toogle &&
        !modalIntro.show &&
        !context?.globalStatus.toast.show && (
          <AlertMui
            message={alertMessage}
            severity="success"
            onClose={() => {
              if (context?.globalStatus.alert) {
                context.globalStatus.alert.status = ''
              }
            }}
            open={context?.globalStatus.alert && alertMessage !== ''}
          />
        )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/BeneficiariesPageGeneral.tsx

```tsx
import { Button } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import axios from 'axios'
import { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  ContentWrapper,
  GenerateLogs,
  ModalAlert,
  ModalContent,
  NewTable,
  Spinner,
  Toast
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SettlementDataInfo } from '../../components'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage, getParamUrl } from '../../helpers'
import {
  createFractionSpecialSettlement,
  getSettlementData,
  reportFolioDetailTxtOnly,
  updateAssignments
} from '../../services'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS, useFolioDetail } from '../FolioDetailPage'
import { AddFraction } from './AddFraction'
import { useBeneficiaries } from './hooks/useBeneficiaries'

export const BeneficiariesPageGeneral = () => {
  const [selectedCustodian, setSelectedCustodian] = useState<string>('')
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<any>([])
  const [settlement, setSettlement] = useState<
    (SettlementDataInfo | undefined)[]
  >([])
  const [modalAddFraction, setModalAddFraction] = useState(false)
  const origin = getParamUrl('origin')
  const tradeIdNumber = Number(getParamUrl('tradeId'))
  const sideIdNumber = Number(getParamUrl('sideId'))
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(
    FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME
  )
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const { participantId, userType, id, status, country } = infoUserNubo
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false)
  const [checkedAll, setCheckedAll] = useState(false)
  const [SettlementList, setSettlementList] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [rowAcomulated, setRowAcomulated] = useState(0)
  const [modalDeleteFraction, setModalDeleteFraction] = useState(false)
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [pushMessage, setPushMessage] = useState({ message: '', variant: '' })
  const [btnDissabled, setBtnDissabled] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
  const [btnSaveModal, setBtnSaveModal] = useState(false)
  const [newAddFraction, setNewAddFraction] = useState()
  const [numberRows, setNumberRows] = useState(0)
  const [modalSaveFraction, setModalSaveFraction] = useState(false)
  const [updateTable, setUpdateTable] = useState(false)
  const [currenFraction, setCurrenFraction] = useState<number>(0)
  const [addingRow, setAddingRow] = useState(false)
  const [infoModalFraction, setInfoModalFraction] = useState<any>({
    title: '',
    message: '',
    variant: '',
    textSuccess: ''
  })
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rowAcomulated > 100) {
      setPushMessage({
        message:
          'El porcentaje total de las fracciones no puede ser mayor a 100%',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)
      setBtnDissabled(true)
    }
    if (rowAcomulated < 100 && rowAcomulated > 0) {
      setPushMessage({
        message:
          'El porcentaje total de las fracciones no puede ser menor a 100%',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)
      setBtnDissabled(true)
    }
    if (rowAcomulated === 100) {
      setBtnDissabled(false)
    }
  }, [rowAcomulated])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (settlement.length === 0) {
      setLoading(true)
    }
    if (settlement.length > 0) {
      setLoading(false)
      const lastFraction = settlement[settlement.length - 1]
      setCurrenFraction(lastFraction?.fraction ?? 0)
    }
  }, [settlement])

  const { navigate } = useBeneficiaries()

  const { headerActionsLeft, columnsModules, deleteFraction } = useFolioDetail({
    participantId,
    setSelectedCustodian,
    selectedCustodian,
    thereAreSelected,
    setThereAreSelected,
    origin,
    setModalAddFraction,
    editMode,
    checkedAll,
    SettlementList,
    setSettlement,
    settlement,
    rowAcomulated,
    setModalDeleteFraction,
    setPushMessage,
    setViewToast,
    setInfoModalFraction,
    updateTable
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchData = async () => {
      setLoading(true)
      try {
        if (origin === 'detail_spc_opc') {
          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
          const data: { content: any[] } = await getSettlementData({
            tradeIdNumber,
            sideIdNumber
          })
          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
          const dataInfo = data.content.map((item: any) => ({
            specialTradeId: item?.specialTradeId,
            side: item?.side,
            fraction: item?.fraction,
            identificationType: item?.investor?.identificationType,
            documentNumber: item?.investor?.documentNumber,
            firstName: item?.investor?.firstName,
            lastName: item?.investor?.lastName,
            accountNumber: item?.investorAccount?.accountNumber,
            bankAccount: item?.bankAccount,
            commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage,
            fractionPercentage: item.fractionPercentage,
            investorAccountId: item?.investorAccount.id,
            bankAccountId: item?.bankAccount.id,
            bankAccountNumber: item?.bankAccount.accountNumber,
            bank: []
          }))
          setSettlement(dataInfo)
          setNumberRows(dataInfo.length)
        } else if (origin === 'detail_folio' && participantId) {
          const sideIdSend = [sideIdNumber]
          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
          const data: any[] = await reportFolioDetailTxtOnly(
            client_user,
            tradeIdNumber.toString(),
            sideIdSend
          )
          setSettlement(data)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching data:', error)
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    fetchData()
  }, [origin, participantId, updateTable])

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setSettlementList(dataTable)
  }

  const handleAddRow = async () => {
    const mergeSettlement = [...settlement, newAddFraction]
    setEditMode(true)
    setAddingRow(true)
    setSettlement(mergeSettlement)
    setModalAddFraction(false)
  }

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    if (addingRow) {
      /* eslint-disable-next-line */
      const filterSettlement = settlement.map((item: any) => {
        return {
          investorAccountId: item.investorAccountId,
          bankAccountId: item.bankAccountId,
          fractionPercentage: item.fractionPercentage,
          commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage
        }
      })

      try {
        await createFractionSpecialSettlement({
          tradeIdNumber,
          temporalDataSettlement: filterSettlement
        })
        if (client_user) {
          await GenerateLogs(client_user, {
            actionType: `Se agregaron fracciones del especial trade ${tradeIdNumber}`,
            actionDestination: 'Operaciones Especiales visualización general',
            participantId,
            countryId: country.id,
            userNuboId: id,
            statusId: status.id
          })
        }
        setUpdateTable(true)
      } catch (error) {
        let message = 'Error desconocido'
        if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
          message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
          if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
            message = 'Error en el servidor.'
          if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '400')
            message = 'Error en la petición.'
          if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '404')
            message = 'No se encontraron datos'
        }
        context?.setModalAlert({
          title: 'Ocurrió un error al agregar la fracción',
          variant: 'error',
          message: message,
          textSuccess: 'aceptar',
          onClick: () => {
            context?.clearModalAlert()
          }
        })
      }
      handleClose(false)
      setAddingRow(false)
      setModalSaveFraction(false)
      setEditMode(false)
      setUpdateTable(true)
      return
    }

    try {
      if (settlement.length < numberRows) {
        const filterSettlement = settlement.map((item: any) => {
          return {
            investorAccountId: item.investorAccountId,
            bankAccountId: item.bankAccountId,
            fractionPercentage: item.fractionPercentage,
            commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage
          }
        })
        await createFractionSpecialSettlement({
          tradeIdNumber,
          temporalDataSettlement: filterSettlement
        })
      } else {
        const filterSettlement = settlement.map((item: any) => {
          return {
            fraction: item.fraction,
            investorAccountId: item.investorAccountId,
            bankAccountId: item.bankAccountId,
            fractionPercentage: item.fractionPercentage,
            commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage
          }
        })
        await updateAssignments({
          tradeIdNumber,
          newSettlements: filterSettlement
        })

        if (client_user) {
          await GenerateLogs(client_user, {
            actionType: `Se modificaron las fracciones del especial trade ${tradeIdNumber}`,
            actionDestination: 'Operaciones Especiales visualización general',
            participantId,
            countryId: country.id,
            userNuboId: id,
            statusId: status.id
          })
        }
      }
      handleClose(false)
      setModalSaveFraction(false)
      setEditMode(false)
      setAddingRow(false)
      setUpdateTable(true)
      setViewToast(true)
      setPushMessage({
        message: 'Fracciones guardadas correctamente',
        variant: 'success'
      })
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '400')
          message = 'Error en la petición.'
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '404')
          message = 'No se encontraron datos'
      }
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error al editar la fracción',
        variant: 'error',
        message: message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    }
    handleClose(false)
    setAddingRow(false)
    setModalSaveFraction(false)
    setEditMode(false)
  }

  const handleClose = (value: boolean) => {
    setEditMode(value)
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper
      title="Beneficiarios"
      className="mb-[62px] mt-14 flex flex-col"
      actionBack={() => navigate(-1)}
    >
      {loading || settlement.length === 0 ? (
        <Spinner />
      ) : (
        <NewTable
          columns={columnsModules}
          provisionalId="fraction"
          customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
          setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
          rows={SettlementList.length > 0 ? SettlementList : settlement}
          setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
          rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
          isIdSpecialTrade={origin === 'detail_spc_opc'}
          isSettlement={origin === 'detail_folio'}
          setCheckedAll={setCheckedAll}
          disableRowSelectionOnClick={true}
          setRowAcomulated={setRowAcomulated}
          rowFieldAcomulated="fractionPercentage"
        />
      )}

      <div className="mt-4 flex w-full justify-end gap-4">
        {!editMode && (
          <Button
            size="large"
            variant="contained"
            onClick={() => setEditMode(true)}
            className={`w-[240px] ${userType === 'EXTERNAL' || (userType === 'INTERNAL' && thereAreSelected.length === 0) ? 'cursor-not-allowed bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]' : 'bg-[#FF4201]'} font-Roboto text-[15px] font-medium uppercase`}
            disabled={
              userType === 'EXTERNAL' ||
              (userType === 'INTERNAL' && thereAreSelected.length === 0)
            }
          >
            Editar
          </Button>
        )}
        {(editMode || addingRow) && (
          <>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="large"
              variant="outlined"
              onClick={() => {
                handleClose(false)
                setAddingRow(false)
                setUpdateTable(true)
              }}
              style={{
                color: '#FF4201',
                width: '240px',
                borderColor: 'rgba(255, 66, 1, 0.5)'
              }}
            >
              Cancelar
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="large"
              onClick={() => {
                setInfoModalFraction({
                  title: '¿Desea guardar estas modificaciones?',
                  message:
                    'Los campos que has modificado se actualizarán.Si deseas continuar, haz clic en Guardar cambios. Si no, puedes revisar las modificaciones antes de confirmar.',
                  variant: 'warning',
                  textSuccess: 'guardar cambios'
                })
                setModalSaveFraction(true)
              }}
              className={`w-[240px] ${btnDissabled ? 'bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]' : 'bg-[#FF4201]'} text-[15px] font-medium`}
              disabled={btnDissabled}
            >
              Guardar
            </Button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      {modalAddFraction && (
        <ModalContent
          title="Agregar Fracción"
          description="Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla"
          handleAccept={handleAddRow}
          handleClose={() => setModalAddFraction(false)}
          className="w-full max-w-[600px] gap-y-[32px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText="Agregar"
          iconClose={false}
          btnDisabled={!btnSaveModal}
        >
          <AddFraction
            country="COLOMBIA"
            rowAcomulated={rowAcomulated}
            tradeIdNumber={tradeIdNumber}
            setPushMessage={setPushMessage}
            setViewToast={setViewToast}
            setBtnSaveModal={setBtnSaveModal}
            setNewAddFraction={setNewAddFraction}
            currentFraction={currenFraction}
            settlement={settlement}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}
      {modalDeleteFraction && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={infoModalFraction.title}
          message={infoModalFraction.message}
          variant={infoModalFraction.variant}
          textSuccess={infoModalFraction.textSuccess}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={deleteFraction}
          handleCancel={() => setModalDeleteFraction(false)}
        ></ModalAlert>
      )}
      {modalSaveFraction && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={infoModalFraction.title}
          message={infoModalFraction.message}
          variant={infoModalFraction.variant}
          textSuccess={infoModalFraction.textSuccess}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={handleAccept}
          handleCancel={() => setModalSaveFraction(false)}
        ></ModalAlert>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={pushMessage.message}
          variant={pushMessage.variant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/Checkbox.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

interface Props {
  documentNumber: string
  checkAll: boolean
  setCheckRow: (arg: string[] | ((prevCheckRow: string[]) => string[])) => void
}

export const Checkbox = ({ documentNumber, checkAll, setCheckRow }: Props) => {
  const [checkboxSelected, setCheckboxSelected] = useState<boolean>(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setCheckboxSelected(checkAll)
  }, [checkAll])

  useEffect(() => {
    setCheckRow((prevCheckRow: string[]) => {
      if (checkboxSelected) {
        return [...prevCheckRow, documentNumber]
      } else {
        return prevCheckRow.filter((item: string) => item !== documentNumber)
      }
    })
  }, [checkboxSelected])

  return (
    <div className="beneficiaries-container-checkbox" key={documentNumber}>
      <button
        onClick={() => setCheckboxSelected(!checkboxSelected)}
        className={`beneficiaries-btn-checkbox ${checkboxSelected ? 'bg-[#0E9753]' : 'border-[#FF411C]'}`}
      >
        {checkboxSelected && (
          <svg
            width="14"
            height="15"
            viewBox="0 0 14 15"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <path
              d="M11.6673 4.31055L5.25065 10.7272L2.33398 7.81055"
              stroke="#FFFBFA"
              stroke-width="1.5"
              stroke-linecap="round"
              stroke-linejoin="round"
            />
          </svg>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/ContainerDropdownEdit.tsx

```tsx
// import { useState } from "react";
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { MuiSelect } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SettlementDataInfo } from '../../components'

interface ContainerInputEditProps {
  rowInfo: SettlementDataInfo
  setSettlement: ((prevState: any) => void) | undefined
  settlement: SettlementDataInfo[]
  optionsBank: any[]
  bankSelectedList: any[]
  setBankSelectedList: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<
      {
        bankAccountId: string
        bankAccountNumber: string
        bankName: string
      }[]
    >
  >
  value?: string
  id: string
  temporaryValue?: string
  test: any
}

export const ContainerDropdownEdit = ({
  rowInfo,
  setSettlement,
  settlement,
  optionsBank,
  setBankSelectedList,
  bankSelectedList,
  value,
  id,
  temporaryValue,
  test
}: ContainerInputEditProps) => {
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<any[]>([])

  const onChange = (option: any) => {
    const { specialTradeId, fraction, side } = rowInfo

    const selectedBank = optionsBank?.find((item) => {
      return item.bank.id === option.value
    })

    const modifiedSettlement = settlement.map((row: any) => {
      if (
        row.specialTradeId === Number(specialTradeId) &&
        row.fraction === Number(fraction) &&
        row.side.id === side.id
      ) {
        setBankSelectedList((prev: any[]) => {
          const index = prev.findIndex((item) => item.bankAccountId === option)
          const newBank = {
            id: `${row.specialTradeId}-${row.fraction}-${row.side.id}`,
            bankAccountId: option?.value,
            bankAccountNumber: selectedBank?.accountNumber,
            bankName: selectedBank?.bankName
          }
          if (index !== -1) {
            // Si ya existe, reemplaza
            const updated = [...prev]
            updated[index] = newBank
            return updated
          } else {
            // Si no existe, agrega
            return [...prev, newBank]
          }
        })
        return {
          ...row,
          bankAccountId: option?.value,
          bankAccountNumber: selectedBank?.accountNumber
        }
      }
      return row
    })
    setSettlement && setSettlement(modifiedSettlement)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const reponse = optionsBank?.map((item) => {
      return {
        id: item.bank.id,
        name: item.bankName,
        value: item.bank.id,
        bankAccount: item.accountNumber
      }
    })
    setOptions(reponse)
  }, [])

  return (
    <MuiSelect
      key={settlement}
      id={id}
      dataReturn={rowInfo}
      value={
        (optionsBank?.length === 0 || optionsBank === undefined) && test === id
          ? value
          : bankSelectedList?.length > 0
            ? value
            : null
      }
      placeholder="Selecciona Banco Liquidador"
      options={
        optionsBank?.length === 0 || optionsBank === undefined
          ? [
              {
                id: value,
                name: temporaryValue
              }
            ]
          : options
      }
      onChange={onChange}
      disabled={optionsBank?.length === 0 || optionsBank === undefined}
    />
  )
}

```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/ContainerInputEdit.tsx

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'

import { InputBasic } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SettlementDataInfo } from '../../components'
import { getAccount } from '../../services'

interface ContainerInputEditProps {
  id: string
  initialState: string | number
  field: string
  rowInfo: SettlementDataInfo
  setSettlement: ((prevState: any) => void) | undefined
  setPushMessage?: (arg: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast?: (isVisible: boolean) => void
  settlement: SettlementDataInfo[]
  setBankSelectedList?: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<
      {
        bankAccountId: string
        bankAccountNumber: string
        bankName: string
      }[]
    >
  >
  bankSelectedList?: {
    id: string
    bankAccountId: string
    bankAccountNumber: string
    bankName: string
  }[]
}

export const ContainerInputEdit = ({
  id,
  initialState,
  field,
  rowInfo,
  setViewToast,
  setPushMessage,
  setSettlement,
  settlement,
  setBankSelectedList,
  bankSelectedList
}: ContainerInputEditProps) => {
  const [state, setState] = useState(initialState)

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (field === 'accountNumber') {
      setState(e.target.value)
      return
    }
    if (field === 'PercentageFraction' || field === 'commissionPercentage') {
      const value = e.target.value.replace('%', '') // Eliminar el símbolo '%' antes de guardar el valor
      const numericValue = parseFloat(value)
      if (numericValue <= 100) {
        setState(value)
      }
    }
  }

  const handleKeyPress = async (
    event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === 'Tab') {
      const { specialTradeId, fraction, side } = rowInfo

      if (field === 'accountNumber') {
        const accountExists = settlement.some((row: any) => {
          return row.accountNumber === state
        })

        if (accountExists) {
          setState(initialState)
          if (setPushMessage && setViewToast) {
            setPushMessage({
              message: 'Cuenta títulos ya existe',
              variant: 'error'
            })
            setViewToast(true)
          }
          return
        }

        try {
          const accountInfo = await getAccount({
            specialTradeId,
            numberAccount: state
          })

          const setBankList =
            bankSelectedList?.filter((item) => item.id !== id) ?? []

          setBankSelectedList?.(setBankList)

          const modifiedSettlement = settlement.map((row: any) => {
            if (
              row.specialTradeId === Number(specialTradeId) &&
              row.fraction === Number(fraction) &&
              row.side.id === side.id
            ) {
              return {
                ...row,
                accountNumber: state,
                identificationType:
                  accountInfo?.investorAccount?.investor?.identificationType,
                firstName: accountInfo?.investorAccount?.investor?.firstName,
                lastName: accountInfo?.investorAccount?.investor?.lastName,
                documentNumber:
                  accountInfo?.investorAccount?.investor?.documentNumber,
                bank: accountInfo.investorBankAccounts
              }
            }
            return row
          })
          setSettlement && setSettlement(modifiedSettlement)
        } catch (error) {
          if (setPushMessage && setViewToast) {
            setPushMessage({
              message: 'Cuenta títulos no existe en el depósito',
              variant: 'error'
            })
            setViewToast(true)
          }
        }
      } else if (
        field === 'PercentageFraction' ||
        field === 'commissionPercentage'
      ) {
        const value = state.toString().replace('%', '')
        const numericValue = parseFloat(value)
        if (numericValue <= 100) {
          setState(value)
          const { specialTradeId, fraction, side } = rowInfo

          const modifiedSettlement = settlement.map((row: any) => {
            if (
              row.specialTradeId === Number(specialTradeId) &&
              row.fraction === Number(fraction) &&
              row.side.id === side.id
            ) {
              if (field === 'PercentageFraction') {
                return { ...row, fractionPercentage: Number(value) }
              } else if (field === 'commissionPercentage') {
                return { ...row, commissionPercentage: Number(value) }
              }
            }
            return row
          })
          setSettlement && setSettlement(modifiedSettlement)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <InputBasic
        key={field}
        field={field}
        id={id}
        value={
          field === 'PercentageFraction' || field === 'commissionPercentage'
            ? `${state}%`
            : state
        } // Mostrar el símbolo '%' en la visualización
        onChange={handleChange}
        className="h-[40px] outline-none"
        showLabel={false}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
      />
      {/* <p>{field}</p> */}
    </>
  )
}
```
