## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/InlineBeneficiariesPage.tsx

```tsx
import { FolioDetailModel } from '@/models/folioDetail.model'
import { Button, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

import {
  ModalContent,
  ModalAlert,
  NewTable,
  Toast
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { StateModalAlert } from '../FolioDetailPage'
import { AddFraction } from './AddFraction'
import {
  useBeneficiariesTableEdit,
  useBeneficiariesTable,
  useBeneficiaries,
  useBeneficiariesFetch
} from './hooks'
import { useBeneficiariesEdit } from './hooks/useBeneficiariesEdit'
import { useBeneficiariesModalFraction } from './hooks/useBeneficiariesModalFraction'

interface InlineBeneficiariesPageProps {
  origenes: any[]
  sideId?: number
  edit?: boolean
  dataState?: any
  folioDetail?: FolioDetailModel
  clientUser: string
  participantId?: number
  onCancelInline?: () => void
  onSaveInline?: () => void
  setCurrentQuantity?: (val: string) => void
  currentQuantity?: string
  btnSaveModal?: boolean
  setModalAddFraction?: (val: boolean) => void
  showCrudToast?: (message: string, variant: string) => void
}

export const InlineBeneficiariesPage = ({
  origenes,
  sideId,
  edit,
  dataState,
  folioDetail,
  clientUser,
  onCancelInline,
  onSaveInline,
  setCurrentQuantity,
  currentQuantity,
  showCrudToast
  // setModalAddFraction
  // btnSaveModal
}: InlineBeneficiariesPageProps) => {
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [pushMessage, setPushMessage] = useState({ message: '', variant: '' })
  // Local replacements for useBeneficiariesStates & location.state
  const [assignmentEdit] = useState<boolean>(!!edit)
  const [sideIdNumber] = useState<number>(Number(sideId))
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<{
    id?: number
    field: string
    message: string
  }>({ field: '', message: '' })
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [folioBeneficiaries, setFolioBeneficiaries] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [modalConfirm, setModalConfirm] = useState(false)
  const [modalTransferCustodian, setModalTransferCustodian] = useState(false)
  const [selectedCustodian, _setSelectedCustodian] = useState<string>('')
  const [_localBtnDisabled, setLocalBtnDisabled] = useState(true) // NUEVO: estado local para el botón
  const [openFractionModal, setOpenFractionModal] = useState(false)
  const [confirmAddFraction, setConfirmAddFraction] = useState(false)
  const [confirmSaveInline, setConfirmSaveInline] = useState(false)
  const [modalAlert, setModalAlert] = useState<StateModalAlert | null>(null)
  const changeModalAlert = (state: StateModalAlert | null) => {
    const value = {
      ...state,
      open: state ? true : undefined
    } as StateModalAlert
    setModalAlert(value)
  }
  const [hasErrors, setHasErrors] = useState(false)
  const {
    newAddFraction,
    directDepositor,
    amount,
    commissionAmount,
    netAmount,
    transferValue,
    valTax,
    valTaxAmount,
    fractionVolumeDvp,
    fractionVolumeLp,
    fractionVolumeDvd
  } = dataState || {}

  let paramsNewSettlement
  if (newAddFraction) {
    paramsNewSettlement = {
      id: 1,
      tradeIdNumber: newAddFraction.tradeIdNumber,
      side: { id: newAddFraction.sideId },
      investorAccountId: newAddFraction.investorAccountId,
      participantAccountId: newAddFraction.participantAccountId,
      bankAccountId: newAddFraction.bankAccountId,
      fiduciarySpecialist: newAddFraction.fiduciarySpecialist,
      sourceQuoteTypeId: Number(
        newAddFraction?.origen || newAddFraction.sourceQuoteTypeId
      ),
      sourceQuoteType: {
        id: String(newAddFraction?.origen),
        name: newAddFraction?.origenDescription,
        value: String(newAddFraction?.origen)
      },
      reference: newAddFraction.reference,
      fractionQuantity: newAddFraction.fractionQuantity,
      commissionPercentage: (
        newAddFraction?.commissionPercentage ?? 0
      ).toString(),
      accountNumber: newAddFraction.accountNumber,
      // NUEVOS CAMPOS
      investorAccount: {
        accountNumber: newAddFraction.accountNumber,
        ...(newAddFraction?.allData?.investorAccount || {}),
        investor: newAddFraction?.allData?.investorAccount?.investor
      },
      participantAccount: newAddFraction?.allData?.participantAccount || null,
      finalBeneficiaryAccount: newAddFraction.finalBeneficiaryAccount,
      cashAccount: newAddFraction.settlementAccountNumber || '',
      compensatingEntity: newAddFraction.clearingEntity || '',
      settlementAccountNumber: newAddFraction.settlementAccountNumber || '', // añadido
      clearingEntity: newAddFraction.clearingEntity || '', // añadido
      valTax,
      fraction: newAddFraction.fraction,
      countryId: newAddFraction.allData?.investorAccount?.investor?.country?.id,
      investor: newAddFraction.allData?.investorAccount?.investor,
      bankAccount: {
        bankAccount: newAddFraction?.bankAccountNumber,
        id: newAddFraction.bankAccountId,
        bank: { bankName: newAddFraction?.bankAccount }
      },
      directDepositor,
      amount,
      commissionAmount,
      netAmount,
      transferValue,
      valTaxAmount,
      fractionVolumeDvp,
      fractionVolumeLp,
      fractionVolumeDvd
    }
  }

  const setErrorForm = (form: {
    id?: number
    field: string
    message: string
  }) => setFormError(form)

  const {
    headerActionsLeft,
    btnAceptText,
    description,
    textModalConfirm,
    columnsModules
  } = (() => {
    // Minimal reuse of useFolioDetail: call with required params only
    return {
      headerActionsLeft: () => null,
      btnAceptText: '',
      description: '',
      textModalConfirm: '',
      columnsModules: []
    }
  })()

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, _rows: []) => {}

  const {
    client_user
    // navigate
  } = useBeneficiaries()

  const tradeId = folioDetail?.trade?.id ?? 0

  const {
    typePayment,
    quantityAvailable,
    editSettlement,
    // editSettlementSelect,
    fractionIds,
    setSettlementValue,
    // setSettlementBank,
    addSettlementRecord,
    getSettlementNextFraction,
    removeSelectedFractions,
    setSettlementCashEntity
  } = useBeneficiariesEdit(
    folioDetail,
    sideIdNumber,
    setFolioBeneficiaries,
    clientUser,
    folioDetail?.trade.country.id ?? 0,
    folioDetail?.trade.price ?? 0,
    thereAreSelected,
    setErrorForm,
    paramsNewSettlement,
    newAddFraction,
    showCrudToast,
    setPushMessage,
    setViewToast,
    setHasErrors
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    window.localStorage.editSettlement = JSON.stringify(editSettlement || [])
  }, [editSettlement])

  const {
    // modal,
    handleToogleModal,
    showModalNewSettlement,
    // modalBtnDisabled,
    btnSaveModal,
    handleSetBtnSaveModal,
    setNewInlineFraction,
    handleAccept,
    setBtnSaveModal
  } = useBeneficiariesModalFraction(
    // typePayment,
    // quantityAvailable,
    folioDetail?.trade?.specialTrade?.directDepositorOutDto,
    // clientUser,
    tradeId ?? 0,
    sideIdNumber,
    getSettlementNextFraction,
    // editSettlement,
    addSettlementRecord,
    formError,
    setErrorForm,
    // currentQuantity,
    setOpenFractionModal
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalBtnDisabled(!btnSaveModal)
  }, [btnSaveModal])

  const { updateFractionsBeneficiaries } = useBeneficiariesFetch(
    // navigate,
    tradeId,
    client_user,
    editSettlement,
    sideIdNumber,
    folioDetail,
    setFolioBeneficiaries,
    newAddFraction,
    (message, variant) => {
      showCrudToast?.(message, variant)
    }
  )

  const { editAssignmentEditColumns, headerActionsLeftAssignmentEdit } =
    useBeneficiariesTableEdit(
      quantityAvailable,
      formError,
      editSettlement,
      setSettlementValue,
      // setSettlementBank,
      // editSettlementSelect,
      removeSelectedFractions,
      showModalNewSettlement,
      thereAreSelected,
      tradeId, // added
      sideIdNumber, // added
      setSettlementCashEntity, // added
      folioDetail,
      origenes,
      setPushMessage,
      setViewToast
    )

  const { assignmentColumns } = useBeneficiariesTable(
    removeSelectedFractions,
    showModalNewSettlement,
    thereAreSelected
  )

  // const { showModalUpdateFractions } = useValidateModal(
  //   async () => {}, // updateFractionsBeneficiaries inline could be implemented here if needed
  //   assignmentColumns,
  //   editSettlement,
  //   fractionIds
  // );

  const handleSaveInline = async () => {
    await updateFractionsBeneficiaries()
    if (onSaveInline) onSaveInline()
  }

  // NUEVO: recalcular cantidad restante del folio
  useEffect(() => {
    const totalFolioQuantity = Number(folioDetail?.trade?.quantity ?? 0)
    const sourceRows = assignmentEdit ? editSettlement : folioBeneficiaries
    const usedQuantity = sourceRows.reduce((acc: number, row: any) => {
      const raw = row?.fractionQuantity ?? row?.quantity ?? 0
      const numeric =
        typeof raw === 'string'
          ? Number(raw.replace(/[.,\s]/g, ''))
          : Number(raw)
      return acc + (isNaN(numeric) ? 0 : numeric)
    }, 0)
    const remaining = totalFolioQuantity - usedQuantity
    if (setCurrentQuantity) setCurrentQuantity(String(remaining))
  }, [
    assignmentEdit,
    editSettlement,
    folioBeneficiaries,
    folioDetail?.trade?.quantity,
    setCurrentQuantity
  ])
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <NewTable
        customToolbar={
          assignmentEdit
            ? headerActionsLeftAssignmentEdit()
            : headerActionsLeft()
        }
        provisionalId="fraction"
        columns={assignmentEdit ? editAssignmentEditColumns : assignmentColumns}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
        rows={assignmentEdit ? editSettlement : folioBeneficiaries}
        setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
        rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
      />
      {modalAlert && modalAlert?.open && <ModalAlert {...modalAlert} />}

      {assignmentEdit && (
        <div className="mt-4 flex w-full justify-end space-x-2">
          <Button
            variant="text"
            className="text-[#181818]"
            onClick={() => onCancelInline?.()}
          >
            Cancelar
          </Button>
          <DefaultComponents.Tooltip
            title="La cantidad total de acciones en las fracciones, no corresponde con la cantidad total de acciones de la operación"
            placement="top"
          >
            <Button
              disabled={
                (newAddFraction === undefined && fractionIds.length === 0) ||
                quantityAvailable > 0 ||
                hasErrors
              }
              className="bg-[#FF4201] text-[#FFFFFF] disabled:bg-gray-500"
              onClick={() => setConfirmSaveInline(true)}
            >
              Guardar
            </Button>
          </DefaultComponents.Tooltip>
        </div>
      )}
      {openFractionModal && (
        <>
          <ModalContent
            title="Agregar asignación"
            description="Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla"
            // NUEVO: interceptar confirmación
            handleAccept={() => setConfirmAddFraction(true)}
            handleClose={() => handleToogleModal()}
            className="w-full max-w-[600px] gap-y-[32px]"
            btnCancelText="Cancelar"
            btnAceptText="Agregar"
            iconClose={false}
            btnDisabled={!btnSaveModal}
          >
            <AddFraction
              country={folioDetail?.trade?.country?.name}
              rowAcomulated={0}
              tradeIdNumber={tradeId}
              setPushMessage={(msg) => {
                setPushMessage(msg)
                setViewToast(true)
              }}
              setViewToast={setViewToast}
              setBtnSaveModal={handleSetBtnSaveModal}
              setNewAddFraction={setNewInlineFraction} // sigue para compatibilidad
              setNewInlineFraction={setNewInlineFraction} // fuerza actualización inmediata vía prop dedicada
              settlement={editSettlement}
              isFolioDetail={true}
              bankAccountRequired={typePayment ? false : true}
              // currentQuantity={String(quantityAvailable + editSettlement.reduce((s, f) => s + Number(f.fractionQuantity || 0), 0))}
              currentQuantity={currentQuantity}
              currentSide={sideIdNumber}
              skipDuplicateValidation={true}
              changeModalAlert={changeModalAlert}
              setBtnSaveModalOriginal={setBtnSaveModal}
            />
          </ModalContent>
        </>
      )}

      {/* NUEVO: Modal confirmación agregar fracción */}
      {confirmAddFraction && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Estás seguro de agregar la asignación?"
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="Agregar asignación"
          textCancel="Cancelar"
          onClick={() => {
            handleAccept() // acción original
            setConfirmAddFraction(false)
          }}
          handleCancel={() => setConfirmAddFraction(false)}
          orientation="horizontal"
        />
      )}
      {/* NUEVO: Modal confirmación guardar cambios inline */}
      {confirmSaveInline && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Estás seguro de guardar la asignación?"
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="Guardar asignación"
          textCancel="Cancelar"
          onClick={async () => {
            await handleSaveInline()
            setConfirmSaveInline(false)
          }}
          handleCancel={() => setConfirmSaveInline(false)}
          orientation="horizontal"
        />
      )}
      {modalConfirm && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={textModalConfirm}
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess={btnAceptText}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={() => {}}
          handleCancel={() => setModalConfirm(false)}
        />
      )}
      {modalTransferCustodian && (
        <ModalContent
          title={selectedCustodian}
          description={description}
          handleClose={setModalTransferCustodian}
          handleAccept={() => setModalConfirm(true)}
          className="w-full max-w-[1140px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText={btnAceptText}
        >
          <NewTable
            customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
            columns={columnsModules}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
            rows={folioBeneficiaries}
            setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={pushMessage.message}
          variant={pushMessage.variant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/InputEdit.tsx

```tsx
import axios from 'axios'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useState } from 'react'

type Props = {
  placeholder?: string
  accountType?: number
  participantId?: number
  width?: string
  account?: boolean
  reference?: boolean
  quantity?: boolean
  trade?: number
  fraction?: number
  side?: number
  row?: any
  value?: string // Añadir esta prop para pasar el valor de la cuenta
  onAccountDataFetched?: (data: any) => void | undefined
  setViewToast?: (value: boolean) => void
  setTextToast?: (arg: string) => void
  setVariantToast?: (arg: 'success' | 'error') => void
}

interface ErrorResponse {
  response?: {
    data?: {
      httpCode?: string
    }
  }
}

export const InputEdit = ({
  placeholder,
  accountType,
  participantId,
  width = '84px',
  account = false,
  reference = false,
  quantity = false,
  trade,
  fraction,
  side,
  row,
  onAccountDataFetched,
  setViewToast,
  setTextToast,
  setVariantToast,
  value // Añadir esta prop para pasar el valor de la cuenta
}: Props) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<string>(value || '') // Inicializar con el valor de la cuenta

  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState<string>('')

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setInputValue(e.target.value)
  }

  const handleKeyPress = async (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Tab') && account) {
      try {
        const response = await axios.get(
          `${import.meta.env.VITE_MASTER_URL}/investor-account/account-number/${inputValue}`,
          {
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`,
              client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
              client_user: localStorage.getItem('username')
            }
          }
        )
        if (accountType === 21) {
          if (participantId !== response?.data?.participant.id) {
            setTextToast &&
              setTextToast(
                'Los datos de asignación no corresponden con el origen Posición Propia'
              )
            setVariantToast && setVariantToast('error')
            setViewToast && setViewToast(true)
            return
          }
          setNewValue(inputValue) // Actualizar el valor del input
        }

        onAccountDataFetched && onAccountDataFetched(response?.data) // Llama a la función de callback con los datos obtenidos
      } catch (error) {
        const err = error as ErrorResponse
        if (err?.response?.data?.httpCode === '404') {
          setTextToast && setTextToast('Cuenta títulos no existe en Deceval')
          setVariantToast && setVariantToast('error')
          setViewToast && setViewToast(true)
        }
      }
    }

    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Tab') && reference) {
      const body = { referenceAllocId: inputValue }
      try {
        await axios.patch(
          `${import.meta.env.VITE_OPERATIONS_URL}/settlement/trade/${trade}/fraction/${fraction}/side/${side}`,
          body,
          {
            headers: {
              Authorization: ` Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`,
              client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
              client_user: localStorage.getItem('username')
            }
          }
        )
        location.reload()
      } catch {
        console.error('Error fetching account data')
      }
    }
    if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Tab') && quantity) {
      const {
        investor,
        investorAccount,
        participantAccount,
        commissionPercentage,
        valTax,
        status,
        tradingSystem
      } = row

      const body = [
        {
          fraction,
          investorId: investor.id,
          investorAccountId: investorAccount.id,
          participantAccountId: participantAccount.id,
          fractionQuantity: Number(inputValue),
          commissionPercentage,
          valTax,
          statusId: status.id,
          tradingSystemId: tradingSystem.id
        }
      ]
      try {
        await axios.post(
          `${import.meta.env.VITE_OPERATIONS_URL}/settlement/trade/${trade}/side/${side}`,
          body,
          {
            headers: {
              Authorization: ` Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`,
              client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
              client_user: localStorage.getItem('username')
            }
          }
        )

        location.reload()
      } catch {
        console.error('Error fetching account data')
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <input
      type="text"
      style={{
        borderRadius: '4px 20px 4px 20px',
        border: '1px solid #7A7A7A',
        width
      }}
      className={`h-8 bg-[#F4F4F4] px-3 py-1 outline-none`}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      value={newValue ? newValue : inputValue}
      onChange={handleInputChange}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
    />
  )
}

```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/InputEditCommission.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

// import { RootState } from "remoteShell/mf-store";
// import { useSelector } from "react-redux";
// import { useCalculator } from "./hooks/useCalculator";

interface Props {
  placeholder: string | number
  editMode: boolean
  row?: {
    commissionPercentage?: number
    fractionPercentage?: number
    specialTrade: { id: number }
    investor: { id: number }
    fraction: number
    investorAccount: { id: number }
    participantAccount: { id: number }
  }
  width?: string
  height?: string
  setData?: (data: any) => void
  inputKey: string
  isFraction?: boolean
  account?: number
  setPorcentageFraction?: (arg: number) => void
}

export const InputEditCommission = ({
  placeholder,
  row,
  width = '101px',
  height = '48px',
  setData,
  inputKey,
  account,
  setPorcentageFraction
}: Props) => {
  const [valuePercentage, setValuePercentage] = useState<string>(
    placeholder ? placeholder.toString() : ''
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (valuePercentage && setData) {
      setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, [inputKey]: valuePercentage }))
    }
  }, [valuePercentage])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (row && setData) {
      const infoRow = {
        specialTradeId: row?.specialTrade?.id,
        investorId: row?.investor?.id,
        fraction: account,
        investorAccountId: row?.investorAccount?.id,
        participantAccountId: row.participantAccount.id
      }
      setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, ...infoRow }))
    }
  }, [valuePercentage])

  useEffect(() => {
    setPorcentageFraction && setPorcentageFraction(Number(placeholder))
  }, [])

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value.replace('%', '')
    if (/^\d{0,3}(\.\d{0,2})?$/.test(value) && Number(value) <= 100) {
      setValuePercentage(value)
      setPorcentageFraction && setPorcentageFraction(Number(value))
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder={`${placeholder}%`}
        style={{ borderRadius: '4px 20px 4px 20px', width, height }}
        className={`border-none bg-[#F4F4F4] px-3 py-1 text-[#7A7A7A] outline-none`}
        value={
          valuePercentage.includes('%')
            ? valuePercentage
            : `${valuePercentage}%`
        }
        onChange={handleInputChange}
        onFocus={(e) => {
          setValuePercentage(e.target.value.replace('%', ''))
        }}
        onBlur={(e) => {
          if (!e.target.value.includes('%')) {
            setValuePercentage(`${e.target.value}%`)
          }
        }}
      />
    </>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/dataColumn.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import iconDownload from '../../assets/icons/icon-download.svg'
import iconPlus from '../../assets/icons/icon-plus.svg'
import iconTrash from '../../assets/icons/icon-trash.svg'
import { updateSpecialSettlement } from '../../services/specialSettlement'
import { InputEdit, SelectComponent } from '../OperationDetailPage'
import { DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../OperationDetailPage/detailStrings'
import { Checkbox } from './Checkbox'
import { CheckboxAll } from './CheckboxAll'
import { InputEditCommission } from './InputEditCommission'

export const dataColumn = (
  editMode: boolean,
  tradeIdNumber: number,
  setViewToast: (arg: boolean) => void,
  setTextToast: (arg: string) => void,
  setVariantToast: (arg: 'success' | 'error') => void,
  sideIdNumber: number,
  setChangeSettlement: (arg: boolean) => void,
  setData: (arg: any) => void
) => {
  const [checkAll, setCheckAll] = useState(false)
  const [checkRow, setCheckRow] = useState<string[]>([])
  const [temporalDataSettlement, setTemporalDataSettlement] = useState<any[]>(
    []
  )
  const [tabAccount, setTabAccount] = useState(false)
  const [tabAccountInfo, setTabAccountInfo] = useState({
    documentNumber: '',
    identificationType: '',
    accountNumber: 0
  })
  const [currentFraction, setCurrentFraction] = useState<number>(0)
  const [porcentageFraction, setPorcentageFraction] = useState(0)

  const [headerActionsModule, setHeaderActionsModule] = useState([
    {
      label: `Agregar fracción`,
      disabled: false,
      type: 'add',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconPlus}
          alt="cancel"
          className="text-[#FF411C]"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: `Eliminar fracción`,
      disabled: false,
      type: 'delete',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconTrash}
          alt="check"
          className="text-[#FF411C]"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: 'Descargar comprobante',
      type: 'download',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt="filter"
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    }
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    setHeaderActionsModule((prevState) =>
      prevState.map((action) => {
        if (action.type === 'add') {
          return {
            ...action,
            disabled: porcentageFraction >= 100,
            icon: (
              <img
                src={iconPlus}
                alt="cancel"
                className={
                  porcentageFraction >= 100 ? 'icon-gray' : 'text-[#FF411C]'
                }
                style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
              />
            )
          }
        }
        return action
      })
    )
  }, [porcentageFraction])

  const sendTemporalData = () => {
    if (temporalDataSettlement && temporalDataSettlement.length > 0) {
      updateSpecialSettlement({
        temporalDataSettlement,
        tradeIdNumber,
        currentFraction,
        sideIdNumber,
        setChangeSettlement
      })
    }
  }

  let account = 0
  const columnsBeneficiaries = [
    {
      width: 5,
      name: <CheckboxAll setCheckAll={setCheckAll} />,
      render: (row: { investor: { documentNumber: string } }) => {
        return (
          <Checkbox
            documentNumber={row?.investor?.documentNumber}
            checkAll={checkAll}
            setCheckRow={setCheckRow}
          />
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 5,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.ID}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: () => {
        account++
        return <span>{account}</span>
      }
    },
    {
      width: 10,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.TYPE}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        investor: { identificationType: { description: string } }
        fraction: number
      }) => {
        setCurrentFraction(row?.fraction)
        return (
          <span>
            {' '}
            {tabAccount
              ? tabAccountInfo.identificationType
              : (row?.investor?.identificationType?.description ?? '--')}
          </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 17,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.DOCUMENT_TYPE}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: { investor: { documentNumber: string } }) => {
        return (
          <span>
            {' '}
            {tabAccount
              ? tabAccountInfo.documentNumber
              : (row?.investor?.documentNumber ?? '--')}{' '}
          </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 17,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        investorAccount: { accountNumber: string }
        investor: { documentNumber: string }
      }) => {
        const thereIsCheck = checkRow.includes(row.investor.documentNumber)

        return editMode && thereIsCheck ? (
          <InputEdit
            placeholder={row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber}
            setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
            inputKey="accountNumber"
            setViewToast={setViewToast}
            setTextToast={setTextToast}
            setVariantToast={setVariantToast}
            setTabAccountInfo={setTabAccountInfo}
            setTabAccount={setTabAccount}
          />
        ) : (
          <span>
            {' '}
            {tabAccount
              ? tabAccountInfo.accountNumber
              : row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber}{' '}
          </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 25,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center whitespace-pre-wrap">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.CLEARING_BANK}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        bankAccount: { bankName: string }
        investor: { documentNumber: string }
      }) => {
        const thereIsCheck = checkRow.includes(row.investor.documentNumber)
        return editMode && thereIsCheck ? (
          <SelectComponent
            setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
            selectKey="bankName"
            placeholder=""
          />
        ) : (
          <span> {row?.bankAccount?.bankName} </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 15,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center whitespace-pre-wrap">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        bankAccount: { accountNumber: number }
        investor: { documentNumber: string }
      }) => {
        const thereIsCheck = checkRow.includes(row.investor.documentNumber)
        return editMode && thereIsCheck ? (
          <InputEdit
            placeholder={row?.bankAccount?.accountNumber}
            setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
            inputKey="accountNumber"
          />
        ) : (
          <span>{row?.bankAccount?.accountNumber}</span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 12,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.COMMISSION}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        commissionPercentage: number
        investor: { documentNumber: string }
      }) => {
        const thereIsCheck = checkRow.includes(row.investor.documentNumber)
        return editMode && thereIsCheck ? (
          <InputEditCommission
            placeholder={row?.commissionPercentage}
            editMode={editMode}
            setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
            inputKey="commissionPercentage"
            // @ts-ignore
            row={row}
            account={account}
          />
        ) : (
          <span>
            {row?.commissionPercentage ? `${row?.commissionPercentage}%` : '--'}
          </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 15,
      name: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>{DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION}</span>
        </div>
      ),
      render: (row: {
        fractionPercentage: number
        investor: { documentNumber: string }
      }) => {
        porcentageFraction === 0 &&
          setPorcentageFraction(row?.fractionPercentage)
        const thereIsCheck = checkRow.includes(row.investor.documentNumber)
        return editMode && thereIsCheck ? (
          <InputEditCommission
            placeholder={row?.fractionPercentage}
            editMode={editMode}
            setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
            inputKey="fractionPercentage"
            // @ts-ignore
            row={row}
            isFraction={true}
            setPorcentageFraction={setPorcentageFraction}
            account={account}
          />
        ) : (
          <span>
            {' '}
            {row?.fractionPercentage
              ? ` ${row?.fractionPercentage}%`
              : '--'}{' '}
          </span>
        )
      }
    }
  ]

  const headerActions = async (action: {
    type: string
    url?: string
    label: string
  }) => {
    if (action.type === 'add') {
      const newRowTemp = {
        investor: {
          documentNumber: '--',
          identificationType: { description: '--' }
        },
        investorAccount: {
          accountNumber: (
            <InputEdit
              placeholder={0}
              setData={setTemporalDataSettlement}
              inputKey="accountNumber"
              setViewToast={setViewToast}
              setTextToast={setTextToast}
              setVariantToast={setVariantToast}
              setTabAccountInfo={setTabAccountInfo}
              setTabAccount={setTabAccount}
            />
          )
        },
        bankAccount: { bankName: '', accountNumber: 0 },
        commissionPercentage: '--',
        fractionPercentage: '--'
      }
      setData((prev: any) => {
        // const lastRow = prev[prev.length - 1];
        // const newRow = { ...lastRow, ...newRowTemp }; // Crear una copia exacta del último elemento
        return [...prev, newRowTemp]
      })
    }
    if (action.type === 'delete') {
    }
    if (action.type === 'edit') {
    }
    if (action.type === 'navigate' && !editMode) {
    }
  }

  return {
    columnsBeneficiaries,
    sendTemporalData,
    headerActionsModule,
    headerActions,
    porcentageFraction
  }
}

```

```typescript
import { useContext } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../../FolioDetailPage'

export const useBeneficiaries = () => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(
    FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME
  )
  const participantId = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth.infoUserNubo.participantId
  )

  return {
    context,
    client_user,
    participantId,
    navigate
  }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesEdit.ts

```typescript
import { ErrorResponse } from '@/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks'
import axios from 'axios'
import { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../../helpers'
import {
  BeneficiariesCalculationPayloadModel,
  FormErrorModel,
  InvestorBankAccount,
  SettlementDtoModel
} from '../../../models'
import {
  FolioDetailModel,
  SettlementItem
} from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'
import {
  accountValidation,
  calculationNoCountry,
  calculation,
  getAccountFolio
} from '../../../services'

export const useBeneficiariesEdit = (
  folioDetail: FolioDetailModel | undefined,
  sideIdNumber: number,
  setFolioBeneficiaries: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any[]>>,
  client_user: string | null,
  tradeCountryId: number,
  tradePrice: number,
  thereAreSelected: any,
  setErrorForm: (form: FormErrorModel) => void,
  paramsNewSettlement: any,
  newAddFraction?: any,
  onToast?: (message: string, variant: 'error' | 'success' | string) => void,
  setPushMessage?: any,
  setViewToast?: any,
  setHasErrors?: any
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [editSettlement, setEditSettlement] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [editSettlementSelect, setEditSettlementSelect] = useState<{
    [fraction: number]: { value: string; label: string }[]
  }>({})
  const [fractionIds, setfractionIds] = useState<number[]>([])
  const [quantityAvailable, setQuantityAvailable] = useState<number>(0)
  const [typePayment, setTypePayment] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const OWNER_POSITION_ID = 121

  const validateOriginVsAccountInline = (
    originId?: number,
    options?: { accountData?: any; settlement?: any }
  ): boolean => {
    if (!originId) return true

    const beneficiary =
      options?.accountData?.participantAccount ??
      options?.accountData?.investorAccount ??
      options?.settlement?.participantAccount ??
      options?.settlement?.investorAccount ??
      newAddFraction?.allData?.participantAccount ??
      newAddFraction?.allData?.investorAccount

    const originType = beneficiary?.originType
    if (!originType) return true

    const isPosicionPropiaOrigin =
      originType.id === OWNER_POSITION_ID ||
      originType.description?.toUpperCase() === 'POSICIÓN PROPIA'

    const isPosicionPropiaOption = originId === OWNER_POSITION_ID

    const isInvalid = isPosicionPropiaOrigin !== isPosicionPropiaOption

    const originString = isPosicionPropiaOption
      ? 'Posición Propia'
      : 'Terceros/Carteras Colectivas'

    if (isInvalid) {
      onToast?.(
        `Los datos de asignación no corresponden con el origen ${originString}.`,
        'error'
      )
      return false
    }

    const participantIdForSide =
      sideIdNumber === 1
        ? folioDetail?.trade?.participantBuy?.id
        : folioDetail?.trade?.participantSell?.id

    if (isPosicionPropiaOption && participantIdForSide) {
      const accountParticipantId =
        beneficiary?.participant?.id ??
        beneficiary?.investor?.id ??
        beneficiary?.participant?.participant?.id ??
        beneficiary?.investor?.investor?.id ??
        beneficiary?.id

      if (
        accountParticipantId &&
        accountParticipantId !== participantIdForSide
      ) {
        onToast?.(
          'Los datos de asignación no corresponden con el origen Posición Propia.',
          'error'
        )
        return false
      }
    }

    return true
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (folioDetail?.settlement && newAddFraction === undefined) {
      const folioBeneficiaries = folioDetail.settlement.filter(
        (item: any) => Number(item.side.id) === sideIdNumber && item
      )
      setFolioBeneficiaries(folioBeneficiaries)
      setEditSettlement(folioBeneficiaries)
      if (context?.fractions && context.fractions.length > 0) {
        setEditSettlement(context?.fractions)
      } else {
        context?.setEditFractions(folioBeneficiaries)
      }
    }
    if (newAddFraction !== undefined && paramsNewSettlement) {
      const enriched = {
        ...paramsNewSettlement,
        investorAccount: paramsNewSettlement.investorAccount
          ? {
              ...paramsNewSettlement.investorAccount,
              accountNumber:
                paramsNewSettlement.investorAccount.accountNumber ??
                paramsNewSettlement.accountNumber
            }
          : { accountNumber: paramsNewSettlement.accountNumber },
        participantAccount: paramsNewSettlement.participantAccount || null,
        finalBeneficiaryAccount:
          paramsNewSettlement.finalBeneficiaryAccount ?? '',
        cashAccount:
          paramsNewSettlement.settlementAccountNumber ??
          paramsNewSettlement.settlementAccountNumber ??
          '',
        compensatingEntity:
          paramsNewSettlement.compensatingEntity ??
          paramsNewSettlement.clearingEntity ??
          '',
        settlementAccountNumber:
          paramsNewSettlement.settlementAccountNumber ??
          paramsNewSettlement.cashAccount ??
          '',
        clearingEntity:
          paramsNewSettlement.clearingEntity ??
          paramsNewSettlement.compensatingEntity ??
          ''
      }
      setEditSettlement((prev) => {
        if (prev.length === 0) return [enriched]
        const exists = prev.some((p) => p.fraction === enriched.fraction)
        if (!exists) return [...prev, enriched]
        return prev.map((p) =>
          p.fraction === enriched.fraction ? enriched : p
        )
      })
      // FIX: evitar uso de forma funcional (setEditFractions no es un setter tipado como React.Dispatch)
      const currentFractions = Array.isArray(context?.fractions)
        ? context!.fractions
        : []
      const fractionsExists = currentFractions.some(
        (p: any) => p.fraction === enriched.fraction
      )
      const newFractions = fractionsExists
        ? currentFractions.map((p: any) =>
            p.fraction === enriched.fraction ? enriched : p
          )
        : [...currentFractions, enriched]
      context?.setEditFractions(newFractions)
    }
  }, [folioDetail, newAddFraction])

  // Añadir/completar finalBeneficiaryAccount en registros existentes
  useEffect(() => {
    setEditSettlement((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) => {
        const participantData =
          item?.participantAccount?.participant ||
          item?.investorAccount?.participant ||
          item?.investorAccount?.investor
        const calcBeneficiary = [
          participantData?.identificationType?.code,
          participantData?.documentNumber,
          participantData?.shortName
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')
        return {
          ...item,
          finalBeneficiaryAccount:
            item.finalBeneficiaryAccount || calcBeneficiary
        }
      })
    )
  }, [folioDetail])

  useEffect(() => {
    const actualQuantity: number = editSettlement.reduce(
      (sum, fraction) => sum + Number(fraction.fractionQuantity),
      0
    )
    setQuantityAvailable(
      Number(folioDetail?.trade?.quantity ?? 0) - actualQuantity
    )
    if (folioDetail?.trade?.paymentType?.id === 102) setTypePayment(true)
  }, [editSettlement])

  const getSettlementNextFraction = () => {
    const fractions = editSettlement.map((item: any) => item.fraction)
    return fractions.length > 0 ? Math.max(...fractions) + 1 : 1
  }

  const setModalAlert = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: '¿Está seguro de eliminar la fracción?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Eliminar fracción',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        if (editSettlement.length > 1) {
          setEditSettlement((prev) =>
            prev.filter((item) => !thereAreSelected.includes(item.fraction))
          )
        }
        context?.clearModalAlert()
      }
    })
  }

  const removeSelectedFractions = () => {
    setModalAlert()
  }

  const addSettlementRecord = (newSettlement: SettlementDtoModel) => {
    const participantData =
      (newSettlement as any)?.participantAccount?.participant ||
      (newSettlement as any)?.investorAccount?.participant ||
      (newSettlement as any)?.investorAccount?.investor

    if (!(newSettlement as any).finalBeneficiaryAccount && participantData) {
      ;(newSettlement as any).finalBeneficiaryAccount = [
        participantData?.identificationType?.code,
        participantData?.documentNumber,
        participantData?.shortName
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')
    }
    if (
      !(newSettlement as any).cashAccount &&
      (newSettlement as any).settlementAccountNumber
    ) {
      ;(newSettlement as any).cashAccount = (
        newSettlement as any
      ).settlementAccountNumber
    }
    if (
      !(newSettlement as any).compensatingEntity &&
      (newSettlement as any).clearingEntity
    ) {
      ;(newSettlement as any).compensatingEntity = (
        newSettlement as any
      ).clearingEntity
    }

    if (!(newSettlement as any).fractionVolumeDvp) {
      ;(newSettlement as any).fractionVolumeDvp = (
        newSettlement as any
      ).fractionVolumeDvp
    }

    getSettlementCalculation({
      field: 'commissionPercentage',
      settlement: newSettlement,
      countryId:
        tradeCountryId === 0
          ? (newSettlement as any).countryId
          : tradeCountryId,
      data: {
        quantity: (newSettlement as any).fractionQuantity ?? 0,
        price: tradePrice,
        commission: (newSettlement as any).commissionPercentage ?? 0,
        sideId: (newSettlement as any).side?.id ?? 0,
        valTax: (newSettlement as any).valTax ?? 0
      },
      isEditFraction: false
    })

    setEditSettlement((prev) => [...prev, newSettlement])
    addFractionId((newSettlement as any).fraction ?? 0)
    context?.setToast({
      show: true,
      text: 'Fracción agregada correctamente',
      variant: 'success'
    })
  }

  const calculateAmounts = (
    totalAmount: number,
    currentAmount: number,
    volume: number
  ) => {
    //MONTO DVP FRACCIÓN = (CANTIDAD FRACION / CANTIDAD TOTAL FOLIO) * MONTO DVP FOLIO
    const response = (currentAmount / totalAmount) * volume
    return response
  }

  const getSettlementCalculation = async ({
    field,
    settlement,
    countryId,
    data,
    isEditFraction
  }: {
    field: string
    settlement: any
    countryId: number
    data: BeneficiariesCalculationPayloadModel
    isEditFraction: boolean
  }) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)

      let calculationData: any = null
      if (isEditFraction) {
        calculationData = await calculationNoCountry(client_user, data)
      } else {
        calculationData = await calculation(countryId, data)
      }

      if (calculationData) {
        settlement.commissionAmount = Number(calculationData.commissionAmount)
        settlement.netAmount = Number(calculationData.netAmount)
        settlement.valTaxAmount = settlement?.investor?.taxExemp
          ? 0
          : Number(calculationData.valTaxAmount)
        settlement.valTax = Number(calculationData.valTax)
        settlement.transferValue = calculationData.transferValue
        settlement.fractionVolumeDvp = calculateAmounts(
          folioDetail?.trade?.quantity || 0,
          Number(data.quantity),
          folioDetail?.trade?.volumeDvp || 0
        )
        settlement.fractionVolumeLp = calculateAmounts(
          folioDetail?.trade?.quantity || 0,
          Number(data.quantity),
          folioDetail?.trade?.volumeLp || 0
        )
        settlement.fractionVolumeDvd = calculateAmounts(
          folioDetail?.trade?.quantity || 0,
          Number(data.quantity),
          folioDetail?.trade?.volumeDvd || 0
        )
      }
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }

      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error realizando el cálculo',
        variant: 'error',
        message: message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })

      setErrorForm({ id: settlement.fraction, field: field, message: message })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const AccountValidate = async (
    fraction: number,
    account: string,
    settlement: SettlementItem
  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const existingItem = editSettlement.find(
        (item: SettlementItem) =>
          item.fraction !== fraction &&
          (item.investorAccount?.accountNumber === account ||
            item.participantAccount?.accountNumber === account ||
            (item as any)?.accountNumber === account)
      )
      if (existingItem) {
        context?.setModalAlert({
          title: 'Error validando la cuenta',
          variant: 'error',
          message:
            'La cuenta ya esta asignada a la fraccion ' + existingItem.fraction,
          textSuccess: 'aceptar',
          textCancel: 'hidden',
          onClick: context?.clearModalAlert
        })
        setErrorForm({
          id: fraction,
          field: 'investorAccount.accountNumber',
          message:
            'La cuenta ya esta asignada a la fraccion ' + existingItem.fraction
        })
        setEditSettlementSelect({})
        setHasErrors?.(true)
        return false
      }

      const tradeIdFallback =
        (settlement as any).tradeId ??
        (settlement as any).tradeIdNumber ??
        folioDetail?.trade?.id
      const sideIdFallback = settlement.side?.id ?? sideIdNumber

      let accountData: any = null
      try {
        accountData = await getAccountFolio({
          tradeId: tradeIdFallback,
          numberAccount: account,
          sideId: sideIdFallback,
          originId:
            (settlement as any)?.origen ||
            (settlement as any)?.originId ||
            (settlement as any)?.sourceQuoteTypeId
        })
      } catch (error) {
        const err = error as ErrorResponse
        if (err?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'INVESTOR_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND') {
          setPushMessage({
            message:
              'No se encuentra la cuenta títulos con el origen de la operación',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          setHasErrors?.(true)
          return false
        }
        accountData = await accountValidation(
          account,
          tradeIdFallback,
          sideIdFallback
        )
      }

      if (accountData) {
        setHasErrors?.(false)
        const bankAccountsSource =
          accountData?.participantAccount === null
            ? accountData?.investorBankAccounts
            : accountData?.participantBankAccounts

        // PROTECCIÓN: id puede venir undefined
        const updatedFolioEditSelect = (bankAccountsSource || []).map(
          (acc: any, idx: number) => ({
            value: acc?.id != null ? String(acc.id) : `tmp-${fraction}-${idx}`,
            label: `${acc?.accountNumber ?? ''} | ${acc?.bankName ?? ''}`
          })
        )
        //comentado temporalmente
        setEditSettlementSelect((prevState) => ({
          ...prevState,
          [fraction]: updatedFolioEditSelect
        }))

        settlement.fiduciarySpecialist = accountData.fiduciarySpecialist
        settlement.sourceQuoteType = accountData?.sourceQuoteType
        settlement.participantAccount =
          accountData?.participantAccount ?? settlement.participantAccount

        // Mantener siempre investorAccount con accountNumber
        if (accountData?.investorAccount) {
          settlement.investorAccount = accountData.investorAccount
        } else {
          settlement.investorAccount = {
            ...(settlement.investorAccount || {}),
            accountNumber: account
          } as any
        }

        settlement.investor =
          accountData?.investorAccount?.investor ?? settlement.investor

        if (!settlement.bankAccount) {
          settlement.bankAccount = {
            id: -1,
            bankAccount: '',
            bank: { bankName: '' }
          }
        } else {
          settlement.bankAccount = {
            id: -1,
            bankAccount: '',
            bank: { bankName: '' }
          }
        }

        const participantData = accountData?.participantAccount
          ? accountData.participantAccount.participant
          : accountData?.investorAccount?.participant ||
            accountData?.investorAccount?.investor

        const finalBeneficiaryAccount = [
          participantData?.identificationType?.code,
          participantData?.documentNumber,
          participantData?.shortName
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')

        settlement.finalBeneficiaryAccount = finalBeneficiaryAccount
        addFractionId(fraction)
        const originId =
          (settlement as any).sourceQuoteTypeId ??
          settlement.sourceQuoteType?.id ??
          (settlement as any).origen ??
          (settlement as any).originId

        // Validate and stop if invalid to avoid persisting invalid changes
        const isValid = validateOriginVsAccountInline(originId, { accountData })
        if (!isValid) {
          // No further changes applied; exit early
          return false
        }

        return true
      }

      return false
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND') {
          setPushMessage?.({
            message: 'La cuenta títulos no existe o no es válida',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast?.(true)
        }
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error validando la cuenta',
        variant: 'error',
        message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => context?.clearModalAlert()
      })
      setErrorForm({
        id: fraction,
        field: 'investorAccount.accountNumber',
        message: 'Ocurrió un error validando la cuenta'
      })
      return false
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const setSettlementBank = (
    fraction: number,
    bankAccount: InvestorBankAccount
  ) => {
    setEditSettlement((prev) =>
      prev.map((item: SettlementItem) => {
        if (item.fraction === fraction) {
          return {
            ...item,
            bankAccount: {
              id: bankAccount.id,
              bankAccount: bankAccount.accountNumber,
              bank: {
                bankName: bankAccount.bankName
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return item
      })
    )
    addFractionId(fraction)
  }

  const setSettlementValue = async (
    fraction: number,
    field: string,
    inputValue: any
  ) => {
    const editSettlement = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.editSettlement)
    const settlementIndex = editSettlement.findIndex(
      (item: SettlementItem) => item.fraction === fraction
    )
    if (settlementIndex === -1) return
    const settlement = { ...editSettlement[settlementIndex] }
    const showError = (message: string) => {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Error Editando la Fracción',
        variant: 'error',
        message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: context?.clearModalAlert
      })
      setErrorForm({ id: fraction, field, message })
    }
    const applyDotPath = (obj: any, path: string, value: any) => {
      const parts = path.split('.')
      let cursor = obj
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length - 1; i++) {
        const key = parts[i]
        if (cursor[key] == null || typeof cursor[key] !== 'object') {
          cursor[key] = {}
        }
        cursor = cursor[key]
      }
      cursor[parts[parts.length - 1]] = value
    }

    let allowPersist = true

    if (field === 'investorAccount.accountNumber') {
      if (!settlement.investorAccount) {
        settlement.investorAccount = { accountNumber: inputValue } as any
      } else {
        settlement.investorAccount.accountNumber = inputValue
      }
      ;(settlement as any).accountNumber = inputValue

      const ok = await AccountValidate(fraction, inputValue, settlement)
      if (!ok) allowPersist = false
    } else if (field === 'fractionQuantity') {
      const valoranterior: number =
        Number(quantityAvailable) + Number(settlement.fractionQuantity)
      if (Number(inputValue) - valoranterior > Number(quantityAvailable)) {
        showError('La cantidad de la fracción supera la cantidad disponible')
        return
      }
      await getSettlementCalculation({
        field,
        settlement,
        countryId: tradeCountryId,
        data: {
          quantity: inputValue,
          price: tradePrice,
          commission: settlement?.commissionPercentage,
          sideId: settlement?.side?.id,
          valTax: settlement.valTax
        },
        isEditFraction: true
      })
      settlement.fractionQuantity = inputValue
      addFractionId(fraction)
    } else if (field === 'commissionPercentage') {
      if (inputValue >= 100) {
        showError('EL porcentaje de comisión no puede superar el 99%')
        return
      }
      await getSettlementCalculation({
        field,
        settlement,
        countryId: tradeCountryId,
        data: {
          quantity: settlement.fractionQuantity,
          price: tradePrice,
          commission: inputValue,
          sideId: settlement.side.id,
          valTax: settlement.valTax
        },
        isEditFraction: true
      })
      settlement.commissionPercentage = inputValue
      addFractionId(fraction)
    } else if (field === 'reference') {
      settlement.reference = inputValue
      addFractionId(fraction)
    } else if (field.startsWith('sourceQuoteType')) {
      applyDotPath(settlement, field, inputValue)
      if (field === 'sourceQuoteType.id') {
        ;(settlement as any).sourceQuoteTypeId = inputValue
        const numericOriginId =
          typeof inputValue === 'string' ? Number(inputValue) : inputValue
        const isValid = validateOriginVsAccountInline(numericOriginId, {
          settlement
        })
        if (!isValid) allowPersist = false
      }
      addFractionId(fraction)
    } else {
      // Campo genérico (futuras expansiones)
      if (field.includes('.')) {
        applyDotPath(settlement, field, inputValue)
        addFractionId(fraction)
      } else {
        ;(settlement as any)[field] = inputValue
        addFractionId(fraction)
      }
    }

    if (!allowPersist) return

    setEditSettlement((prev) => {
      const newSettlement = [...prev]
      newSettlement[settlementIndex] = settlement
      return newSettlement
    })
  }

  const setSettlementCashEntity = (
    fraction: number,
    cashAccount: string,
    compensatingEntity: string
  ) => {
    setEditSettlement((prev) =>
      prev.map((item) =>
        item.fraction === fraction
          ? { ...item, cashAccount, compensatingEntity }
          : item
      )
    )
    addFractionId(fraction)
  }

  const addFractionId = (fraction: number) => {
    setfractionIds((prev) =>
      prev.includes(fraction) ? prev : [...prev, fraction]
    )
  }

  // Efecto adicional: Enriquecer nuevas fracciones añadidas (segunda, tercera, etc.)
  // Evita bucles: solo setea estado si algún elemento cambia.
  useEffect(() => {
    setEditSettlement((prev) => {
      let changed = false
      const updated = prev.map((item) => {
        const participantData =
          item?.participantAccount?.participant ||
          item?.investorAccount?.participant ||
          item?.investorAccount?.investor

        const computedBeneficiary = [
          participantData?.identificationType?.code,
          participantData?.documentNumber,
          participantData?.shortName
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ')

        const finalBeneficiaryAccount =
          item.finalBeneficiaryAccount || computedBeneficiary
        const cashAccount =
          item.cashAccount || item.settlementAccountNumber || ''
        const compensatingEntity =
          item.compensatingEntity || item.clearingEntity || ''

        if (
          finalBeneficiaryAccount !== item.finalBeneficiaryAccount ||
          cashAccount !== item.cashAccount ||
          compensatingEntity !== item.compensatingEntity
        ) {
          changed = true
          return {
            ...item,
            finalBeneficiaryAccount,
            cashAccount,
            compensatingEntity
          }
        }
        return item
      })
      return changed ? updated : prev
    })
    // Dependemos del tamaño (nueva fracción) y no de todo el objeto para minimizar renders
  }, [editSettlement.length])

  return {
    typePayment,
    quantityAvailable,
    editSettlement,
    editSettlementSelect,
    fractionIds,
    AccountValidate,
    setSettlementValue,
    setSettlementBank,
    getSettlementCalculation,
    addSettlementRecord,
    getSettlementNextFraction,
    removeSelectedFractions,
    setSettlementCashEntity // added
  }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesFetch.ts

```typescript
import { validateCudAccount } from '@/services/specialSettlement/addFraction'
import axios from 'axios'
import { useContext, useEffect } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../../helpers'
import { BeneficiariesFractionPayloadModel } from '../../../models'
import {
  FolioDetailModel,
  SettlementItem
} from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'
import {
  accountValidation,
  createFractionSettlement,
  updateFractions
} from '../../../services'

export const useBeneficiariesFetch = (
  // navigate: NavigateFunction,
  tradeId: number,
  client_user: string | null,
  editSettlement: SettlementItem[] | undefined,
  sideIdNumber: number,
  folioDetail: FolioDetailModel | undefined,
  setFolioBeneficiaries: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<any[]>>,
  newAddFraction: any,
  onSuccessToast?: (message: string, variant: string) => void
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (folioDetail?.settlement) {
      const folioBeneficiaries = folioDetail.settlement.filter(
        (item: any) => Number(item.side.id) === sideIdNumber && item
      )
      setFolioBeneficiaries(folioBeneficiaries)
      context?.setEditFractions(folioBeneficiaries)
    }
  }, [folioDetail, context?.fieldErrors.fraction])

  const getBankAccountId = (account: string) => async () => {
    const bankAccountValidation = await accountValidation(
      account,
      tradeId,
      sideIdNumber
    )

    if ((bankAccountValidation as any)?.participantBankAccounts) {
      return (bankAccountValidation as any)?.participantBankAccounts?.[0]?.bank
        ?.id
    }

    if ((bankAccountValidation as any)?.investorBankAccounts) {
      return (bankAccountValidation as any)?.investorBankAccounts?.[0]?.bank?.id
    }

    return null
    // Se asume que la respuesta tiene bankAccountId o id.
  }

  const getParticipantBanckAccountId =
    (efectiveAccount: string) => async () => {
      const data = await validateCudAccount({
        tradeId: tradeId,
        sideId: Number(sideIdNumber),
        accountNumber: efectiveAccount || '', //settlementAccountNumber
        pageNumber: 0,
        pageSize: 1
      })
      return data.content[0]?.participant_bank_account_id
    }

  const updateFractionsBeneficiaries = async () => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      if (newAddFraction === undefined) {
        // Resolver bankAccountId faltante
        const settlementFiltered =
          editSettlement?.filter(
            (item: any) => Number(item.side.id) === sideIdNumber
          ) || []

        const data: BeneficiariesFractionPayloadModel[] = await Promise.all(
          settlementFiltered.map(async (item: any) => {
            let bankAccountId = item?.bankAccount?.id
            if (!bankAccountId) {
              const accountNumber = item?.accountNumber
              if (accountNumber) {
                bankAccountId = await getBankAccountId(accountNumber)()
              }
            }

            return {
              directDepositorId: item?.directDepositor?.id,
              investorAccountId: item?.investorAccount?.id,
              participantAccountId: item?.participantAccount?.id,
              bankAccountId,
              fiduciarySpecialist: item?.fiduciarySpecialist,
              sourceQuoteTypeId: item?.sourceQuoteType?.id,
              reference: item?.reference,
              fractionQuantity: Number(item?.fractionQuantity),
              commissionPercentage: item?.commissionPercentage.toString(),
              valTax: item?.valTax
            }
          })
        )
        await updateFractions(client_user, data, tradeId, sideIdNumber)
      } else {
        const settlementFiltered =
          editSettlement?.filter(
            (item: any) => Number(item.side?.id) === sideIdNumber
          ) || []

        if (newAddFraction.participantAccountId) {
          const data: BeneficiariesFractionPayloadModel[] = await Promise.all(
            settlementFiltered.map(async (item: any) => {
              let bankAccountId = item?.bankAccount?.id
              if (!bankAccountId || bankAccountId <= 0) {
                const accountNumber = item?.accountNumber
                if (accountNumber) {
                  bankAccountId = await getBankAccountId(accountNumber)()
                }
              }
              let efectiveAccount = item?.settlementAccountNumber || ''
              let participantBankAccountId
              if (efectiveAccount) {
                participantBankAccountId =
                  await getParticipantBanckAccountId(efectiveAccount)()
              }
              return {
                participantAccountId: item?.participantAccount?.id || null,
                investorAccountId: item?.investorAccount?.id || null,
                directDepositorId: item.directDepositor?.id,
                bankAccountId,
                fiduciarySpecialist: item.fiduciarySpecialist,
                sourceQuoteTypeId: item.sourceQuoteType?.id,
                reference: item.reference,
                fractionQuantity: Number(item.fractionQuantity),
                commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage.toString(),
                participantBankAccountId: participantBankAccountId || null
              }
            })
          )
          await createFractionSettlement({
            tradeIdNumber: tradeId,
            sideId: newAddFraction.sideId,
            body: data
          })
        } else {
          const data: any[] = await Promise.all(
            settlementFiltered.map(async (item: any) => {
              let bankAccountId = item?.bankAccount?.id
              if (!bankAccountId && bankAccountId <= 0) {
                const accountNumber = item?.accountNumber
                if (accountNumber) {
                  bankAccountId = await getBankAccountId(accountNumber)()
                }
              }
              return {
                investorAccountId: item?.investorAccount?.id,
                participantAccountId: item?.participantAccount?.id,
                directDepositorId: item.directDepositor?.id,
                bankAccountId,
                fiduciarySpecialist: item.fiduciarySpecialist,
                sourceQuoteTypeId: item.sourceQuoteType?.id,
                reference: item.reference,
                fractionQuantity: Number(item.fractionQuantity),
                commissionPercentage: item.commissionPercentage.toString()
              }
            })
          )
          await createFractionSettlement({
            tradeIdNumber: tradeId,
            sideId: newAddFraction.sideId,
            body: data
          })
        }
      }

      context?.clearModalContent()
      onSuccessToast?.('Asignación guardada exitosamente', 'success')
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error actualizando las fracciones',
        variant: 'error',
        message: message,
        textSuccess: 'aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }
  return { updateFractionsBeneficiaries }
}
```
