## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesModal.tsx

```tsx
import axios from 'axios'
import { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import {
  InputModal,
  MuiSelectModal
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../../helpers'
import {
  FormErrorModel,
  InvestorBankAccount,
  SettlementDtoModel
} from '../../../models'
import { DirectDepositorOutDto } from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'
import { accountValidation } from '../../../services'

interface AssignmentModal {
  toogle: boolean
  title: string
  message: string
  content: {
    select: boolean
    input: boolean
    value?: string
  }
}

export const useBeneficiariesModal = (
  typePayment: boolean,
  quantityAvailable: number,
  directDepositorData: DirectDepositorOutDto | undefined,
  tradeId: number,
  side: number,
  getSettlementNextFraction: () => number,
  editSettlement: any[],
  addSettlementRecord: (newSettlement: SettlementDtoModel) => void,
  formError: FormErrorModel,
  setErrorForm: (form: FormErrorModel) => void
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<AssignmentModal>({
    toogle: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    content: { select: false, input: false }
  })
  const [newSettlement, setNewSettlement] = useState<SettlementDtoModel>({})
  const [folioEditSelect, setFolioEditSelect] = useState<
    { value: string; label: string }[]
  >([])

  const AccountValidate = async (account: string) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const existingItem = editSettlement.find(
        (item: any) => item.investorAccount?.accountNumber === account
      )
      const accountExists = existingItem !== undefined
      const fraction = accountExists ? existingItem.fraction : undefined
      if (accountExists) {
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'La cuenta ya esta asignada a la fraccion ' + fraction,
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setErrorForm({
          field: 'account',
          message: 'La cuenta ya esta asignada a la fraccion ' + fraction
        })
        return
      }

      const accountData = await accountValidation(account, tradeId, side)
      if (accountData) {
        const updatedFolioEditSelect = accountData.investorBankAccounts.map(
          (account: InvestorBankAccount) => ({
            value: account.id.toString(),
            label: `${account.accountNumber} | ${account.bankName}`
          })
        )
        setFolioEditSelect(updatedFolioEditSelect)
        setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
          ...prevState,
          fraction: getSettlementNextFraction(),
          tradeId: tradeId,
          fiduciarySpecialist: accountData?.fiduciarySpecialist,
          reference: '',
          valtax: 19,
          side: {
            id: side
          },
          investor: {
            identificationType: {
              description:
                accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.identificationType
                  ?.description
            },
            documentNumber:
              accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.documentNumber,
            firstName: accountData?.investorAccount?.investor?.firstName
          },
          investorAccount: {
            id: accountData?.investorAccount?.id,
            accountNumber: accountData?.investorAccount?.accountNumber
          },
          sourceQuoteType: {
            id: accountData?.sourceQuoteType?.id,
            description: accountData?.sourceQuoteType?.description
          },
          directDepositor: {
            id: directDepositorData?.id ?? 0,
            code: directDepositorData?.code ?? '',
            name: directDepositorData?.name ?? ''
          }
        }))
        setErrorForm({ field: '', message: '' })
      }
    } catch (error) {
      let message = 'Error desconocido'
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }
      context?.setToast({ show: true, text: message, variant: 'error' })
      setErrorForm({ field: 'account', message: message })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleUpdateNewSettlement = (
    _id: number,
    event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>
  ) => {
    if (event.target.name === 'account') {
      AccountValidate(event.target.value)
      return
    }
    if (event.target.name === 'fractionQuantity') {
      if (Number(event.target.value) <= 0)
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'La fracción debe ser mayor a cero.',
          variant: 'error'
        })
      if (Number(event.target.value) > quantityAvailable) {
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'La cantidad total de acciones de la fracción es mayor que la cantidad total de acciones de la operación.',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setErrorForm({
          field: 'fractionQuantity',
          message:
            'La cantidad total de acciones de la fraccion es mayor que la cantidad total de acciones de la operación.'
        })
        return
      }
    }
    if (event.target.name === 'bank') {
      const selectedOption = folioEditSelect.find(
        (option) => option.value === event.target.value
      )
      const newLabel = selectedOption ? selectedOption.label : ''
      const [bankAccount, bankName] = newLabel.split(' | ')
      setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
        ...prevState,
        bankAccount: {
          id: Number(event.target.value),
          bankAccount: bankAccount,
          bank: {
            id: Number(event.target.value),
            bankName: bankName
          }
        }
      }))
      return
    }
    if (event.target.name === 'commissionPercentage') {
      const onlyNumbersAndCommas = event.target.value.replace(/[^\d,]/g, '')
      const withOnlyOneComma = onlyNumbersAndCommas
        .replace(/[,]/g, '.')
        .replace(/[.]+/g, '.')
      const withDotInsteadOfComma = withOnlyOneComma.replace(',', '.')
      event.target.value = withDotInsteadOfComma.replace(/\.\d?$/, (match) => {
        return match.length > 1 ? match : ''
      })
    }
    setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      [event.target.name]: event.target.value
    }))
  }

  const setModalAlert = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: '¿Está seguro de guardar la fracción?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Guardar fracción',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        saveSettlement()
      },
      handleCancel: () => {
        setNewSettlement({})
      }
    })
  }

  const saveSettlement = async () => {
    context?.clearModalAlert()
    addSettlementRecord(newSettlement)
    setNewSettlement({})
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setNewSettlement((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      commissionPercentage: '0',
      fractionQuantity: quantityAvailable
    }))
  }, [quantityAvailable])

  const form: React.ReactNode = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 py-10">
      <InputModal
        field="account"
        label="Cuenta"
        placeholder="123456"
        value={newSettlement?.investorAccount?.accountNumber}
        onKeyDown={handleUpdateNewSettlement}
        validate="numbers"
        error={
          formError.field === 'account' ||
          !newSettlement?.investorAccount?.accountNumber
        }
        required={true}
        onBlur={(e: any, id: number) =>
          handleUpdateNewSettlement(
            id,
            e as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
          )
        }
      />
      <MuiSelectModal
        field="bank"
        options={folioEditSelect}
        placeholder="Seleccione Banco Liquidador"
        onChange={handleUpdateNewSettlement}
        value={newSettlement?.bankAccount?.id}
        disabled={folioEditSelect.length === 0}
        error={typePayment ? !typePayment : !newSettlement?.bankAccount?.id}
        required={true}
        onBlur={(e: any, id: number) =>
          handleUpdateNewSettlement(
            id,
            e as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
          )
        }
      />
      <InputModal
        field="bankAccount"
        label="Cuenta Banco Liquidador"
        value={newSettlement?.bankAccount?.bankAccount}
        disabled={true}
        error={
          typePayment ? !typePayment : !newSettlement?.bankAccount?.bankAccount
        }
        shrink={!!newSettlement?.bankAccount?.bankAccount}
        required={true}
      />
      <InputModal
        field="commissionPercentage"
        label="Porcentaje de Comisión"
        value={`${newSettlement?.commissionPercentage}%`}
        onKeyDown={handleUpdateNewSettlement}
        validate="numbers"
        error={
          formError.field === 'commissionPercentage' ||
          !newSettlement?.commissionPercentage
        }
        required={true}
        onBlur={(e: any, id: number) =>
          handleUpdateNewSettlement(
            id,
            e as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
          )
        }
      />
      <InputModal
        field="fractionQuantity"
        label="Cantidad"
        value={newSettlement?.fractionQuantity}
        onKeyDown={handleUpdateNewSettlement}
        validate="numbers"
        error={
          formError.field === 'fractionQuantity' ||
          !newSettlement?.fractionQuantity
        }
        required={true}
        onBlur={(e: any, id: number) =>
          handleUpdateNewSettlement(
            id,
            e as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
          )
        }
      />
    </div>
  )

  const showModalNewSettlement = () => {
    context?.setModalContent({
      title: 'Agregar Fracción',
      description: 'Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla',
      handleClose: () => {
        // setNewSettlement({})
        setFolioEditSelect([])
      },
      handleAccept: () => {
        context?.clearModalContent()
        setModalAlert()
      },
      btnAceptText: 'Guardar',
      btnDisabled: typePayment
        ? !newSettlement?.investorAccount?.accountNumber ||
          !newSettlement?.commissionPercentage ||
          !newSettlement?.fractionQuantity
        : !newSettlement?.investorAccount?.accountNumber ||
          !newSettlement?.bankAccount?.id ||
          !newSettlement?.commissionPercentage ||
          !newSettlement?.fractionQuantity,
      btnCancelText: 'Cancelar',
      children: form
    })
  }

  const handleToogleModal = (value?: boolean) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      toogle: value ?? !prevState.toogle
    }))
  }

  const clearModalContent = () => {
    context?.clearModalContent()
  }

  const handleInputContent = (value: boolean) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      content: { ...prevState.content, input: value }
    }))
  }

  const handleValueContent = (value: string) => {
    setModal((prevState) => ({
      ...prevState,
      content: { ...prevState.content, value: value }
    }))
  }

  const modalNewSettlement = () => {
    setModal({
      toogle: true,
      title: 'Agregar Fracción',
      message: 'Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla',
      content: {
        select: true,
        input: false,
        value: 'w-full max-w-[540px] gap-y-[32px]'
      }
    })
  }
  const modalSettlementUpdate = () => {
    setModal({
      toogle: true,
      title: 'Confirmación de los datos corregidos',
      message:
        'Verifica si los datos que has ingresado son correctos antes de guardarlos, este paso es irreversible sin generar otra corrección.',
      content: {
        select: false,
        input: true,
        value: 'w-full max-w-[900px] gap-y-[32px]'
      }
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (context?.globalStatus.modalContent.show) showModalNewSettlement()
  }, [newSettlement, folioEditSelect, formError])

  return {
    modal,
    handleToogleModal,
    modalNewSettlement,
    modalSettlementUpdate,
    handleInputContent,
    handleValueContent,
    clearModalContent,
    showModalNewSettlement,
    setNewSettlement
  }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesModalFraction.tsx

```tsx
import { useContext, useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { FormErrorModel, SettlementDtoModel } from '../../../models'
import { DirectDepositorOutDto } from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'

// import { AddFraction } from "../AddFraction";

interface AssignmentModal {
  toogle: boolean
  title: string
  message: string
  content: {
    select: boolean
    input: boolean
    value?: string
  }
}

export const useBeneficiariesModalFraction = (
  // typePayment: boolean,
  // quantityAvailable: number,
  directDepositorData: DirectDepositorOutDto | undefined,
  // client_user: string | null,
  tradeId: number,
  side: number,
  getSettlementNextFraction: () => number,
  // editSettlement: any[],
  addSettlementRecord: (newSettlement: SettlementDtoModel) => void,
  _formError: FormErrorModel, // se mantiene por compatibilidad
  _setErrorForm: (form: FormErrorModel) => void, // se mantiene por compatibilidad
  // currentQuantity?: string,
  setOpenFractionModal?: (value: boolean) => void
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [modal, _setModal] = useState<AssignmentModal>({
    toogle: false,
    title: '',
    message: '',
    content: { select: false, input: false }
  })

  const [btnSaveModal, setBtnSaveModal] = useState(false)
  const [newInlineFraction, setNewInlineFraction] = useState<any>(null)
  const newInlineFractionRef = useRef<any>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    newInlineFractionRef.current = newInlineFraction
  }, [newInlineFraction])
  const [pushMessage, setPushMessage] = useState<{
    message: string
    variant: string
  } | null>(null)
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)

  const clearLocal = () => {
    setBtnSaveModal(false)
    setNewInlineFraction(null)
  }

  const closeModal = () => {
    if (setOpenFractionModal) setOpenFractionModal(false)

    // setModal(prev => ({ ...prev, toogle: false }));
    clearLocal()
    context?.clearModalContent()
  }

  const buildSettlementFromFraction = (): SettlementDtoModel | null => {
    const fractionData = newInlineFractionRef.current
    if (!fractionData) return null
    const data = fractionData.allData || {}
    const isInvestor =
      data?.investorAccount !== null &&
      data?.investorAccount !== undefined &&
      data?.participantAccount === null
    return {
      fraction: getSettlementNextFraction(),
      tradeId,
      side: { id: side },
      fiduciarySpecialist: fractionData.fiduciarySpecialist,
      reference: fractionData.reference ?? '',
      valTax: 19,
      investor: isInvestor
        ? data?.investorAccount?.investor
        : data?.participantAccount?.participant,
      investorAccount: isInvestor ? data?.investorAccount : undefined,
      participantAccount: isInvestor ? undefined : data?.participantAccount,
      sourceQuoteTypeId: Number(fractionData?.origen),
      sourceQuoteType: fractionData?.origen
        ? {
            id: String(fractionData?.origen),
            description: fractionData?.origenDescription,
            value: String(fractionData?.origen)
          }
        : undefined,
      directDepositor: {
        id: directDepositorData?.id ?? 0,
        code: directDepositorData?.code ?? '',
        name: directDepositorData?.name ?? ''
      },
      bankAccount: {
        id: Number(fractionData.bankAccountId) || -1,
        bankAccount: fractionData.bankAccountNumber || '',
        bank: {
          id: Number(fractionData.bankAccountId) || -1,
          bankName: fractionData.bankAccount || fractionData.bankName || ''
        }
      },
      fractionQuantity: Number(fractionData.fractionQuantity),
      commissionPercentage: Number(fractionData.commissionPercentage) || 0,
      commissionAmount: 0,
      netAmount: 0,
      valTaxAmount: 0,
      transferValue: 0,
      settlementAccountNumber: fractionData.settlementAccountNumber || '',
      clearingEntity: fractionData.clearingEntity || '',
      cashAccount: fractionData.settlementAccountNumber || '',
      bankAccountId: fractionData.bankAccountId,
      accountNumber: fractionData.accountNumber || ''
    }
  }

  const handleAccept = () => {
    const currentFraction = newInlineFractionRef.current
    //temporalmente deshabilitado el btnSaveModal
    if (/*!currentBtn ||*/ !currentFraction) {
      context?.setToast?.({
        show: true,
        text: 'Completa los datos de la fracción antes de guardar.',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      return
    }
    const settlement = buildSettlementFromFraction()
    if (!settlement) {
      context?.setToast?.({
        show: true,
        text: 'No se pudo construir la fracción, verifica los datos.',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      return
    }
    addSettlementRecord(settlement)
    closeModal()
  }

  const showModalNewSettlement = () => {
    if (setOpenFractionModal) {
      setOpenFractionModal(true)
      return
    }
    // setModal({
    //   toogle: true,
    //   title: "Agregar Fracción",
    //   message: "Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla",
    //   content: {
    //     select: true,
    //     input: false,
    //     value: "w-full max-w-[600px] gap-y-[32px]"
    //   }
    // });
    // context?.setModalContent({
    //   title: "Agregar Fracciónn",
    //   description: "Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla",
    //   handleClose: () => {
    //     closeModal();
    //   },
    //   handleAccept: handleAccept,
    //   btnAceptText: "Agregar",
    //   btnCancelText: "Cancelar",
    //   btnDisabled: false, //!btnSaveModal, // ajustado: deshabilita cuando no está listo
    //   children: (
    //     <AddFraction
    //       rowAcomulated={0}
    //       tradeIdNumber={tradeId}
    //       setPushMessage={(msg) => {
    //         setPushMessage(msg);
    //         setViewToast(true);
    //       }}
    //       setViewToast={setViewToast}
    //       setBtnSaveModal={handleSetBtnSaveModal}
    //       setNewAddFraction={setNewInlineFraction}        // sigue para compatibilidad
    //       setNewInlineFraction={setNewInlineFraction}     // fuerza actualización inmediata vía prop dedicada
    //       settlement={editSettlement}
    //       isFolioDetail={true}
    //       bankAccountRequired={typePayment ? false : true}
    //       // currentQuantity={String(quantityAvailable + editSettlement.reduce((s, f) => s + Number(f.fractionQuantity || 0), 0))}
    //       currentQuantity={currentQuantity}
    //       currentSide={side}
    //       skipDuplicateValidation={true}
    //     />
    //   )
    // });
  }

  // Actualiza el estado del botón en el modal solo si realmente cambia (evita bucle)
  const handleSetBtnSaveModal = (value: boolean) => {
    setBtnSaveModal(value)
    if (!modal.toogle) return
    const mc = context?.globalStatus.modalContent
    if (!mc) return
    // estructura puede ser {show, props} o plano; intentamos ambas
    const current = (mc as any).props ? (mc as any).props : mc
    const currentDisabled = current.btnDisabled
    const desiredDisabled = !value
    if (currentDisabled !== desiredDisabled) {
      // context.setModalContent({ ...current, btnDisabled: desiredDisabled });
    }
  }

  const handleToogleModal = (value?: boolean) => {
    if (setOpenFractionModal) setOpenFractionModal(false)
    // setModal(prev => ({ ...prev, toogle: value ?? !prev.toogle }));
    if (!(value ?? !modal.toogle)) clearLocal()
  }

  return {
    modal,
    handleToogleModal,
    showModalNewSettlement,
    pushMessage,
    viewToast,
    modalBtnDisabled: !btnSaveModal, // mantener por compatibilidad
    btnSaveModal, // NUEVO: exponer estado crudo para consumo directo
    handleSetBtnSaveModal,
    setBtnSaveModal,
    setViewToast,
    setNewInlineFraction,
    setPushMessage,
    handleAccept
  }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesStates.ts

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'

import { getParamUrl } from '../../../helpers'
import { FormErrorModel } from '../../../models'

export const useBeneficiariesStates = () => {
  const edit = getParamUrl('edit')
  const [assignmentEdit, setAssignmentEdit] = useState<boolean>(!!edit)
  const [sideIdNumber, setSideIdNumber] = useState<number>(
    Number(getParamUrl('sideId'))
  )
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<FormErrorModel>({
    id: undefined,
    field: '',
    message: ''
  })

  const setEditAssignment = () => {
    setAssignmentEdit(true)
  }

  const setErrorForm = (form: FormErrorModel) => {
    setFormError(form)
  }

  return {
    assignmentEdit,
    setEditAssignment,
    sideIdNumber,
    setSideIdNumber,
    formError,
    setErrorForm
  }
}
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useBeneficiariesTableEdit.tsx

```tsx
// import { GlobalStatusContext } from "../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext";
import { FolioDetailModel } from '@/models/folioDetail.model'
import { validateCudAccount } from '@/services/specialSettlement/addFraction'
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import {
  MaterialIcons,
  TRenderCellParams
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { ReactNode, useCallback, useRef } from 'react'
import React from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { InputModal, MuiSelect } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { getUserInfo } from '@/shared/utils/getInfoUser'

import { RowDataMui } from '../../../components'
import { formatNumberWithTwoDecimals } from '../../../helpers'
import { FormErrorModel } from '../../../models'
import NumericInputField from '../../../shared/components/NumericInputField'
import { BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS } from '../beneficiariesString'

// interface FolioEditSelect {
//     [fraction: number]: {
//         value: string;
//         label: string;
//     }[];
// }

export const useBeneficiariesTableEdit = (
  quantityAvailable: number,
  formError: FormErrorModel,
  editSettlement: any[],
  setSettlementValue: (
    fraction: number,
    field: string,
    inputValue: any
  ) => void,
  // updateInvestorBankAccount: (fraction: number, bankAccount: InvestorBankAccount) => void,
  // folioEditSelect: FolioEditSelect,
  removeSelectedRecords: () => void,
  modalNewSettlement: () => void,
  thereAreSelected: number[],
  tradeId: number, // added
  sideIdNumber: number, // added
  setSettlementCashEntity: (
    fraction: number,
    cashAccount: string,
    compensatingEntity: string
  ) => void,
  folioDetail?: FolioDetailModel | undefined,
  origenes: any[] = [],
  setPushMessage?: any,
  setViewToast?: any
) => {
  // const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext);
  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  // const handleSetAlertModification = (id: number, event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => {
  //     context?.setModalAlert({
  //         title: "¿Está seguro de que desea cambiar el beneficiario final?",
  //         variant: "warning",
  //         textSuccess: "Modificar",
  //         orientation: "horizontal",
  //         onClick: () => { context?.clearModalAlert(); handleUpdateSettlement(id, event); },
  //     })
  // }

  const headerActionsLeftAssignmentEdit = () => {
    return (
      <>
        <button
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            color: quantityAvailable === 0 ? 'gray' : '#FF4201'
          }}
          onClick={modalNewSettlement}
          disabled={quantityAvailable === 0}
          className="w-[166px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase outline-none"
        >
          <MaterialIcons.NoteAddOutlined fontSize="small" />
          Agregar Fracción
        </button>
        <button
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center'
          }}
          disabled={
            thereAreSelected?.length === 0 || editSettlement?.length === 1
          }
          onClick={removeSelectedRecords}
          className="w-[166px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase text-[#FF4201] outline-none disabled:text-[gray]"
        >
          <MaterialIcons.DeleteOutlined fontSize="small" />
          Eliminar Fracción
        </button>
      </>
    )
  }
  const onHandleUpdateSettlement = ({
    value,
    name,
    id
  }: {
    value: string
    name: string
    id: number
  }) => {
    const onlyNumbersAndCommas = value.replace(/[^\d,]/g, '')

    const withOnlyOneComma = onlyNumbersAndCommas
      .replace(/[,]/g, '.')
      .replace(/[.]+/g, '.')
    const withDotInsteadOfComma = withOnlyOneComma.replace(',', '.')
    const withValidDecimal = withDotInsteadOfComma.replace(
      /\.\d?$/,
      (match) => {
        return match?.length > 1 ? match : ''
      }
    )
    setSettlementValue(id, name, withValidDecimal)
  }
  const handleUpdateSettlement = (
    id: number,
    event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>
  ) => {
    onHandleUpdateSettlement({
      value: event.target.value,
      name: event.target.name,
      id
    })
  }

  // const handleBlurAccount = async (e:any, id: number) => {
  //     await handleSetAlertModification(id, e)
  // }

  const handleBlurUpdateSettlement = async (e: any, id: number) => {
    await handleUpdateSettlement(id, e)
  }

  // Borradores por fracción para cuenta títulos
  const accountDraftRef = useRef<{ [fraction: number]: string }>({})

  const setAccountDraft = (fraction: number, value: string) => {
    accountDraftRef.current[fraction] = value ? '' : value
  }

  const clearAccountDraft = (fraction: number) => {
    delete accountDraftRef.current[fraction]
  }

  const handleAccountChange = (fraction: number) => (_id: any, e: any) => {
    // Soporta event.target.value o valor directo
    const value =
      e && typeof e === 'object' && 'target' in e
        ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value
        : typeof e === 'string'
          ? e
          : ''
    setAccountDraft(fraction, value)
  }

  const handleAccountCommit = async (fraction: number, value?: string) => {
    const draft = value ?? accountDraftRef.current[fraction]
    if (!draft || draft.trim() === '') return
    const trimmed = draft.trim()

    await setSettlementValue(fraction, 'investorAccount.accountNumber', trimmed)

    clearAccountDraft(fraction)
  }

  const handleAccountKeyDown =
    (fraction: number) => async (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        await handleAccountCommit(
          fraction,
          (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value
        )
      }
    }

  const handleAccountBlur =
    (fraction: number) => async (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      onHandleUpdateSettlement({
        value: '0',
        name: 'commissionPercentage',
        id: fraction
      })
      await handleAccountCommit(fraction, e.target.value)
    }

  const cashDraftRef = useRef<{ [fraction: number]: string }>({})

  const setCashDraft = (fraction: number, value: string) => {
    cashDraftRef.current[fraction] = value
  }

  const clearCashDraft = (fraction: number) => {
    delete cashDraftRef.current[fraction]
  }

  const handleCashAccountChange = (fraction: number) => (e: any) => {
    const value =
      e && typeof e === 'object' && 'target' in e
        ? (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value
        : typeof e === 'string'
          ? e
          : ''
    setCashDraft(fraction, value)
  }

  const handleCashAccountCommit = async (fraction: number, value?: string) => {
    const draft = value ?? cashDraftRef.current[fraction]
    if (draft === undefined) return
    const trimmed = draft.trim()
    await validateAndSetCashAccount(fraction, trimmed)
    clearCashDraft(fraction)
  }

  const handleCashAccountKeyDown =
    (fraction: number) => async (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        await handleCashAccountCommit(
          fraction,
          (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value
        )
      }
    }

  const handleCashAccountBlur =
    (fraction: number) => async (e: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      await handleCashAccountCommit(fraction, e.target.value)
    }

  const validateAndSetCashAccount = useCallback(
    async (fraction: number, accountValue: string) => {
      const trimmed = (accountValue || '').trim()

      if (!trimmed) {
        setSettlementCashEntity(fraction, '', '')
        return
      }

      try {
        const data = await validateCudAccount({
          tradeId,
          sideId: sideIdNumber,
          accountNumber: trimmed,
          pageNumber: 0,
          pageSize: 1
        })

        const list = Array.isArray(data?.content) ? data.content : []
        const match =
          list.find((item: any) => item.bank_account === trimmed) ?? list[0]

        if (!match) {
          // Mantiene la cuenta digitada pero sin entidad compensadora
          setSettlementCashEntity(fraction, trimmed, '')
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'La cuenta efectivo no existe o no es válida',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }

        const participantDoc = match.participant?.documentNumber || ''
        setSettlementCashEntity(fraction, match.bank_account, participantDoc)
      } catch {
        // En error, dejamos la cuenta pero sin compensadora
        setSettlementCashEntity(fraction, trimmed, '')
      }
    },
    [tradeId, sideIdNumber, setSettlementCashEntity]
  )

  const { userType } = useSelector(getUserInfo)

  const handleOriginChange = (fraction: number) => (option: any) => {
    if (userType === 'EXTERNAL') return
    const optionId: string =
      typeof option === 'string' ? option : (option?.id ?? option?.value ?? '')
    if (!optionId) return
    const selected = origenes.find((o) => o.id === optionId)
    const numericId = Number(optionId)
    if (Number.isNaN(numericId)) return

    setSettlementValue(fraction, 'sourceQuoteType.id', numericId)
    setSettlementValue(
      fraction,
      'sourceQuoteType.description',
      selected?.name || ''
    )
    setSettlementValue(fraction, 'sourceQuoteTypeId', numericId)
  }

  const isColombiaCountry = folioDetail?.trade?.country?.name
    ?.toUpperCase()
    ?.includes('COLOMBIA')

  const ALL_EDIT_COLUMNS: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      width: 150,
      field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.FIELD,
      headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.LABEL
    },
    {
      width: 160,
      field: 'accountNumber',
      headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT.LABEL,
      renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => {
        const draft = accountDraftRef.current[row.fraction]
        const persisted =

        const shownValue = draft !== undefined ? draft : persisted

        return (

              id={row.fraction}
              field="accountNumber"

              validate="numbers"
              error={
                formError.id === row.fraction &&
                formError.field === 'accountNumber'
              }
              onChange={handleAccountChange(row.fraction)}
              onKeyDown={handleAccountKeyDown(row.fraction)}
              onBlur={handleAccountBlur(row.fraction)}
              inputSx={{
                '& .MuiOutlinedInput-root': {

                '& .MuiOutlinedInput-input': {
```

## src/pages/BeneficiariesPage/hooks/useCalculator.ts

```typescript
import axios from 'axios'
import { format } from 'date-fns'

export const useCalculator = () => {
  const handleCalculator = async (
    trade: number,
    fraction: number,
    side: number,
    valueCommission: string
  ) => {
    const body = {
      commissionPercentage: Number(valueCommission)
    }
    try {
      await axios.patch(
        `${import.meta.env.VITE_OPERATIONS_URL}/settlement/trade/${trade}/fraction/${fraction}/side/${side}`,
        body,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: ` Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`,
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: localStorage.getItem('username')
          }
        }
      )
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching account data')
      throw error
    }
  }

  return {
    handleCalculator
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { useContext } from 'react'

import { NewTable } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'

export const useValidateModal = (
  updateFractionsBeneficiaries: () => Promise<void>,
  assignmentColumns: GridColDef[],
  editSettlement: any[],
  fractionIds: number[]
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const showModalUpdateFractions = () => {
    context?.setModalContent({
      title: 'Confirmación de los datos corregidos',
      description:
        'Verifica si los datos que has ingresado son correctos antes de guardarlos, este paso es irreversible sin generar otra corrección.',
      handleClose: () => {},
      handleAccept: updateFractionsBeneficiaries,
      btnAceptText: 'Guardar',
      btnCancelText: 'Cancelar',
      className: 'max-w-[95%]',
      children: (
        <NewTable
          provisionalId="fraction"
          columns={assignmentColumns}
          rows={editSettlement?.filter((settlement) =>
            fractionIds.includes(settlement.fraction)
          )}
          checkboxSelection={false}
        />
      )
      // <DataGridBasic
      //     className="max-w-[1300px]"
      //     provisionalId="fraction"
      //     columns={assignmentColumns}
      //     rows={editSettlement?.filter(settlement => fractionIds.includes(settlement.fraction))}
      //     rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
      //     checkboxSelection={false}
      // />
    })
  }

  return {
    showModalUpdateFractions
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import eyeIcon from '../../../assets/icons/eyeIcon.svg'
import { YesOrNotComponent } from '../../../components'
import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator
} from '../../../helpers'
import { ButtonStatus } from '../../../models'
import { BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS } from '../beneficiariesString'

export const useBeneficiariesTable = (
  removeSelectedRecords: () => void,
  modalNewSettlement: () => void,
  thereAreSelected: any[]
) => {
  const [assignmentColumns, setAssignmentColumns] = useState<GridColDef[]>([])

  const buttonStatus: ButtonStatus = {
    viewEditSettlemnt: false,
    addSettlemnt: false,
    saveNewSettlement: false,
    sendEditFractions: false
  }

  const headerActionsLeftAssignment = () => (
    <>
      <button
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          color: buttonStatus.addSettlemnt ? 'gray' : 'inherit'
        }}
        onClick={modalNewSettlement}
        disabled={buttonStatus.addSettlemnt}
      >
        <img
          src={eyeIcon}
          alt="eyeIcon"
          className="icon-red h-5 w-5"
          style={{
            marginRight: '8px',
            filter: buttonStatus.addSettlemnt ? 'grayscale(100%)' : 'red(100%)'
          }}
        />
        AGREGAR FRACCIÓN
      </button>
      <button
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          color:
            Array.isArray(thereAreSelected) && thereAreSelected.length === 0
              ? 'gray'
              : 'inherit'
        }}
        disabled={
          !(Array.isArray(thereAreSelected) && thereAreSelected.length > 0)
        }
        onClick={removeSelectedRecords}
      >
        <img
          src={eyeIcon}
          alt="eyeIcon"
          className="icon-red h-5 w-5"
          style={{
            marginRight: '8px',
            filter:
              Array.isArray(thereAreSelected) && thereAreSelected.length === 0
                ? 'grayscale(100%)'
                : 'red(100%)'
          }}
        />
        ELIMINAR FRACCIÓN
      </button>
    </>
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    setAssignmentColumns([
      {
        width: 40,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FRACTION.LABEL
      },
      {
        width: 250,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.IDENTIFICATION_TYPE.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.IDENTIFICATION_TYPE.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({
          row
        }: {
          row: { investor: { identificationType: { description: string } } }
        }) => checkNullValue(row.investor?.identificationType?.description)
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.DOCUMENT_NUMBER.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.DOCUMENT_NUMBER.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({
          row
        }: {
          row: { investor: { documentNumber: string } }
        }) => checkNullValue(row?.investor?.documentNumber)
      },
      {
        width: 200,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.NAME.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.NAME.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { investor: { firstName: string } } }) =>
          checkNullValue(row?.investor?.firstName)
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.ACCOUNT.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({
          row
        }: {
          row: { investorAccount: { accountNumber: string }; fraction: number }
        }) => checkNullValue(row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber)
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FIDUCIARY_SPECIALIST.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.FIDUCIARY_SPECIALIST.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { fiduciarySpecialist: boolean } }) => (
          <YesOrNotComponent value={row?.fiduciarySpecialist} />

        renderCell: ({

        }: {

      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.TAX_AMOUNT.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.TAX_AMOUNT.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { valTaxAmount: number } }) =>
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.valTaxAmount, true)
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.NET_AMOUNT.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.NET_AMOUNT.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { netAmount: number } }) =>
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.netAmount, true)
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_NAME.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_NAME.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { custodian: { name: string } } }) =>
          checkNullValue(row?.custodian?.name)
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.BLOQUINGS_STATUS.FIELD,
        headerName: BENEFICIARIES_STRINGS.TABLE.BLOQUINGS_STATUS.LABEL,
        renderCell: ({
          row
        }: {
          row: { bloquingStatus: { description: string } }
        }) => checkNullValue(row?.bloquingStatus?.description)
      }
    ])
  }, [])

  return {
    assignmentColumns,
    headerActionsLeftAssignment
  }
}
```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/CompensationsPage.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { useScreenActions } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-useScreenActions'
import {
  AlertMui,
  ContentWrapper,
  NewTable
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS } from '@/shared/constants/actionCodes'

import useWebSocket from '../../hooks/webSocket'
import CompensationFilters from './Components/CompensationFilters'
import {
  useCompensationStates,
  useCompensationTable,
  useCompensationPaymentAndCollection,
  useCompensationClose
} from './Hooks'
import { COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS } from './compensationStrings'

export const CompensationsPage = () => {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [inforegisterDate, setInforegisterDate] = useState<Date | null>()
  const [infoComplianceDate, setInfoComplianceDate] = useState<Date | null>()
  const path = import.meta.env.VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_SOCKETS_URL
  const topic = `/topic/special-trade-compensation-payments/special-trade/${operation?.id}/payment-type/${payment?.id}`
  const { mensaje } = useWebSocket(path, topic)
  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
  const specialTradeId = searchParams.get('specialTradeId')
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const { hasAction } = useScreenActions()
  const {
    canClosureBtn,
    canExclusionInclusionColumn,
    canCollectBtn,
    canViewDetails,
    canEditCollection,
    canEditPayment,
    canPayBtn,
    canReconcileBtn,
    canSchedulesBtn,
    canTransactionsBtn
  } = useMemo(
    () => ({
      canClosureBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.CLOSURE),
      canExclusionInclusionColumn: hasAction(
        COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.EXCLUSION_INCLUSION
      ),
      canCollectBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.COLLECT),
      canViewDetails: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.DETAILS),
      canEditCollection: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.EDIT_COLLECTION),
      canEditPayment: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.EDIT_PAYMENT),
      canPayBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.PAY),
      canReconcileBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.RECONCILE),
      canSchedulesBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.SCHEDULES),
      canTransactionsBtn: hasAction(COMPENSATIONS_ACTIONS.TRANSACTIONS)
    }),
    [hasAction]
  )
  const {
    client_user,
    payEdit,
    handlePayEdit,
    handleSetCloseValidattion,
    closeValidattion,
    infoUserNubo
  } = useCompensationStates()

  const {
    columns,
    t,
    columnGroupingModel,
    getDataWithTotals,
    alert,
    setAlert
  } = useCompensationTable(rows, closeValidattion, operation, payment)

  const {
    openModal,
    paymentsProcessValidattionPayment,
    paymentsProcessValidattionCollection
  } = useCompensationPaymentAndCollection(
    client_user,
    rows,
    payEdit,
    handlePayEdit,
    setRows,
    canEditCollection,
    canEditPayment
  )

  const headerActionsLeft = () => (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      {canSchedulesBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => {
            console.log('object')
          }}
          className="w-[67px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 text-[13px] uppercase"
        >
          {t('Compensations.Horarios')}
        </Button>
      )}
      {canTransactionsBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => {
            navigate('/operation-spec-management/transaction-bank')
          }}
          className="px-[5px]gap-0 w-[110px] py-1 text-[13px] uppercase"
        >
          {t('Compensations.Transacciones')}
        </Button>
      )}
      {canReconcileBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => {
            navigate('/operation-spec-management/conciliation', {
              state: {
                operation,
                payment: payment?.id,
                registerDate: inforegisterDate,
                complianceDate: infoComplianceDate
              }
            })
          }}
          className="w-[71px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 text-[13px] uppercase"
        >
          {t('Compensations.Conciliar')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const { setModalClose, setModalRevert } = useCompensationClose(
    rows,
    client_user,
    operation,
    handleSetCloseValidattion,
    closeValidattion,
    infoUserNubo
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mensaje) {
      try {
        const parsedMessage = JSON.parse(mensaje)
        if (parsedMessage.content) {
          setRows(parsedMessage.content)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing WebSocket message:', error)
      }
    }
  }, [mensaje])

  const createButtons = (props: {
    type: string
    label: string
    class: string
    validation: boolean
  }) => {
    let message = ''
    if (props.validation)
      message =
        'Hay transacciones en proceso, por favor intenta nuevamente en unos minutos.'
    if (closeValidattion) message = 'La operación esta cerrada.'
    return (
      <DefaultComponents.Tooltip title={message}>
        <span>
          <Button
            variant="outlined"
            className={props.class}
            onClick={() => openModal(props.type)}
            disabled={props.validation}
          >
            {props.label}
          </Button>
        </span>
      </DefaultComponents.Tooltip>
    )
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper title={t('Compensations.CompensaciónOpEspecial')}>
      <CompensationFilters
        onPaymentChange={(value) => {
          setPayment(value)
        }}
        onOperationChange={setOperation}
        setInforegisterDate={setInforegisterDate}
        specialTradeId={specialTradeId}
        setInfoComplianceDate={setInfoComplianceDate}
      />
      {operation && payment && (
        <>
          <NewTable
            columns={columns(canViewDetails, canExclusionInclusionColumn)}
            customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
            hideFooter={true}
            height="auto"
            rows={getDataWithTotals(rows)}
            checkboxSelection={false}
            columnGroupingModel={columnGroupingModel(
              canViewDetails,
              canExclusionInclusionColumn
            )}
            columnGroupHeaderHeight={35}
            endpoint={`/special-trade-compensation/payments/special-trade/${operation?.id}/payment-type/${payment.id}`}
            axiosInstanceKey="httpSpecOperationsCompensations"
            method="POST"
            rowsPerPageOptions={[50]}
            getRowClassName={(params: any) => {
              if (params.id === 'total') {
                return 'border-t border-[#b8b8b8] sticky bottom-0 z-10 hover:bg-transparent'
              }
              return ''
            }}
          />

          <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex h-full w-full items-end justify-end gap-3">
            {canClosureBtn && (
              <Button
                variant="text"
                className="w-60 text-[#181818]"
                onClick={closeValidattion ? setModalRevert : setModalClose}
              >
                {closeValidattion ? 'Reversar' : 'Cierre'}
              </Button>
            )}
            {canPayBtn && (
              <span>
                {createButtons({
                  type: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SELL,
                  label: t('Compensations.Pagar'),
                  validation:
                    paymentsProcessValidattionPayment || closeValidattion,
                  class: `${paymentsProcessValidattionPayment || closeValidattion ? 'text-[#808080] border-[#808080] ' : 'text-[#FF4201] border-[#FF4201] '} w-60`
                })}
              </span>
            )}
            {canCollectBtn && (
              <span>
                {createButtons({
                  type: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.BUY,
                  label: t('Compensations.Recaudar'),
                  validation:
                    paymentsProcessValidattionCollection || closeValidattion,
                  class: `${paymentsProcessValidattionCollection || closeValidattion ? 'bg-[#808080]' : 'bg-[#FF4201]'} text-white w-60`
                })}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      <AlertMui
        message={
          !alert?.exclusion
            ? 'El participante ' +
              alert?.name +
              ' fue del incluido ciclo de recaudos y pagos.'
            : 'El participante ' +
              alert?.name +
              ' fue excluido del ciclo de recaudos y pagos.'
        }
        severity="success"
        onClose={() => setAlert(null)}
        open={alert}
      />
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}

```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/Components/CompensationFilters.tsx

```tsx
import { Select, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect } from 'react'

import {
  AutoCompleteInput,
  DataPicker
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { useCompensationFilters } from '../Hooks/useCompensationsFilters'

interface CompensationFiltersProps {
  onPaymentChange: (value: any) => void
  onOperationChange: (value: any) => void
  setInforegisterDate?: (value: Date | null) => void
  setInfoComplianceDate?: (value: Date | null) => void
  specialTradeId?: string | null
}

const CompensationFilters = ({
  onPaymentChange,
  onOperationChange,
  setInfoComplianceDate,
  setInforegisterDate,
  specialTradeId
}: CompensationFiltersProps) => {
  const {
    registerDate,
    setRegisterDate,
    complianceDate,
    setComplianceDate,
    country,
    countryOptions,
    payment,
    paymentOptions,
    handleChangePayment,
    selectedOption,
    handleOptionChange,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    handleChangeCountry
  } = useCompensationFilters({ onPaymentChange, onOperationChange })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (registerDate && setInforegisterDate) {
      setInforegisterDate(registerDate)
    }

    if (complianceDate && setInfoComplianceDate) {
      setInfoComplianceDate(complianceDate)
    }
  }, [registerDate, complianceDate])
  useEffect(() => {
    if (specialTradeId && !selectedOption) {
      // Buscar la operación por ID y setearla
      fetchOptionsSpecialOp(specialTradeId).then((options) => {
        const foundOperation = options.data.find(
          (option: any) => option.id.toString() === specialTradeId
        )
        if (foundOperation) {
          handleOptionChange(foundOperation)
        }
      })
    }
  }, [
    specialTradeId,
    selectedOption,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    handleOptionChange
  ])

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex w-full justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="w-full">
          <Select
            size="small"
            formControlProps={{ fullWidth: true }}
            options={countryOptions}
            onChange={handleChangeCountry}
            valueKey="id"
            labelKey="name"
            label="País"
            value={country}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha de registro"
            value={registerDate}
            onChange={(newValue: Date) => {
              setRegisterDate(newValue || null)
            }}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha de cumplimiento"
            value={complianceDate}
            onChange={(newValue: Date) => setComplianceDate(newValue || null)}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <AutoCompleteInput
            label="Operación especial"
            fetchOptions={fetchOptionsSpecialOp}
            onChange={handleOptionChange}
            value={selectedOption || specialTradeId}
            required
            itemsPerPage={10}
            minSearchLength={3}
            debounceTime={300}
            renderOption={(
              props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
              option: { id: number; label: string }
            ) => (
              <DefaultComponents.Box
                component="li"
                {...props}
                key={option.id}
                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </DefaultComponents.Box>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      {selectedOption && (
        <div className="mb-6 mt-4 w-full gap-6 rounded-md border border-white p-6 shadow-[0px_3px_3px_-2px_#00000033]">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">Operación Especial</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.label}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">País</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.country?.name ?? '---'}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">Forma de Pago</p>
                <Select
                  size="small"
                  options={paymentOptions}
                  onChange={handleChangePayment}
                  valueKey="id"
                  labelKey="name"
                  label="Forma de Pago"
                  value={payment}
                  sx={{
                    width: '220px'
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">Fecha de Registro</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.recordDate}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">Fecha de Cumplimiento</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.settlementDate}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}

export default CompensationFilters

```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/DetailsCompensationsPage/DetailsCompensantionsPage.tsx

```tsx
import { Select, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useLocation, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'

import {
  AutoCompleteInput,
  ContentWrapper,
  DataPicker,
  NewTable,
  Spinner
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers'
import {
  getDetailTotalPayments,
  getParticipant,
  getSides,
  getSpecialTrade,
  getTypePayment
} from '../../../services'
import { useDetailsCompensantions } from './Hooks/useDetailsCompensantions'

interface OptionType {
  label: string
  id: number
  country?: { name: string; id: number }
  recordDate?: string
  settlementDate?: string
}

export const DetailsCompensantionsPage = () => {
  const [registerDate, setRegisterDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [complianceDate, setComplianceDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [totalPayments, setTotalPayments] = useState({
    amountToCollect: 0,
    amountCollect: 0,
    amountDue: 0,
    totalPaid: 0
  })
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [paymentOptions, setPaymentOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: string }[]
  >([])
  const [country, setCountry] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [sideOptions, setSideOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; description: string }[]
  >([])
  const [sideSelected, setSideSelected] = useState<{
    id: number
    description: string
  } | null>(null)
  const { columns, t, getDataWithTotals } = useDetailsCompensantions(rows)
  const [specialOpSearchQuery, setSpecialOpSearchQuery] = useState<string>('')
  const [participantSearchQuery, setParticipantSearchQuery] =
    useState<string>('')
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<OptionType | null>(null)
  const recordDateSelected = selectedOption?.recordDate
    ? new Date(selectedOption.recordDate)
    : null
  const settlementDateSelected = selectedOption?.settlementDate
    ? new Date(selectedOption.settlementDate)
    : null
  const [selectedParticipant, setSelectedParticipant] =
    useState<OptionType | null>(null)
  const { operationId } = useParams<{
    operationId: string
    compensationId: string
  }>()
  const location = useLocation()
  const [stateParticipant, setStateParticipant] = useState(
    location.state?.participant || null
  )
  const [stateSide, setStateSide] = useState(location.state?.side || null)
  const [statePaymentMethod, setStatePaymentMethod] = useState(
    location.state?.paymentMethod || null
  )

  const handleChangePayment = (value: { id: number; name: string }) => {
    setPayment(value)
    setStatePaymentMethod(0)
  }

  const handleChangeCountry = (value: { id: number; name: string }) => {
    if (value?.id !== country?.id) {
      setCountry(value)
      setSelectedOption(null)
      setSelectedParticipant(null)
      setStateParticipant(null)
      setPayment(null)
      setStatePaymentMethod(0)
      setSideSelected(null)
      setStateSide(null)
    }
  }

  const CountryOptions = [
    { id: 135, name: 'Perú' },
    { id: 37, name: 'Colombia' },
    { id: 35, name: 'Chile' }
  ]

  const handleChangeSide = (value: { id: number; description: string }) => {
    setSideSelected(value)
    setStateSide(null)
  }

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const handleOptionChange = (option: OptionType | null) => {
    setSelectedOption(option)
    setSelectedParticipant(null)
    setStateParticipant(null)
    setPayment(null)
    setStatePaymentMethod(0)
    setSideSelected(null)
    setStateSide(null)
  }

  const handleChangeParticipant = (option: any) => {
    setSelectedParticipant(option)
    setStateParticipant(null)
    if (option === null) {
      setPayment(null)
      setStatePaymentMethod(0)
    }
  }

  const fetchOptionsSpecialOp = useCallback(
    async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        setSpecialOpSearchQuery(query ?? '')
        if (country || registerDate || complianceDate) {
          const response = await getSpecialTrade({
            specialOperationIdName: query,
            recordDate: registerDate || undefined,
            settlementDate: complianceDate || undefined,
            countryId: country?.id || undefined,
            options: { page, size }
          })

          return {
            data: response.content.map(
              (item: { id: number; specialOperationName: string }) => ({
                ...item,
                label: item.specialOperationName
              })
            ),
            total: response.totalElements
          }
        }

        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [country, registerDate, complianceDate]
  )

  const fetchOptionsParticipants = useCallback(
    async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        setParticipantSearchQuery(query ?? '')
        if (selectedOption) {
          const response = await getParticipant(
            selectedOption?.id,
            query,
            page,
            size
          )

          return {
            data: response.content.map(
              (item: { id: number; shortName: string }) => ({
                ...item,
                label: item.shortName
              })
            ),
            total: response.totalElements
          }
        }

        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [selectedOption]
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!operationId) {
      fetchOptionsSpecialOp(specialOpSearchQuery)
    }
  }, [
    country,
    registerDate,
    complianceDate,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    specialOpSearchQuery,
    operationId
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!operationId && selectedOption === null) {
      setSelectedParticipant(null)
      setStateParticipant(null)
    }
  }, [selectedOption, operationId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedOption) {
      fetchOptionsParticipants(participantSearchQuery)
    }
  }, [selectedOption, fetchOptionsParticipants, participantSearchQuery])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchPaymentOptions = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await getTypePayment() // Asegúrate de que esta función devuelva datos válidos
        const options = response.map(
          (item: { id: number; description: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.description // Asegúrate de que el campo sea correcto
          })
        )
        setPaymentOptions(options)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payment options:', error)
      }
    }

    fetchPaymentOptions()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchSideOptions = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await getSides()
        const options = response.map(
          (item: { id: number; description: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            description: item.description
          })
        )
        setSideOptions(options)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payment options:', error)
      }
    }

    fetchSideOptions()
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (operationId) {
      const fetchSpecialTrade = async () => {
        try {
          setLoading(true)
          const response = await getSpecialTrade({ id: operationId })
          const specialTrade = response.content[0]
          setSelectedOption({
            label: specialTrade.specialOperationName,
            id: specialTrade.id,
            country: specialTrade.country,
            recordDate: specialTrade.recordDate,
            settlementDate: specialTrade.settlementDate
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching special trade:', error)
        } finally {
          setLoading(false)
        }
      }

      fetchSpecialTrade()
    }
  }, [operationId])

  const showDetailsSection = selectedOption !== null

  const isDataGridVisible = useCallback(() => {
    const hasSelectedOption = !!selectedOption
    const hasPaymentMethod = (payment?.id || statePaymentMethod?.id) > 0
    const hasSide = (sideSelected?.id || stateSide?.id) > 0
    const hasParticipant = !!selectedParticipant || !!stateParticipant

    return hasSelectedOption && hasPaymentMethod && hasSide && hasParticipant
  }, [
    selectedOption,
    payment,
    statePaymentMethod,
    sideSelected,
    stateSide,
    selectedParticipant,
    stateParticipant
  ])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTotalPayments = async () => {
      try {
        if (isDataGridVisible()) {
          const response = await getDetailTotalPayments(
            selectedOption?.id,
            payment?.id || statePaymentMethod.id,
            selectedParticipant?.id ?? stateParticipant?.id
          )
          setTotalPayments(response)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payments:', error)
      }
    }

    fetchTotalPayments()
  }, [
    selectedOption?.id,
    payment,
    statePaymentMethod,
    selectedParticipant?.id,
    stateParticipant?.id,
    sideSelected,
    stateSide,
    isDataGridVisible
  ])

  if (loading) {
    return <Spinner />
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper title={t('CompensationsDetail.DetalleTitulo')}>
      <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex w-full justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="w-full">
          <Select
            size="small"
            formControlProps={{ fullWidth: true }}
            options={CountryOptions}
            onChange={handleChangeCountry}
            valueKey="id"
            labelKey="name"
            label="País"
            value={
              CountryOptions.find((option) => option.id === country?.id) ||
              selectedOption?.country
            }
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha de registro"
            value={
              registerDate
                ? registerDate.toISOString()
                : (recordDateSelected?.toISOString() ?? null)
            }
            onChange={(newValue: string) => {
              const parsed = newValue ? new Date(newValue) : null
              if (!operationId) {
                setRegisterDate(parsed || null)
                setSelectedParticipant(null)
                setStateParticipant(null)
                setPayment(null)
                setStatePaymentMethod(0)
                setSideSelected(null)
                setStateSide(null)
              } else {
                setRegisterDate(parsed || null)
              }
            }}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha de cumplimiento"
            value={
              complianceDate
                ? complianceDate.toISOString()
                : (settlementDateSelected?.toISOString() ?? null)
            }
            onChange={(newValue: string) => {
              const parsed = newValue ? new Date(newValue) : null
              if (!operationId) {
                setComplianceDate(parsed || null)
                setSelectedParticipant(null)
                setStateParticipant(null)
                setPayment(null)
                setStatePaymentMethod(0)
                setSideSelected(null)
                setStateSide(null)
              } else {
                setComplianceDate(parsed || null)
              }
            }}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <AutoCompleteInput
            label="Operación especial"
            fetchOptions={fetchOptionsSpecialOp}
            onChange={handleOptionChange}
            value={selectedOption}
            required
            itemsPerPage={10}
            minSearchLength={3}
            debounceTime={300}
            renderOption={(
              props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
              option: { id: number; label: string }
            ) => (
              <DefaultComponents.Box
                component="li"
                {...props}
                key={option.id}
                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </DefaultComponents.Box>
            )}
            key={`special-op-${country}-${registerDate?.toISOString() ?? ''}-${complianceDate?.toISOString() ?? ''}`}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full">
          <AutoCompleteInput
            label="Participante"
            fetchOptions={fetchOptionsParticipants}
            onChange={handleChangeParticipant}
            value={selectedParticipant || stateParticipant}
            required
            itemsPerPage={10}
            minSearchLength={3}
            debounceTime={300}
            renderOption={(
              props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
              option: { id: number; label: string }
            ) => (
              <DefaultComponents.Box
                component="li"
                {...props}
                key={option.id}
                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </DefaultComponents.Box>
            )}
            disabled={!selectedOption}
            key={`participant-${selectedOption?.id}`}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {showDetailsSection && (
        <div className="mb-6 mt-4 w-full gap-6 rounded-md border border-white p-6 shadow-[0px_3px_3px_-2px_#00000033]">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('Compensations.OperacionEspecial')}
                </p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.label}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">{t('Compensations.Pais')}</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.country?.name ?? '--'}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">{t('Compensations.FormaPago')}</p>
                <Select
                  options={paymentOptions}
                  size="small"
                  valueKey="id"
                  labelKey="name"
                  onChange={handleChangePayment}
                  className="w-[220px]"
                  // height="28px"
                  value={payment || statePaymentMethod}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">{t('Compensations.Punta')}</p>
                <Select
                  options={sideOptions}
                  size="small"
                  labelKey="description"
                  valueKey="id"
                  onChange={handleChangeSide}
                  className="w-[220px]"
                  // height="28px"
                  value={sideSelected || stateSide}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">{t('Compensations.FechaRegistro')}</p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.recordDate}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('Compensations.FechaCumplimiento')}
                </p>
                <p>{selectedOption?.settlementDate}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('CompensationsDetail.Participante')}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {selectedParticipant?.label ??
                    stateParticipant?.shortName ??
                    '--'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {isDataGridVisible() && (
        <NewTable
          columns={columns}
          setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
          hideFooter={true}
          height="auto"
          checkboxSelection={false}
          endpoint={`/special-trade-compensation/detail/special-trade/${selectedOption?.id}/payment-type/${payment?.id || statePaymentMethod?.id}/participant/${selectedParticipant?.id ?? stateParticipant?.id}/side/${sideSelected?.id || (stateSide?.id ?? 0)}`}
          axiosInstanceKey="httpSpecOperationsCompensations"
          rows={getDataWithTotals(rows)}
          getRowClassName={(params: any) => {
            if (params.id === 'total') {
              return 'border-t border-[#b8b8b8] sticky bottom-0 z-10 hover:bg-transparent'
            }
            return ''
          }}
        />
      )}

      {isDataGridVisible() && totalPayments && (
        <div className="mt-6 flex w-full flex-col rounded border border-[#cccccc] p-6">
          <div className="flex w-full gap-6">
            <div className="flex w-1/2 flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex w-full justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('CompensationsDetail.RecaudoParticipante')}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                    totalPayments.amountCollect
                  ) ?? '--'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex w-full justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('CompensationsDetail.SaldoRecaudar')}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                    totalPayments.amountToCollect
                  ) ?? '--'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex w-1/2 flex-col gap-6">
              <div className="flex w-full justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('CompensationsDetail.PagadoParticipante')}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                    totalPayments.totalPaid
                  ) ?? '--'}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex w-full justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
                <p className="font-bold">
                  {t('CompensationsDetail.SaldoPagar')}
                </p>
                <p>
                  {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                    totalPayments.amountDue
                  ) ?? '--'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```
