## src/pages/CompensationsPage/DetailsCompensationsPage/Hooks/useDetailsCompensantions.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid'
import { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'

import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator
} from '../../../../helpers'

export const useDetailsCompensantions = (rows: any) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')

  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  const columns: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Folio'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Folio'),
      renderCell: (params) => {
        if (params.row.id === 'total' || params.row.summaryRow) {
          return <Container className="font-bold">Monto Total</Container>
        }
        return checkNullValue(params.row.matchId)
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Fraccion'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Fraccion'),
      renderCell: (params) => checkNullValue(params.row?.fraction)
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Punta'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Punta'),
      renderCell: (params) => checkNullValue(params.row?.side.description)
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Nemotecnico'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Nemotecnico'),
      renderCell: (params) => checkNullValue(params.row?.securityTitle.mnemonic)
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Cantidad'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Cantidad'),
      renderCell: (params) => checkNullValue(params.row?.quantity)
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Precio'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Precio'),
      renderCell: (params) =>
        checkNullValue(formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(params.row?.price))
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Monto'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Monto'),
      renderCell: (params) =>
        checkNullValue(formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(params.row?.amount)),
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 190,
      field: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Field.Estado'),
      headerName: t('CompensationsDetail.Table.Estado'),
      renderCell: (params) => checkNullValue(params.row?.status.description)
    }
  ]

  const calculateTotals = () => {
    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return null

    const totals = {
      id: 'total',
      summaryRow: true,
      matchId: null,
      fraction: null,
      side: { description: '' },
      securityTitle: { mnemonic: '' },
      quantity: null,
      price: null,
      amount: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amount: any }) => sum + (Number(row?.amount) || 0),
        0
      ),
      status: { description: '' }
    }

    return totals
  }

  const getDataWithTotals = (originalData: any[]) => {
    const totalsRow = calculateTotals()
    return totalsRow ? [...originalData, totalsRow] : originalData
  }

  return {
    columns,
    getDataWithTotals,
    t
  }
}
```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/Hooks/useCompensationClose.tsx

```tsx
import { useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { CompensationsModel } from '../../../models'
import { sendClose, sendRevert } from '../../../services'
import { OptionType } from './useCompensationTable'

export const useCompensationClose = (
  rows: CompensationsModel[],
  client_user: string | null,
  operation: OptionType | null,
  handleSetCloseValidattion: (value: boolean) => void,
  closeValidattion: boolean,
  infoUserNubo: any
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [isRevertButtonActive, setIsRevertButtonActive] =
    useState<boolean>(true)
  const specialTradeId = operation?.id
  const { participantId, id: id_user_nubo, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  useEffect(() => {
    handleSetCloseValidattion(operation?.status.id === 46)
  }, [operation?.status.id])

  function getDiffStatusList(
    rows: CompensationsModel[]
  ): { status: string; count: number }[] {
    return rows.reduce(
      (acc, curr) => {
        if (
          curr.status.id !== 12 &&
          curr.status.id !== 44 &&
          curr.status.id !== 45
        ) {
          const existing = acc.find(
            (item) => item.status === curr.status.description
          )
          if (!existing) {
            acc.push({ status: curr.status.description, count: 1 })
          } else {
            existing.count++
          }
        }
        return acc
      },
      [] as { status: string; count: number }[]
    )
  }

  const getDiffChildren = (list: { status: string; count: number }[]) => {
    return (
      <>
        <ul>
          {list.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.status}>{`${item.status}: ${item.count}`}</li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <div className="flex justify-center">¿Desea cerrar la operación?</div>
      </>
    )
  }

  const handleSendClose = async () => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      if (specialTradeId !== undefined) {
        if (await sendClose(client_user, specialTradeId)) {
          context?.setToast({
            show: true,
            text: 'La operación ha sido cerrada con éxito.',
            variant: 'success'
          })
          handleSetCloseValidattion(true)
          if (client_user) {
            GenerateLogs(client_user, {
              actionType: `Operación de compensación cerrada`,
              actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/compensations',
              participantId: participantId,
              countryId: country?.id,
              userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
              statusId: status?.id
            })
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title:
          'Error al realizar el cierre de la compensación de la operación especial',
        variant: 'error',
        textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleSendRevert = async () => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      if (specialTradeId !== undefined) {
        if (await sendRevert(client_user, specialTradeId)) {
          context?.setToast({
            show: true,
            text: `El cierre de la operación "${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.id} - ${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName}" ha sido reversado con éxito`,
            variant: 'success'
          })
          handleSetCloseValidattion(false)
          if (client_user) {
            GenerateLogs(client_user, {
              actionType: `Cierre de la operación de compensación revertida`,
              actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/compensations',
              participantId: participantId,
              countryId: country?.id,
              userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
              statusId: status?.id
            })
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title:
          'Error al revertir el cierre de la compensación de la operación especial',
        variant: 'error',
        textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const setModalClose = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: `¿Esta seguro de generar el cierre de la compensación para la operación especial ${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.id} - ${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName}?`,
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Confirmar cierre',
      textCancel: 'Volver',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        setModalDiff()
      }
    })
  }

  const setModalDiff = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: 'Diferencias en el cierre de la operación',
      message: 'Existen folios con estados pendientes de cumplimiento.',
      variant: 'error',
      textSuccess: 'Confirmar cierre',
      textCancel: 'Cancelar',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      children: getDiffChildren(getDiffStatusList(rows)),
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        handleSendClose()
      }
    })
  }

  const setModalRevertConfirm = () => {
    setActiveRevertButton()
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: `¿Esta seguro de reversar el cierre para la operación especial "${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.id} - ${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName}"?`,
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Si, reversar',
      textCancel: 'Volver',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        handleSendRevert()
      },
      handleCancel: () => setIsRevertButtonActive(false)
    })
  }

  const setModalRevert = () => {
    setActiveRevertButton()
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: `Esta operación "${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.id} - ${rows[0]?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName}" ya ha sido cerrada, ¿deseas reversar el cierre?`,
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Si, reversar',
      disabled: isRevertButtonActive,
      textCancel: 'Volver',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        setIsRevertButtonActive(false)
        setModalRevertConfirm()
      },
      handleCancel: () => {
        setIsRevertButtonActive(false)
      }
    })
  }

  const setActiveRevertButton = () => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsRevertButtonActive(false)
    }, 3000)
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isRevertButtonActive) {
      setModalRevert()
    }
  }, [isRevertButtonActive])

  return {
    setModalClose,
    setModalRevert,
    closeValidattion
  }
}

```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/Hooks/useCompensationPaymentAndCollection.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import axios from 'axios'
import {
  Dispatch,
  ReactNode,
  SetStateAction,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState
} from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  ButtonMui,
  GenerateLogs,
  InputModal,
  NewTable
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatClientDatetime,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator,
  getErrorMessage
} from '../../../helpers'
import { CompensationsModel } from '../../../models'
import { PaymentAndCollectionModel } from '../../../models/compensations'
import { sendPaymentAndCollection } from '../../../services'
import { COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS } from '../compensationStrings'

const Container = ({
  children,
  className
}: {
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
}) => (
  <div className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}>
    {children}
  </div>
)

export const useCompensationPaymentAndCollection = (
  client_user: string | null,
  rows: CompensationsModel[],
  payEdit: boolean,
  handlePayEdit: (value: boolean) => void,
  setRows: Dispatch<SetStateAction<any[]>>,
  canEditCollection: boolean,
  canEditPayment: boolean
) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [modalType, setModalType] = useState<string>('')
  const [rowsFiltered, setRowsFiltered] = useState<CompensationsModel[]>([])
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const { participantId, id, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  const paymentsProcessValidattionPayment = rows.some(
    (row) =>
      row.side?.id === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SIDE_SELL_NUMBER &&
      row.status.id === 201
  )
  const paymentsProcessValidattionCollection = rows.some(
    (row) =>
      row.side?.id === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SIDE_BUY_NUMBER &&
      (row.status.id === 200 || row.status.id === 220)
  )

  const handleFormChange = (
    id: number,
    event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>
  ) => {
    if (event.target.value === '' || event.target.value === null) return
    setRowsFiltered(
      rowsFiltered.map((row) => {
        if (row.id === id) {
          return { ...row, [event.target.name]: event.target.value }
        }
        return row
      })
    )
  }

  const modalHeaderActionsRight = () => {
    const isSell = modalType === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SELL
    const canEdit = isSell ? canEditPayment : canEditCollection

    return canEdit ? (
      <ButtonMui
        text={t('PaymentAndCollection.Editar')}
        size="small"
        variant="text"
        color="secondary"
        handleClick={() => openAlert()}
        className="w-[67px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase text-[#FF4201] outline-none"
        icon="EditIcon"
        iconLeft={true}
        iconSize={15}
      />
    ) : null
  }

  const isSell = modalType === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SELL
  const PaymentAndCollectionColumns: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      width: 150,
      field:
        COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_PAYMENT_OPTION,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.FormaPago'),
      renderCell: ({ row }) => checkNullValue(row.paymentType.description)
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      field: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_PARTICIPANT,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.Participante'),
      renderCell: ({ row }) => checkNullValue(row.participant.name)
    },
    {
      width: 115,
      field: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_SIDE,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.Punta'),
      renderCell: ({ row }) => checkNullValue(row.side.description)
    },
    {
      width: 115,
      field: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_MOVEMENT,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.Movimiento'),
      renderCell: () =>
        checkNullValue(
          isSell
            ? t('PaymentAndCollection.Pago')
            : t('PaymentAndCollection.Recaudo')
        )
    },
    {
      width: 115,
      field: isSell
        ? COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_AMOUNT_PAYMENT
        : COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS
            .FIELD_AMOUNT_COLLECTION,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.Valor'),
      renderCell: ({ row, field, value }) =>
        payEdit ? (
          <Container>
            <InputModal
              id={row.id}
              field={field}
              value={value}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
              validate={
                COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS
                  .VALIDATE_NUMBERS
              }
            />
          </Container>
        ) : (
          checkNullValue(formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(value, true) || '0')
        )
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      field: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_COLLECTION_COLUMNS.FIELD_OBSERVATION,
      headerName: t('PaymentAndCollection.Observacion'),
      renderCell: ({ row, field, value }) =>
        payEdit ? (
          <Container>
            <InputModal
              id={row.id}
              field={field}
              value={value}
              onChange={handleFormChange}
            />
          </Container>
        ) : (
          checkNullValue(value)
        )
    }
  ]

  const openModal = (type: string) => {
    setModalType(type)
    const title =
      type === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SELL
        ? t('PaymentAndCollection.Pago')
        : t('PaymentAndCollection.Recaudo')
    if (rowsFiltered.length === 0) {
      setRowsFiltered(
        rows.filter(
          (row) => row.side.description === type && row.exclusion === false
        )
      )
    }
    if (rowsFiltered.length != 0) {
      context?.setModalContent({
        title: `${t('PaymentAndCollection.ModalContent.Title')} ${title}`,
        description: t('PaymentAndCollection.ModalContent.Description'),
        btnAceptText: 'Aceptar',
        btnCancelText: 'Cancelar',
        handleAccept: handleSendPaymentAndCollection,
        handleClose: () => {
          setModalType('')
          setRowsFiltered([])
          handlePayEdit(false)
        },
        children: (
          <NewTable
            columns={PaymentAndCollectionColumns}
            rows={rowsFiltered}
            checkboxSelection={false}
            customToolbar={modalHeaderActionsRight()}
          />
        )
      })
    }
  }

  const handleSendPaymentAndCollection = async () => {
    context?.clearModalAlert()
    try {
      const isSell = modalType === COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.SELL
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const payload: PaymentAndCollectionModel[] = rowsFiltered.map((row) => ({
        sideId: row.side.id,
        specialTradeId: row.specialTrade.id,
        participantId: row.participant.id,
        paymentTypeId: row.paymentType.id,
        transactionAmount: isSell
          ? row.totalPayments || 0
          : row.totalCollect || 0,
        transactionDate: formatClientDatetime(),
        currencyId: row.currency.id,
        observations: row.observation || ''
      }))

      const response = await sendPaymentAndCollection(
        client_user,
        payload,
        isSell
          ? COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.PAYMENT_API_URL
          : COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.COLLECTION_API_URL
      )
      if (response) {
        GenerateLogs(client_user!, {
          actionType: `Transacciones ${isSell ? t('PaymentAndCollection.Pago') : t('PaymentAndCollection.Recaudo')} (${rowsFiltered.length}): IDs [${rowsFiltered.map((row) => row.id).join(', ')}]`,
          actionDestination: 'Compensación de Operaciones Especiales',
          participantId,
          countryId: country.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
        context?.setLoading(false)
        context?.clearModalContent()
        setModalType('')
        setRowsFiltered([])
        handlePayEdit(false)
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: `${isSell ? t('PaymentAndCollection.Pago') : t('PaymentAndCollection.Recaudo')} ${t('PaymentAndCollection.ToastTitleSuccess')}`,
          variant: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.VARIANT_SUCCESS
        })
      }

      setRows(
        rows.map((row) =>
          rowsFiltered.some((filteredRow) => filteredRow.id === row.id)
            ? { ...row, status: { id: 200, description: 'REGISTRADO' } }
            : row
        )
      )
    } catch (error) {
      let message = t('PaymentAndCollection.UnknownError')
      if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
        message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
        if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500')
          message = t('PaymentAndCollection.ServerError')
      }

      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: t('PaymentAndCollection.ModalAlert.Error.Title'),
        variant: 'error',
        message: message,
        textSuccess: t('PaymentAndCollection.Aceptar'),
        textCancel: COMPENSATIONS_STRINGS.VARIANT_HIDDEN,
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const openAlert = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: t('PaymentAndCollection.ModalAlert.Warning.Title'),
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: t('PaymentAndCollection.ModalAlert.Warning.TextSuccess'),
      textCancel: t('PaymentAndCollection.Cancelar'),
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        handlePayEdit(true)
        context?.clearModalAlert()
      }
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    modalType != '' && openModal(modalType)
  }, [payEdit, rowsFiltered])

  return {
    openModal,
    modalHeaderActionsRight,
    paymentsProcessValidattionPayment,
    paymentsProcessValidattionCollection
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

import { STRINGS } from '../../../helpers/strings'

export const useCompensationStates = () => {
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME)
  const [payEdit, setPayEdit] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [closeValidattion, setCloseValidattion] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)

  const handleSetCloseValidattion = (value: boolean) => {
    setCloseValidattion(value)
  }

  const handlePayEdit = (value: boolean) => {
    setPayEdit(value)
  }

  return {
    client_user,
    payEdit,
    handlePayEdit,
    handleSetCloseValidattion,
    closeValidattion,
    infoUserNubo
  }
}
```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/Hooks/useCompensationTable.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColumnGroupingModel } from '@mui/x-data-grid'
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { ReactNode, useContext, useState } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator
} from '../../../helpers'
import { updateCompensation } from '../../../services'

export interface OptionType {
  label: string
  id: number
  country?: { name: string }
  recordDate?: string
  settlementDate?: string
  status: {
    id: number
  }
}

export const useCompensationTable = (
  rows: any,
  closeValidattion: boolean,
  operation?: any,
  payment?: any
) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState<{
    name: string
    exclusion: boolean
  } | null>(null)
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  const handleSwitchChange = async (
    id: number,
    name: string,
    exclusion: boolean
  ) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      await updateCompensation([
        {
          specialTradeCompensationId: id,
          exclusion: exclusion
        }
      ])
      setAlert({ name, exclusion })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating exclusion:', error)
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(true)
    }
  }

  const columns = (
    canViewDetails: boolean,
    canExclusionInclusionColumn: boolean
  ): GridColDef[] => [
    ...(canViewDetails
      ? [
          {
            flex: 1,
            minWidth: 97,
            field: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles'),
            headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles'),
            renderCell: (params: any) => {
              if (params.row.id === 'total' || params.row.summaryRow) {
                return <Container className="font-bold">Total</Container>
              }
              const basePath = `/operation-spec-management/compensations/details/${params.row.id}`
              const fullPath = operation
                ? `${basePath}/${operation.id}`
                : basePath
              return (
                <Container>
                  <Link
                    className="text-red-500 underline decoration-solid"
                    to={fullPath}
                    state={{
                      participant: {
                        ...params.row.participant,
                        label: params.row.participant.shortName
                      },
                      side: params.row.side,
                      paymentMethod: payment
                    }}
                  >
                    Ver detalles
                  </Link>
                </Container>
              )
            },
            cellClassName: ({ row }: { row: { summaryRow: boolean } }) =>
              row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : ''
          }
        ]
      : []),
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Participante'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Participante'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { participant: { name: string } } }) =>
        checkNullValue(row.participant?.name),
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Punta'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Punta'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { side: { description: string } } }) =>
        checkNullValue(row.side?.description),
      rowSpanValueGetter: () => null
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Field.totalCollect'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalRecaudo'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalCollect) || '0'
        ),
      rowSpanValueGetter: () => null,
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountToCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountToCollect) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountCollect) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalPayments: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalPayments) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountDue: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountDue) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { paymentsProcess: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.paymentsProcess) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { manualPayments: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.manualPayments) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalPaid: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalPaid) || '0'
        )
    },
    ...(canExclusionInclusionColumn
      ? [
          {
            flex: 1,
            minWidth: 115,
            field: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión'),
            headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión'),
            renderCell: (params: any) => {
              if (params.row.id === 'total' || params.row.summaryRow) {
                return '-'
              }
              return (
                <DefaultComponents.Switch
                  defaultChecked={params.row.exclusion}
                  size="small"
                  disabled={closeValidattion}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    handleSwitchChange(
                      params.row.id,
                      params.row.participant.shortName,
                      event.target.checked
                    )
                  }
                />
              )
            }
          }
        ]
      : [])
  ]

  const columnGroupingModel = (
    canViewDetails: boolean,
    canExclusionInclusionColumn: boolean
  ): GridColumnGroupingModel => [
    {
      groupId: 'Detalles',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      headerName: '',
      children: [
        { field: '__check__' },
        ...(canViewDetails
          ? [{ field: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles') }]
          : []),
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Participante') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Punta') }
      ]
    },
    {
      groupId: 'Recaudos',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      children: [
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Field.totalCollect') }
      ]
    },
    {
      groupId: 'Pagos',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      children: [
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado') },
        ...(canExclusionInclusionColumn
          ? [{ field: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión') }]
          : [])
      ]
    }
  ]

  const calculateTotals = () => {
    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return null

    const totals = {
      id: 'total',
      summaryRow: true,
      participant: { name: '' },
      side: { description: '' },
      totalPaid: null,
      totalCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { totalCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.totalCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountToCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountToCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountToCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      totalPayments: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { totalPayments: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.totalPayments) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountDue: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountDue: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountDue) || 0),
        0
      ),
      paymentsProcess: null,
      manualPayments: null,
      exclusion: false
    }

    return totals
  }

  const getDataWithTotals = (originalData: any[]) => {
    const totalsRow = calculateTotals()
    return totalsRow ? [...originalData, totalsRow] : originalData
  }

  return {
    columns,
    t,
    columnGroupingModel,
    getDataWithTotals,
    setAlert,
    alert
  }
}
```

## src/pages/CompensationsPage/Hooks/useCompensationsFilters.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useContext } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getCountry, getSpecialTrade, getTypePayment } from '../../../services'
import { OptionType } from './useCompensationTable'

interface CompensationFiltersProps {
  onPaymentChange: (value: any) => void
  onOperationChange: (value: any) => void
}

export const useCompensationFilters = ({
  onPaymentChange,
  onOperationChange
}: CompensationFiltersProps) => {
  const [registerDate, setRegisterDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [complianceDate, setComplianceDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [country, setCountry] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [countryOptions, setCountryOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: string }[]
  >([])
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [paymentOptions, setPaymentOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: string }[]
  >([])
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('')
  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
  const specialTradeId = searchParams.get('specialTradeId')

  const fetchOptionsSpecialOp = useCallback(
    async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        setSearchQuery(query ?? '')
        const response = await getSpecialTrade({
          specialOperationIdName: query,
          recordDate: registerDate || undefined,
          settlementDate: complianceDate || undefined,
          countryId: country?.id || undefined,
          options: { page, size }
        })

        return {
          data: response.content.map(
            (item: { id: number; specialOperationName: string }) => ({
              ...item,
              label: item.specialOperationName
            })
          ),
          total: response.totalElements
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [country, registerDate, complianceDate]
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp(searchQuery)
  }, [
    country,
    registerDate,
    complianceDate,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    searchQuery
  ])

  const handleChangeCountry = (value: { id: number; name: string }) =>
    setCountry(value)

  const handleChangePayment = (payment: { id: number; name: string }) => {
    setPayment(payment)
    onPaymentChange(payment)
  }
  const handleOptionChange = (option: OptionType | null) => {
    setSelectedOption(option)
    onOperationChange(option)
    if (option === null) {
      setPayment(payment)
      onPaymentChange(payment)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (specialTradeId) {
      const fetchSpecialTrade = async () => {
        try {
          context?.setLoading(true)
          const response = await getSpecialTrade({ id: specialTradeId })
          const specialTrade = response.content[0]
          setSelectedOption({
            label: specialTrade.specialOperationName,
            id: specialTrade.id,
            country: specialTrade.country,
            recordDate: specialTrade.recordDate,
            settlementDate: specialTrade.settlementDate,
            status: specialTrade.status
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching special trade:', error)
        } finally {
          context?.setLoading(false)
        }
      }

      fetchSpecialTrade()
    } else {
      fetchOptionsSpecialOp(searchQuery)
    }
  }, [specialTradeId, searchQuery, fetchOptionsSpecialOp])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchOptions = async () => {
      try {
        context?.setLoading(true) // Activar loading
        const [response, responseCountries] = await Promise.all([
          getTypePayment(),
          getCountry()
        ])

        const paymentOptions = response.map(
          (item: { id: number; description: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.description
          })
        )

        const countryOptions = responseCountries.map(
          (item: { id: number; name: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.name
          })
        )

        setPaymentOptions(paymentOptions)
        setCountryOptions(countryOptions)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payment or country options:', error)
      } finally {
        context?.setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    fetchOptions()
  }, [])

  return {
    registerDate,
    searchQuery,
    setRegisterDate,
    complianceDate,
    setComplianceDate,
    country,
    countryOptions,
    handleChangeCountry,
    payment,
    paymentOptions,
    handleChangePayment,
    selectedOption,
    handleOptionChange,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp
  }
}

```

```tsx
import { Button, MaterialIcons } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'

interface BtnFileUploadProps {
  onClick: (arg: boolean) => void
  payment?: number
}

export const BtnFileUpload = ({ onClick, payment }: BtnFileUploadProps) => {
  return (
    <Button
      size="large"
      onClick={() => onClick(true)}
      disabled={payment === 0}
      className={`flex w-[220px] justify-evenly px-2 text-[15px] font-medium ${
        payment !== 0
          ? 'bg-[#FF4201] text-[#FFFFFF]'
          : 'bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] text-[rgba(0,0,0,0.38)]'
      }`}
    >
      <MaterialIcons.FileUploadOutlined className="mr-2" />
```

## src/pages/ConciliationPage/Components/ConciliationComponent.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import { useScreenActions } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-useScreenActions'
import {
  MuiSelect,
  DataPicker,
  AutoCompleteInput
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { CONCILIATIONS_ACTIONS } from '@/shared/constants/actionCodes'

import { ConciliationData } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { useConciliationFilters } from '../Hooks/useConciliationFilters'
import { BtnFileDownload } from './BtnFileDownload'
import { BtnFileUpload } from './BtnFileUpload'
import { CheckBalances } from './CheckBalances'
import { CheckResult } from './CheckResult'
import { OperationInformation } from './OperationInformation'
import { VerificationOfExtract } from './VerificationOfExtract'

interface ConciliationComponentProps {
  onPaymentChange: (value: any) => void
  onOperationChange: (value: any) => void
  setOpen: (value: boolean) => void
  setConfirmConciliation: (value: boolean) => void
  setConfirmConciliationInfo: (value: any) => void
  conciliationData: ConciliationData
  setConciliationData: (value: ConciliationData) => void
  setPushMessage: (value: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast: (value: boolean) => void
  operationParams: any
  paymentParams: any
  registerDateParams?: Date | null
  complianceDateParams?: Date | null
}

const ConciliationComponent = ({
  onPaymentChange,
  onOperationChange,
  setOpen,
  setConfirmConciliation,
  setConfirmConciliationInfo,
  conciliationData,
  setConciliationData,
  setPushMessage,
  setViewToast,
  operationParams = {},
  paymentParams
}: ConciliationComponentProps) => {
  const [conciliationState, setConciliationState] = useState<string>('')
  const { hasAction } = useScreenActions()
  const {
    canViewConciliateBtn,
    canViewConfirmConciliationBtn,
    canViewDownloadReportBtn,
    canViewLoadDocumentBtn
  } = useMemo(
    () => ({
      canViewConciliateBtn: hasAction(CONCILIATIONS_ACTIONS.CONCILIATE),
      canViewConfirmConciliationBtn: hasAction(
        CONCILIATIONS_ACTIONS.CONFIRM_CONCILIATION
      ),
      canViewDownloadReportBtn: hasAction(
        CONCILIATIONS_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_REPORT
      ),
      canViewLoadDocumentBtn: hasAction(CONCILIATIONS_ACTIONS.LOAD_DOCUMENT)
    }),
    [hasAction]
  )
  const {
    registerDate,
    setRegisterDate,
    complianceDate,
    setComplianceDate,
    country,
    countryOptions,
    handleChangeCountry,
    payment,
    paymentOptions,
    handleChangePayment,
    selectedOption,
    handleOptionChange,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    handleConciliation,
    operationInfo,
    t
  } = useConciliationFilters({
    onPaymentChange,
    onOperationChange,
    setConciliationData,
    setPushMessage,
    setViewToast,
    setConciliationState
  })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (conciliationData) {
      setConfirmConciliationInfo(conciliationData)
    }
  }, [conciliationData])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (Object.keys(operationParams).length > 0 && paymentParams) {
      setRegisterDate(
        operationParams?.recordDate ? operationParams?.recordDate : null
      )
      setComplianceDate(
        operationParams?.settlementDate ? operationParams?.settlementDate : null
      )
      handleChangeCountry(operationParams?.country.id)
      handleOptionChange(operationParams)
      handleChangePayment(paymentParams)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex w-full justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="w-full">
          <MuiSelect
            options={countryOptions}
            onChange={handleChangeCountry}
            placeholder={t('Conciliacion.Filtros.SelectorPais')}
            value={country}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label={t('Conciliacion.Filtros.SelectorFechaRegistro')}
            value={registerDate}
            onChange={(newValue: Date) => setRegisterDate(newValue)}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="w-full">
          <DataPicker
            label={t('Conciliacion.Filtros.SelectorFechaCumplimiento')}
            value={complianceDate}
            onChange={(newValue: Date) => setComplianceDate(newValue)}
            height={40}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="w-full">
          <AutoCompleteInput
            label={t('Conciliacion.Filtros.SelectorOperacionEspecial')}
            fetchOptions={fetchOptionsSpecialOp}
            onChange={handleOptionChange}
            value={selectedOption}
            disabled={country === 0}
            itemsPerPage={10}
            minSearchLength={1}
            debounceTime={300}
            renderOption={(
              props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
              option: { id: number; label: string }
            ) => (
              <DefaultComponents.Box
                component="li"
                {...props}
                key={option.id}
                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </DefaultComponents.Box>
            )}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <DefaultComponents.Typography
        variant="h6"
        className="font-medium text-[#3D3D3D]"
      >
        {t('Conciliacion.Title.TitleInformacionOperacion')}
      </DefaultComponents.Typography>

      <OperationInformation
        operationInfo={operationInfo[0]}
        payment={payment}
        handleChangePayment={handleChangePayment}
        paymentOptions={paymentOptions}
        conciliationTime={conciliationData?.conciliationTime}
        selectedOption={selectedOption}
      />

      <div className="mb-4 flex w-full">
        {canViewLoadDocumentBtn && (
          <BtnFileUpload onClick={setOpen} payment={payment} />
        )}
        {canViewDownloadReportBtn && (
          <BtnFileDownload conciliationData={conciliationData} />
        )}
      </div>

      <h2 className="font-Roboto text-xl font-medium text-[#3D3D3D]">
        {t('Conciliacion.Title.TitleVerificacionExtracto')}
      </h2>

      <VerificationOfExtract conciliationData={conciliationData} />

      <h2 className="font-Roboto text-xl font-medium text-[#3D3D3D]">
        {t('Conciliacion.Title.TitleVerificarSaldos')}
      </h2>

      <CheckBalances conciliationData={conciliationData} />

      <h2 className="font-Roboto text-xl font-medium text-[#3D3D3D]">
        {t('Conciliacion.Title.TitleVerificarResultado')}
      </h2>

      <CheckResult
        conciliationData={conciliationData}
        conciliationState={conciliationState}
      />

      <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-end gap-3">
        {canViewConciliateBtn && (
          <Button
            size="large"
            variant="outlined"
            onClick={handleConciliation}
            disabled={payment === 0}
            className={`w-[240px] ${
              payment !== 0
                ? 'border-[#FF4201] text-[#FF4201]'
                : 'border-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] text-[rgba(0,0,0,0.38)]'
            }`}
          >
            {t('Conciliacion.Botones.Conciliar')}
          </Button>
        )}
        {canViewConfirmConciliationBtn && (
          <Button
            size="large"
            onClick={() => setConfirmConciliation(true)}
            disabled={
              conciliationData?.status?.id !== 205 &&
              conciliationData?.status?.id !== 207
            }
            className={`w-[240px] px-2 ${
              conciliationData?.status?.id !== 205 &&
              conciliationData?.status?.id !== 207
                ? 'bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] text-[rgba(0,0,0,0.38)]'
                : 'bg-[#FF4201] text-[#FFFFFF]'
            }`}
          >
            {t('Conciliacion.Botones.ConfirmarConciliacion')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

export default ConciliationComponent

```

```tsx
import { format, isValid, parseISO } from 'date-fns'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'

import { MuiSelect } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

interface OperationInformationProps {
  selectedOption: any | null
  payment: any
  handleChangePayment: (value: any) => void
  paymentOptions: any[]
  conciliationTime: string | undefined
  operationInfo: any | null
}

export const OperationInformation = ({
  handleChangePayment,
  payment,
  selectedOption,
  paymentOptions,
  conciliationTime,
  operationInfo
}: OperationInformationProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')

  const formatDate = (date: any) => {
    const parsedDate = typeof date === 'string' ? parseISO(date) : date
    return isValid(parsedDate) ? format(parsedDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy') : '--'
  }

  return (
    <div className="mb-6 mt-4 w-full gap-6 rounded-md border border-white p-6 shadow-[0px_3px_3px_-2px_#00000033]">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.OperacionEspecial')}
            </p>
            <p>{`${operationInfo?.specialOperationId ?? '--'} ${operationInfo?.specialOperationName ?? ''}`}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.Pais')}
            </p>
            <p>{operationInfo?.country?.name ?? '--'}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.FormaPago')}
            </p>
            <MuiSelect
              options={paymentOptions}
              onChange={handleChangePayment}
              className="w-[220px]"
              height="28px"
              placeholder="Seleccione"
              value={payment}
              disabled={selectedOption === null}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.FechaRegistro')}
            </p>
            <p>{formatDate(operationInfo?.recordDate)}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.FechaCumplimiento')}
            </p>
            <p>{formatDate(operationInfo?.settlementDate)}</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
            <p className="font-bold">
              {t('Conciliacion.InformacionOperacion.FechaConciliacion')}
            </p>
            <p>{conciliationTime ? formatDate(conciliationTime) : '--'}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { ConciliationData } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers/formattedNumber'
import { TotalAccounts } from './TotalAccounts'

interface VerificationProps {
  conciliationData?: ConciliationData
}

export const VerificationOfExtract = ({
  conciliationData
}: VerificationProps) => {
  const {
    transactionsNuboQuantity,
    transactionsBankQuantity,
    transactionsDifferenceQuantity,
    debitNuboQuantity,
    debitBankQuantity,
    debitDifferenceQuantity,
    debitNuboAmount,
    debitBankAmount,
    debitDifferenceAmount,
    creditNuboQuantity,
    creditBankQuantity,
    creditDifferenceQuantity,
    creditNuboAmount,
    creditBankAmount,
    creditDifferenceAmount
  } = conciliationData || {}

  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex w-full flex-col gap-6 rounded-[4px] border border-[#7A7A7A] p-6">
        <h3>Total transacciones</h3>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
              <p className="font-bold">nuBO (Cantidad)</p>
              <p>
                {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                  transactionsNuboQuantity,
                  false,
                  false
                ) ?? '---'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
            <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
              <p className="font-bold">Banco (Cantidad)</p>
              <p>
                {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                  transactionsBankQuantity,
                  false,
                  false
                ) ?? '---'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex w-full justify-between border-b border-[#f4f4f4]">
          <p className="font-bold">Diferencia</p>

          <p
            style={{
              fontWeight: 'bold',
              color:
                transactionsDifferenceQuantity === 0
                  ? '#3D3D3D'
                  : (transactionsDifferenceQuantity ?? 0) > 0
                    ? '#085F3B'
                    : '#B22A09'
            }}
          >
            {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
              transactionsDifferenceQuantity,
              false,
              false
            ) ?? '---'}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <TotalAccounts
          totalOrigin="Total Debitos"
          quantityNubo={debitNuboQuantity}
          quantityBank={debitBankQuantity}
          quantityDiferences={debitDifferenceQuantity}
          amountNubo={debitNuboAmount}
          amountBank={debitBankAmount}
          amountDiferences={debitDifferenceAmount}
        />

        <TotalAccounts
          totalOrigin="Total Creditos"
          quantityNubo={creditNuboQuantity}
          quantityBank={creditBankQuantity}
          quantityDiferences={creditDifferenceQuantity}
          amountNubo={creditNuboAmount}
          amountBank={creditBankAmount}
          amountDiferences={creditDifferenceAmount}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/ConciliationPage/ConciliationPage.tsx

```tsx
import WarningAmberRoundedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/WarningAmberRounded'
import { Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useContext, useState } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  ContentWrapper,
  GenerateLogs,
  InputBasic,
  ModalAlert,
  Toast,
  UploadFile
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ConciliationData } from '../../Declares/declares'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import {
  getCalculationConfirm,
  getCalculationStatement
} from '../../services/conciliations/conciliations'
import ConciliationComponent from './Components/ConciliationComponent'

export const ConciliationPage = () => {
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<number>(0)
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  const [confirmConciliation, setConfirmConciliation] = useState(false)
  const [confirmConciliationInfo, setConfirmConciliationInfo] =
    useState<ConciliationData>({})
  const [conciliationData, setConciliationData] = useState<ConciliationData>({})
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [pushMessage, setPushMessage] = useState({ message: '', variant: '' })
  const [justification, setJustification] = useState(false)
  const [justificationComment, setJustificationComment] = useState<string>('')
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const {
    participantId,
    id: id_user_nubo,
    status,
    country: countryState
  } = infoUserNubo
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')
  const userNameState = localStorage.getItem('username') ?? ''
  const location = useLocation()

  const { operation: operationParams, payment: paymentParams } =
    location.state || {}
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const getFile = async (file: any) => {
    if (file) {
      try {
        context?.setLoading(true)
        const response = await getCalculationStatement(
          file,
          operation?.id,
          payment
        )
        setConciliationData(response.data)
        setPushMessage({ message: t('Documento cargado'), variant: 'success' })
        setViewToast(true)

        await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
          actionType: `Cargar documento`,
          actionDestination: 'Conciliacion',
          participantId: participantId,
          countryId: countryState?.id,
          userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
          statusId: status.id
        })
      } catch (error) {
        console.log('🚀 ~ getFile ~ error:')
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'STATEMENT_ALREADY_USED'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'La declaración ya se utilizó en otra conciliación',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'XML_PROCESSING_ERROR'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'Error al procesar el xml',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
          'STATEMENT_INVALID_EXTENSION'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'La declaración debe tener extensión .xml',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
          'STATEMENT_INVALID_EXTENSION'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'La declaración debe tener extensión .xml',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
          'STATEMENT_NOT_EXIST_TO_CONCILIATION'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'No hay declaración a la conciliación',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
          'CALCULATION_NOT_EXIST_TO_CONCILIATION'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'No hay cálculo para la conciliación',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        if (
          (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
          'ERROR_DESERIALIZABLE_XML'
        ) {
          setPushMessage({
            message: 'Error deserializable xml',
            variant: 'error'
          })
          setViewToast(true)
          return
        }
        setPushMessage({
          message: 'Error al cargar el documento',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
      } finally {
        context?.setLoading(false)
      }
    }
  }

  const handleCancel = () => {
    setConfirmConciliation(false)
    setJustification(false)
    setJustificationComment('')
  }

  const handleChangeJustification = (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const { value } = e.target
    setJustificationComment(value)
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper className="bg-transparent py-0" viewTop={false}>
      <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col bg-white p-4">
        <div className="flex gap-4">
          <Typography variant="h5" className="w-full text-left">
            {t('Conciliacion.Title.TitleConciliacionOperacionesEspeciales')}
          </Typography>
        </div>

        <ConciliationComponent
          onPaymentChange={setPayment}
          onOperationChange={setOperation}
          setOpen={setOpen}
          setConfirmConciliation={setConfirmConciliation}
          setConfirmConciliationInfo={setConfirmConciliationInfo}
          conciliationData={conciliationData}
          setConciliationData={setConciliationData}
          setPushMessage={setPushMessage}
          setViewToast={setViewToast}
          operationParams={operationParams}
          paymentParams={paymentParams}
        />
      </div>
      {open && <UploadFile open={open} onClose={setOpen} getFile={getFile} />}
      {confirmConciliation && (
        <>
          {confirmConciliationInfo.quantityDifferencesTotal === 0 ? (
            <ModalAlert
              title="¿Confirmar conciliación?"
              variant="warning"
              textSuccess="Confirmar"
              textCancel="Volver"
              handleCancel={handleCancel}
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  context?.setLoading(true)
                  const { data } = await getCalculationConfirm(
                    confirmConciliationInfo?.specialTradeId?.toString() ?? '',
                    confirmConciliationInfo?.paymentTypeId ?? 0,
                    confirmConciliationInfo?.codeOperation ?? '',
                    justificationComment
                  )
                  setConciliationData(data)
                  setJustification(false)
                  setConfirmConciliation(false)
                  setJustificationComment('')
                  setPushMessage({
                    message: 'Conciliación confirmada',
                    variant: 'success'
                  })

                  await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
                    actionType: `Conciliación confirmada`,
                    actionDestination: 'Conciliacion',
                    participantId: participantId,
                    countryId: countryState?.id,
                    userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
                    statusId: status.id
                  })
                } catch (error) {
                  console.log('🚀 ~ onClick={async ~ error:', error)
                } finally {
                  context?.setLoading(false)
                }
              }}
              orientation="horizontal"
              disabled={false}
              customStyles={{}}
              className="w-[427px] gap-4 px-6 py-12"
            >
              <p className="text-center text-[#3D3D3D]">
                Estas a punto de confirmar la conciliación, para{' '}
                <span className="text-bold">confirmar</span>, haz clic en
                Confirmar de lo contrario has clic en volver y verifica la
                información.
              </p>
            </ModalAlert>
          ) : (
            <ModalAlert
              title="Inconsistencias en el proceso de conciliación"
              variant="error"
              textSuccess={`${justification ? 'Confirmar' : 'Continuar'}`}
              textCancel="Volver"
              handleCancel={handleCancel}
              onClick={async () => {
                if (
                  justification &&
                  Object.keys(confirmConciliationInfo).length > 0
                ) {
                  try {
                    context?.setLoading(true)
                    const { data } = await getCalculationConfirm(
                      confirmConciliationInfo?.specialTradeId?.toString() ?? '',
                      confirmConciliationInfo?.paymentTypeId ?? 0,
                      confirmConciliationInfo?.codeOperation ?? '',
                      justificationComment
                    )
                    setConciliationData(data)
                    setConfirmConciliation(false)
                    setJustification(false)
                    setJustificationComment('')
                    setPushMessage({
                      message: 'Conciliación confirmada',
                      variant: 'success'
                    })
                    await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
                      actionType: `Conciliación confirmada`,
                      actionDestination: 'Conciliacion',
                      participantId: participantId,
                      countryId: countryState?.id,
                      userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
                      statusId: status.id
                    })
                  } catch (error) {
                    console.log('🚀 ~ onClick={async ~ error:', error)
                  } finally {
                    context?.setLoading(false)
                  }
                } else {
                  setJustification(true)
                }
              }}
              orientation="horizontal"
              disabled={
                justification
                  ? justificationComment.length < 50 ||
                    justificationComment.length > 200
                  : false
              }
              customStyles={{}}
              className="w-[427px] gap-4 px-6 py-12"
            >
              {justification ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <p className="mb-4 font-bold text-[#3D3D3D]">
                    Al continuar por favor justifique el porque de la
                    confirmación de la conciliación.
                  </p>
                  <InputBasic
                    field="justification"
                    id="justification"
                    showLabel={false}
                    value={justificationComment}
                    onChange={handleChangeJustification}
                    multiline
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-between">
                    <p
                      style={{ color: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50)', fontSize: '10px' }}
                    >
                      Mínimo 50 caracteres.
                    </p>
                    <p
                      style={{ color: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.50)', fontSize: '10px' }}
                    >
                      {justificationComment.length}/200
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <p className="font-bold text-[#3D3D3D]">
                    Inconsistencias encontradas:{' '}
                    {confirmConciliationInfo?.quantityDifferencesTotal}
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex w-[95%] items-start gap-[14px]">
                    <WarningAmberRoundedIcon
                      sx={{ fontSize: 22, color: '#3D3D3D' }}
                    />

                    <p className="w-full text-[14px]">
                      Encontramos inconsistencias en la conciliación. Revise los
                      detalles:
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <ul className="list-disc pl-5 text-[14px] text-[#3D3D3D]">
                    {confirmConciliationInfo?.detailInconsistencies &&
                      confirmConciliationInfo?.detailInconsistencies.map(
                        (item: string) => <li>{item}</li>
                      )}
                  </ul>
                </div>
              )}
            </ModalAlert>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={pushMessage.message}
          variant={pushMessage.variant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
        />
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/ConciliationPage/Hooks/useConciliationFilters.tsx

```tsx
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useContext } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ConciliationData } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getCountry, getSpecialTrade, getTypePayment } from '../../../services'
import {
  findConciliation,
  getCalculationBank
} from '../../../services/conciliations/conciliations'
import { OptionType } from './useConciliationTable'

interface CompensationFiltersProps {
  onPaymentChange: (value: any) => void
  onOperationChange: (value: any) => void
  setConciliationData: (value: ConciliationData) => void
  setPushMessage: (value: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast: (value: boolean) => void
  setConciliationState: (value: string) => void
}

export const useConciliationFilters = ({
  onPaymentChange,
  onOperationChange,
  setConciliationData,
  setPushMessage,
  setViewToast,
  setConciliationState
}: CompensationFiltersProps) => {
  const [registerDate, setRegisterDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [complianceDate, setComplianceDate] = useState<Date | null>(null)
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(0)
  const [countryOptions, setCountryOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: string }[]
  >([])
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState(0)
  const [paymentOptions, setPaymentOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: string }[]
  >([])
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('')
  const [operationInfo, setOperationInfo] = useState<any>([])

  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
  const specialTradeId = searchParams.get('specialTradeId')
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')

  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const {
    participantId,
    id: id_user_nubo,
    status,
    country: countryState
  } = infoUserNubo

  const userNameState = localStorage.getItem('username') ?? ''

  const fetchOptionsSpecialOp = useCallback(
    async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        setSearchQuery(query ?? '')
        const response = await getSpecialTrade({
          specialOperationIdName: query,
          recordDate: registerDate || undefined,
          settlementDate: complianceDate || undefined,
          countryId: country || undefined,
          options: { page, size },
          validateDate: true
        })
        return {
          data: response.content.map(
            (item: { id: number; specialOperationName: string }) => ({
              ...item,
              label: item.specialOperationName
            })
          ),
          total: response.totalElements
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [country, registerDate, complianceDate]
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedOption) {
      const getInfo = async () => {
        const { data } = await fetchOptionsSpecialOp(searchQuery)
        setOperationInfo(data)
      }
      getInfo()
    }
  }, [
    country,
    registerDate,
    complianceDate,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    searchQuery
  ])

  const handleChangeCountry = (e: number) => setCountry(e)

  const handleChangePayment = (payment: number) => {
    setPayment(payment)
    onPaymentChange(payment)
  }

  const handleOptionChange = (option: OptionType | null) => {
    setSelectedOption(option)
    onOperationChange(option)
    // if (option === null) {
    //     setPayment(0);
    //     onPaymentChange(0);
    // }
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (payment > 0) {
      const getFindConciliation = async () => {
        try {
          context?.setLoading(true)
          const { data } = await findConciliation(selectedOption?.id, payment)
          setConciliationData(data)

          await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
            actionType: `Encontrar conciliacion inicial`,
            actionDestination: 'Conciliacion',
            participantId: participantId,
            countryId: countryState?.id,
            userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
            statusId: status.id
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching special trade:', error)
          setConciliationData({})
          // setPushMessage({ message: 'No existe insumo para Conciliar', variant: 'error' });
          // setViewToast(true);
        } finally {
          context?.setLoading(false)
        }
      }
      getFindConciliation()
    }
  }, [payment, country, selectedOption])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (specialTradeId) {
      const fetchSpecialTrade = async () => {
        try {
          context?.setLoading(true)
          const response = await getSpecialTrade({ id: specialTradeId })
          const specialTrade = response.content[0]
          setSelectedOption({
            label: specialTrade.specialOperationName,
            id: specialTrade.id,
            country: specialTrade.country,
            recordDate: specialTrade.recordDate,
            settlementDate: specialTrade.settlementDate,
            status: specialTrade.status
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching special trade:', error)
        } finally {
          context?.setLoading(false)
        }
      }

      fetchSpecialTrade()
    } else {
      fetchOptionsSpecialOp(searchQuery)
    }
  }, [specialTradeId, searchQuery, fetchOptionsSpecialOp])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchOptions = async () => {
      try {
        context?.setLoading(true) // Activar loading
        const [response, responseCountries] = await Promise.all([
          getTypePayment(),
          getCountry()
        ])

        const paymentOptions = response.map(
          (item: { id: number; description: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.description
          })
        )

        const countryOptions = responseCountries.map(
          (item: { id: number; name: string }) => ({
            id: item.id,
            name: item.name
          })
        )

        setPaymentOptions(paymentOptions)
        setCountryOptions(countryOptions)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching payment or country options:', error)
      } finally {
        context?.setLoading(false)
      }
    }

    fetchOptions()
  }, [])

  const handleConciliation = async () => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const { data } = await getCalculationBank(selectedOption?.id, payment)
      setConciliationState('')
      setConciliationData(data)

      await GenerateLogs(userNameState, {
        actionType: `Calculo sin extracto`,
        actionDestination: 'Conciliacion',
        participantId: participantId,
        countryId: countryState?.id,
        userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
        statusId: status.id
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching special trade:', error)

      if (
        (error as any)?.response?.data?.errorCode ===
        'STATEMENT_NOT_EXIST_TO_CONCILIATION'
      ) {
        setPushMessage({
          message: 'No hay declaración a la conciliación',
          variant: 'error'
        })
        setViewToast(true)
        return
      }
      setConciliationState('Conciliación fallida')
      setPushMessage({
        message: 'No existe insumo para Conciliar',
        variant: 'error'
      })
      setViewToast(true)
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  return {
    registerDate,
    searchQuery,
    setRegisterDate,
    complianceDate,
    setComplianceDate,
    country,
    countryOptions,
    handleChangeCountry,
    payment,
    paymentOptions,
    handleChangePayment,
    selectedOption,
    handleOptionChange,
    fetchOptionsSpecialOp,
    handleConciliation,
    setConciliationData,
    operationInfo,
    t
  }
}
```
