## src/pages/ConciliationPage/Hooks/useConciliationTable.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColumnGroupingModel } from '@mui/x-data-grid'
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { ReactNode, useContext, useState } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import {
  checkNullValue,
  formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator
} from '../../../helpers'
import { updateCompensation } from '../../../services'

export interface OptionType {
  label: string
  id: number
  country?: { name: string }
  recordDate?: string
  settlementDate?: string
  status: {
    id: number
  }
}

export const useConciliationTable = (
  rows: any,
  closeValidattion: boolean,
  operation?: any,
  payment?: any
) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState<{
    name: string
    exclusion: boolean
  } | null>(null)
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  const handleSwitchChange = async (
    id: number,
    name: string,
    exclusion: boolean
  ) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      await updateCompensation([
        {
          specialTradeCompensationId: id,
          exclusion: exclusion
        }
      ])
      setAlert({ name, exclusion })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error updating exclusion:', error)
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(true)
    }
  }

  const columns: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 97,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles'),
      renderCell: (params) => {
        if (params.row.id === 'total' || params.row.summaryRow) {
          return <Container className="font-bold">Total</Container>
        }
        const basePath = `/operation-spec-management/compensations/details/${params.row.id}`
        const fullPath = operation ? `${basePath}/${operation.id}` : basePath
        return (
          <Container>
            <Link
              className="text-red-500 underline decoration-solid"
              to={fullPath}
              state={{
                participant: {
                  ...params.row.participant,
                  label: params.row.participant.shortName
                },
                side: params.row.side,
                paymentMethod: payment
              }}
            >
              Ver detalles
            </Link>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Participante'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Participante'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { participant: { name: string } } }) =>
        checkNullValue(row.participant?.name),
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Punta'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Punta'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { side: { description: string } } }) =>
        checkNullValue(row.side?.description),
      rowSpanValueGetter: () => null
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Field.totalCollect'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalRecaudo'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalCollect) || '0'
        ),
      rowSpanValueGetter: () => null,
      cellClassName: ({ row }) => (row.summaryRow ? 'font-bold' : '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountToCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountToCollect) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountCollect: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountCollect) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalPayments: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalPayments) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { amountDue: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.amountDue) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { paymentsProcess: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.paymentsProcess) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { manualPayments: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.manualPayments) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado'),
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { totalPaid: number } }) =>
        checkNullValue(
          formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row?.totalPaid) || '0'
        )
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión'),
      headerName: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión'),
      renderCell: (params) => {
        if (params.row.id === 'total' || params.row.summaryRow) {
          return '-'
        }
        return (
          <DefaultComponents.Switch
            defaultChecked={params.row.exclusion}
            size="small"
            disabled={closeValidattion}
            onChange={(event) =>
              handleSwitchChange(
                params.row.id,
                params.row.participant.shortName,
                event.target.checked
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
    }
  ]

  const columnGroupingModel: GridColumnGroupingModel = [
    {
      groupId: 'Detalles',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      headerName: '',
      children: [
        { field: '__check__' },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Detalles') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Participante') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Punta') }
      ]
    },
    {
      groupId: 'Recaudos',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      children: [
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudado') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoRecaudar') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Field.totalCollect') }
      ]
    },
    {
      groupId: 'Pagos',
      headerClassName: 'flex justify-center items-center m-auto text-center',
      headerAlign: 'center',
      children: [
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagos') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.SaldoPagar') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosProceso') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.PagosManuales') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.TotalPagado') },
        { field: t('Compensations.Table.Exclusión') }
      ]
    }
  ]

  const calculateTotals = () => {
    if (!rows || rows.length === 0) return null

    const totals = {
      id: 'total',
      summaryRow: true,
      participant: { name: '' },
      side: { description: '' },
      totalPaid: null,
      totalCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { totalCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.totalCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountToCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountToCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountToCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountCollect: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountCollect: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountCollect) || 0),
        0
      ),
      totalPayments: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { totalPayments: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.totalPayments) || 0),
        0
      ),
      amountDue: rows.reduce(
        (sum: number, row: { amountDue: any }) =>
          sum + (Number(row?.amountDue) || 0),
        0
      ),
      paymentsProcess: null,
      manualPayments: null,
      exclusion: false
    }

    return totals
  }

  const getDataWithTotals = (originalData: any[]) => {
    const totalsRow = calculateTotals()
    return totalsRow ? [...originalData, totalsRow] : originalData
  }

  return {
    columns,
    t,
    columnGroupingModel,
    getDataWithTotals,
    setAlert,
    alert
  }
}

```

```tsx
              className="cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleTradeHistory && handleTradeHistory()}
            />
          ) : (
            '--'
          )
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: 'Columna 3',
      rows: [
        { label: 'Folio', value: folioId },
        { label: 'Deposito', value: trade?.depository?.description ?? 'N/A' },
        { label: 'Tipo de Operación', value: effectiveOperationType ?? 'N/A' },
        {
          label: 'Precio de liquidación',
          value: formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
            trade?.price?.toString() ?? 'N/A',
            true
          )
        },
        {
          label: 'Monto total',
          value: trade?.volume
            ? formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
                trade?.volume?.toString() ?? 'N/A',
                true
              )
            : 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  const [rows, setRows] = useState([])

  const tabs = [
    {
      label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.BUY,
      content: <BoxInfo columns={buyColumns} noBorder={false} />,
      id: 'BUY'
    },
    {
      label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.SELL,
      content: <BoxInfo columns={sellColumns} noBorder={false} />,
      id: 'SELL'
    }
  ]

  const filteredTabs = tabs.map((tab) => ({
    ...tab,
    disabled:
      userType !== 'INTERNAL' &&
      ((folioDetail?.trade?.participantBuy?.id !== participantId &&
        tab.label === FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.BUY) ||
        (folioDetail?.trade?.participantSell?.id !== participantId &&
          tab.label === FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.SELL))
  }))

  const setDataRemoteInner = (_page: number, dataTable: []) =>
    setRows(dataTable)
  const endpointForAssociatedFolios = useMemo(() => {
    if (!tradeId) {
      console.log(tradeId)
      return ''
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
    const URL = ENDPOINTS.ASSOCIATED_FOLIOS.replace('{folioId}', `${tradeId}`)
    return `${URL}?${params.toString()}`
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [window.location.search])

  const [origenes, setOrigenes] = useState<any[]>([])

  // cargar opciones origen
  useEffect(() => {
    const loadOrigen = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getCategoryTypes('ORIGEN PUNTA')
        if (userType === 'EXTERNAL' && folioDetail?.trade?.originType) {
          const { id, description } = folioDetail.trade.originType
          data.push({ id, description, value: id })
        }
        const formatted = (data || []).map((item: any) => ({
          id: String(item.id),
          name: item.description,
          value: String(item.id)
        }))
        setOrigenes(formatted)
      } catch {
        setOrigenes([])
      }
    }
    loadOrigen()
  }, [])

  const MY_TABS = [
    {
      label: 'DATOS GENERALES',
      content: (
        <>
          <BoxInfo columns={generalDataBOX} />
          <Typography variant="h6" className="my-3 text-start font-bold">
            Folios asociados
          </Typography>
          <NewTable
            axiosInstanceKey="httpOperationsSpecFolios"
            columns={columnsForAssociatedFolios}
            checkboxSelection={false}
            endpoint={endpointForAssociatedFolios}
            rows={rows}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemoteInner}
            provisionalId="associatedFolioNumber"
          />
        </>
      ),
      id: 'datos-generales'
    },
    {
      label: 'BENEFICIARIO FINAL',
      content: (
        <TabComponent
          tabs={filteredTabs}
          onTabChange={handleTabChange}
          hasShadow={false}
        >
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center bg-white bg-opacity-50">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Typography variant="h6" className="my-3 text-start font-bold">
                Cuenta beneficiario final
              </Typography>
              {showBeneficiariesPage && inlineBeneficiariesData ? (
                <InlineBeneficiariesPage
                  origenes={origenes}
                  sideId={inlineBeneficiariesData.sideId}
                  edit={inlineBeneficiariesData.edit}
                  dataState={inlineBeneficiariesData.dataState}
                  folioDetail={inlineBeneficiariesData.folioDetail} //inlineBeneficiariesData.folioDetail
                  clientUser={inlineBeneficiariesData.clientUser}
                  participantId={inlineBeneficiariesData.participantId}
                  onCancelInline={() => {
                    setShowBeneficiariesPage(false)
                    setInlineBeneficiariesData(null)
                    window.localStorage.editSettlement = '[]'
                  }}
                  onSaveInline={() => {
                    setShowBeneficiariesPage(false)
                    setInlineBeneficiariesData(null)
                    setUpdateTable((prev) => !prev) // refresca tabla
                    window.localStorage.editSettlement = '[]'
                  }}
                  setCurrentQuantity={setCurrentCurrentQuantity} // NUEVO: actualiza currentQuantity dinámicamente
                  currentQuantity={currentQuantity} //currentQuantity
                  btnSaveModal={btnSaveModal}
                  setModalAddFraction={setModalAddFraction}
                  showCrudToast={showCrudToast}
                />
              ) : (
                <NewTable
                  hasTotalCalculation={true}
                  key={currentSide}
                  columns={columnsModules || []}
                  provisionalId="fraction"
                  customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
                  setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
                  setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
                  setCheckedAll={setCheckedAll}
                  disableRowSelectionOnClick={true}
                  rowsPerPageOptions={[3]}
                  rows={filteredSettlementList}
                  axiosInstanceKey="httpOperationsSpecFolios"
                  height="400px"
                />
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </TabComponent>
      ),
      id: 'beneficiario-final'
    },
    {
      id: 'reasignaciones',
      label: 'REASIGNACIONES',
      content: (
        <ReassignmentTab
          specialTradeId={specialtradeId}
          trade={trade as Trade}
          tradeEquity={tradeEquity as TradeEquity}
          currentSide={currentSide}
          participantId={participantId}
          userType={userType}
          tradeIdNumber={tradeIdNumber}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      id: 'liquidacion',
      label: 'LIQUIDACIÓN',
      content: <SettlementTab tradeId={tradeId} />
    }
  ]

  return (
    <ContentWrapper title={title} actionBack={actionBack}>
      <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-4">
        <TabComponent tabs={MY_TABS} onTabChange={() => {}} width="180px" />
      </div>
      {modalAddFraction && (
        <ModalContent
          title="Agregar asignación"
          description="Diligencia los datos para ingresarlos a la tabla"
          handleAccept={() => setConfirmAddFraction(true)}
          handleClose={() => setModalAddFraction(false)}
          className="w-full max-w-[600px] gap-y-[32px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText="Agregar"
          iconClose={false}
          btnDisabled={!btnSaveModal}
        >
          <AddFraction
            country={folioDetail?.trade?.country?.name}
            rowAcomulated={rowAcomulated}
            tradeIdNumber={tradeIdNumber}
            setPushMessage={setPushMessage}
            setViewToast={setViewToastCrud}
            setBtnSaveModal={setBtnSaveModal}
            setNewAddFraction={setNewAddFraction}
            settlement={settlement}
            isFolioDetail={true}
            bankAccountRequired={bankAccountRequired}
            currentQuantity={folioDetail?.trade?.quantity?.toString() ?? '0'} //{(showBeneficiariesPage && inlineBeneficiariesData) ? currentQuantity : currentQuantitySide} //currentQuantity
            currentSide={currentSide}
            folioDetail={folioDetail}
            changeModalAlert={changeModalAlert}
            setBtnSaveModalOriginal={setBtnSaveModal}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}
      {modalAlert && modalAlert?.open && <ModalAlert {...modalAlert} />}
      {confirmAddFraction && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Estás seguro de agregar la asignación?"
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="Agregar asignación"
          textCancel="Cancelar"
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={() => {
            handleAddRow() // acción original
            setConfirmAddFraction(false)
          }}
          handleCancel={() => setConfirmAddFraction(false)}
        />
      )}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <ModalInfo
          setIsModalOpen={setIsModalOpen}
          title={modalDetailAccount?.title || ''}
          subtitle={
            modalDetailAccount?.subtitle || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          subtitle2={
            modalDetailAccount?.subtitle2 || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          dataColumns={
            modalDetailAccount?.columns || {
              assignmentColumns: { title: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING, content: [] },
              custodianColumns: { title: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING, content: [] },
              complianceColumns: { title: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING, content: [] }
            }
          }
        />
      )}
      {isModalOpenTwo && (
        <ModalInfoTwo
          setIsModalOpen={setIsModalOpenTwo}
          title={modalDetailAccountTwo?.title || ''}
          subtitle={modalDetailAccountTwo?.subtitle || { bold: '', text: '' }}
          subtitle2={modalDetailAccountTwo?.subtitle2 || { bold: '', text: '' }}
          columns={modalDetailAccountTwo?.columns || []}
        />
      )}
      {isModalFollowUp && (
        <ModalInfo
          setIsModalOpen={setIsModalFollowUp}
          title={modalHistory?.title || STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING}
          subtitle={
            modalHistory?.subtitle || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          subtitle2={
            modalHistory?.subtitle2 || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          dataColumns={modalFollowUpColumns as ModalFollowUpColumns}
        />
      )}
      {modalContent && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalContent.title}
          message={modalContent.message}
          variant={modalContent.variant}
          onClick={modalContent.onClick}
          handleCancel={modalContent.handleCancel}
          textCancel={modalContent.textCancel}
          textSuccess={modalContent.textSuccess}
        />
      )}
      {modalConfirm && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={textModalConfirm}
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess={btnAceptText}
          onClick={() => {}}
          handleCancel={() => setModalConfirm(false)}
        ></ModalAlert>
      )}
      {modalTransferCustodian && (
        <ModalContent
          title={selectedCustodian}
          description={description}
          handleClose={handleClose}
          handleAccept={handleAcceptTransferCustodian}
          className="w-full max-w-[1140px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText={btnAceptText}
          btnDisabled={
            selectedCustodian === 'Traslado a Custodio'
              ? validateThereCheck ||
                !allCustodiansSameStatus ||
                !thereIsCustodianSelected
              : !(activeBtn && validateThereCheck)
          }
        >
          <NewTable
            columns={columnsCustodian}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
            rows={settlementsCustodian}
            setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelectedModal}
            isSettlement={true}
            rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}
      {modalConfirm && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={textModalConfirm}
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess={btnAceptText}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={async () => {
            setModalTransferCustodian(false)
            if (selectedCustodian) {
              await updateSettlementStatus({
                quantityCustodian,
                setViewToast,
                setModalConfirm,
                causalRejection,
                selectedCustodian,
                infoUserNubo,
                username
              })
              setSettlement([])
              setSettlementList([])
              setUpdateTable((prev) => !prev)
              // window.location.reload()
            }
          }}
          handleCancel={() => setModalConfirm(false)}
          disabled={
            selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio' ? getValidateBtn() : false
          }
        >
          {selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio' && (
            <MuiSelect
              options={listRejection}
              placeholder="Seleccione una opción"
              onChange={handleChangeCausal}
              className="w-full"
              nameValue="reason"
            />
          )}
          {causalRejection && currentMotivo === 14 && (
            <InputBasic
              key="textRejection"
              field="textRejection"
              id="textRejection"
              label="¿Cuál?"
              value={textRejection}
              onChange={handleChangeRejection}
              className="h-[40px]"
            />
          )}
        </ModalAlert>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={toastMessage}
          variant={toastVariant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
      {viewToastCrud && (
        <Toast
          text={pushMessage.message}
          variant={pushMessage.variant}
          onClose={() => setViewToastCrud(!viewToastCrud)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
      {modalContent2 && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalContent2.title}
          message={modalContent2.message}
          variant={modalContent2.variant}
          onClick={modalContent2.onClick}
          handleCancel={modalContent2.handleCancel}
          textCancel={modalContent2.textCancel}
          textSuccess={modalContent2.textSuccess}
          orientation="horizontal"
        />
      )}
      {isLoadingModal && (
        <ModalLoad
          reset={() => setIsLoadingModal(false)}
          progress={progress}
          message="Estamos preparando la descarga:"
          fileName={totalRecords === 1 ? '' : 'comprobantes.zip'}
          closeButtonText="Cancelar"
        />
      )}
      {isToastVisible && (
        <Toast
          text="Descarga completada"
          onClose={() => setIsToastVisible(!isToastVisible)}
        />
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/FolioDetailPage/Hooks/useFolioDetail.tsx

```tsx
import { formatNumberWithTwoDecimals } from '@/helpers'
import {
  Button,
  MaterialIcons,
  TRenderCellParams
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { pdf } from '@react-pdf/renderer'
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver'
import JSZip from 'jszip'
import { ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { Dropdown, GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

// import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from "../../../helpers/utilities";
import eyeIcon from '../../../assets/icons/eyeIcon.svg'
import {
  RowDataMuiInfo,
  SettlementDataInfo,
  YesOrNotComponent
} from '../../../components'
import { FolioDetailModel } from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'
import { getInvestorAccountDetails, reportOperations } from '../../../services'
import { ContainerDropdownEdit } from '../../BeneficiariesPage/ContainerDropdownEdit'
import { ContainerInputEdit } from '../../BeneficiariesPage/ContainerInputEdit'
import { DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../../OperationDetailPage'
import { VoucherDocumentC } from '../VoucherDocument/VoucherDocumentC'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../folioDetailStrings'
import { ContentSettlement, IReportOperation } from '../types'

interface MenuOptionProps {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  action?: () => void
  textSize?: string
  textColor?: string
  subItems?: MenuOptionProps[]
  disabled?: boolean
}

interface ModalHistory {
  title: string
  subtitle: { bold: string; text: string | number }
  subtitle2?: { bold: string; text: string | number }
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  columns: any[]
}

interface JointMemberDetail {
  identificationType: { description: string }
  documentNumber: string
  firstName: string
  lastName: string
}
interface Argument {
  participantId: string
  folioDetail?: FolioDetailModel | undefined
  handleTradeHistory?: () => void
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  handleTradeBlockHistory?: (arg?: any) => void
  setSelectedCustodian: (arg: string) => void
  setModalTransferCustodian?: (arg: boolean) => void
  selectedCustodian: string
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  thereAreSelected: any
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  setThereAreSelected?: (arg: any) => void
  origin?: string | null
  isViewFolio?: boolean
  setModalAddFraction?: (arg: boolean) => void
  setSettlementsCustodian?: (arg: []) => void
  setCurrentStatus?: (arg: number) => void
  thereAreSelectedModal?: string[] | number[]
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  SettlementList?: any[]
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  setSettlementList?: (arg: any[]) => void
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  settlement?: any[]
  setSettlement?: (arg: SettlementDataInfo[]) => void
  tradeId?: string
  identification?: string
  id_user_nubo?: string
  status?: { id: string }
  country?: { id: string }
  checkedAll?: boolean
  userType?: string
  name?: string
  editMode?: boolean
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  rowAcomulated?: any
  setModalDeleteFraction?: (arg: boolean) => void
  setPushMessage?: (arg: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast?: (arg: boolean) => void
  updateTable?: boolean
  setInfoModalFraction?: (arg: {
    title: string
    message: string
    variant: string
    textSuccess: string
  }) => void
  setCurrentCurrentQuantity?: (arg: string) => void
  isModalOpen?: boolean
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  setModalContent?: any
  handleSetModal?: (arg: string) => void
  isAvailableAddFraction?: boolean
}

interface MenuOptionProps {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  action?: () => void
  textSize?: string
  textColor?: string
  subItems?: MenuOptionProps[]
  disabled?: boolean
}

export const useFolioDetail = ({
  participantId,
  setSelectedCustodian,
  setModalTransferCustodian,
  selectedCustodian,
  thereAreSelected,
  setThereAreSelected,
  setSettlementsCustodian,
  setCurrentStatus,
  thereAreSelectedModal,
  folioDetail,
  setModalAddFraction,
  handleTradeHistory,
  handleTradeBlockHistory,
  isViewFolio,
  origin,
  SettlementList = [],
  setSettlementList,
  settlement = [],
  setSettlement,
  tradeId,
  identification,
  id_user_nubo,
  status,
  country,
  userType,
  name,
  editMode,
  rowAcomulated,
  setModalDeleteFraction,
  setPushMessage,
  setViewToast,
  setInfoModalFraction,
  updateTable,
  setCurrentCurrentQuantity,
  setModalContent,
  handleSetModal,
  isAvailableAddFraction
}: Argument) => {
  if (handleSetModal) {
    // fr edeeddeedde
  }
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(1)
  const [isOptionCustodianDisabled, setIsOptionCustodianDisabled] =
    useState(false)
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const [columnsModules, setColumnsModules] = useState<any[]>()
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const [sendToModalCustodian, setSendToModalCustodian] = useState<any[]>()
  const [isLoadingModal, setIsLoadingModal] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [totalRecords, setTotalRecords] = useState(0)
  const [isToastVisible, setIsToastVisible] = useState<boolean>(false)
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const [modalContent2, setModalContent2] = useState<any>(null)
  const [records, setRecords] = useState<ContentSettlement[]>()
  const [closeValidation, setCloseValidation] = useState<boolean>(false)
  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const [bankSelectedList, setBankSelectedList] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState('')
  const [toastVariant, setToastVariant] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [btnAceptText, setbtnAceptText] = useState('')
  const [textModalConfirm, settextModalConfirm] = useState('')
  const [isModalOpenTwo, setIsModalOpenTwo] = useState(false)
  const [modalDetailAccountTwo, setModalDetailAccountTwo] =
    useState<ModalHistory | null>(null)
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username') as string

  const handleTabChange = (index: number) => setActiveTab(index + 1)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (folioDetail?.trade?.settlementStatus?.id === 46)
      setCloseValidation(true)
  }, [folioDetail])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (thereAreSelected?.length > 0) {
      setIsOptionCustodianDisabled(true)
    }
    if (thereAreSelected?.length === 0 && setSettlementList) {
      setIsOptionCustodianDisabled(false)
      setRecords([])
      return
    }

    setRecords(SettlementList)

    const response = SettlementList.filter((item) => {
      const { tradeId, fraction, side } = item
      const newId = `${tradeId}-${fraction}-${side.id}`
      return Array.isArray(thereAreSelected) && thereAreSelected.includes(newId)
    })

    setSendToModalCustodian(response)
  }, [thereAreSelected, updateTable])

  const handleJointMembers = async (
    client_user: string,
    row: any,
    setModalDetailAccountTwo: React.Dispatch<
      React.SetStateAction<ModalHistory | null>
    >,
    setIsModalOpenTwo: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>
  ) => {
    try {
      // setLoading(true);
      const investorAccountDetails: JointMemberDetail[] =
        await getInvestorAccountDetails(client_user, row.investorAccount.id)
      const columns = investorAccountDetails.map((detail) => ({
        Tipo: detail.identificationType.description,
        ID: detail.documentNumber,
        Nombre: `${detail.firstName} ${detail.lastName}`
      }))
      setModalDetailAccountTwo({
        title: 'Detalle de la cuenta',
        subtitle: {
          bold: 'Cuenta',
          text: row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber || 'N/A'
        },
        columns
      })
      setIsModalOpenTwo(true)
    } catch {
      setModalContent({
        title: 'Error en el servidor',
        message:
          'Ha ocurrido un error en el servidor. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.',
        variant: 'error',
        onClick: () => {
          setModalContent(null)
          setIsModalOpenTwo(false)
          navigate('/operation-management/')
        }
      })
    } finally {
      // setLoading(false);
    }
  }
  // @ts-expect-error dkemkmemkdemk
  if (setModalDetailAccountTwo && handleJointMembers) {
    // fr edeeddeedde
  }

  const dataGeneral = [
    {
      title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_1,
      rows: [
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.SPECIAL_OPERATION_ID,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.specialTrade?.id ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.FOLIO,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.matchId
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.DAYS_TO_SETTLEMENT,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.daysToSettlement ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.OPERATION_TYPE,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.type?.description ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.ISIN,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.securityTitle?.isin ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.INSTRUMENT_TYPE,
          value:
            folioDetail?.trade?.securityTitle?.classOutDto?.description ?? 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_2,
      rows: [
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.OPERATION_NAME,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.DEPOSITORY,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.depository?.description ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.COUNTRY,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.country?.name ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.PAYMENT,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.paymentType?.description ?? 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.ISSUER,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.securityTitle?.issuer.name ?? 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_3,
      rows: [
        {
          label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.REGISTER_DATE,
          value: folioDetail?.trade?.matchTime
            ? new Date(folioDetail?.trade?.matchTime)
                .toISOString()

  const options = [
    'Traslado a Custodio',
    'Realizar Pre-Match',
    'Admisión Custodio',
    'Rechazo Custodio'
  ]

  const optionToIdMap: Record<string, number> = {
    'Traslado a Custodio': 20, // TRASLADADA
    'Realizar Pre-Match': 21, // PRE-MATCH
    'Admisión Custodio': 22, // ADMITIDA
    'Rechazo Custodio': 23 // RECHAZADA
  }

  /* eslint-disable-next-line */
  const filterForStatus = (response: any[], selectedOption: string) => {
    // Maquina de estados
    const selectedStatus = optionToIdMap[selectedOption] // ID de la opción seleccionada
    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setCurrentStatus && setCurrentStatus(selectedStatus)
    if (selectedStatus === 20) {
      // vista Traslado a custodio apareceran ==> Rechazo [23] y nulos
      const result = response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 23 || item.custodianStatus === null
      )
      return result
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 21) {
      // vista Prematch apareceran ==> Traslado [20]
      const result = response.filter((item) => item.custodianStatus?.id === 20)
      return result
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 22) {
      // vista Admision apareceran ==> Traslado [20], Prematch [21]
      const result = response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 20 || item.custodianStatus?.id === 21
      )
      return result
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 23) {
      const result = response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 20 ||
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 21 ||
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 22
      )
      return result
    }

    if (!selectedStatus) return []
  }

  const handleSelect = (option: string) => {
    const responseFilter =
      sendToModalCustodian &&
      sendToModalCustodian?.length > 0 &&
      filterForStatus(sendToModalCustodian, option)

    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setSettlementsCustodian && setSettlementsCustodian(responseFilter as [])
    setSelectedCustodian(option)
    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setModalTransferCustodian && setModalTransferCustodian(true)
  }

  const addFraction = () => {
    setModalAddFraction?.(true)
  }
  const deleteFraction = () => {
    const updatedSettlementList = settlement.filter((item) => {
      const { specialTradeId, fraction, side } = item
      const newId = `${specialTradeId}-${fraction}-${side.id}`
      return (
        Array.isArray(thereAreSelected) && !thereAreSelected?.includes(newId)
      )
    })
    setRecords(updatedSettlementList)
    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setSettlement && setSettlement(updatedSettlementList)
    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setThereAreSelected && setThereAreSelected([])
    /* eslint-disable-next-line */
    setModalDeleteFraction && setModalDeleteFraction(false)
  }

  const opcionesDeAsignacion: MenuOptionProps[] = [

      disabled: !isAvailableAddFraction
    },
    {
      id: 'modificar-asignacion',
      label: 'Modificar asignación',
      action: () =>
        navigate(
          `${FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.BENEFICIARIES}?tradeId=${folioDetail?.trade.id}&sideId=${activeTab}&edit=true`
        ),
      disabled: isAvailableAddFraction
    },
    {
      id: 'validar-asignacion',
      label: 'Validar asignación',
      action: () =>
        navigate(
          `${FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.ASSIGNMENT_VALIDATION}?tradeId=${folioDetail?.trade.id}&sideId=${activeTab}`
        )
    }
  ]

  const headerActionsLeft = () => (
    <>
      {/* {
                (!isFullView && settlement.length === 0) && (

                        variant="text"
                        onClick={() => addFraction()}
                        className={`${rowAcomulated >= 100 ? 'text-[rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'} outline-none py-1 px-[5px] font-Roboto font-medium gap-0 text-[13px] uppercase`}
                    >
                        <MaterialIcons.NoteAddOutlined fontSize="small" />
                        Agregar Asignación
                    </Button>
                )
            } */}
      {/* <p>{JSON.stringify(isFullView)}</p>
            <p>{JSON.stringify(settlement.length > 0)}</p>
            <p>{JSON.stringify(fullview)}</p> */}
      {isViewFolio && (
        <Dropdown
          title="Opciones de Asignación"

      )}
      {isViewFolio && (
        <>

            options={options}
            onSelect={handleSelect}
            disabled={
              closeValidation ? true : !isOptionCustodianDisabled || false
            }
          />

      )}
      {/* {
                (isViewFolio && (!isFullView && settlement.length > 0 && !fullview)) && (
                    <Dropdown
                        title="Opciones de Custodio"
                        options={options}
                        onSelect={handleSelect}
                        disabled={closeValidation ? true : !isOptionCustodianDisabled || false}
                    />

                )
            } */}
      {!isViewFolio && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={addFraction}
          className={`${rowAcomulated >= 100 || rowAcomulated === 0 ? 'text-[rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'} w-[166px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase outline-none`}
          disabled={rowAcomulated >= 100 || rowAcomulated === 0}
        >
          <MaterialIcons.PersonAddAlt1Outlined fontSize="small" />
          Agregar Fracción
        </Button>
      )}
      {!isViewFolio && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => {
            if (
              thereAreSelected.length === 0 &&
              setPushMessage &&
              setViewToast
            ) {
              setPushMessage({
                message: 'Debe seleccionar al menos una fracción',
                variant: 'error'
              })
              setViewToast(true)
              // setBtnDissabled(true);
              return
            }

            if (
              settlement.length === 2 &&
              setInfoModalFraction &&
              setModalDeleteFraction
            ) {
              setModalDeleteFraction(true)
              setInfoModalFraction({
                title: 'Estas a punto de convertir esta operación en entera',
                message:
                  'Al eliminar las fracciones seleccionadas, esta operación pasara a ser entera, solo procede si estas seguro de esta decisión.',
                variant: 'warning',
                textSuccess: 'Convertir a entera'
              })
            }

            if (
              settlement.length > 2 &&
              setInfoModalFraction &&
              setModalDeleteFraction
            ) {
              setModalDeleteFraction(true)
              setInfoModalFraction({
                title: '¿Desea eliminar esta fracción?',
                message:
                  'Estas a punto de eliminar esta fracción y toda la información asociada a ella. Esta es una acción permanente y no se puede deshacer.',
                variant: 'warning',
                textSuccess: 'Eliminar fracción'
              })
            }
          }}
          className={`${(editMode ? editMode : settlement.length <= 1) ? 'text-[rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'} w-[166px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase outline-none`}
          disabled={editMode ? editMode : settlement.length <= 1}
        >
          <MaterialIcons.DeleteOutlined fontSize="small" />
          Eliminar Fracción
        </Button>
      )}
      <Button
        size="small"
        variant="text"
        onClick={handleDownloadPdf}
        className={`${rowAcomulated >= 100 || rowAcomulated === 0 ? 'text-[rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'} w-[166px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase outline-none`}
        disabled={rowAcomulated >= 100 || rowAcomulated === 0}
      >
        <MaterialIcons.FileDownloadOutlined
          className={'icon-red'}
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
        Comprobante
      </Button>
    </>
  )

  const formatDate = (date: Date) => {
    const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
    const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') // Los meses son indexados desde 0
    const year = date.getFullYear()
    return `${day}-${month}-${year}`
  }

  const generatePDF = async (record: IReportOperation) => {
    const nro = record.settlement.issuedReceiptNumber || 'NRO'
    const nombreEntidad =
      Number(record?.settlement.side.id) === 1
        ? record?.participantBuy.name
        : record?.participantSell.name
    const now = new Date()
    const fecha = formatDate(now)
    const fileName = `Comp_${nro}_${nombreEntidad}_${fecha}_${identification}.pdf`

    let blob

    try {
      blob = await pdf(<VoucherDocumentC data={record} />).toBlob()
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error generating PDF blob:', error)
      throw error
    }

    return { blob, fileName }
  }

  const handleDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (
      (!records || records.length === 0) &&
      setViewToast &&
      userType === 'EXTERNAL'
    ) {
      console.error('No records found')
      setViewToast(true)
      setToastMessage('Debe seleccionar al menos un beneficiario')
      setToastVariant('warning')
      return
    }
    setModalContent2({
      title: 'Confirmación de descarga',
      message: '¿Está seguro de que desea descargar el comprobante?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Sí',
      textCancel: 'No',
      handleCancel: () => {
        setModalContent2(null)
      },
      onClick: async () => {
        setModalContent2(null)
        setIsLoadingModal(true)
        try {
          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
          let result: any = []
          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
          let sideId: any
          if (tradeId) {
            if (userType === 'INTERNAL') {
              sideId = [
                {
                  sideId: 1
                },
                {
                  sideId: 2
                }
              ]
            } else {
              sideId = [
                {
                  sideId: activeTab
                }
              ]
            }
            result = await reportOperations(client_user, tradeId, sideId)
            if (result.length === 0) {
              console.error('No records found in the additional request')
              setIsLoadingModal(false)
              return
            }

            const totalRecords = result.length
            setTotalRecords(totalRecords)

            if (totalRecords === 1) {
              // Generar un solo PDF
              const firstResult = result[0]
              const { blob, fileName } = await generatePDF(firstResult)

              if (blob) {
                saveAs(blob, fileName)
              } else {
                console.error(
                  `Failed to generate PDF for record ${firstResult.trade.id}`
                )
              }
            } else {
              // Generar un archivo ZIP con múltiples PDFs
              const zip = new JSZip()

              for (let i = 0; i < totalRecords; i++) {
                const dataOp = result[i]
                const { blob, fileName } = await generatePDF(dataOp)

                if (blob) {
                  // Asegurarse de que cada archivo tenga un nombre único
                  const uniqueFileName = `${fileName.replace('.pdf', '')}_${i + 1}.pdf`
                  zip.file(uniqueFileName, blob)
                } else {
                  console.error(
                    `Failed to generate PDF for record ${dataOp.trade.id}`
                  )
                }

                // Update progress
                setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / totalRecords) * 100))
              }

              const from = totalRecords > 0 ? 1 : 0
              const to = totalRecords >= 1 ? totalRecords : 0
              const now = new Date()
              const fecha = formatDate(now)

              const nameDownload = `${from}-${to}_${name}_${fecha}_${client_user}.zip`

              const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' })
              saveAs(zipBlob, nameDownload)
            }

            setIsToastVisible(true)
            const { id: statusId } = status || {}
            GenerateLogs(client_user, {
              actionType: `Generación de comprobantes de operación por el usuario con identificación ${identification} NUAM NUBO`,
              actionDestination: 'OperationDetails',
              participantId: participantId,
              countryId: country?.id,
              userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
              statusId: statusId
            })
          }

          /* eslint-disable-next-line */
        } catch (error) {
          setModalContent2({
            title: 'Error en el servidor',
            message:
              'Ha ocurrido un error en el servidor. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.',
            variant: 'error',
            onClick: () => {
              setModalContent2(null)
            }
          })
        } finally {
          setIsLoadingModal(false)
        }
      }
    })
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Traslado a Custodio') {
      setDescription(
        'Selecciona las fracciones que vas a trasladar a un custodio.'
      )
      setbtnAceptText('Trasladar a custodio')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas enviar ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'} al custodio?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones enviadas' : 'Fracción enviada'} al custodio con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Realizar Pre-Match') {
      setDescription(
        'Selecciona las fracciones a los que vas a realizar Pre-Match'
      )
      setbtnAceptText('Realizar Pre-match')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas realizar pre-match de ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones enviadas' : 'Fracción enviada'} a prematch con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Admisión Custodio') {
      setDescription('Selecciona las fracciones que vas a admitir')
      setbtnAceptText('Admitir')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas admitir ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones admitidas' : 'Fracción admitida'} con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio') {
      setDescription('Selecciona las fracciones que vas a rechazar')
      setbtnAceptText('rechazar')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas rechazar ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal && thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones rechazadas' : 'Fracción rechazada'} con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
  }, [selectedCustodian, thereAreSelectedModal])

  return {
    dataGeneral,
    dataOperationStatus,
    participantId,
    currentSide: activeTab,
    description,
    btnAceptText,
    textModalConfirm,
    columnsModules,
    toastMessage,
    toastVariant,
    handleTabChange,
    navigate,
    headerActionsLeft,
    isLoadingModal,
    setIsLoadingModal,
    progress,
    totalRecords,
    setIsToastVisible,
    isToastVisible,
    modalContent2,
    deleteFraction,
    handleDownloadPdf,
    isModalOpenTwo,
    modalDetailAccountTwo,
    setIsModalOpenTwo,
    setActiveTab
  }
}
```

## src/pages/FolioDetailPage/Hooks/useFolioDetailFetch.ts

```typescript
import axios from 'axios'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom'

import { getParamUrl } from '../../../helpers'
import { FolioDetailModel } from '../../../models/folioDetail.model'
import { getFolioDetailById } from '../../../services'

// import { GlobalStatusContext } from "../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext";

export const useFolioDetailFetch = ({
  client_user,
  updateTable,
  setIsLoading
}: {
  client_user: string | null
  origin?: string | null
  updateTable?: boolean
  setIsLoading?: (arg: boolean) => void
}) => {
  // const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext);
  const { tradeId } = useParams<{ tradeId: string }>()
  const tradeIdNumber = Number(getParamUrl('tradeId'))
  const [folioDetail, setFolioDetail] = useState<FolioDetailModel>()
  const directDepositorData =
    folioDetail?.trade?.specialTrade?.directDepositorOutDto

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTradeData = async () => {
      try {
        if (setIsLoading) setIsLoading(true)
        const folioDetailResponse = await getFolioDetailById(
          tradeIdNumber ? tradeIdNumber : tradeId,
          client_user
        )
        setFolioDetail(folioDetailResponse)
      } catch (error) {
        if (
          axios.isAxiosError(error) &&
          error.response?.status &&
          error.response.status !== 401
        ) {
          // const errorMessage = error.response.status === 500
          //     ? "Ha ocurrido un error en el servidor. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde."
          //     : "Ha ocurrido un error inesperado. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.";
          // setModalContent({
          //     title: error.response.status === 500 ? "Error en el servidor" : "Error inesperado",
          //     message: errorMessage,
          //     variant: 'error',
          //     onClick: () => {
          //         setModalContent(null);
          //         navigate('/operation-management/');
          //     },
          // });
        }
      } finally {
        if (setIsLoading) setIsLoading(false)
      }
    }

    fetchTradeData()
  }, [client_user, tradeId, updateTable])

  return {
    folioDetail,
    directDepositorData,
    setFolioDetail
  }
}
```

## src/pages/FolioDetailPage/Hooks/useFolioDetailHistory.tsx

```tsx
import { useContext, useState } from 'react'

import { ModalAlertProps } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { STRINGS } from '../../../helpers/strings'
import { ModalFollowUpColumns, ModalHistoryModel } from '../../../models'
import { getTradeHistoryV2 } from '../../../services'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../folioDetailStrings'

export const useFolioDetailHistory = (
  tradeId: number,
  folio: number,
  fecha: string | undefined,
  client_user: string | null
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [modalHistory, setModalHistory] = useState<
    ModalHistoryModel | undefined
  >()
  const [modalDetailAccount, setModalDetailAccount] = useState<any>(null)
  const [isModalFollowUp, setIsModalFollowUp] = useState(false)
  const [modalFollowUpColumns, setModalFollowUpColumns] =
    useState<ModalFollowUpColumns>()
  const [modalContent, setModalContent] = useState<ModalAlertProps | null>(null)
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false)

  const handleTradeHistory = async ({
    currentTradeId,
    currentFolio,
    currentFecha
  }: {
    currentTradeId?: string | number
    currentFolio?: string | number
    currentFecha?: string
  } = {}) => {
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)

      let data

      if (currentTradeId) {
        data = await getTradeHistoryV2(Number(currentTradeId), client_user)
      } else {
        data = await getTradeHistoryV2(tradeId, client_user)
      }

      const custodianColumns = data.custodianStatusHistory.map((history) => {
        const [year, month, day] = history.date?.split('-') ?? ''
        return {
          Fecha: `${day}/${month}/${year}`,
          Hora: history.time.slice(0, 5),
          Estado: history.status.description,
          Punta: history.side.description,
          Beneficiario: history.beneficiaryId,
          Detalle: history.status.detail
        }
      })

      const complianceColumns = data.complianceStatusHistory.map((history) => {
        const [year, month, day] = history.date?.split('-') ?? ''
        return {
          Fecha: `${day}/${month}/${year}`,
          Hora: history.time.slice(0, 5),
          Estado: history.status.description,
          Detalle: history.status.detail
        }
      })

      setModalFollowUpColumns({
        custodianColumns: {
          title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.HISTORY.CUSTODIAN_TITLE,
          content: custodianColumns
        },
        complianceColumns: {
          title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.HISTORY.STATUS,
          content: complianceColumns
        }
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching trade history:', error)
      setModalContent({
        title: STRINGS.ERROR.SERVER_ERROR,
        message: STRINGS.ERROR.SERVER_ERROR_MESSAGE,
        variant: 'error',
        onClick: () => {
          setModalContent(null)
          setIsModalFollowUp(false)
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
    setModalHistory({
      title: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.HISTORY.TITLE,
      subtitle: {
        bold: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.HISTORY.SUBTITLE,
        text: currentFolio ?? folio ?? 'N/A'
      },
      subtitle2: {
        bold: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.HISTORY.SUBTITLE2,
        text: currentFecha ?? fecha ?? 'N/A'
      },
      columns: modalFollowUpColumns!
    })
    setIsModalFollowUp(true)
  }

  return {
    modalHistory,
    modalDetailAccount,
    isModalFollowUp,
    modalFollowUpColumns,
    modalContent,
    isModalOpen,
    setIsModalOpen,
    handleTradeHistory,
    setModalDetailAccount,
    setIsModalFollowUp,
    setModalContent
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { Modal } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import noData from '../../../assets/no_data.svg'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../folioDetailStrings'

interface ModalInfoProps {
  setIsModalOpen: (isOpen: boolean) => void
  title: string
  subtitle: { bold: string; text: string | number }
  subtitle2?: { bold: string; text: string | number }
  dataColumns: any
}

const columnWidths = {
  Fecha: '70px',
  Hora: '50px',
  Estado: '120px',
  Punta: '60px',
  Beneficiario: '80px',
  Fracción: '50px',
  Detalle: '100px'
}

export const ModalInfo = ({
  setIsModalOpen,
  subtitle,
  subtitle2,
  dataColumns
}: ModalInfoProps) => {
  return (
    <Modal
      handleClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
      showCancelButton={false}
      width="800px"
    >
      <div className="border-b-input-bg flex gap-6 border-b">
        <h2 className="text-text pb-2 text-base">
          <span className="font-bold">{subtitle.bold}</span> {subtitle.text}
        </h2>
        {subtitle2 && (
          <h2 className="text-text pb-2 text-base">
            <span className="font-bold">{subtitle2.bold}</span> {subtitle2.text}
          </h2>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="scrollbar-thin overflow-auto" style={{ height: '500px' }}>
        {dataColumns?.assignmentColumns?.content && (
          <>
            <div className="pb-[10px] pt-[15px]">
              {dataColumns?.assignmentColumns?.title}
            </div>
            {tableGenerator(
              dataColumns?.assignmentColumns?.content,
              columnWidths
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {dataColumns?.custodianColumns?.content && (
          <>
            <div className="pb-[10px] pt-[15px]">
              {dataColumns?.custodianColumns?.title}
            </div>
            {tableGenerator(
              dataColumns?.custodianColumns?.content,
              columnWidths
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {dataColumns?.complianceColumns?.content && (
          <>
            <div className="pb-[10px] pt-[15px]">
              {dataColumns?.complianceColumns?.title}
            </div>
            {tableGenerator(
              dataColumns?.complianceColumns?.content,
              columnWidths
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </Modal>
  )
}

function tableGenerator(
  columns: { [key: string]: any }[],
  columnWidths: { [key: string]: string }
) {
  const headers = columns?.length > 0 ? Object.keys(columns[0]) : []

  return (
    <div
      className="scrollbar-thin overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-red-400"
      style={{ height: '240px', marginRight: '10px' }}
    >
      {columns?.length > 0 ? (
        <table className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="textCol text-text border-b-2 border-gray-300 font-bold">
              {headers.map((header, index) => (
                <th
                  key={index}
                  className="text-text py-3 pl-2 pr-2 text-start"
                  style={{ width: columnWidths[header] || 'auto' }}
                >
                  {header}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {columns.map((row, rowIndex) => (
              <tr
                key={rowIndex}
                className="border-input-bg group border hover:bg-[#F8E2DA]"
              >
                {headers.map((header, colIndex) => (
                  <td
                    key={colIndex}
                    className="text-text text-ellipsis whitespace-pre-line break-words py-3 pl-2 pr-2"
                  >
                    {row[header]}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center bg-[#F4F4F4]">
          <img src={noData} alt="No Data" className="mb-5 h-28" />
          <p className="text-light-orange mb-5 text-2xl font-bold">
            {FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.NO_DATA.TITLE}
          </p>
          <p className="text-text text-sm">
            {FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.NO_DATA.DESCRIPTION}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
```

```tsx
        - {footerText} -
      </Text>
    </Page>
  )
}

export const VoucherDocumentC: React.FC<VoucherDocumentProps> = ({ data }) => {
  return (
    <Document>
      <VoucherPage footerText="AFILIADO" data={data} />
      <VoucherPage footerText="CLIENTE o COPIA" data={data} />
    </Document>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { Document, Page, Text, View, StyleSheet } from '@react-pdf/renderer'

import { IReportOperation } from '../types'

interface VoucherDocumentProps {
  data: IReportOperation | null
}

interface VoucherPageProps {
  footerText: string
  data: any
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  page: {
    padding: 20
  },
  header: {
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between'
  },
  leftColumn: {
    width: '50%',
    borderTop: '1px solid black',
    borderBottom: '1px solid black',
    borderLeft: '1px solid black',
    padding: 10
  },
  rightColumn: {
    width: '50%',
    border: '1px solid black',
    padding: 10,
    textAlign: 'center',
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'column',
    gap: 5
  },
  box: {
    border: '1px solid black',
    padding: 10
  },
  boxWithOutBottom: {
    borderTop: '1px solid black',
    borderLeft: '1px solid black',
    borderRight: '1px solid black',
    padding: 10
  },
  boxWithOutTop: {
    borderBottom: '1px solid black',
    borderLeft: '1px solid black',
    borderRight: '1px solid black',
    padding: 10
  },
  row: {
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'row',
    justifyContent: 'space-between'
  },

    gap: 4

})
```

## src/pages/FolioDetailPage/components/ReassignmentTab.tsx

```tsx
import { YesOrNotComponent } from '@/components'
import { formatNumberWithTwoDecimals } from '@/helpers/utilities'
import { Trade, TradeEquity } from '@/models/folioDetail.model'
import { DETAIL_STRINGS } from '@/pages/OperationDetailPage'
import { Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useState } from 'react'

import {
  BoxInfo,
  NewTable,
  TabComponent
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

import { reassignmentColumns } from '../constants/reassignmentColumns'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../folioDetailStrings'

interface ReassignmentTabProps {
  specialTradeId?: string
  trade: Trade
  tradeEquity: TradeEquity
  currentSide: number
  participantId?: number
  userType?: string
  tradeIdNumber: number
}

export const ReassignmentTab: React.FC<ReassignmentTabProps> = ({
  trade,
  tradeEquity,
  currentSide,
  participantId,
  userType,
  tradeIdNumber
}) => {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([])

  const setDataRemoteInner = (_page: number, dataTable: []) =>
    setRows(dataTable)

  const handleTabChange = (index: number) => setActiveTab(index + 1)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(1)

  const currency = trade?.currency
    ? `${trade?.currency?.code} - ${trade?.currency?.name}`
    : trade?.currency?.name || 'N/A'

  const participantBuy = trade?.participantBuy?.code
    ? `${trade?.participantBuy?.code} - ${trade?.participantBuy?.name}`
    : trade?.participantBuy?.name || 'N/A'

  const boxInfo = [
    {
      title: 'Column 1',
      rows: [
        { label: 'Participante', value: participantBuy },
        {
          label: 'Precio de liquidación',
          value: formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
            trade?.price?.toString() ?? 'N/A',
            true
          )
        },
        {
          label: 'Monto total',
          value: trade?.volume
            ? formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
                trade?.volume?.toString() ?? 'N/A',
                true
              )
            : 'N/A'
        },
        {
          label: 'Recaudo compra',
          value: trade?.purchaseCollectionStatus?.description ?? 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: 'Column 2',
      rows: [
        {
          label: 'Responsable de la operación',
          value:
            activeTab == 1
              ? (tradeEquity?.foreignBrokerBuy ?? 'N/A')
              : (tradeEquity?.foreignBrokerSell ?? 'N/A')
        },
        {
          label: 'Moneda de liquidación',
          value: currency
        },
        {
          label: 'Estado punta',
          value:
            activeTab == 1
              ? (trade?.buyStatus?.description ?? 'N/A')
              : (trade?.sellStatus?.description ?? 'N/A')
        },
        {
          label: 'Pago venta',
          value: trade?.salePaymentStatus?.description ?? 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: 'Column 3',
      rows: [
        {
          label: 'Código del fondo (Solo AFP)',
          value:
            activeTab == 1
              ? (trade?.afpFundBuy?.description ?? '')
              : (trade?.afpFundSell?.description ?? '')
        },
        {
          label: 'Cantidad',
          value: formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
            trade?.quantity?.toString() ?? 'N/A',
            true
          )
        },
        {
          label: 'Garantia Compra',
          value: (
            <YesOrNotComponent
              value={!!trade?.salesGuarantee || !!trade?.purchaseGuarantee}
            />
          )
        },
        {
          label: activeTab == 1 ? 'Ciclo posterior' : 'Ciclo Previo',
          value: trade?.subsequentCycleStatus?.description ?? 'N/A',
          infoText: 'Solo aplica Chile.'
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  const canSeeBuy =
    userType === 'INTERNAL' || trade?.participantBuy?.id === participantId

  const canSeeSell =
    userType === 'INTERNAL' || trade?.participantSell?.id === participantId

  const buyTabDisabled = !canSeeBuy
  const sellTabDisabled = !canSeeSell

  const getEndpointBySide = (sideId: number) =>
    `${ENDPOINTS.REASSIGNMENT_BY_SIDE}?specialTradeId=${tradeIdNumber}&sideId=${sideId}`

  const reassignmentTabs = [
    {
      label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.BUY,
      content: (
        <>
          <BoxInfo columns={boxInfo} noBorder={false} />
          <Typography variant="h6" className="my-3 text-start font-bold">
            Seguimiento Reasignaciones
          </Typography>
          <NewTable
            key={`reassignment-buy-${currentSide}`}
            axiosInstanceKey={DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
            columns={reassignmentColumns}
            endpoint={getEndpointBySide(1)}
            checkboxSelection={false}
            rows={rows}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemoteInner}
            rowsPerPageOptions={[10, 20, 30, 50]}
          />
        </>
      ),
      id: 'BUY',
      disabled: buyTabDisabled
    },
    {
      label: FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.SELL,
      content: (
        <>
          <BoxInfo columns={boxInfo} noBorder={false} />
          <Typography variant="h6" className="my-3 text-start font-bold">
            Seguimiento Reasignaciones
          </Typography>
          <NewTable
            key={`reassignment-sell-${currentSide}`}
            axiosInstanceKey={DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
            columns={reassignmentColumns}
            endpoint={getEndpointBySide(2)}
            checkboxSelection={false}
            rows={rows}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemoteInner}
            rowsPerPageOptions={[10, 20, 30, 50]}
          />
        </>
      ),
      id: 'SELL',
      disabled: sellTabDisabled
    }
  ]

  return (
    <>
      <TabComponent
        tabs={reassignmentTabs}
        onTabChange={handleTabChange}
        hasShadow={false}
      />
    </>
  )
}

export default ReassignmentTab

```

## src/pages/FolioDetailPage/components/SettlementTab.tsx

```tsx
import getColumns from '@/pages/FolioDetailPage/utils/getColumns'
import { columns } from '@/pages/FolioDetailPage/utils/getTableColumns'
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import {
  BoxInfo,
  Dropdown,
  NewTable
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

type ExtraInfoType = {
  participantBuyCodeName: string
  participantSellCodeName: string
}

const SettlementTab = ({ tradeId }: any) => {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([])
  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: any[]) => {
    const newRows =
      dataTable?.map((data, i) => ({
        ...data,
        index: i + 1
      })) || []
    setRows(newRows as any)
  }
  const [extraInfo, setExtraInfo] = useState<ExtraInfoType>()

  const endpoint = useMemo(() => {
    // const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
    return `${ENDPOINTS.FRACTION_REASSIGNMENT}/${tradeId}`
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [window.location.search])

  const boxInfoColumns = useMemo(() => {
    const { participantBuyCodeName = '', participantSellCodeName = '' } =
      extraInfo || {}
    return getColumns({ participantBuyCodeName, participantSellCodeName })
  }, [extraInfo])

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="mb-10">
        <BoxInfo columns={boxInfoColumns} />
      </div>
      <NewTable
        getAllResponse={(data: any) => {
          if (extraInfo?.participantBuyCodeName) return
          const {
            participantBuyCodeName = 'N/A',
            participantSellCodeName = 'N/A'
          } = data || {}
          setExtraInfo({ participantBuyCodeName, participantSellCodeName })
          console.log(data)
        }}
        customToolbar={
          // TODO: Aquí se agregarán las opciones de cumplimiento a medida que se implementen
          <Dropdown
            title="OPCIONES DE CUMPLIMIENTO"
            options={[]}
            disabled={true}
          />
        }
        axiosInstanceKey="httpOperationCmdReassignment"
        checkboxSelection={true}
        columns={columns}
        endpoint={endpoint}
        hasTotalCalculation={true}
        provisionalId="fractionId"
        rows={rows}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

export default SettlementTab

```

```tsx
import { TRenderCellParams } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'

import formatDate from '@/shared/utils/formatDate'

const columnsForAssociatedFolios = [
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Fecha de registro',
    field: 'matchDate',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) =>
      row?.recordDate ? formatDate(row.recordDate) : ''
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Folio Asociado',
    field: 'matchId',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => row?.associatedFolioNumber || ''
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Fecha cumplimiento',
    field: 'clearingDate',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => row?.settlementDate ?? ''
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Participante compra',
    field: 'participantBuy.name',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
      const { code = '', name = '' } = row?.buyParticipant || {}
      return code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
    }
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    field: 'participantSell.name',
    headerName: 'Participante venta',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
      const { code = '', name = '' } = row?.sellParticipant || {}
      return code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
    }
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Custodio compra',
    field: 'custodianIdBuy', // PENDIENTE - cambiar custodianBuy.name
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
      const { code = '', name = '' } = row?.buyCustodian || {}
      return code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
    }
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Custodio venta',
    field: 'custodianIdSell', // PENDIENTE - cambiar a custodianSell.name
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
      const { code = '', name = '' } = row?.sellCustodian || {}
      return code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
    }
  },
  {
    flex: 1,
    headerName: 'Estado',
    field: 'status.description',
    renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => row?.status?.description ?? ''
  }
]

export default columnsForAssociatedFolios
```

```typescript
import { httpOperationCmdReassignment } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

type Props = {
  tradeId: string
  fractionToSearch: string
  currentPage: number
  itemsPerPage: number
}

const getFractionsId = async ({
  tradeId,
  fractionToSearch = '',
  currentPage = CURRENT_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT,
  itemsPerPage = ITEMS_PER_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT
}: Props) => {
  const searchParams = fractionToSearch ? `fractionId=${fractionToSearch}&` : ''
  const params = `${searchParams}page=${currentPage}&size=${itemsPerPage}`
  const urlWithParams = `${ENDPOINTS.FRACTION_REASSIGNMENT_IDS}/${tradeId}?${params}`

  const response = await get({
    axiosInstance: httpOperationCmdReassignment,
    urlWithParams
  })

  const {
    data: { content, totalPages }
  } = response || {}

  return {
    data: content.map((fractionId: number) => ({
      id: fractionId,
      name: fractionId,
      label: fractionId
    })),
    total: totalPages
  }
}

export default getFractionsId

```
