## src/pages/FoliosPage/FoliosPage.tsx

```tsx
import {
  MaterialIcons,
  TRenderCellParams
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  ContentWrapper,
  MuiSelect,
  InputBasic,
  ModalAlert,
  ModalContent,
  ModalLoad,
  Toast,
  NewTable,
  FilterBar
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

import { STRINGS } from '../../helpers/strings'
import { ModalFollowUpColumns, FolioSpecialTradeModel } from '../../models'
import { getRejectionReason, updateSettlementStatus } from '../../services'
import {
  ModalInfo,
  useFolioDetailFetch,
  useFolioDetailHistory
} from '../FolioDetailPage'
import { useFolioFulfillment } from './Hooks/useFolioFulfillment'
import { useFolioTableCopy } from './Hooks/useFolioTableCopy'
import { useOptionsCustodian } from './Hooks/useOptionsCustodian'
import { filtersConfig } from './constants/filterConfig'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from './foliosStrings'

export interface InfoSend {
  id?: string
  tradeId: number
  fraction: number
  sideId: string
  custodianId?: number
  ficAdministratorId?: number
  statusId: number
  custodianStatusId: number
}

export const FoliosPage = () => {
  const [selectedFolios, setSelectedFolios] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<FolioSpecialTradeModel[]>([])
  const [modalTransferCustodian, setModalTransferCustodian] = useState(false)
  const [modalConfirm, setModalConfirm] = useState(false)
  const [selectedCustodian, setSelectedCustodian] = useState<string>()
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<string[] | number[]>(
    []
  )
  const [thereAreSelectedModal, setThereAreSelectedModal] = useState<
    string[] | number[]
  >([])
  const [settlementsCustodian, setSettlementsCustodian] = useState<[]>([])
  const [thereIsCustodianSelected, setThereIsCustodianSelected] =
    useState<boolean>(false)
  const [quantityCustodian, setQuantityCustodian] = useState<InfoSend[]>([])
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [currentStatus, setCurrentStatus] = useState(0)
  const [listRejection, setListRejection] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [textRejection, setTextRejection] = useState<string>('')
  const [causalRejection, setCausalRejection] = useState<any>()
  const [currentMotivo, setcurrentMotivo] = useState<number>(0)
  const [checkedAll, setCheckedAll] = useState(false)
  const [isToastVisible, setIsToastVisible] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [isToastVisibleError, setIsToastVisibleError] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [activeBtn, setActiveBtn] = useState<boolean>(false)
  const [closeValidation, setCloseValidation] = useState<boolean>(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (rows.length > 0 && rows[0].settlementStatus?.id === 46) {
      setCloseValidation(true)
    }
  }, [rows])

  let validateThereCheck
  if (
    (currentStatus === 21 || currentStatus === 22 || currentStatus === 23) &&
    thereAreSelectedModal.length > 0
  ) {
    validateThereCheck = true
  }
  if (
    (currentStatus === 20 && thereIsCustodianSelected) ||
    ((currentStatus === 21 || currentStatus === 22 || currentStatus === 23) &&
      thereAreSelectedModal.length === 0)
  ) {
    validateThereCheck = false
  }

  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams()

  const tradeId = searchParams.get('tradeId') ?? STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
  const sideId = searchParams.get('sideId') ?? STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING

  const { infoUserNubo, username } = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth
  )
  const {
    participantId,
    id: id_user_nubo,
    status,
    country,
    identification,
    userType,
    name
  } = infoUserNubo
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')

  const { folioDetail } = useFolioDetailFetch({
    client_user,
    origin
  })

  const { columnsCustodian, allCustodiansSameStatus } = useOptionsCustodian({
    settlementsCustodian,
    thereAreSelectedModal,
    setThereIsCustodianSelected,
    setQuantityCustodian,
    currentStatus,
    modalTransferCustodian,
    setIsToastVisibleError,
    setActiveBtn
  })

  const {
    handleTradeHistory,
    isModalFollowUp,
    setIsModalFollowUp,
    modalHistory,
    modalFollowUpColumns
  } = useFolioDetailHistory(
    folioDetail?.trade.id ?? 0,
    folioDetail?.trade.matchId ?? 0,
    folioDetail?.trade.matchDate.toString().split('T')[0],
    client_user
  )

  const { handleSetModal } = useFolioFulfillment(
    thereAreSelected,
    infoUserNubo,
    client_user
  )

  const {
    columnsModules,
    headerActionsLeft,
    description,
    btnAceptText,
    textModalConfirm,
    toastMessage,
    toastVariant,
    isLoadingModal,
    setIsLoadingModal,
    progress,
    totalRecords,
    modalContent2,
    handleDownloadExcel
  } = useFolioTableCopy({
    participantId,
    setSelectedCustodian,
    setModalTransferCustodian,
    selectedCustodian,
    thereAreSelected,
    userType,
    setSettlementsCustodian,
    quantityCustodian,
    setCurrentStatus,
    thereAreSelectedModal,
    tradeId,
    sideId,
    identification,
    id_user_nubo,
    status,
    country,
    checkedAll,
    name,
    handleTradeHistory,
    closeValidation,
    handleSetModal,
    rows,
    setViewToast
  })

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const handleAcceptTransferCustodian = () => {
    setModalConfirm(true)
  }

  const handleChangeCausal = (e: number) => {
    setcurrentMotivo(e)
    setCausalRejection({
      ...causalRejection,
      motivoId: e
    })
  }

  const handleChangeRejection = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setTextRejection(e.target.value)
    setCausalRejection({
      ...causalRejection,
      motivo: e.target.value
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio') {
      const getListRejection = async () => {
        const response = await getRejectionReason()
        response.map((item: { id: number; reason: string }) => {
          const data = { id: item.id, name: item.reason }
          setListRejection((prev) => [...prev, data])
        })
      }
      getListRejection()
    }
  }, [selectedCustodian])

  const handleClose = (e: boolean) => {
    setModalTransferCustodian(e)
    setThereAreSelectedModal([])
    setActiveBtn(false)
  }
  const getValidateBtn = () => {
    if (causalRejection) {
      return false
    } else {
      return true
    }
  }

  const onRowDoubleClick = (params: TRenderCellParams) => {
    const rowId = params.row.id
    const specialTradeParam = tradeId ? `specialtradeId=${tradeId}&` : ''
    navigate(
      `${FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL}${rowId}/?${specialTradeParam}tradeId=${rowId}&origin=detail_folio`
    )
  }

  const endpoint = useMemo(() => {
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)?.toString()
    const specialTradeParam = tradeId ? `specialTradeId=${tradeId}` : ''
    const params = urlParams
      ? specialTradeParam
        ? `&${urlParams}`
        : urlParams
      : ''
    return `${ENDPOINTS.ALL_FOLIOS}?${specialTradeParam}${params}`
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [window.location.search])

  return (
    <>
      {participantId && (
        <ContentWrapper
          title="Visualización folios - Operaciones Especiales"
          className=""
        >
          <FilterBar config={filtersConfig} />
          <NewTable
            customToolbar={headerActionsLeft(selectedFolios)}
            columns={columnsModules}
            endpoint={endpoint}
            axiosInstanceKey={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
            setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
            setThereAreSelected={(rows: any) => {
              setThereAreSelected(rows || [])
              setSelectedFolios(rows || [])
            }}
            setCheckedAll={setCheckedAll}
            onRowDoubleClick={onRowDoubleClick}
            className="cursor-pointer"
            addMenuItems={[
              {
                text: 'Descargar (.xls/.xlsx)',
                onClick: () => handleDownloadExcel(),
                icon: <MaterialIcons.Download fontSize="small" />
              }
            ]}
          />
        </ContentWrapper>
      )}
      {modalTransferCustodian && (
        <ModalContent
          title={selectedCustodian}
          description={description}
          handleClose={handleClose}
          handleAccept={handleAcceptTransferCustodian}
          className="w-full max-w-[1140px]"
          btnCancelText="Cancelar"
          btnAceptText={btnAceptText}
          btnDisabled={
            selectedCustodian === 'Traslado a Custodio'
              ? validateThereCheck ||
                !allCustodiansSameStatus ||
                !thereIsCustodianSelected
              : !(activeBtn && validateThereCheck)
          }
        >
          <NewTable
            columns={columnsCustodian}
            // endpoint={`/trade/all-special-trade?specialTradeId=${tradeId}`}
            // axiosInstanceKey={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
            rows={settlementsCustodian}
            isSettlement={true}
            rowsPerPageOptions={[10]}
            setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelectedModal}
          />
        </ModalContent>
      )}
      {modalConfirm && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={textModalConfirm}
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess={btnAceptText}
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={() => {
            setModalTransferCustodian(false)
            setActiveBtn(false)

            if (selectedCustodian) {
              updateSettlementStatus({
                quantityCustodian,
                setViewToast,
                setModalConfirm,
                causalRejection,
                selectedCustodian,
                infoUserNubo,
                username
              })
            }
          }}
          handleCancel={() => setModalConfirm(false)}
          disabled={
            selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio' ? getValidateBtn() : false
          }
        >
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-y-[30px]">
            {selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio' && (
              <MuiSelect
                options={listRejection}
                placeholder="Seleccione una opción"
                onChange={handleChangeCausal}
                className="w-full"
                nameValue="reason"
              />
            )}
            {causalRejection && currentMotivo === 14 && (
              <InputBasic
                key="textRejection"
                field="textRejection"
                id="textRejection"
                label="¿Cuál?"
                value={textRejection}
                onChange={handleChangeRejection}
                className="h-[40px]"
              />
            )}
          </div>
        </ModalAlert>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={toastMessage}
          variant={toastVariant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
      {modalContent2 && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalContent2.title}
          message={modalContent2.message}
          variant={modalContent2.variant}
          onClick={modalContent2.onClick}
          handleCancel={modalContent2.handleCancel}
          textCancel={modalContent2.textCancel}
          textSuccess={modalContent2.textSuccess}
        />
      )}
      {isLoadingModal && (
        <ModalLoad
          reset={() => setIsLoadingModal(false)}
          progress={progress}
          message="Estamos preparando la descarga:"
          fileName={totalRecords === 1 ? '' : 'comprobantes.zip'}
          closeButtonText="Cancelar"
        />
      )}
      {isModalFollowUp && (
        <ModalInfo
          setIsModalOpen={setIsModalFollowUp}
          title={modalHistory?.title || STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING}
          subtitle={
            modalHistory?.subtitle || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          subtitle2={
            modalHistory?.subtitle2 || {
              bold: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING,
              text: STRINGS.EMPTY_STRING
            }
          }
          dataColumns={modalFollowUpColumns as ModalFollowUpColumns}
        />
      )}
      {isToastVisible && (
        <Toast
          text="Descarga completada"
          onClose={() => setIsToastVisible(!isToastVisible)}
        />
      )}

      {isToastVisibleError && selectedCustodian === 'Traslado a Custodio' && (
        <Toast
          text="Custodios no pueden ser diferentes."
          variant="error"
          onClose={() => setIsToastVisibleError(!isToastVisibleError)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  )
}

```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useFolioFulfillment.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { ReactNode, useContext } from 'react'

import { GenerateLogs, NewTable } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ModalAlertProps } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { BuySellComponent } from '../../../components'
import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { checkParticipant, errorManagment } from '../../../helpers'
import {
  sendCollection,
  sendDeposit,
  sendPayment,
  sendPealUnlock
} from '../../../services'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../foliosStrings'

export const useFolioFulfillment = (
  thereAreSelected: string[] | number[],
  infoUserNubo: any,
  client_user: string | null,
  tradeIdExists?: string | number
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const { participantId, id: id_user_nubo, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  const FolioStatusContent = (rows: any) => {
    const columnsModules: GridColDef[] = [
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 300,
        field: 'specialOperationid',
        headerName: 'Operación Especial',
        type: 'string',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{`${params.row.specialTrade.specialOperationId} - ${params.row.specialTrade.specialOperationName}`}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 150,
        field: 'matchDate',
        headerName: 'Fecha registro',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{params.row.matchDate}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 180,
        field: 'clearingDate',
        headerName: 'Fecha de cumplimiento',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{params.row.clearingDate}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 180,
        field: 'matchId',
        headerName: 'Folio',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{params.row.matchId}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 100,
        field: 'fraction',
        headerName: 'Fracción',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{params.row.fraction}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 140,
        headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.PARTICIPANT,
        field: 'participant',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container className="text-sm">
            <BuySellComponent
              booleanBuy={true}
              valueBuy={params.row.participantBuy.code}
              booleanSell={true}
              valueSell={params.row.participantSell.code}
              participantId={participantId}
              type={checkParticipant(
                participantId,
                params.row.participantBuy.id,
                params.row.participantSell.id
              )}
            />
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 140,
        headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN,
        field: 'custodian',
        renderCell: (params) => (
          <Container className="text-sm">
            {params.row.custodianSell && (
              <BuySellComponent
                booleanBuy={true}
                valueBuy={params.row.custodianBuy.code}
                booleanSell={true}
                valueSell={params.row.custodianSell.code}
                type={checkParticipant(
                  participantId,
                  params.row.custodianBuy.id,
                  params.row.custodianSell.id
                )}
              />
            )}
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        filterable: true,
        width: 500,
        headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.REASON,
        field: 'reason',
        renderCell: (params) => <Container>{params.row.reason}</Container>
      }
    ]
    return (
      <NewTable
        columns={columnsModules}
        rows={rows}
        disableColumnMenu
        disableColumnResize
        disableColumnSorting
        disableRowSelectionOnClick
        hideFooter
        checkboxSelection={false}
        // getRowHeight={() => 'auto'}
        height="320px"
      />
    )
  }

  const setTitleAndMessageFolioError = (
    title: string,
    typeError: 'default' | 'deposit' = 'default'
  ) => {
    const titleAndMessage = {
      default: {
        message: `Algunos de los folios no cumplen con las condiciones para ${title}, a continuación los detalles.`,
        title: `No es posible realizar el ${title}`
      },
      deposit: {
        message: `Algunos de los folios no cumplen con las condiciones para enviar al deposito, a continuación los detalles.`,
        title: `No es posible enviar la ${title}`
      }
    }
    return {
      title: titleAndMessage[typeError].title,
      message: titleAndMessage[typeError].message
    }
  }

  const handleAction = async (
    type: 'deposit' | 'unblock' | 'collection' | 'payment',
    title: string
  ) => {
    context?.clearModalAlert()
    try {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      const service = {
        deposit: sendDeposit,
        unblock: sendPealUnlock,
        collection: sendCollection,
        payment: sendPayment
      }[type]

      let response: any

      if (tradeIdExists) {
        response = await service([{ tradeId: Number(tradeIdExists) }])
      } else {
        response = await service(
          thereAreSelected.map((id) => ({ tradeId: Number(id) }))
        )
      }

      if (response.validOperation) {
        GenerateLogs(client_user ?? '', {
          actionType: title,
          actionDestination:
            'operation-spec-management/operation-detail/folios',
          participantId: participantId,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
          statusId: status?.id
        })
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text:
            type === 'payment'
              ? 'Solicitud de pago registrada'
              : 'Se registro exitosamente su solicitud de envío al deposito.',
          variant: 'success'
        })
      } else {
        const titleAndMessage = setTitleAndMessageFolioError(
          title,
          type === 'deposit' ? 'deposit' : 'default'
        )
        setModalAlert({
          title: titleAndMessage.title,
          message: titleAndMessage.message,
          variant: 'warning',
          textCancel: 'Volver',
          handleCancel: () => {},
          children: FolioStatusContent(response.trade),
          containerClassName: 'px-[30px] py-[33px]',
          contentClassName: 'bg-blue-200',
          iconClose: true,
          width: '1140px'
        })
      }
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error en opciones de cumplimiento',
        variant: 'error',
        message: errorManagment(error),
        textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const dataAlertProps: { [key: string]: ModalAlertProps } = {
    deposit: {
      title: '¿Enviar liquidación a deposito?',
      variant: 'warning',
      message: '¿Estás seguro de enviar al deposito las filas seleccionadas?',
      textSuccess: 'Enviar a deposito',
      textCancel: 'cancelar',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        handleAction('deposit', 'liquidación al depósito')
      }
    },
    unblock: {
      title: 'Desbloqueo de repique',
      variant: 'warning',
      message:
        '¿Estás seguro de desbloquear por repique las filas seleccionadas?',
      textSuccess: 'Desbloquear',
      textCancel: 'cancelar',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        handleAction('unblock', 'desbloqueo de repique')
      }
    },
    collection: {
      title: 'Recaudo al comprador',
      variant: 'warning',
      message:
        '¿Estás seguro de realizar un recaudo al comprador de las filas seleccionadas?',
      textSuccess: 'Solicitar recaudo',
      textCancel: 'cancelar',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        handleAction('collection', 'recaudo al comprador')
      }
    },
    payment: {
      title: 'Pago al vendedor',
      variant: 'warning',
      message:
        '¿Estás seguro de realizar pago al venderor de las filas seleccionadas?',
      textSuccess: 'Solicitar pago',
      textCancel: 'cancelar',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        handleAction('payment', 'pago al vendedor')
      }
    }
  }

  const handleSetModal = (type: string) => {
    setModalAlert(dataAlertProps[type])
  }

  const setModalAlert = (data: ModalAlertProps) => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: data.title,
      variant: data.variant,
      message: data.message,
      textSuccess: data.textSuccess,
      textCancel: data.textCancel,
      orientation: data.orientation,
      onClick: data.onClick,
      children: data.children,
      containerClassName: data.containerClassName,
      contentClassName: data.contentClassName,
      iconClose: data.iconClose,
      width: data.width,
      textSuccessColor: data.textSuccessColor
    })
  }

  return { handleSetModal }
}
```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useFolioStates.ts

```typescript
import { useState } from 'react'

import { ModalAlertProps } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import { STRINGS } from '../../../helpers/strings'
import { Columnfilter } from '../../../models/columnfilter.model'
import { ItemModel } from '../../../models/item.model'
import { ModalHistoryModel } from '../../../models/modalHistory.model'
import { ModalContentModel } from '../../../models/modelContent.model'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../foliosStrings'

const useFolioStates = (participantId: string, tradeId: string) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState<ItemModel[]>([])
  const [loadingModal, setLoadingModal] = useState({
    isLoading: false,
    fileName: '',
    progress: 0
  })
  const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<ItemModel[]>([])
  const [sidePanel, setSidePanel] = useState(false)
  const [clearFilters, setClearFilters] = useState(false)
  const [modalAlert, setModalAlert] = useState<ModalAlertProps | null>(null)
  const [_modalContent, setModalContent] = useState<ModalContentModel | null>(
    null
  )
  const [modalHistory, setModalHistory] = useState<ModalHistoryModel | null>(
    null
  )
  const [isModalFollowUp, setIsModalFollowUp] = useState(false)
  const [modalFollowUpColumns, setModalFollowUpColumns] = useState<
    {
      Fecha: string
      Hora: string
      Estado: string
      Punta: string
      Fracción: number
      Detalle: string
    }[]
  >([])
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Columnfilter>({
    sort: 'id',
    order: false,
    url:
      participantId &&
      `${FOLIOS_STRINGS.URL_API}?${FOLIOS_STRINGS.SPECIAL_TRADE_ID}=${tradeId}`
  })
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME)

  return {
    data,
    setData,
    setLoadingModal,
    loadingModal,
    selectedItems,
    setSelectedItems,
    clearFilters,
    sidePanel,
    setSidePanel,
    setClearFilters,
    filter,
    setFilter,
    modalAlert,
    setModalAlert,
    isModalFollowUp,
    setIsModalFollowUp,
    modalHistory,
    setModalHistory,
    setModalContent,
    modalFollowUpColumns,
    setModalFollowUpColumns,
    client_user
  }
}

export default useFolioStates
```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useFolioTable.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react'
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import { ModalAlertProps } from '../../../Declares/declares'
import iconDownload from '../../../assets/icons/icon-download.svg'
import iconFilter from '../../../assets/icons/icon-filter.svg'
import iconSort from '../../../assets/icons/icon-sort.svg'
import {
  BuySellComponent,
  ComplianceComponent,
  YesOrNotComponent
} from '../../../components'
import { columnsXLS } from '../../../helpers'
import { generateCsvReport, generateExcelReport } from '../../../hooks'
import {
  ItemModel,
  ModalContentModel,
  ModalHistoryModel
} from '../../../models'
import { getAllSettlement } from '../../../services'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../foliosStrings'

export const useFolioTable = (
  client_user: string | null,
  participantId: string,
  selectedItems: ItemModel[],
  handleSetSidePanel: (value: boolean) => void,
  handleSetFilter: (sort: string) => void,
  setLoadingModal: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<{
      isLoading: boolean
      fileName: string
      progress: number
    }>
  >,
  loadingModal: { isLoading: boolean; fileName: string; progress: number },
  data: ItemModel[],
  setModalAlert: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<ModalAlertProps | null>>,
  _setModalHistory: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<ModalHistoryModel | null>
  >,
  _setModalContent: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<ModalContentModel | null>
  >,
  _setIsModalFollowUp: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<boolean>>,
  _setModalFollowUpColumns: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<
      {
        Fecha: string
        Hora: string
        Estado: string
        Punta: string
        Fracción: number
        Detalle: string
      }[]
    >
  >,
  _modalFollowUpColumns: {
    Fecha: string
    Hora: string
    Estado: string
    Punta: string
    Fracción: number
    Detalle: string
  }[]
) => {
  const headerActions = async (action: { type: string; url?: string }) => {
    if (
      action.type ===
      FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_DOWNLOAD_ACTION_TYPE
    ) {
      setModalAlert({
        title: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.TITLE,
        message: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.MESSAGE,
        variant: 'warning',
        textSuccess: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.SUCCESS,
        textCancel: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.CANCEL,
        handleCancel: () => {
          setModalAlert(null)
        },
        onClick: async () => {
          setModalAlert(null)
          setLoadingModal({
            isLoading: true,
            fileName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_LOADING.MESSAGE_XLS,
            progress: 0
          })
          generateExcelReport(
            selectedItems,
            columnsXLS,
            FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_DOWNLOAD_FILE_NAME
          )
          setLoadingModal({ isLoading: false, fileName: '', progress: 0 })
        }
      })
    }
    if (
      action.type ===
      FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_CSV_ACTION_TYPE
    ) {
      setModalAlert({
        title: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.TITLE,
        message: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.MESSAGE,
        variant: 'warning',
        textSuccess: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.SUCCESS,
        textCancel: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_ALERT.CANCEL,
        handleCancel: () => {
          setModalAlert(null)
        },
        onClick: async () => {
          setModalAlert(null)
          setLoadingModal({
            isLoading: true,
            fileName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.MODAL_LOADING.MESSAGE_CSV,
            progress: 0
          })
          const trades = await getAllSettlement(client_user, participantId)
          generateCsvReport(
            trades,
            FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_CSV_FILE_NAME
          )
          setLoadingModal({ isLoading: false, fileName: '', progress: 0 })
        }
      })
    }
    if (
      action.type ===
      FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_FILTER_ACTION_TYPE
    )
      handleSetSidePanel(true)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout
    if (loadingModal.isLoading) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setLoadingModal((prev) => {
          const newProgress = prev.progress + 10
          if (newProgress >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval)
            return { ...prev, progress: 100 }
          }
          return { ...prev, progress: newProgress }
        })
      }, 1000)
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [loadingModal.isLoading])

  const checkParticipant = (
    participantId: string,
    valueBuy: string,
    valueSell: string
  ) => {
    if (participantId === valueBuy && participantId === valueSell) {
      return true
    } else if (participantId === valueBuy) {
      return FOLIOS_STRINGS.CHECK_PARTICIPANT.BUY
    } else if (participantId === valueSell) {
      return FOLIOS_STRINGS.CHECK_PARTICIPANT.SELL
    } else {
      return false
    }
  }

  const columnsModules = useMemo(
    () => [
      {
        width: 2,
        name: (
          <input
            key="0"
            id="check-0"
            type="checkbox"
            className="r-2 border-light-orange checked:after:content-checked ml-2 h-5 w-5 appearance-none rounded border checked:border-green-500 checked:bg-green-500 checked:after:flex checked:after:h-full checked:after:w-full checked:after:items-center checked:after:justify-center"
          />
        ),
        render: (row: any) => (
          <div>
            <input
              key={row.id}
              id={`check-${row.id}`}
              type="checkbox"
              className="r-2 border-light-orange checked:after:content-checked pointer-events-none ml-2 h-5 w-5 appearance-none rounded border checked:border-green-500 checked:bg-green-500 checked:after:flex checked:after:h-full checked:after:w-full checked:after:items-center checked:after:justify-center"
            />
          </div>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 5,
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SPEC_OPERATION_ID}
            </span>
          </div>
        ),
        render: (row: { specialTrade: { id: number } }) => (
          <span> {row?.specialTrade.id} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 7,
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SPEC_OPERATION_NAME}
            </span>
          </div>
        ),
        render: (row: { specialTrade: { specialOperationName: string } }) => (
          <span> {row?.specialTrade.specialOperationName} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 5,
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.REGISTER}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('matchDate')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        render: (row: { matchDate: string }) => <span> {row?.matchDate} </span>
      },
      {
        width: 5,
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.FOLIO}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('matchId')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        render: (row: { matchId: string }) => <span> {row?.matchId} </span>
      },
      {
        name: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.COMPLIANCE,
        width: 5,
        render: (row: {
          type: { description: string }
          clearingDate: string
          returnClearingDate: string
          participantBuy: { id: string }
          participantSell: { id: string }
        }) => (
          <ComplianceComponent
            dateIn={row.clearingDate}
            dateOut={row.returnClearingDate}
            type={row.type.description}
          />
        )
      },
      {
        width: 6,
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.COMPLIANCE_STATUS}
            </span>
          </div>
        ),
        render: (row: { settlementStatus: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row?.settlementStatus.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.DEPOSITORY}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('depository')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 4,
        render: (row: { depository: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row?.depository.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.COUNTRY}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('country')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 4,
        render: (row: { country: any }) => <span> {row?.country.name} </span>
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.TYPE}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('type')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 5,
        render: (row: { type: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row?.type.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.PAYMENT_TYPE}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('paymentType.description')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 7,
        render: (row: { paymentType: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row?.paymentType.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.PAYMENT_TYPE_INDICATOR}
            </span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('paymentType.description')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 5,
        render: (row: { purchasePaymentIndicator: boolean }) => (
          <YesOrNotComponent value={row?.purchasePaymentIndicator} />
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MNEMONIC}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('securityTitle.mnemonic')}

          </div>
        ),
        width: 5,
        render: (row: { securityTitle: { mnemonic: string } }) => (
          <span> {row.securityTitle.mnemonic} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.PARTICIPANT,
        width: 5,
        render: (row: {
          participantBuy: { code: string; id: string }
          participantSell: { code: string; id: string }
        }) => (
          <BuySellComponent
            booleanBuy={true}
            valueBuy={row.participantBuy.code}
            booleanSell={true}
            valueSell={row.participantSell.code}
            participantId={participantId}
            type={checkParticipant(
              participantId,
              row.participantBuy.id,
              row.participantSell.id
            )}
          />
        )
      },
      {
        name: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN,
        width: 4,
        render: (row: {
          participantBuy: { code: string; id: string }
          participantSell: { code: string; id: string }
        }) => (
          <BuySellComponent
            booleanBuy={true}
            valueBuy={row.participantBuy.code}
            booleanSell={true}
            valueSell={row.participantSell.code}
            type={checkParticipant(
              participantId,
              row.participantBuy.id,
              row.participantSell.id
            )}
          />
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN_STATUS}
            </span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('securityTitle.mnemonic')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 5,
        render: (row: { custodianStatus: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row.custodianStatus.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.ASSIGNMENT}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('securityTitle.mnemonic')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 4,
        render: (row: {
          assignmentMarkBuy: boolean
          assignmentMarkSell: boolean
        }) => (
          <BuySellComponent
            booleanBuy={row.assignmentMarkBuy}
            booleanSell={row.assignmentMarkSell}
          />
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.ASSIGNMENT_STATUS}
            </span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('securityTitle.mnemonic')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 8,
        render: (row: { settlementStatus: { description: string } }) => (
          <span> {row.settlementStatus.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        name: (
          <div className="flex items-center">
            <span>{FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.CANCEL}</span>
            <img
              src={iconSort}
              alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.SORT}
              className="w-4 cursor-pointer"
              onClick={() => handleSetFilter('securityTitle.mnemonic')}
            />
          </div>
        ),
        width: 5,
        render: (row: { canceledStatus: boolean }) => (
          <YesOrNotComponent value={row.canceledStatus} applyBg={false} />
        )
      },
      {
        width: 3,
        name: '',
        render: (row: ItemModel) => (
          <div className="hidden hover:underline group-hover:inline-block">
            <Link
              className="text-red-500"
              to={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL + row.id}
            >
              {FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE}
            </Link>
          </div>
        )
      }
    ],
    [data]
  )

  const headerActionsModule = [
    {
      label: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_COMPLIANCE_OPTIONS,
      type: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
        .MENU_COMPLIANCE_OPTIONS_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt={
            FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
              .MENU_COMPLIANCE_OPTIONS_ACTION_TYPE
          }
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_CUSTODIAN_OPTIONS,
      type: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
        .MENU_CUSTODIAN_OPTIONS_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt={
            FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
              .MENU_CUSTODIAN_OPTIONS_ACTION_TYPE
          }
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_COMPENSATION_STATUS,
      type: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
        .MENUS_COMPENSATION_STATUS_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt={
            FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
              .MENUS_COMPENSATION_STATUS_ACTION_TYPE
          }
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_DOWNLOAD,
      disabled: selectedItems.length === 0,
      type: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_CSV_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_DOWNLOAD}
          className={selectedItems.length === 0 ? 'icon-gray' : 'icon-red'}
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_FILTER,
      type: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_FILTER_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconFilter}
          alt={FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.MENU_FILTER}
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    }
  ]

  return {
    headerActions,
    columnsModules,
    headerActionsModule
  }
}

```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useFolioTableCopy.tsx

```tsx
import { generateTxtReport } from '@/hooks'
import {
  getFindAllSettlementByUser,
  reportFolioDetailTxtMultiple
} from '@/services'
import {
  Button,
  MaterialIcons,
  TRenderCellParams
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { PropsWithChildren, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { Dropdown, GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import formatDate from '@/shared/utils/formatDate'

import eyeIcon from '../../../assets/icons/eyeIcon.svg'
import { disabledItemsMenu } from '../../../helpers/folioFullfillment'
import { FolioSpecialTradeModel } from '../../../models'
import { InfoSend } from '../FoliosPage'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../foliosStrings'
import { generateFileExcel } from '../helpers/generateFileExcel'
import { useHandleNoCompliance } from './useHanleNoCompliance'

interface MenuOptionProps {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  action?: () => void
  textSize?: string
  textColor?: string
  subItems?: MenuOptionProps[]
  disabled?: boolean
}

type PropsContainer = PropsWithChildren<{ className?: string }>

const Container = ({ children, className }: PropsContainer) => (
  <div className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}>
    {children}
  </div>
)

type Folio = {
  participantId: string
  setSelectedCustodian: (arg: string) => void
  setModalTransferCustodian: (arg: boolean) => void
  setSettlementsCustodian: (arg: []) => void
  selectedCustodian?: string
  thereAreSelected: string[] | number[]
  userType: string
  quantityCustodian: InfoSend[]
  setCurrentStatus: (arg: number) => void
  thereAreSelectedModal: string[] | number[]
  closeValidation: boolean
  SettlementList?: any[]
  tradeId?: string
  sideId?: string
  identification?: string
  id_user_nubo?: string
  status?: { id: string }
  country?: { id: string }
  checkedAll?: boolean
  name?: string
  handleTradeHistory?: (arg?: {
    currentTradeId?: string | number
    currentFolio?: string | number
    currentFecha?: string
  }) => void
  setCurrentTradeId?: (arg: number) => void
  handleSetModal: (type: string) => void
  rows: FolioSpecialTradeModel[]
  setViewToast?: (arg: boolean) => void
}

export const useFolioTableCopy = ({
  participantId,
  setModalTransferCustodian,
  setSelectedCustodian,
  selectedCustodian,
  thereAreSelected,
  userType,
  setSettlementsCustodian,
  setCurrentStatus,
  thereAreSelectedModal,
  tradeId,
  id_user_nubo,
  status,
  country,
  checkedAll,
  name,
  handleTradeHistory,
  closeValidation,
  rows,
  handleSetModal,
  setViewToast
}: Folio) => {
  const registerLog = () => {
    GenerateLogs(client_user ?? '', {
      actionType: '¿Registrar incumplimientos?',
      actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/operation-detail/folios',
      participantId: participantId,
      countryId: country?.id,
      userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
      statusId: status?.id
    })
  }
  const { onExecutionAction } = useHandleNoCompliance({
    title: 'Incumplimiento',
    rows
  })

  const [isOptionCustodianDisabled, setIsOptionCustodianDisabled] =
    useState(false)
  const [isLoadingModal, setIsLoadingModal] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [totalRecords, setTotalRecords] = useState(0)
  const [modalContent2, setModalContent2] = useState<any>(null)
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState('')
  const [toastVariant, setToastVariant] = useState('')
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('')
  const [btnAceptText, setbtnAceptText] = useState('')
  const [textModalConfirm, settextModalConfirm] = useState('')

  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username') as string

  useEffect(() => {
    if (thereAreSelected?.length > 0) {
      setIsOptionCustodianDisabled(true)
    }
    if (thereAreSelected?.length === 0) {
      setIsOptionCustodianDisabled(false)
    }
  }, [thereAreSelected])

  const columnsModules = [
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 80,
      field: 'specialTradeId ',
      headerName: 'ID',
      type: 'string',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.specialTrade?.specialOperationId || ''}
            </p>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 200,
      field: 'specialTrade.specialOperationName',
      headerName: 'Operación Especial',
      type: 'string',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName || ''}
            </p>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'matchDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha Registro',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">
            {row?.matchDate ? formatDate(row.matchDate) : 'N/A'}
          </p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'matchId',
      headerName: 'Folio',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.matchId ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'clearingDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha Cumplimiento',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">
            {row?.clearingDate ? formatDate(row.clearingDate) : 'N/A'}
          </p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Estado',
      field: 'statusDescription',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
        const currentTradeId = row?.id
        const currentFolio = row?.matchId
        const currentFecha = row?.matchDate

        return (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.status?.description || 'N/A'}</p>
            <div className="flex items-center hover:underline group-hover:inline-block">
              <img
                src={eyeIcon}
                alt="eyeIcon"
                className="h-6 w-6 cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() =>
                  handleTradeHistory &&
                  handleTradeHistory({
                    currentTradeId,
                    currentFolio,
                    currentFecha
                  })
                }
              />
            </div>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'depositoryDescription',
      headerName: 'Deposito',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.depository?.description ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'countryName',
      headerName: 'País',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.country?.name ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'typeDescription',
      headerName: 'Tipo de Operación',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.type?.description ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Nemotécnico',
      field: 'securityTitleMnemonic',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.securityTitle?.mnemonic ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Participante Compra',
      field: 'ParticipantBuyCode',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.participantBuy?.code ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Participante Venta',
      field: 'ParticipantSellCode',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.participantSell?.code ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Custodio Compra',
      field: 'custodianIdBuy',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.custodianBuy?.code ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Custodio Venta',
      field: 'custodianIdSell',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.custodianSell?.code ?? 'N/A'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Asignación Compra',
      field: 'assignmentMarkBuy',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.assignmentMarkBuy ? 'Sí' : 'No'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      headerName: 'Asignación Venta',
      field: 'assignmentMarkSell',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{row?.assignmentMarkSell ? 'Sí' : 'No'}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    }
  ]

  const options = [
    'Traslado a Custodio',
    'Realizar Pre-Match',
    'Admisión Custodio',
    'Rechazo Custodio'
  ]
  const optionToIdMap: Record<string, number> = {
    'Traslado a Custodio': 20, // TRASLADADA
    'Realizar Pre-Match': 21, // PRE-MATCH
    'Admisión Custodio': 22, // ADMITIDA
    'Rechazo Custodio': 23 // RECHAZADA
  }

  const filterForStatus = (
    response: FolioSpecialTradeModel[],
    selectedOption: string
  ) => {
    // Maquina de estados
    const selectedStatus = optionToIdMap[selectedOption] // ID de la opción seleccionada
    setCurrentStatus(selectedStatus)
    if (selectedStatus === 20) {
      // vista Traslado a custodio apareceran ==> Rechazo [23] y nulos
      return response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 23 || item.custodianStatus === null
      )
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 21) {
      // vista Prematch apareceran ==> Traslado [20]
      return response.filter((item) => item.custodianStatus?.id === 20)
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 22) {
      // vista Admision apareceran ==> Traslado [20], Prematch [21]
      return response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 20 || item.custodianStatus?.id === 21
      )
    }
    if (selectedStatus === 23) {
      // vista Rechazo apareceran ==> Traslado [20], Prematch [21], Admitida [22]
      return response.filter(
        (item) =>
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 20 ||
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 21 ||
          item.custodianStatus?.id === 22
      )
    }

    if (!selectedStatus) return []
  }

  const handleSelect = async (option: string) => {
    const response = await getFindAllSettlementByUser({
      tradeIds: thereAreSelected,
      participantId,
      userType
    })
    const responseFilter = filterForStatus(response, option)
    // @ts-expect-error not sure about the type
    setSettlementsCustodian(responseFilter)
    setSelectedCustodian(option)
    setModalTransferCustodian(true)
  }

  const optionsWithSubmenus: MenuOptionProps[] = [
    {
      id: 'envio-liquidacion-deposito',
      label: 'Envío liquidación a depósito',
      action: () => handleSetModal('deposit'),
      disabled: disabledItemsMenu({
        id: 'envio-liquidacion-deposito',
        rows,
        selectedRows: thereAreSelected
      })
    },
    {
      id: 'envio-asignacion-deposito',
      label: 'Envío asignación al depósito',
      action: () =>
        console.info('Botón clickeado: Envío asignación al depósito'),
      disabled: disabledItemsMenu({
        id: 'envio-asignacion-deposito',
        rows,
        selectedRows: thereAreSelected
      })
    },
    {
      id: 'recaudo-comprador',
      label: 'Recaudo al comprador',
      action: () => handleSetModal('collection'),
      disabled: disabledItemsMenu({
        id: 'recaudo-comprador',
        rows,
        selectedRows: thereAreSelected
      })
    },
    {
      id: 'pago-vendedor',
      label: 'Pago al vendedor',
      action: () => handleSetModal('payment'),
      disabled: disabledItemsMenu({
        id: 'pago-vendedor',
        rows,
        selectedRows: thereAreSelected
      })
    },
    {
      id: 'incumplimiento',
      label: 'Incumplimiento',
      action: () =>
        onExecutionAction({
          generateLogs: registerLog,
          participantId: participantId,
          thereAreSelected: thereAreSelected
        }),
      disabled: disabledItemsMenu({
        id: 'incumplimiento',
        rows,
        selectedRows: thereAreSelected
      })
    }
  ]

  const headerActionsLeft = (rows: any[]) => {
    const isDisabled = !(rows?.length === 1)
    const specialTradeParam = tradeId ? `specialtradeId=${tradeId}&` : ''
    const URL = isDisabled
      ? ''
      : FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL +
        rows[0] +
        `/?${specialTradeParam}tradeId=${rows[0]}&origin=detail_folio`

    return (
      <div className="folios-toolbar">
        <Button
          disabled={isDisabled}
          className="center disabled flex text-sm font-medium"
          variant="text"
          onClick={() => navigate(URL)}
        >
          VER ASIGNACIÓN
        </Button>

        <Dropdown
          title="OPCIONES DE CUMPLIMIENTO"
          options={optionsWithSubmenus}
          disabled={thereAreSelected.length === 0}
        />

        <Dropdown
          title="Opciones de Custodio"
          options={options}
          onSelect={handleSelect}
          disabled={!isOptionCustodianDisabled || closeValidation}
        />

        {userType === 'INTERNAL' && (
          <Button
            className="center flex text-sm font-medium"
            variant="text"
            onClick={() =>
              navigate(
                `/operation-spec-management/compensations?specialTradeId=${tradeId}`
              )
            }
          >
            COMPENSACIÓN
          </Button>
        )}

        <Button
          className="center flex text-sm font-medium"
          variant="text"
          onClick={handleDownloadTXT}
        >
          <MaterialIcons.FileDownloadOutlined
            className="icon-red"
            style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
          />
          COMPROBANTE MASIVO
        </Button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const handleDownloadExcel = () => {
    if (rows.length === 0 && setViewToast) {
      console.error('No records found in the additional request')
      setViewToast(true)
      setToastMessage('No se encontraron registros en la solicitud')
      setToastVariant('warning')
      setIsLoadingModal(false)
      return
    }

    setIsLoadingModal(true)
    setModalContent2({
      title: 'Confirmación de descarga',
      message: '¿Está seguro de que desea descargar el comprobante?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Sí',
      textCancel: 'No',
      handleCancel: () => {
        setIsLoadingModal(false)
        setModalContent2(null)
      },
      onClick: async () => {
        try {
          setModalContent2(null)
          setIsLoadingModal(true)

          const data = rows.map((row) => ({
            ID: row?.specialTrade?.specialOperationId || '',
            'Operación Especial': row?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName || '',
            'Fecha Registro': row?.matchDate
              ? formatDate(row.matchDate)
              : 'N/A',
            Folio: row?.matchId ?? 'N/A',
            'Fecha Cumplimiento': row?.clearingDate
              ? formatDate(row.clearingDate)
              : 'N/A',
            Estado: row?.status?.description || 'N/A',
            Deposito: row?.depository?.description ?? 'N/A',
            País: row?.country?.name ?? 'N/A',
            'Tipo de Operación': row?.type?.description ?? 'N/A',
            Nemotécnico: row?.securityTitle?.mnemonic ?? 'N/A',
            'Participante Compra': row?.participantBuy?.code ?? 'N/A',
            'Participante Venta': row?.participantSell?.code ?? 'N/A',
            'Custodio Compra': row?.custodianBuy?.code ?? 'N/A',
            'Custodio Venta': row?.custodianSell?.code ?? 'N/A',
            'Asignación Compra': row?.assignmentMarkBuy ? 'Sí' : 'No',
            'Asignación Venta': row?.assignmentMarkSell ? 'Sí' : 'No'
          }))

          const now = new Date()
          const fechaDeGeneracion = now
            .toLocaleDateString('es-ES')
            .replace(/\//g, '-')
          const fileName = `Op_especiales_${fechaDeGeneracion}`

          await generateFileExcel(data, setProgress, fileName)
          setProgress(0)

          if (setViewToast) {
            setViewToast(true)
            setToastMessage('Su descarga se ha realizado exitosamente')
            setToastVariant('success')
          }
        } catch {
          console.log(' error al descargar el excel')
          setModalContent2({
            title: 'Error en el servidor',
            message:
              'Ha ocurrido un error al descargar el archivo Excel. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.',
            variant: 'error',
            onClick: () => {
              setModalContent2(null)
            }
          })
        } finally {
          setIsLoadingModal(false)
        }
      }
    })
  }

  const handleDownloadTXT = async () => {
    const records = await getFindAllSettlementByUser({
      tradeIds: thereAreSelected,
      participantId,
      userType
    })

    if (records.length === 0 && setViewToast) {
      console.error('No records found')
      setViewToast(true)
      setToastMessage('Debe seleccionar al menos un folio')
      setToastVariant('warning')
      return
    }
    setIsLoadingModal(true)
    setModalContent2({
      title: 'Confirmación de descarga',
      message: '¿Está seguro de que desea descargar el comprobante?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Sí',
      textCancel: 'No',
      handleCancel: () => {
        setIsLoadingModal(false)
        setModalContent2(null)
      },
      onClick: async () => {
        setModalContent2(null)
        setIsLoadingModal(true)
        try {
          let data: FolioSpecialTradeModel[] = []
          // let sideIdSend:any = []
          if (thereAreSelected) {
            if (checkedAll || thereAreSelected.length > 0) {
              const getTradeId = thereAreSelected.map(
                (item: string | number) => {
                  return {
                    tradeId: item
                  }
                }
              )
              const userId = id_user_nubo
              data = await reportFolioDetailTxtMultiple(
                client_user,
                getTradeId,
                userId
              )
              generateTxtReport({ data, name, setProgress })
              setProgress(0)
            }

            if (data.length === 0 && setViewToast) {
              console.error('No records found in the additional request')
              setViewToast(true)
              setToastMessage('No se encontraron registros en la solicitud')
              setToastVariant('warning')
              setIsLoadingModal(false)
              return
            }

            const totalRecords = data.length
            setTotalRecords(totalRecords)
          }

          GenerateLogs(client_user, {
            actionType: `Generación de comprobantes en Visualización de operaciones especiales por Folio`,
            actionDestination: 'OperationSpecials/Folio',
            participantId: participantId,
            countryId: country?.id,
            userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
            statusId: status?.id
          })
        } catch (error) {
          console.log('🚀 ~ handleDownloadTXT ~ error:', error)
          setModalContent2({
            title: 'Error en el servidor',
            message:
              'Ha ocurrido un error en el servidor. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.',
            variant: 'error',
            onClick: () => {
              setModalContent2(null)
            }
          })
        } finally {
          setIsLoadingModal(false)
        }
      }
    })
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Traslado a Custodio') {
      setDescription(
        'Selecciona las fracciones que vas a trasladar a un custodio.'
      )
      setbtnAceptText('Trasladar a custodio')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas enviar ${thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'} al custodio?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones enviadas' : 'Fracción enviada'} al custodio con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Realizar Pre-Match') {
      setDescription(
        'Selecciona las fracciones a los que vas a realizar Pre-Match'
      )
      setbtnAceptText('Realizar Pre-match')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas realizar pre-match de ${thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones enviadas' : 'Fracción enviada'} a prematch con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Admisión Custodio') {
      setDescription('Selecciona las fracciones que vas a admitir')
      setbtnAceptText('Admitir')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas admitir ${thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones admitidas' : 'Fracción admitida'} con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
    if (selectedCustodian === 'Rechazo Custodio') {
      setDescription('Selecciona las fracciones que vas a rechazar')
      setbtnAceptText('rechazar')
      settextModalConfirm(
        `¿Deseas rechazar ${thereAreSelectedModal.length} ${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'fracciones' : 'fracción'}?`
      )
      setToastMessage(
        `${thereAreSelectedModal.length > 1 ? 'Fracciones rechazadas' : 'Fracción rechazada'} con éxito`
      )
      setToastVariant('success')
    }
  }, [selectedCustodian, thereAreSelectedModal])

  return {
    columnsModules,
    headerActionsLeft,
    description,
    btnAceptText,
    textModalConfirm,
    toastMessage,
    toastVariant,
    isLoadingModal,
    setIsLoadingModal,
    progress,
    totalRecords,
    modalContent2,
    handleDownloadTXT,
    handleDownloadExcel
  }
}
```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useHanleNoCompliance.tsx

```tsx
import {
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState
} from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { errorManagment } from '../../../helpers'
import { FolioSpecialTradeModel } from '../../../models'
import { sendEnforceNoCompliance, sendNoCompliance } from '../../../services'
import { FolioStatusContentNoCompliance } from '../../OperationDetailPage/components/FoliosNoCompliance/FoliosStatusContentNoCompliance'
import { FolioStatusContentNoComplianceError } from '../../OperationDetailPage/components/FoliosNoCompliance/FoliosStatusContentNoComplianceError'

export const useHandleNoCompliance = ({
  rows,
  title
}: {
  title: string
  rows: FolioSpecialTradeModel[]
}) => {
  const [thereAreSelectedModal, setThereAreSelectedModal] = useState<
    (number | string)[]
  >([])
  const selectedMotivesRef = useRef<
    {
      specialOperationId: number
      matchId: number
      value: number
      label: string
    }[]
  >([])
  const selectedItemsRef = useRef<any[]>([])
  const dataAlertProps = useMemo(
    () => ({
      noncompliance: {
        title: '¿Registrar incumplimientos?',
        variant: 'warning',
        message:
          '¿Estás seguro de realizar un registro de incumplimiento para las filas seleccionadas?',
        textSuccess: 'Registrar Incumplimientos',
        textCancel: 'cancelar',
        orientation: 'horizontal',
        handleCancel() {
          setThereAreSelectedModal([])
        },
        onClick: () => {
          handleSendNoCompliance()
        }
      }
    }),
    []
  )

  const handleSendNoCompliance = async () => {
    const payload = selectedMotivesRef.current.map((item) => ({
      specialTradeId: item.specialOperationId, // este es tu ID del specialTrade
      matchId: item.matchId ?? 0,
      reasonId: item.value, // value del motivo seleccionado
      motive: item.label ?? '' // descripción del motivo
    }))

    try {
      const response = await sendEnforceNoCompliance(payload)

      if (response.validOperation) {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'Incumplimiento registrado con exito',
          variant: 'success'
        })
      } else {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'Incumplimiento no registrado',
          variant: 'error'
        })
      }
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error en opciones de cumplimiento',
        variant: 'error',
        message: errorManagment(error),
        textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      selectedMotivesRef.current = []
      setThereAreSelectedModal([])
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const selectedRows = rows.filter((row: any) =>
      thereAreSelectedModal.includes(row.id)
    )
    selectedItemsRef.current = selectedRows
  }, [thereAreSelectedModal, rows])

  const setTitleAndMessageFolioError = (
    title: string,
    typeError: 'default' | 'deposit' | 'noncompliance' = 'default'
  ) => {
    const titleAndMessage = {
      default: {
        message: `Algunos de los folios no cumplen con las condiciones para ${title}, a continuación los detalles.`,
        title: `No es posible realizar el ${title}`
      },
      deposit: {
        message: `Algunos de los folios no cumplen con las condiciones para enviar al deposito, a continuación los detalles.`,
        title: `No es posible enviar la ${title}`
      },
      noncompliance: {
        message: `¿Estás seguro de generar el ${title} para los folios generados? Selecciona una razon de ${title} por folio`,
        title: `${title}`
      }
    }
    return {
      title: titleAndMessage[typeError].title,
      message: titleAndMessage[typeError].message
    }
  }

  const onExecutionAction = useCallback(
    async ({
      generateLogs,
      participantId,
      thereAreSelected
    }: {
      participantId: string
      generateLogs: () => void
      thereAreSelected: string[] | number[]
    }) => {
      context?.clearModalAlert()
      const service = sendNoCompliance
      const thereAreSelectedTyped: number[] = thereAreSelected.filter(
        (item): item is number => typeof item === 'number'
      )
      const matchingRows = rows.filter((row) =>
        thereAreSelectedTyped.includes(row.id)
      )
      const hasValidDescriptions = matchingRows.some((row) => {
        const description = row?.status?.category?.toUpperCase?.()
        return ['ASIGNACION', 'CUSTUDIOS', 'CUMPLIMIENTO'].includes(description)
      })
      try {
        const response = await service(
          rows.map((row: any) => ({
            specialTradeId: row.specialTrade.id,
            matchId: row.matchId,
            statusId: row.specialTrade.statusId,
            canceledStatus: true,
            participantId: row.specialTrade.participantId,
            typeId: row.specialTrade.typeId,
            countryId: row.specialTrade.countryId,
            startMatchDate: row.matchDate,
            endMatchDate: row.matchDate,
            endClearingDate: row.clearingDate
          }))
        )
        if (!response.validOperation) {
          generateLogs()
        } else if (hasValidDescriptions) {
          const titleAndMessage = setTitleAndMessageFolioError(
            title,
            'noncompliance'
          )
          setModalAlert({
            title: titleAndMessage.title,
            message: titleAndMessage.message,
            variant: 'warning',
            textSuccess: 'Enviar incumplimiento',
            textCancel: 'Cancelar',
            handleCancel: () => {
              context?.setLoading(false)
            },
            onClick: () => {
              if (selectedItemsRef.current.length > 0) {
                setModalAlert(dataAlertProps['noncompliance'])
                console.log(selectedMotivesRef.current)
              }
            },
            children: (
              <FolioStatusContentNoCompliance
                participantId={participantId.toString()}
                rows={response.trade}
                setThereAreSelectedModal={setThereAreSelectedModal}
                onSelectChange={handleSelectChange}
              />
            ),
            orientation: 'horizontal',
            containerClassName: 'px-[30px] py-[33px]',
            contentClassName: 'w-full',
            iconClose: true,
            width: '90%'
          })
        } else {
          const titleAndMessage = setTitleAndMessageFolioError(
            title,
            'noncompliance'
          )
          setModalAlert({
            title: titleAndMessage.title,
            message: titleAndMessage.message,
            variant: 'warning',
            textCancel: 'Reintentar',
            handleCancel: () => {
              context?.setLoading(false)
            },
            children: (
              <FolioStatusContentNoComplianceError
                participantId={participantId.toString()}
                rows={matchingRows}
              />
            ),
            orientation: 'horizontal',
            containerClassName: 'px-[30px] py-[33px]',
            contentClassName: 'w-full',
            iconClose: true,
            textSuccessColor:
              selectedItemsRef.current.length > 0 ? 'primary' : 'inherit',
            width: '90%'
          })
        }
      } catch (error) {
        context?.setModalAlert({
          title: 'Ocurrió un error en opciones de cumplimiento',
          variant: 'error',
          message: errorManagment(error),
          textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
          textCancel: 'hidden',
          onClick: () => {
            context?.clearModalAlert()
          }
        })
      } finally {
        context?.setLoading(false)
      }
    },
    [rows]
  )

  const handleSelectChange = (
    specialOperationId: number,
    matchId: number,
    option: { value: number; label: string }
  ) => {
    if (!selectedMotivesRef.current) {
      selectedMotivesRef.current = []
    }

    // Elimina cualquier entrada con el mismo matchId y specialOperationId
    selectedMotivesRef.current = selectedMotivesRef.current.filter(
      (item: any) =>
        item.specialOperationId !== specialOperationId ||
        item.matchId !== matchId
    )

    // Agregar la nueva entrada
    selectedMotivesRef.current.push({
      specialOperationId,
      matchId,
      ...option
    })
  }

  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const setModalAlert = (data: any) => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: data.title,
      variant: data.variant,
      message: data.message,
      textSuccess: data.textSuccess,
      textCancel: data.textCancel,
      orientation: data.orientation,
      onClick: data.onClick,
      handleCancel: data.handleCancel,
      children: data.children,
      containerClassName: data.containerClassName,
      contentClassName: data.contentClassName,
      iconClose: data.iconClose,
      textSuccessColor: data.textSuccessColor,
      width: data.width
    })
  }

  return {
    onExecutionAction
  }
}
```
