## src/pages/FoliosPage/Hooks/useOptionsCustodian.tsx

```tsx
import { ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { MuiSelect } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { RowDataMui } from '../../../components/Declares'
import {
  getFindAllFicAdmin,
  getFindParticipantCustody
} from '../../../services'
import { InfoSend } from '../FoliosPage'

const Container = ({
  children,
  className
}: {
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
}) => (
  <div className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}>
    {children}
  </div>
)

interface Argument {
  settlementsCustodian: []
  thereAreSelectedModal: string[] | number[]
  setThereIsCustodianSelected: (arg: boolean) => void
  setQuantityCustodian: (arg: InfoSend[]) => void
  currentStatus: number
  modalTransferCustodian: boolean
  specialtradeId?: string
  setIsToastVisibleError?: (arg: boolean) => void
  setActiveBtn?: (arg: boolean) => void
  updateTable?: boolean
  SettlementList?: any[]
}

type Custodian = {
  id: number
  name: string
}
type CustodianStorage = {
  id: string | undefined
  custodian: number
  ficAdministrator: number
}
type Fic = {
  id: number
  description: string
}

export const useOptionsCustodian = ({
  settlementsCustodian,
  thereAreSelectedModal,
  setThereIsCustodianSelected,
  setQuantityCustodian,
  currentStatus,
  modalTransferCustodian,
  specialtradeId,
  setIsToastVisibleError,
  setActiveBtn,
  updateTable,
  SettlementList
}: Argument) => {
  const [selectedCustodio, setSelectedCustodio] = useState<InfoSend[]>([])
  const [custodios, setCustodios] = useState<Custodian[]>([])
  const [ficAdmin, setFicAdmin] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [allCustodiansSameStatus, setAllCustodiansSameStatus] = useState(true)
  const [columnsCustodian, setColumnsCustodian] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [custodianSelectedList, setCustodianSelectedList] = useState<
    CustodianStorage[]
  >([])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!modalTransferCustodian) {
      setFicAdmin([])
      setCustodios([])
    }
  }, [modalTransferCustodian])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (settlementsCustodian.length > 0) {
      const getCustodian = async () => {
        const response = await getFindParticipantCustody()

        response?.map((item: Custodian) => {
          const data = { id: item.id, name: item.name }
          setCustodios((prev) => [...prev, data])
        })
      }
      const getFic = async () => {
        const responseFic = await getFindAllFicAdmin()

        responseFic?.map((item: Fic) => {
          const data = { id: item.id, name: item.description }
          setFicAdmin((prev) => [...prev, data])
        })
      }
      getCustodian()
      getFic()
    }
  }, [settlementsCustodian])

  useEffect(() => {
    setThereIsCustodianSelected(
      selectedCustodio.length > 0 &&
        thereAreSelectedModal.length > 0 &&
        selectedCustodio.length === thereAreSelectedModal.length
    )
    setQuantityCustodian(selectedCustodio)
  }, [selectedCustodio])

  useEffect(() => {
    // Verificar si todos los custodios seleccionados son iguales
    const allCustodiansSame = selectedCustodio.every(
      (item) => item.custodianId === selectedCustodio[0]?.custodianId
    )
    const allCustodiansSelected =
      selectedCustodio.length > 0 &&
      selectedCustodio.every((item) => item.custodianId !== 0)

    if (
      !allCustodiansSame ||
      (!allCustodiansSelected &&
        thereAreSelectedModal.length > 0 &&
        selectedCustodio.length > 1)
    ) {
      setIsToastVisibleError && setIsToastVisibleError(true)
      setAllCustodiansSameStatus(false)
    } else {
      setIsToastVisibleError && setIsToastVisibleError(false)
      setAllCustodiansSameStatus(true)
    }
  }, [selectedCustodio, thereAreSelectedModal])

  type DataReturn = {
    dataReturn: any
    value?: string
    placeholder?: string
    id?: string
  }

  const handleDropdownChange = ({
    dataReturn,
    value,
    placeholder,
    id
  }: DataReturn) => {
    setCustodianSelectedList((prev) => {
      const index = prev.findIndex((item) => item.id === id)
      if (index !== -1) {
        // Modifica el existente
        const updated = [...prev]
        updated[index] = {
          ...updated[index],
          custodian:
            placeholder === 'Seleccione un custodio'
              ? Number(value)
              : updated[index].custodian,
          ficAdministrator:
            placeholder === 'Seleccione un FIC'
              ? Number(value)
              : updated[index].ficAdministrator
        }
        return updated
      } else {
        // Agrega uno nuevo
        return [
          ...prev,
          {
            id,
            custodian:
              placeholder === 'Seleccione un custodio' ? Number(value) : 0,
            ficAdministrator:
              placeholder === 'Seleccione un FIC' ? Number(value) : 0
          }
        ]
      }
    })

    const { tradeId, fraction, side, trade, custodian, ficAdministrator } =
      dataReturn
    const { specialTrade } = trade

    const statusId = specialtradeId ? specialtradeId : specialTrade.statusId

    setSelectedCustodio((prev: any) => {
      // Buscar si ya existe un objeto con el mismo id
      const existingIndex = prev.findIndex((item: any) => item.id === id)
      let updatedItem =
        existingIndex !== -1
          ? { ...prev[existingIndex] }
          : {
              id,
              tradeId,
              fraction,
              sideId: side?.id,
              statusId,
              custodianStatusId: currentStatus,
              ficAdministratorId: ficAdministrator?.id ?? 0,
              custodianId: custodian?.id ?? 0
            }

      if (placeholder === 'Seleccione un FIC') {
        updatedItem.ficAdministratorId = Number(value)
      }
      if (placeholder === 'Seleccione un custodio') {
        updatedItem.custodianId = Number(value)
      }

      // Si el objeto ya existe, actualizarlo
      if (existingIndex !== -1) {
        const updatedArray = [...prev]
        updatedArray[existingIndex] = updatedItem
        return updatedArray
      }

      // Si no existe, agregar uno nuevo
      return [...prev, updatedItem]
    })

    // // Verificar si todos los custodios seleccionados son iguales
    // const allCustodiansSame = selectedCustodio.every(item => item.custodianId === Number(value));

    // if (!allCustodiansSame) {
    //     setIsToastVisibleError && setIsToastVisibleError(true);
    //     setAllCustodiansSameStatus(true);
    // } else {
    //     setIsToastVisibleError && setIsToastVisibleError(false);
    //     setAllCustodiansSameStatus(false);
    // }
  }

  const handleRowSelectionChange = (selectedIds: string[]) => {
    setSelectedCustodio((prev) =>
      prev.filter((item) => selectedIds.includes(item.id!))
    )
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    handleRowSelectionChange(thereAreSelectedModal.map(String))
  }, [thereAreSelectedModal])

  useEffect(() => {
    setColumnsCustodian([
      {
        width: 200,
        field: 'id',
        headerName: 'ID operación especial',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => {
          return (
            <Container>
              <p className="w-full">
                {row?.trade?.specialTrade?.specialOperationId} -{' '}
                {row?.trade?.specialTrade?.specialOperationName ?? 'N/A'}
              </p>
            </Container>
          )
        }
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'matchDate',
        headerName: 'Fecha registro',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.trade?.specialTrade?.recordDate ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'matchId',
        headerName: 'Folio',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.trade?.matchId ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        headerName: 'Estado de custodio',
        field: 'custodianStatus',
        renderCell: ({
          row
        }: {
          row: { custodianStatus: { description: string } }
        }) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.custodianStatus?.description ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'clearingDate',
        headerName: 'Fecha cumplimiento',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.trade?.clearingDate ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: 'SideID',
        headerName: 'Punta',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.side?.description ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 120,
        field: 'numberFraction',
        headerName: '# de fracción',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.fraction ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'accountInvestor',
        headerName: 'Cuenta inversionista',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.investorAccount?.accountNumber ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>{' '}
            {/* row?.participantAccount?.accountNumber */}
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'typeId',
        headerName: 'Tipo ID',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.investor?.identificationType?.description ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>{' '}
            {/* row.participantAccount?.type?.description */}
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 180,
        field: 'documentNumber',
        headerName: 'Número ID',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.investor?.documentNumber ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 200,
        field: 'nameInvestor',
        headerName: 'Nombre inversionista',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.investor?.firstName ??
                row?.participantAccount?.participant?.name}{' '}
              {row?.investor?.lastName ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 100,
        field: 'cuantity',
        headerName: 'Cantidad',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => (
          <Container>
            <p className="w-full">{row?.fractionQuantity ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </Container>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 250,
        field: 'Custodian',
        headerName: 'Custodio',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => {
          const { tradeId, fraction, side } = row
          const newId = `${tradeId}-${fraction}-${side.id}`
          // @ts-ignore
          const thereIsCheck = thereAreSelectedModal.includes(newId)
          let validateStatusCurrent = false
          let validateThereCheck = false

          if (
            currentStatus === 21 ||
            currentStatus === 22 ||
            currentStatus === 23
          ) {
            validateStatusCurrent = true
            validateThereCheck = true
            setActiveBtn && setActiveBtn(true)
          }
          if (currentStatus === 20 && thereIsCheck) {
            validateThereCheck = false
            validateStatusCurrent = false
          }
          if (currentStatus === 20 && !thereIsCheck) {
            validateThereCheck = true
            validateStatusCurrent = true
          }

          return (
            <Container>
              <MuiSelect
                id={newId}
                dataReturn={row}
                value={
                  currentStatus === 20
                    ? (custodianSelectedList.find((item) => item.id === newId)
                        ?.custodian ?? 0)
                    : (row?.custodian?.id ?? 0)
                }
                options={custodios}
                placeholder="Seleccione un custodio"
                onChange={
                  currentStatus === 20 ? handleDropdownChange : () => {}
                }
                disabled={validateThereCheck && validateStatusCurrent}
                direcReturn={
                  currentStatus !== 20 && thereIsCheck
                    ? handleDropdownChange
                    : () => {}
                }
              />
            </Container>
          )
        }
      },
      {
        width: 250,
        headerName: 'AdminFIC',
        field: 'Administrador FIC',
        renderCell: ({ row }: RowDataMui) => {
          const { tradeId, fraction, side } = row
          const newId = `${tradeId}-${fraction}-${side.id}`
          // @ts-ignore
          const thereIsCheck = thereAreSelectedModal.includes(newId)
          let validateStatusCurrent = false
          let validateThereCheck = false
          if (
            currentStatus === 21 ||
            currentStatus === 22 ||
            currentStatus === 23
          ) {
            validateStatusCurrent = true
            validateThereCheck = true
          }
          if (currentStatus === 20 && thereIsCheck) {
            validateThereCheck = false
            validateStatusCurrent = false
          }
          if (currentStatus === 20 && !thereIsCheck) {
            validateThereCheck = true
            validateStatusCurrent = true
          }
          return (
            <Container>
              <MuiSelect
                id={newId}
                dataReturn={row}
                value={
                  currentStatus === 20
                    ? (custodianSelectedList.find((item) => item.id === newId)
                        ?.ficAdministrator ?? 0)
                    : (row?.ficAdministrator?.id ?? 0)
                }
                options={ficAdmin}
                placeholder="Seleccione un FIC"
                onChange={handleDropdownChange}
                disabled={validateThereCheck && validateStatusCurrent}
              />
            </Container>
          )
        }
      }
    ])
  }, [
    updateTable,
    custodios,
    ficAdmin,
    thereAreSelectedModal,
    SettlementList,
    settlementsCustodian,
    custodianSelectedList
  ])

  return {
    columnsCustodian,
    allCustodiansSameStatus
  }
}
```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/helpers/generateFileExcel.ts

```typescript
// utils/exportToExcel.ts
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver'
import * as XLSX from 'xlsx'

export const generateFileExcel = (
  data: any[],
  setProgress: (progress: number) => void,
  fileName: string
): Promise<void> => {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    try {
      // Crear hoja y libro
      const worksheet = XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(data)
      const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new()
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(workbook, worksheet, 'Operaciones')

      const excelBuffer = XLSX.write(workbook, {
        bookType: 'xlsx',
        type: 'array'
      })
      const dataBlob = new Blob([excelBuffer], {
        type: 'application/octet-stream'
      })
      saveAs(dataBlob, `${fileName}.xlsx`)

      // 🟢 Actualizar progreso
      setProgress(100)

      resolve() // Todo ok
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error) // Algo salió mal
    }
  })
}

```

## src/pages/FoliosPage/services/getCustodians.ts

```typescript
import {
  CURRENT_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT,
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT
} from '@/pages/FoliosPage/constants/pagination'

import { httpOperationsSpecFolios } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { get } from '@/shared/config/methods'
import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

const getCustodians = async (
  name: string = '',
  currentPage: number = CURRENT_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT,
  itemsPerPage: number = ITEMS_PER_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT
) => {
  try {
    const params = `${name ? `custodioCodeName=${name}&` : ''}page=${currentPage}&size=${itemsPerPage}`
    const urlWithParams = `${ENDPOINTS.ALL_CUSTODIANS}?${params}`

    const response = await get({
      axiosInstance: httpOperationsSpecFolios,
      urlWithParams
    })
    const {
      data: { content, totalPages }
    } = response || {}

    return {
      data: content.map(({ id, code, name }: any) => {
        const innerName = code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
        return {
          id,
          name: innerName,
          label: innerName
        }
      }),
      total: totalPages
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      'Error getting special operations IDs (getSpecialOperationsIDs):',
      error
    )
    throw error
  }
}

export default getCustodians

```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/Hooks/useOperationDetail.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, TRenderCellParams } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  DataPicker,
  GenerateLogs
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import formatDate from '@/shared/utils/formatDate'
import formatTime from '@/shared/utils/formatTime'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers'
import { OperationSpecialItemModel } from '../../../models'
import { updateSpecialTrade } from '../../../services'
import { FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../../FolioDetailPage'
import { InputEdit } from '../components'
import { DETAIL_STRINGS } from '../detailStrings'

interface Row {
  label: string
  value: string | number | boolean | JSX.Element
}

interface Column {
  title: string
  rows: Row[]
}

const createRows = (
  labels: string[],
  values: (string | number | boolean | JSX.Element)[]
) => {
  return labels.map((label, index) => ({ label, value: values[index] }))
}

export const useOperationDetail = (
  data: OperationSpecialItemModel | null,
  editMode: boolean,
  tradeIdNumber: number,
  changeData: boolean,
  setChangeData: (value: boolean) => void,
  setViewToast: (arg: boolean) => void,
  setTextToast: (arg: string) => void,
  setVariantToast: (arg: 'success' | 'error') => void
) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  // const [checkRow, setCheckRow] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [temporalDataTrade, setTemporalDataTrade] = useState({})
  const [complianceDate, setComplianceDate] = useState<Date>()

  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const { participantId, id, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(
    FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (data?.marketEntity?.id) {
      setTemporalDataTrade({ marketEntityId: data?.marketEntity?.id })
    }
  }, [data])

  const sendTemporalData = async () => {
    if (Object.keys(temporalDataTrade).length > 1) {
      console.log({
        temporalDataTrade,
        tradeIdNumber,
        changeData,
        setChangeData
      })
      const response = await updateSpecialTrade({
        temporalDataTrade,
        tradeIdNumber,
        changeData,
        setChangeData
      })

      setTextToast('Operación modificada exitosamente')
      setVariantToast('success')
      setViewToast(true)

      if (response && client_user) {
        await GenerateLogs(client_user, {
          actionType: `Se modificaron los campos del especial trade ${tradeIdNumber}`,
          actionDestination: 'Operaciones Especiales visualización general',
          participantId,
          countryId: country.id,
          userNuboId: id,
          statusId: status.id
        })
      }
    }
  }

  const dataGeneral: Column[] = [
    {
      title: DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_1,
      rows: createRows(
        [
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.RECORD_DATE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.COUNTRY,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.OPERATION_TYPE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.ISIN,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.NUMBER_FOLIOS
        ],
        [
          data?.recordDate ? formatDate(data?.recordDate) : '-',
          data?.country?.name ?? '-',
          data?.type?.description ?? '-',
          data?.securityTitle?.isin ?? '-',
          data?.totalAmount
            ? formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(data?.totalAmount, false)
            : '-',
          <div className="flex flex-row justify-between gap-4">
            {data?.numberFolios ?? '-'}
            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="h-6 min-w-32 px-3 text-sm"
              onClick={() => {
                navigate(
                  `${FOLIO_DETAIL_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.ROOT}?tradeId=${data?.id}&sideId=${data?.sideId}`
                )
              }}
            >
              VER FOLIOS
            </Button>
          </div>
        ]
      )
    },
    {
      title: DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_2,
      rows: createRows(
        [
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.COMPLIANCE_DATE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.OPERATION_ID,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.MARKET,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.DEPOSITORY,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.NEGOTIATION_PRICE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.QUANTITY,
          ''
        ],
        [
          editMode ? (
            <div className="flex w-[320px]">
              <DataPicker
                value={complianceDate}
                onChange={(newValue: Date) => {
                  setComplianceDate(newValue)
                  setTemporalDataTrade((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    settlementDate: newValue
                      ? format(newValue, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
                      : null
                  }))
                }}
                height={40}
              />
            </div>
          ) : data?.settlementDate ? (
            formatDate(data?.settlementDate)
          ) : (
            '-'
          ),
          data?.specialOperationId ?? '-',
          data?.marketEntity?.description ?? '-',
          data?.depository?.description ?? '-',
          data?.price
            ? formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(data?.price, false)
            : '-',
          data?.quantity ?? '-'
        ]
      )
    },
    {
      title: DETAIL_STRINGS.COLUMNS.COLUMN_3,
      rows: createRows(
        [
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.DAYS_TO_SETTLEMENT,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.SPECIAL_OPERATION_NAME,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.MNEMONIC,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.CLIENT_SIDE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.SETTLEMENT_PRICE,
          DETAIL_STRINGS.LABELS.STATUS
        ],
        [
          data?.daysToSettlement ?? '-',
          editMode ? (
            <InputEdit
              width="310px"
              placeholder={data?.specialOperationName}
              setData={setTemporalDataTrade}
              inputKey="specialOperationName"
            />
          ) : (
            (data?.specialOperationName ?? '-')
          ),
          data?.securityTitle?.mnemonic ?? '-',
          data?.side?.description ?? '-',
          data?.localCurrencyPrice
            ? formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(
                data?.localCurrencyPrice,
                false
              )
            : '-',
          data?.status?.description ?? '-'
        ]
      )
    }
  ]

  const handleRowSelection = (newSelection: string[]) => {
    console.log('Selected Rows:', newSelection)
  }

  const tableColumns = [
    {
      width: 200,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>Fecha y hora de solicitud</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'requestDate',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
        return (
          <span>
            {row?.requestDate ? formatDate(row?.requestDate) : ''}
            {row?.requestTime ? ` - ${formatTime(row?.requestTime)}` : ''}
          </span>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 200,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>Proceso</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'processTypeDescription',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <span>{row?.processType?.description ?? ''}</span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>Folio</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'tradeMatchId',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <span>{row?.trade?.matchId ?? ''}</span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>Punta</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'sideDescription',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <span>{row?.side?.description ?? ''}</span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center whitespace-pre-wrap">
          <span>Participante</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'initialAccountParticipantCode',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => {
        const code = row?.initialAccount?.participant?.code || ''
        const name = row?.initialAccount?.participant?.name || ''
        const participant = code ? `${code} - ${name}` : name
        return <span>{participant}</span>
      }
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center whitespace-pre-wrap">
          <span>Estado</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'statusDescription',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <span>{row?.status?.description ?? ''}</span>
      )
    },
    {
      width: 250,
      headerName: (
        <div className="flex items-center">
          <span>Detalle</span>
        </div>
      ),
      field: 'detail',
      renderCell: ({ row }: TRenderCellParams) => (
        <span>{row?.detail ?? ''}</span>
      )
    }
  ]

  return {
    dataGeneral,
    tableColumns,
    sendTemporalData,
    handleRowSelection
  }
}

```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/OperationDetailPage.tsx

```tsx
import { OperationSpecialItemModel } from '@/models'
import { Button, Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { httpOperationsSpec } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  BoxInfo,
  ContentWrapper,
  NewTable,
  ModalAlert,
  Toast
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

import { getParamUrl } from '../../helpers'
import { ContentSettlement } from '../FolioDetailPage'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../FoliosPage'
import { useOperationDetail } from './Hooks'
import { DETAIL_STRINGS } from './detailStrings'

export const OperationDetailPage = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const tradeIdNumber = Number(getParamUrl(DETAIL_STRINGS.PARAMS.TRADE_ID))
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false)
  const [modalSaveOpen, setModalSaveOpen] = useState(false)
  const [changeData, setChangeData] = useState(false)
  const [dataInfo, setDataInfo] = useState<OperationSpecialItemModel | null>(
    null
  )
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [textToast, setTextToast] = useState<string>()
  const [variantToast, setVariantToast] = useState<'success' | 'error'>()
  const [isRegister, setIsRegister] = useState(false)
  const { participantId, userType } = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) =>
      state.auth.infoUserNubo?.[0] || state.auth.infoUserNubo
  )
  const [isDisabledShowFolio, setIsDisabledShowFolio] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    const getSpecialTrade = async () => {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
      const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')

      if (participantId) {
        try {
          const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get(
            `/special-trade/${tradeIdNumber}`,
            {
              headers: {
                client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
                client_user: client_user,
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
              }
            }
          )
          setDataInfo(data)
          if (data?.status?.description === 'REGISTRADA') {
            setIsRegister(true)
          } else {
            setIsRegister(false)
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error getting special trade:', error)
          throw error
        }
      }
    }

    getSpecialTrade()
  }, [participantId, changeData])

  const { dataGeneral, tableColumns, sendTemporalData, handleRowSelection } =
    useOperationDetail(
      dataInfo,
      editMode,
      tradeIdNumber,
      changeData,
      setChangeData,
      setViewToast,
      setTextToast,
      setVariantToast
    )

  const handleData = (_page: number, _dataTable: ContentSettlement[]) => {
    console.log('handleData', _page, _dataTable)
  }

  const handleSaveChanges = () => {
    sendTemporalData()
    setModalSaveOpen(false)
    setEditMode(false)
  }

  const endpoint = `${ENDPOINTS.REASSIGNMENT}?specialTradeId=${tradeIdNumber}`

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any>([])

  return (
    <>
      <ContentWrapper
        title={DETAIL_STRINGS.CONTENT_WRAPPER_TILE}
        actionBack={() => navigate(DETAIL_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.ROOT)}
      >
        <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-6">
          <BoxInfo
            columns={dataGeneral}
            title={DETAIL_STRINGS.TITLE_GENERAL_DATA}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="w-full pt-6">
          <Typography
            variant="h6"
            fontWeight="bold"
            className="mb-4 text-start font-Roboto"
          >
            {DETAIL_STRINGS.TITLE_SETTLEMENT}
          </Typography>
        </div>

        <div className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 rounded-md border border-white px-6 pb-6 pt-0 shadow-[0px_5px_5px_-2px_#00000033]">
          {
            <NewTable
              columns={tableColumns}
              widthContent={DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.WIDTHCONTENT}
              endpoint={endpoint}
              rowsPerPageOptions={[3]}
              pagination={true}
              height={DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.HEIGHT}
              handleRowSelection={(newSelection: string[]) =>
                handleRowSelection(newSelection)
              }
              isTradeId={true}
              axiosInstanceKey={DETAIL_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
              setDataRemote={handleData}
              handleRowSelectionModelChange={(rowsChecked: any) => {
                setRows(rowsChecked)
                setIsDisabledShowFolio(rowsChecked?.length !== 1)
              }}
              customToolbar={
                <Button
                  disabled={isDisabledShowFolio}
                  size="small"
                  variant="text"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const folioId = rows?.[0].split('-')?.[0] || ''
                    console.log({
                      isDisabledShowFolio,
                      folioId,
                      tradeIdNumber
                    })
                    const URL = isDisabledShowFolio
                      ? ''
                      : FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL +
                        folioId +
                        `/?specialtradeId=${tradeIdNumber}&tradeId=${folioId}&origin=detail_folio`
                    navigate(URL)
                  }}
                  fullWidth
                  className="gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 text-[13px] uppercase"
                >
                  VER FOLIO
                </Button>
              }
              checkboxSelection={true}
            />
          }
          {editMode ? (
            <div className="mt-6 flex w-full justify-end gap-x-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="large"
                variant="outlined"
                color="secondary"
                style={{
                  color: '#FF4201',
                  width: '240px',
                  borderColor: 'rgba(255, 66, 1, 0.5)'
                }}
                onClick={() => setEditMode(false)}
              >
                Cancelar
              </Button>
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="large"
                variant="contained"
                style={{ backgroundColor: '#FF4201', width: '240px' }}
                onClick={() => setModalSaveOpen(true)}
                disabled={false}
              >
                Guardar
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-6 flex w-full justify-end">
              <Button
                type="button"
                size="medium"
                variant="contained"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor:
                    userType === 'EXTERNAL' ||
                    (userType === 'INTERNAL' && !isRegister)
                      ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)'
                      : '#FF4201',
                  width: '240px'
                }}
                onClick={() => setEditMode(true)}
                disabled={
                  userType === 'EXTERNAL' ||
                  (userType === 'INTERNAL' && !isRegister)
                }
              >
                Editar
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {viewToast && (
          <Toast
            text={textToast}
            onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
            width="511px"
            variant={variantToast}
          />
        )}
      </ContentWrapper>
      {modalSaveOpen && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Desea guardar estas modificaciones?"
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="Guardar cambios"
          textCancel="Cancelar"
          orientation="horizontal"
          onClick={handleSaveChanges}
          handleCancel={() => {
            setModalSaveOpen(false)
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <p className="text-center">
              Los campos que has modificado se actualizarán.
            </p>
            <p className="text-center">
              Si deseas continuar, haz clic en{' '}
              <span className="font-bold">Guardar cambios.</span> Si no, puedes
              revisar las modificaciones antes de confirmar.
            </p>
          </div>
        </ModalAlert>
      )}
    </>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.tsx

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

interface Props {
  documentNumber: string
  checkAll: boolean
  setCheckRow: (arg: string[] | ((prevCheckRow: string[]) => string[])) => void
}

export const Checkbox = ({ documentNumber, checkAll, setCheckRow }: Props) => {
  const [checkboxSelected, setCheckboxSelected] = useState<boolean>(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    setCheckboxSelected(checkAll)
  }, [checkAll])

  useEffect(() => {
    setCheckRow((prevCheckRow: string[]) => {
      if (checkboxSelected) {
        return [...prevCheckRow, documentNumber]
      } else {
        return prevCheckRow.filter((item: string) => item !== documentNumber)
      }
    })
  }, [checkboxSelected])

  return (
    <div className="beneficiaries-container-checkbox" key={documentNumber}>
      <button
        onClick={() => setCheckboxSelected(!checkboxSelected)}
        className={`beneficiaries-btn-checkbox ${checkboxSelected ? 'bg-[#0E9753]' : 'border-[#FF411C]'}`}
      >
        {checkboxSelected && (
          <svg
            width="14"
            height="15"
            viewBox="0 0 14 15"
            fill="none"
            xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
          >
            <path
              d="M11.6673 4.31055L5.25065 10.7272L2.33398 7.81055"
              stroke="#FFFBFA"
              stroke-width="1.5"
              stroke-linecap="round"
              stroke-linejoin="round"
            />
          </svg>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/components/FoliosNoCompliance/FoliosStatusContentNoCompliance.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid/models'
import { Select, TextField } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { Dispatch, ReactNode, SetStateAction, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { NewTable } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { BuySellComponent } from '../../../../components'
import { checkParticipant } from '../../../../helpers'
import { getNoComplianceOperationMotive } from '../../../../services'
import { FOLIOS_STRINGS } from '../../../FoliosPage'

const Container = ({
  children,
  className
}: {
  children: ReactNode
  className?: string
}) => (
  <div className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}>
    {children}
  </div>
)

interface Rowsparameters {
  matchId: number
  matchDate: string
  clearingDate: string
  specialTrade?: {
    specialOperationId: string
    specialOperationName: string
    id: number
  } | null
  participantBuy: {
    id: number
    code: string
  }
  participantSell: {
    id: number
    code: string
  }
  custodianBuy: {
    id: number
    code: string
  }
  custodianSell: {
    id: number
    code: string
  }
}

export const FolioStatusContentNoCompliance = ({
  rows,
  participantId,
  setThereAreSelectedModal,
  onSelectChange
}: {
  rows: Rowsparameters[]
  participantId: string
  setThereAreSelectedModal: Dispatch<SetStateAction<(string | number)[]>>
  onSelectChange: (
    specialOperationId: number,
    matchId: number,
    option: { value: number; label: string }
  ) => void
}) => {
  const [motiveOptions, setMotiveOptions] = useState<
    { label: string; value: number }[]
  >([])
  const [selectedReasons, setSelectedReasons] = useState<Record<string, any>>(
    {}
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    const responseMotives = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getNoComplianceOperationMotive()
        const optionsNoCompliance = data.map(
          (item: { id: number; reason: string }) => ({
            label: item.reason,
            value: item.id
          })
        )
        setMotiveOptions(optionsNoCompliance)
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error al cargar motivos de no cumplimiento:', err)
      }
    }

    responseMotives()
  }, [])

  const columnsModulesNonCompliance: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 200,
      field: 'specialTradeOperation',
      headerName: 'Operación Especial',
      type: 'string',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container>
          {`${params.row.id ?? ''} - ${params.row.specialOperationName ?? ''}`}
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 150,
      field: 'matchDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha registro',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{params.row.matchDate ?? ''}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'clearingDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha de cumplimiento',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{params.row.clearingDate ?? ''}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 180,
      field: 'matchId',
      headerName: 'Folio',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container>
          <p className="w-full">{params.row.matchId ?? ''}</p>
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 140,
      headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.PARTICIPANT,
      field: 'participant',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container className="text-sm">
          {params.row.participantBuy && params.row.participantSell ? (
            <BuySellComponent
              booleanBuy={true}
              valueBuy={params.row.participantBuy?.code ?? ''}
              booleanSell={true}
              valueSell={params.row.participantSell?.code ?? ''}
              participantId={participantId}
              type={checkParticipant(
                participantId,
                params.row.participantBuy?.id,
                params.row.participantSell?.id
              )}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="w-full text-gray-400"> </p>
          )}
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 140,
      headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.CUSTODIAN,
      field: 'custodian',
      renderCell: (params) => (
        <Container className="text-sm">
          {params.row.custodianBuy && params.row.custodianSell ? (
            <BuySellComponent
              booleanBuy={true}
              valueBuy={params.row.custodianBuy?.code ?? ''}
              booleanSell={true}
              valueSell={params.row.custodianSell?.code ?? ''}
              type={checkParticipant(
                participantId,
                params.row.custodianBuy?.id,
                params.row.custodianSell?.id
              )}
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="w-full text-gray-400"> - </p>
          )}
        </Container>
      )
    },
    {
      filterable: true,
      width: 500,
      headerName: FOLIOS_STRINGS.TABLE.REASON,
      field: 'reason',
      renderCell: (params) => {
        const selectedOption = selectedReasons[params.id]
        const isOtherReason = selectedOption?.value === 4
        return (
          <Container className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Select
              size="small"
              formControlProps={{ fullWidth: true }}
              options={motiveOptions}
              onChange={(option) => {
                if (option.value === 4) {
                  setSelectedReasons((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [params.id]: { value: 4, label: '' }
                  }))
                } else {
                  setSelectedReasons((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [params.id]: option
                  }))
                  onSelectChange(
                    params.row.specialTrade?.id ?? params.row.id,
                    params.row.matchId,
                    option
                  )
                }
              }}
              valueKey="value"
              labelKey="label"
              label="Seleccione el incumplimiento"
              value={selectedOption?.value ?? ''}
            />

            {isOtherReason && (
              <TextField<string>
                size="small"
                label="Describa el motivo"
                value={selectedOption.label}
                onChange={(newValue) => {
                  const updatedOption = {
                    value: 4,
                    label: newValue
                  }

                  setSelectedReasons((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [params.id]: updatedOption
                  }))

                  onSelectChange(
                    params.row.specialTrade?.id ?? params.row.id,
                    params.row.matchId,
                    updatedOption
                  )
                }}
                fullWidth
              />
            )}
          </Container>
        )
      }
    }
  ]

  return (
    <NewTable
      columns={columnsModulesNonCompliance}
      rows={rows}
      disableColumnMenu
      disableColumnResize
      disableColumnSorting
      disableRowSelectionOnClick
      hideFooter
      checkboxSelection={true}
      getRowHeight={() => 'auto'}
      sx={{ maxHeight: '500px' }}
      setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelectedModal}
    />
  )
}
```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/components/InputEdit/InputEdit.tsx

```tsx
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { httpInvestor } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'
import { InputBasic } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import './InputEditStyles.css'

interface InputEditProps {
  placeholder?: string | number
  type?: 'text' | 'number' | 'date'
  inputKey: string
  width?: string
  height?: string
  value?: string // Añadir esta prop para pasar el valor de la cuenta
  setData?: (data: any) => void
  onAccountDataFetched?: (data: any) => void | undefined
  setViewToast?: (value: boolean) => void
  setTextToast?: (arg: string) => void
  setVariantToast?: (arg: 'success' | 'error') => void
  setTabAccountInfo?: (value: {
    documentNumber: string
    identificationType: string
    accountNumber: number
  }) => void
  setTabAccount?: (data: any) => void
}

interface ErrorResponse {
  response?: {
    data?: {
      httpCode?: string
    }
  }
}

export const InputEdit = ({
  placeholder,
  type = 'text',
  setData,
  inputKey,
  setViewToast,
  setTextToast,
  setVariantToast,
  value,
  setTabAccountInfo,
  setTabAccount
}: InputEditProps) => {
  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<string>(value || '')
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState<string>('')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (inputValue && setData) {
      if (inputKey === 'price' || inputKey === 'priceLocal') {
        setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, [inputKey]: Number(inputValue) }))
      } else {
        setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, [inputKey]: inputValue }))
      }
    }
  }, [inputValue])

  const handleInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const value = e.target.value
    if (type === 'date') {
      const formattedDate = formatDate(value)
      setInputValue(formattedDate)
    } else {
      setInputValue(value)
    }
  }

  const formatDate = (date: string): string => {
    const d = new Date(date)
    const year = d.getFullYear()
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`
  }

  const handleKeyPress = async (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'Tab') {
      if (inputKey === 'accountNumber') {
        try {
          const response = await httpInvestor.get(
            `/investor-account/account-number/${inputValue}`,
            {
              headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`,
                client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
                client_user: localStorage.getItem('username')
              }
            }
          )
          setNewValue(inputValue)
          setTabAccount && setTabAccount(true)
          setTabAccountInfo &&
            setTabAccountInfo({
              documentNumber: response.data.investor.documentNumber,
              identificationType:
                response.data.investor.identificationType.description,
              accountNumber: Number(inputValue)
            })
        } catch (error) {
          const err = error as ErrorResponse
          if (err?.response?.data?.httpCode === '404') {
            setTextToast && setTextToast('Cuenta títulos no existe en Deceval')
            setVariantToast && setVariantToast('error')
            setViewToast && setViewToast(true)
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <InputBasic
      type={type}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      value={newValue ? newValue : inputValue}
      style={{ width: '320px', height: '40px' }}
      onChange={handleInputChange}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyPress}
      showLabel={false}
      field={inputKey}
      id={placeholder}
    />
  )
}

```

## src/pages/OperationDetailPage/components/Select/Select.tsx

```tsx
import { Select } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import {
  httpOperationsSpec,
  httpParticipants
} from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

interface SelectProps {
  selectKey: string
  setData: (data: any) => void
  placeholder?: string | undefined
}

export const SelectComponent = ({
  selectKey,
  setData,
  placeholder
}: SelectProps) => {
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<{
    name: string
    id: string
  }>()
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<{ name: string; id: string }[]>([])

  const participantId = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth.infoUserNubo.participantId
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedOption) {
      setData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, [selectKey]: selectedOption.id }))
    }
  }, [selectedOption])

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchOptions = async () => {
      let fetchedOptions: { name: string; id: string }[] = []

      const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
      const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')

      if (selectKey === 'clientSettlementAgent') {
        const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get(
          `/special-trade?participantId=${participantId}`,
          {
            headers: {
              client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
              client_user: client_user,
              Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
            }
          }
        )

        fetchedOptions = data?.content.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.clientSettlementAgent?.description,
          value: item?.clientSettlementAgent?.id,
          id: item?.clientSettlementAgent?.id
        }))
      }

      if (selectKey === 'clientOperator') {
        const { data } = await httpParticipants.get(`/participant?statusId=1`, {
          headers: {
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: client_user,
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        })

        fetchedOptions = data?.content.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.code + ' - ' + item?.name,
          value: item?.id,
          id: item?.id
        }))
      }
      if (selectKey === 'afpFundId') {
        const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get('/afpFund', {
          headers: {
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: client_user,
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        })

        fetchedOptions = data.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.description,
          value: item?.id,
          id: item?.id
        }))
      }

      if (selectKey === 'currencyId') {
        const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get('/currency', {
          headers: {
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: client_user,
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        })

        fetchedOptions = data.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.code + ` (${item?.name})`,
          value: item?.id,
          id: item?.id
        }))
      }
      if (selectKey === 'exchangeRateId') {
        const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get('/exchange-rate', {
          headers: {
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: client_user,
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        })

        fetchedOptions = data.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.baseCurrency.name + ' - ' + item.conversionCurrency.name,
          value: item?.id,
          id: item?.id
        }))
      }

      if (selectKey === 'bankName') {
        const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get('/depository', {
          headers: {
            client_datetime: format(new Date(), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"),
            client_user: client_user,
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
          }
        })

        fetchedOptions = data.map((item: any) => ({
          name: item?.description,
          value: item?.id,
          id: item?.id
        }))
      }

      setOptions(fetchedOptions)
    }

    fetchOptions()
  }, [selectKey])

  const handleSelect = (value: { name: string; id: string }) => {
    setSelectedOption(value)
  }

  return (
    <Select
      label={placeholder}
      options={options}
      onChange={handleSelect}
      valueKey="name"
      labelKey="name"
      value={selectedOption}
      formControlProps={{ sx: { width: '320px' } }}
      size="small"
    />
  )
}

```

## src/pages/OperationsPage/Hooks/useOperationFetch.ts

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

type Data<T> = T | null
type ErrorType = Error | null

interface Params<T> {
  data: Data<T> | null
  loading: boolean
  error: ErrorType
}

export const useOperationFetch = <T>(url: string): Params<T> => {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Data<T>>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [error, setError] = useState<ErrorType>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    let controller = new AbortController()
    const fetchData = async () => {
      try {
        setLoading(true)
        const response = await fetch(url, controller)
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Error en la petición')
        }
        const jsonData: T = await response.json()
        setData(jsonData)
        setError(null)
      } catch (error) {
        setError(error as ErrorType)
      } finally {
        setLoading(false)
      }
    }
    fetchData()
    return () => controller.abort()
  }, [url])

  return { data, loading, error }
}
```

## src/pages/OperationsPage/Hooks/useOperationSelectedItems.ts

```typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'

import { Columnfilter, OperationSpecialItemModel } from '../../../models'

export const useOperationSelectedItems = (
  id: string,
  data: OperationSpecialItemModel[],
  selectedItems: OperationSpecialItemModel[],
  setSelectedItems: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<OperationSpecialItemModel[]>
  >,
  filter: Columnfilter,
  setFilter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<Columnfilter>>,
  urlAPi: string,
  variable: string
) => {
  const allDataInSelectedItems = useCallback(() => {
    return data.every((dataItem) =>
      selectedItems.some((selectedItem) => selectedItem.id === dataItem.id)
    )
  }, [data, selectedItems])

  const setRowColorToggle = useCallback(
    (id: number, set?: boolean, color: string = 'select') => {
      const row = document.getElementById(`tr-${id}`)
      const check = document.getElementById(`check-${id}`) as HTMLInputElement

      if (check) {
        const isChecked = set ? false : check.checked
        check.checked = color === 'select' ? !isChecked : check.checked
        if (row) row.classList.toggle(`color-${color}`, !isChecked)
        return !isChecked
      }
    },
    []
  )

  const addRowSelectedItems = useCallback(
    (id: number) => {
      const item = data.find((dataItem) => dataItem.id === id)
      if (
        item &&
        !selectedItems.some((selectedItem) => selectedItem.id === item.id)
      ) {
        setSelectedItems((prevSelectedItems) => [...prevSelectedItems, item])
      }
    },
    [data]
  )

  const handleSetFilter = useCallback(
    (sort: string) => {
      const newOrder = !filter.order
      const url =
        id &&
        `${urlAPi}?${variable}=${id}&sort=${sort}&order=${newOrder ? 'desc' : 'asc'}`
      setFilter({ sort, order: newOrder, url })
    },
    [filter.sort, filter.order, id]
  )

  const getUrlfilters = useCallback(
    (value: string) => {
      setFilter({
        sort: 'id',
        order: false,
        url: `${urlAPi}?${variable}=${id}${value}`
      })
    },
    [filter.sort, filter.order, id]
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (allDataInSelectedItems()) setRowColorToggle(0, true)
  }, [data])

  useEffect(() => {
    selectedItems.forEach((item) => {
      setRowColorToggle(item.id, true)
    })

    const inputElement = document.getElementById('check-0') as HTMLInputElement
    if (inputElement) {
      const handleCheckboxClick = () => {
        if (inputElement.checked) {
          const updatedItems = [...selectedItems, ...data].filter(
            (item, index, self) =>
              index === self.findIndex((t) => t.id === item.id)
          )
          setSelectedItems(updatedItems)
        }
        if (!inputElement.checked) {
          setSelectedItems(
            selectedItems.filter((item) => !data.some((d) => d.id === item.id))
          )
          selectedItems.forEach((item) => {
            setRowColorToggle(item.id)
          })
        }
      }

      inputElement.addEventListener('click', handleCheckboxClick)

      return () => {
        inputElement.removeEventListener('click', handleCheckboxClick)
      }
    }
  }, [data, selectedItems])

  useEffect(() => {
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll('td[id^="row-"]')

    const handleClick = (event: Event) => {
      const row = event.currentTarget as HTMLTableRowElement
      const id = row.id
      const number = id.split('-')[1]
      const checked = setRowColorToggle(Number(number))
      checked
        ? addRowSelectedItems(Number(number))
        : setSelectedItems(selectedItems.filter((i) => i.id !== Number(number)))
    }

    rows.forEach((row) => {
      row.addEventListener('click', handleClick)
    })

    return () => {
      rows.forEach((row) => {
        row.removeEventListener('click', handleClick)
      })
    }
  }, [data, selectedItems])

  return {
    selectedItems,
    filter,
    handleSetFilter,
    getUrlfilters
  }
}
```

## src/pages/OperationsPage/Hooks/useOperationStates.ts

```typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

import { OperationSpecialItemModel } from '../../../models'

export const useOperationStates = (
  id: string,
  urlAPi: string,
  variable: string
) => {
  const [data, setData] = useState<OperationSpecialItemModel[]>([])
  const [loadingModal, setLoadingModal] = useState({
    isLoading: false,
    fileName: '',
    progress: 0
  })
  const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<
    OperationSpecialItemModel[]
  >([])
  const [sidePanel, setSidePanel] = useState(false)
  const [clearFilters, setClearFilters] = useState(false)
  const userType = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) => state.auth.infoUserNubo.userType
  )

  const endpoint = useMemo(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)?.toString()
    const paramsWithVariable = params
      ? `${params}&${variable}=${id}`
      : `${variable}=${id}`
    const finalParams = userType === 'INTERNAL' ? params : paramsWithVariable
    return `${urlAPi}?${finalParams}`
  }, [window.location.search])

  return {
    data,
    setData,
    setLoadingModal,
    loadingModal,
    selectedItems,
    setSelectedItems,
    clearFilters,
    sidePanel,
    setSidePanel,
    setClearFilters,
    endpoint
  }
}
```

## src/pages/OperationsPage/Hooks/useOperationTable.tsx

```tsx
import { TRenderCellParams } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import iconDownload from '../../../assets/icons/icon-download.svg'
import iconFilter from '../../../assets/icons/icon-filter.svg'
import { columnsXLS } from '../../../helpers'
import { STRINGS } from '../../../helpers/strings'
import { generateCsvReport } from '../../../hooks/generateCsvReport'
import { generateExcelReport } from '../../../hooks/generateExcelReport'
import { OperationSpecialItemModel } from '../../../models'
import { getAllSettlement } from '../../../services'
import { generateFileExcel } from '../../FoliosPage/helpers/generateFileExcel'
import { OPERATION_STRINGS } from '../operationStrings'

export const useOperationTable = (
  client_user: string | null,
  participantId: string,
  selectedItems: OperationSpecialItemModel[],
  handleSetSidePanel: (value: boolean) => void,
  setLoadingModal: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<{
      isLoading: boolean
      fileName: string
      progress: number
    }>
  >,
  loadingModal: { isLoading: boolean; fileName: string; progress: number },
  data: OperationSpecialItemModel[],
  setTotalRecords: (arg: number) => void,
  setViewToast?: (arg: boolean) => void,
  canViewDetailColumn?: boolean
) => {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [modalContent, setModalContent] = useState<any>(null)
  const [isLoadingModal, setIsLoadingModal] = useState(false)
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState('')
  const [toastVariant, setToastVariant] = useState('')

  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const headerActions = async (action: { type: string; url?: string }) => {
    if (
      action.type ===
      OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_XLS_ACTION_TYPE
    ) {
      setLoadingModal({
        isLoading: true,
        fileName: STRINGS.MODAL_LOADING.MESSAGE_XLS,
        progress: 0
      })
      generateExcelReport(
        selectedItems,
        columnsXLS,
        OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_XLS_FILE_NAME
      )
      setLoadingModal({ isLoading: false, fileName: '', progress: 0 })
    }
    if (
      action.type ===
      OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_CSV_ACTION_TYPE
    ) {
      setLoadingModal({
        isLoading: true,
        fileName: STRINGS.MODAL_LOADING.MESSAGE_CSV,
        progress: 0
      })
      const trades = await getAllSettlement(client_user, participantId)
      generateCsvReport(
        trades,
        OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_CSV_FILE_NAME
      )
      setLoadingModal({ isLoading: false, fileName: '', progress: 0 })
    }
    if (
      action.type ===
      OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_SIDEPANEL_ACTION_TYPE
    ) {
      handleSetSidePanel(true)
    }
    if (action.type === 'navigate')
      navigate('/operation-spec-management/compensations')
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout
    if (loadingModal.isLoading) {
      interval = setInterval(() => {
        setLoadingModal((prev) => {
          const newProgress = prev.progress + 10
          if (newProgress >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval)
            return { ...prev, progress: 100 }
          }
          return { ...prev, progress: newProgress }
        })
      }, 1000)
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [loadingModal.isLoading])

  const columnsModules = useMemo(
    () => [
      ...(canViewDetailColumn
        ? [
            {
              width: 134,
              headerName: 'Detalles',
              field: '',
              sortable: false,
              filterable: false,
              renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
                <Link
                  className="text-red-500"
                  to={`${OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL}${params.row?.id}&sideId=${params.row.sideId}`}
                >
                  {OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE}
                </Link>
              )
            }
          ]
        : []),
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.REGISTER,
        field: 'recordDate'
      },
      {
        width: 85,
        headerName: 'ID',
        field: 'specialOperationId',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span>{params.row?.specialOperationId || ''}</span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.ESPECIAL_OPERATION,
        field: 'specialOperationName',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span>{params.row?.specialOperationName || ''} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.COMPLIANCE,
        field: 'settlementDate'
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.COUNTRY,
        field: 'country',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params?.row.country?.name} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.TYPE,
        field: 'type',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params.row?.type?.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.STATUS,
        field: 'status',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params.row?.status?.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.MNEMONIC,
        field: 'securityTitle',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params.row?.securityTitle?.mnemonic} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.DEPOSITORY,
        field: 'depository',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params.row?.depository?.description} </span>
        )
      },
      {
        width: 150,
        headerName: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.SIDE,
        field: 'side',
        renderCell: (params: TRenderCellParams) => (
          <span> {params.row?.side?.description} </span>
        )
      }
    ],
    [data]
  )

  const headerActionsModule = [
    {
      label: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_LABEL,
      disabled: selectedItems.length === 0,
      type: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_XLS_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconDownload}
          alt={OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.DOWNLOAD_LABEL}
          className={selectedItems.length === 0 ? 'icon-gray' : 'icon-red'}
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    },
    {
      label: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.FILTER_LABEL,
      type: OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS
        .DOWNLOAD_SIDEPANEL_ACTION_TYPE,
      url: '',
      icon: (
        <img
          src={iconFilter}
          alt={OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_HEADER_ACTIONS.FILTER_LABEL}
          className="icon-red"
          style={{ width: '32px', height: '20px' }}
        />
      )
    }
  ]
  const handleDownloadExcel = () => {
    if (data.length === 0 && setViewToast) {
      console.error('No records found in the additional request')
      setViewToast(true)
      setToastMessage('No se encontraron registros en la solicitud')
      setToastVariant('warning')
      setIsLoadingModal(false)
      return
    }

    setIsLoadingModal(true)
    setModalContent({
      title: 'Confirmación de descarga',
      message: '¿Está seguro de que desea descargar el comprobante?',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Sí',
      textCancel: 'No',
      handleCancel: () => {
        setIsLoadingModal(false)
        setModalContent(null)
      },
      onClick: async () => {
        try {
          setModalContent(null)
          setIsLoadingModal(true)

          const rows = data.map((row) => ({
            'Fecha registro': row?.recordDate ?? 'N/A',
            'Operación especial': row?.specialOperationName ?? 'N/A',
            Cumplimiento: row?.settlementDate ?? 'N/A',
            País: row?.country?.name ?? 'N/A',
            Estado: row?.status?.description ?? 'N/A',
            'Tipo Operación': row?.type?.description ?? 'N/A',
            Nemotécnico: row?.securityTitle?.mnemonic ?? 'N/A',
            Depósito: row?.depository?.description ?? 'N/A',
            'Punta cliente': row?.side?.description ?? 'N/A',
            Participante: `${row?.participant?.code ?? 'N/A'} - ${row?.participant?.name ?? 'N/A'}`
          }))

          const now = new Date()
          const fechaDeGeneracion = now
            .toLocaleDateString('es-ES')
            .replace(/\//g, '-')
          const fileName = `OpEspeciales_${fechaDeGeneracion}`

          await generateFileExcel(rows, setProgress, fileName)
          setProgress(0)

          const totalRecords = data.length
          setTotalRecords(totalRecords)

          if (setViewToast) {
            setToastMessage('Su descarga se ha realizado exitosamente.')
            setToastVariant('success')
            setViewToast(true)
          }
        } catch {
          console.log(' error al descargar el excel')
          setModalContent({
            title: 'Error en el servidor',
            message:
              'Ha ocurrido un error al descargar el archivo Excel. Por favor, inténtelo de nuevo más tarde.',
            variant: 'error',
            onClick: () => {
              setModalContent(null)
            }
          })
        } finally {
          setIsLoadingModal(false)
        }
      }
    })
  }

  return {
    headerActions,
    columnsModules,
    headerActionsModule,
    handleDownloadExcel,
    progress,
    modalContent,
    isLoadingModal,
    toastMessage,
    toastVariant,
    setIsLoadingModal
  }
}

```

## src/pages/OperationsPage/OperationsPage.tsx

```tsx
import { Button, MaterialIcons } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { useScreenActions } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-useScreenActions'
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import {
  ContentWrapper,
  FilterBar,
  ModalAlert,
  ModalLoad,
  NewTable,
  Toast
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SPECIAL_GENERAL_INFORMATION_ACTIONS } from '@/shared/constants/actionCodes'
import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

import { STRINGS } from '../../helpers/strings'
import { GetLocalStorageItem } from '../../services'
import { useOperationStates } from './Hooks/useOperationStates'
import { useOperationTable } from './Hooks/useOperationTable'
import { filtersConfig } from './constants/filterConfig'
import { OPERATION_STRINGS } from './operationStrings'

export const OperationsPage = () => {
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [totalRecords, setTotalRecords] = useState(0)

  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const client_user = GetLocalStorageItem(STRINGS.CLIENT_USER_LOCAL_STORAGE)
  const { participantId, userType } = useSelector(
    (state: RootState) =>
      state.auth.infoUserNubo?.[0] || state.auth.infoUserNubo
  )

  const { hasAction } = useScreenActions()
  const { canViewDetailColumn } = useMemo(
    () => ({
      canViewDetailColumn: hasAction(SPECIAL_GENERAL_INFORMATION_ACTIONS.DETAIL)
    }),
    [hasAction]
  )
  const {
    data,
    setData,
    setLoadingModal,
    loadingModal,
    selectedItems,
    setSidePanel,
    endpoint
  } = useOperationStates(
    participantId,
    ENDPOINTS.SPECIAL_TRADE_DYNAMIC,
    STRINGS.PARTICIPANT_ID_VARIABLE
  )

  const {
    headerActions,
    columnsModules,
    headerActionsModule,
    handleDownloadExcel,
    progress,
    modalContent,
    isLoadingModal,
    toastMessage,
    setIsLoadingModal,
    toastVariant
  } = useOperationTable(
    client_user,
    participantId,
    selectedItems,
    setSidePanel,
    setLoadingModal,
    loadingModal,
    data,
    setTotalRecords,
    setViewToast,
    canViewDetailColumn
  )

  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setData(dataTable)
  }

  const handleDoubleClick = (params: {
    row: { id: number; sideId: string }
  }) => {
    const rowId = params.row.id
    const sideId = params.row.sideId
    navigate(
      `${OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.MORE_URL_DETAIL}${rowId}&sideId=${sideId}`
    )
  }

  return (
    <ContentWrapper
      title={OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE_CONTENT_COMPONENT_TITLE}
      actionBack={() => navigate(OPERATION_STRINGS.NAVIGATE.ROOT)}
    >
      <FilterBar config={filtersConfig} />
      <NewTable
        columns={columnsModules}
        headerActions={headerActionsModule}
        onAction={headerActions}
        widthContent={OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.WIDTH_CONTENT}
        endpoint={endpoint}
        rows={data}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
        axiosInstanceKey={OPERATION_STRINGS.TABLE.AXIONS_INSTANCE_KEY}
        onRowDoubleClick={canViewDetailColumn ? handleDoubleClick : undefined}
        customToolbar={
          <>
            {userType === 'INTERNAL' && (
              <Button
                className="center flex text-sm font-medium"
                variant="text"
                onClick={() =>
                  navigate(`/operation-spec-management/compensations`)
                }
              >
                compensación
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        }
        addMenuItems={[
          {
            text: 'Descargar (.xls/.xlsx)',
            onClick: () => handleDownloadExcel(),
            icon: <MaterialIcons.Download fontSize="small" />
          }
        ]}
      />
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={toastMessage}
          variant={toastVariant}
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
          width="511px"
        />
      )}
      {isLoadingModal && (
        <ModalLoad
          reset={() => setIsLoadingModal(false)}
          progress={progress}
          message="Estamos preparando la descarga:"
          fileName={totalRecords === 1 ? '' : 'comprobantes.zip'}
          closeButtonText="Cancelar"
        />
      )}
      {modalContent && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalContent.title}
          message={modalContent.message}
          variant={modalContent.variant}
          onClick={modalContent.onClick}
          handleCancel={modalContent.handleCancel}
          textCancel={modalContent.textCancel}
          textSuccess={modalContent.textSuccess}
        />
      )}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}

```
