## src/pages/OperationsPage/services/getSpecialOperation.ts

```typescript
import {
  CURRENT_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT,
  ITEMS_PER_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT
} from '@/pages/FoliosPage/constants/pagination'

import { httpOperationsSpec } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { get } from '@/shared/config/methods'
import { ENDPOINTS } from '@/shared/constants/endpoint'

const getSpecialOperation = async (
  name: string = ' ',
  currentPage: number = CURRENT_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT,
  itemsPerPage: number = ITEMS_PER_PAGE_BY_DEFAULT
) => {
  try {
    const params = `searchValue=${name}&page=${currentPage}&size=${itemsPerPage}`
    const urlWithParams = `${ENDPOINTS.SPECIAL_TRADE_FILTERS}?${params}`

    const response = await get({
      axiosInstance: httpOperationsSpec,
      urlWithParams
    })
    const {
      data: { content, totalPages }
    } = response || {}

    return {
      data: content.map(({ id, specialOperationName: name }: any) => ({
        id,
        name,
        label: name
      })),
      total: totalPages
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      'Error getting special operations IDs (getSpecialOperation):',
      error
    )
    throw error
  }
}

export default getSpecialOperation

```

## src/pages/ReportSubmodule/Hooks/useReport.tsx

```tsx
import { ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'

import { getParticipantReport } from '../services/reportOpSpecial.ts/index.ts'

type Column = {
  width: number
  field: string
  headerName: string
  renderCell: (params: any) => ReactNode
}

export interface OptionType {
  label: string
  id: number
  country?: { name: string }
  recordDate?: string
  settlementDate?: string
}

export interface Props {
  setPushMessage?: (value: { message: string; variant: string }) => void
  setViewToast?: (value: boolean) => void
}

export const useReport = () =>
  // { setPushMessage = () => {}, setViewToast = () => {} }: Props = {}
  {
    const [registerDateStart, setRegisterDateStart] = useState<Date>(new Date())
    const [registerDateEnd, setRegisterDateEnd] = useState<Date>(new Date())
    const [columnsDate, setColumnsDate] = useState<Column[]>([])
    const [currentStatus, setCurrentStatus] = useState<number>(0)
    const [participantSearchQuery, setParticipantSearchQuery] =
      useState<string>('')
    const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<OptionType>({
      label: '',
      id: 0,
      country: { name: '' },
      recordDate: '',
      settlementDate: ''
    })
    const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()

    const optionsStatus = [
      { id: 1, name: 'ASIGNADA' },
      { id: 2, name: 'REGISTRADA' }
    ]

    const onChangeStatus = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      setCurrentStatus(Number(e))
    }

    const Container = ({
      children,
      className
    }: {
      children: ReactNode
      className?: string
    }) => (
      <div
        className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    )

    useEffect(() => {
      setColumnsDate([
        {
          width: 250,
          field: 'Date',
          headerName: 'Fecha y hora de generación',
          renderCell: ({ row }: any) => {
            return (
              <Container>
                <span>
                  {row?.fileRecordDate ?? 'N/A'} - {row?.fileRecordTime ?? ''}
                </span>
              </Container>
            )
          }
        },
        {
          width: 250,
          field: 'User',
          headerName: 'Usuario que genera',
          renderCell: ({ row }: any) => {
            return (
              <Container>
                <span>{row?.user}</span>
              </Container>
            )
          }
        },
        {
          width: 200,
          field: 'Participant',
          headerName: 'Participante',
          renderCell: ({ row }: any) => {
            return (
              <Container>
                <span>{row?.participant}</span>
              </Container>
            )
          }
        },
        {
          width: 200,
          field: 'Operations',
          headerName: 'Numero de operaciones',
          renderCell: ({ row }: any) => {
            return (
              <Container>
                <span>{row?.Operations}</span>
              </Container>
            )
          }
        },
        {
          width: 250,
          field: 'ReportStatus',
          headerName: 'Estado del reporte',
          renderCell: ({ row }: any) => {
            return (
              <Container>
                {
                  typeof row?.ReportStatus === 'function' ? (
                    row.ReportStatus() // Renderiza el botón
                  ) : (
                    <span>{row?.ReportStatus}</span>
                  ) // Renderiza el texto
                }
              </Container>
            )
          }
        }
      ])
    }, [])

    const fetchOptionsParticipants = useCallback(
      async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
        try {
          setParticipantSearchQuery(query ?? '')
          const response = await getParticipantReport(page, size, query)

          return {
            data: response.content.map(
              (item: { id: number; shortName: string; code: string }) => ({
                ...item,
                label: `${item.code} - ${item.shortName}`
              })
            ),
            total: response.totalElements
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
          return { data: [], total: 0 }
        }
      },
      []
    )

    useEffect(() => {
      if (selectedOption) {
        fetchOptionsParticipants(participantSearchQuery)
      }
    }, [selectedOption, fetchOptionsParticipants, participantSearchQuery])

    useEffect(() => {
      const initializeFiltersFromURL = async () => {
        const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
        const participantId = searchParams.get('participante')

        const promises: Promise<void>[] = []

        if (participantId) {
          promises.push(handleParticipantId(participantId))
        }

        await Promise.all(promises)
      }

      const handleParticipantId = async (participantId: string) => {
        try {
          const response = await fetchOptionsParticipants()
          console.log('🚀 ~ handleParticipantId ~ response:', response)
          const participant = response.data.find(
            (item: { id: number; label: string }) =>
              item.id === Number(participantId)
          )
          if (participant) {
            setSelectedOption(participant)
          }
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error fetching participant by ID:', error)
        }
      }

      initializeFiltersFromURL()
    }, [fetchOptionsParticipants])

    const handleOptionChange = useCallback(
      (option: OptionType) => {
        setSelectedOption(option)
        if (option) {
          searchParams.set('participante', option.id.toString())
        } else {
          searchParams.delete('participante')
        }
        setSearchParams(searchParams)
      },
      [searchParams, setSearchParams]
    )

    return {
      registerDateStart,
      setRegisterDateStart,
      registerDateEnd,
      setRegisterDateEnd,
      columnsDate,
      optionsStatus,
      onChangeStatus,
      currentStatus,
      fetchOptionsParticipants,
      handleOptionChange,
      selectedOption
    }
  }

```

## src/pages/ReportSubmodule/components/GenerateReport.tsx

```tsx
import {
  Typography,
  Button,
  DefaultComponents
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import dayjs, { Dayjs } from 'dayjs'
import { useContext, useState } from 'react'

import {
  AutoCompleteInput,
  DataPicker,
  ModalAlert,
  MuiSelect,
  Toast
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { useReport } from '../Hooks/useReport.tsx'
import { generateLiquidFile } from '../services/reportOpSpecial.ts'

export const GenerateReport = () => {
  const [generateReportModal, setGenerateReportModal] = useState(false)
  const [viewToast, setViewToast] = useState(false)
  const [pushMessage, setPushMessage] = useState({ message: '', variant: '' })
  // const [dataSettlement, setDataSettlement] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [modalAlert, setModalAlert] = useState<{
    title: string
    message: string
    variant: string
    textSuccess: string
    open: boolean
    onClose: () => void
  } | null>(null)

  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const {
    registerDateStart,
    setRegisterDateStart,
    registerDateEnd,
    setRegisterDateEnd,
    optionsStatus,
    onChangeStatus,
    currentStatus,
    fetchOptionsParticipants,
    handleOptionChange,
    selectedOption
  } = useReport()

  return (
    <>
      <Typography variant="h6" className="font-medium text-[#3D3D3D]">
        Generar reportes
      </Typography>

      <div className="mb-6 mt-4 flex w-full gap-6 rounded-md border border-white p-6 shadow-[0px_4px_4px_-2px_#00000033]">
        <div className="flex w-[400px] gap-x-2">
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha Inicio"
            value={registerDateStart}
            onChange={(newValue: Dayjs) =>
              setRegisterDateStart(newValue.toDate())
            }
            height={40}
            returnAs="dayjs"
            width="200px"
          />
          <DataPicker
            label="Fecha Final"
            value={registerDateEnd}
            onChange={(newValue: Dayjs) =>
              setRegisterDateEnd(newValue.toDate())
            }
            height={40}
            returnAs="dayjs"
            width="200px"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="w-[400px]">
          <AutoCompleteInput
            label="Participante"
            fetchOptions={fetchOptionsParticipants}
            onChange={(value: { id: number; label: string }) => {
              handleOptionChange(value)
            }}
            value={selectedOption}
            itemsPerPage={10}
            minSearchLength={1}
            debounceTime={300}
            key={`participant-${selectedOption?.id}`}
            renderOption={(
              props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
              option: { id: number; label: string }
            ) => (
              <DefaultComponents.Box
                component="li"
                {...props}
                key={option.id}
                sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
              >
                {option.label}
              </DefaultComponents.Box>
            )}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="w-[400px]">
          <MuiSelect
            options={optionsStatus}
            onChange={onChangeStatus}
            placeholder="Estado"
            value={currentStatus}
          />
        </div>

        <Button
          size="large"
          onClick={() => setGenerateReportModal(true)}
          disabled={
            !registerDateStart ||
            !registerDateEnd ||
            !selectedOption ||
            !currentStatus
          }
          className={`flex w-[114px] items-center justify-center px-2 text-[15px] font-medium ${
            !registerDateStart ||
            !registerDateEnd ||
            !selectedOption ||
            !currentStatus
              ? 'bg-[rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] text-[rgba(0,0,0,0.38)]'
              : 'bg-[#FF4201] text-[#FFFFFF]'
          }`}
        >
          Generar
        </Button>
      </div>

      {generateReportModal && (
        <ModalAlert
          title="¿Generar reportes?"
          variant="warning"
          textSuccess="Generar archivo"
          textCancel="Cancelar"
          handleCancel={() => setGenerateReportModal(false)}
          onClick={async () => {
            context?.setLoading(true)
            setGenerateReportModal(false)
            try {
              await generateLiquidFile({
                startDate: dayjs(registerDateStart).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                endDate: dayjs(registerDateEnd).format('YYYY-MM-DD'),
                statusId: currentStatus,
                participantId: selectedOption?.id
              })

              setPushMessage({
                message:
                  'El archivo se ha generado con éxito, la descarga comenzara cuando este listo',
                variant: 'success'
              })
              setViewToast(true)
            } catch {
              setModalAlert({
                title: 'Error de búsqueda de archivos',
                message:
                  'No se encontró ningún registro relacionado, prueba cambiado los criterios de búsqueda.',
                variant: 'error',
                textSuccess: 'Volver',
                open: true,
                onClose: () => setModalAlert(null)
              })
            } finally {
              context?.setLoading(false)
            }
          }}
          orientation="horizontal"
          disabled={false}
          customStyles={{}}
          className="w-[427px] gap-4 px-6 py-12"
        >
          <p className="text-center text-[#3D3D3D]">
            ¿Deseas generar el archivo?
          </p>
        </ModalAlert>
      )}
      {viewToast && (
        <Toast
          text={pushMessage.message}
          variant={pushMessage.variant}
          width="424px"
          onClose={() => setViewToast(!viewToast)}
        />
      )}
      {modalAlert && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalAlert.title}
          textSuccess={modalAlert.textSuccess}
          message={modalAlert.message}
          variant={modalAlert.variant}
          onClick={modalAlert.onClose}
        />
      )}
    </>
  )
}

```

## src/pages/ReportSubmodule/helpers/generateCSVReport.ts

```typescript
import { format } from 'date-fns'

type GenerateTxtReport = {
  data: any
  name?: string
  setProgress: (progress: number) => void
}

export const generateCSVReport = async ({
  data,
  name,
  setProgress
}: GenerateTxtReport) => {
  // const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username') ?? "unknown_user";

  try {
    let reports: string[] = []

    const dataArray = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [data]
    console.log('🚀 ~ generateCSVReport ~ dataArray:', dataArray)
    const totalRecords = dataArray.length

    const now = new Date()
    const fechaDeGeneracion = format(now, 'dd-MM-yyyy').replace(/[-_.]/g, '')

    const headers = [
      'Fecha y hora de generación',
      'Participante',
      'Usuario que genera',
      'Estado de la operación',
      'Numero de operaciones'
    ].join(',')

    reports.push(headers)

    for (let i = 0; i < totalRecords; i++) {
      const item = dataArray[i]

      const formattedLine = [
        String(item.date ?? '').padStart(8, ' '),
        String(item.Participant ?? '').padStart(15, ' '),
        String(item.User ?? '').padStart(15, ' '),
        String(item.Status ?? '').padStart(15, ' '),
        String(item.Operations ?? '').padStart(15, ' ')
      ].join(',')

      reports.push(formattedLine)

      setProgress(Math.round(((i + 1) / totalRecords) * 100))
    }

    const finalContent = reports.join('\n')

    const nameEntity = (name ?? 'default_name').replace(/\s+/g, '_')
    const fileName = `${nameEntity}_ARCH_LIQM_RV_${fechaDeGeneracion}_${nameEntity}.csv`

    const blob = new Blob([finalContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob)

    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = url
    link.download = `${fileName}.csv`
    document.body.appendChild(link)
    link.click()

    document.body.removeChild(link)
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)

    setProgress(100)
  } catch {
    console.error('Error generating CSV file')
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  httpParticipants,
  httpSpecOperationsReceipts
} from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { getCommonHeaders } from '../../../../helpers'

export const getParticipantReport = async (
  page: number,
  size: number,
  participantCodeName: string | undefined
) => {
  try {
    const headers = await getCommonHeaders()
    const response = await httpParticipants.get(`/participant/search`, {
      headers,
      params: {
        text: participantCodeName,
        page,
        size
      }
    })
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching total guarantees:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

type generateLiquidData = {
  startDate: string
  endDate: string
  statusId: number
  participantId: number
}

export const generateLiquidFile = async ({
  startDate,
  endDate,
  statusId,
  participantId
}: generateLiquidData) => {
  const body = {
    startDate,
    endDate,
    statusId,
    participantId
  }

  try {
    const headers = await getCommonHeaders()
    const response = await httpSpecOperationsReceipts.post(
      `/special-trade-liquidation/generate/settlement-file`,
      body,
      {
        headers
      }
    )
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching total guarantees:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
```

```tsx
import { Typography, Button } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import clsx from 'clsx'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers/utilities'
import { getTotalsDetailsFolios } from '../../../services/transactionsBank/detailsFolios'

interface UseDetailsFoliosProps {
  bankTransactionId: number
  onAddRow?: () => void
  onDissociate?: () => void
  isAddingRow: boolean
  refreshKey?: number
}

export const useDetailsFolios = ({
  bankTransactionId,
  onAddRow,
  onDissociate,
  isAddingRow,
  refreshKey
}: UseDetailsFoliosProps) => {
  const [buttons, setButtons] = useState({
    permissionToAssociate: false,
    permissionToDissociate: false
  })
  const [totals, setTotals] = useState({ totalCount: 0, totalAmount: 0 })
  const [details, setDetails] = useState({
    sequence: '',
    transactionDate: '',
    transactionAmount: 0
  })
  const [specialTradeId, setSpecialTradeId] = useState(0)

  const headerActionsLeft = () => (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <Button
        size="small"
        variant="text"
        color="primary"
        onClick={onAddRow}
        disabled={!buttons.permissionToAssociate || isAddingRow}
        className={clsx({
          'cursor-not-allowed text-gray-400':
            !buttons.permissionToAssociate || isAddingRow,
          'hover:text-link-color cursor-pointer':
            buttons.permissionToAssociate && !isAddingRow
        })}
      >
        Agregar Nuevo
      </Button>
      <Button
        size="small"
        variant="text"
        color="primary"
        onClick={onDissociate}
        disabled={!buttons.permissionToDissociate}
        className={clsx({
          'cursor-not-allowed text-gray-400': !buttons.permissionToDissociate,
          'hover:text-link-color cursor-pointer': buttons.permissionToDissociate
        })}
      >
        Desasociar
      </Button>
    </div>
  )

  const CustomFooter = () => (
    <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-32 bg-[#F4F4F4] py-[28.5px]">
      <div className="flex gap-32">
        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight="medium">
          Cantidad de registros:
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body2" fontWeight="medium">
          {totals?.totalCount}
        </Typography>
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-32">
        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight="medium">
          Total Monto:
        </Typography>
        <Typography variant="body1" fontWeight="medium">
          {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(totals.totalAmount)}
        </Typography>
      </div>
    </div>
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTotals = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getTotalsDetailsFolios(bankTransactionId)
        setButtons({
          permissionToAssociate: data.permissionToAssociate,
          permissionToDissociate: data.permissionToDissociate
        })
        setTotals({
          totalCount: data.recordCount || 0,
          totalAmount: data.totalAmount || 0
        })
        setDetails({
          sequence: data.sequence || '',
          transactionDate: data.transactionDate || '',
          transactionAmount: data.transactionAmount || 0
        })
        setSpecialTradeId(data.specialTradeId || 0)
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching totals:', error)
      }
    }

    fetchTotals()
  }, [bankTransactionId, refreshKey])

  const dataHeader = [
    {
      title: '',
      rows: [{ label: 'Secuencia', value: details?.sequence ?? 'N/A' }]
    },
    {
      title: '',
      rows: [
        {
          label: 'Fecha de Transacción',
          value: details?.transactionDate ?? 'N/A'
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      title: '',
      rows: [
        {
          label: 'Monto de la Transacción',
          value:
            formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(details?.transactionAmount) ??
            'N/A'
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  return {
    headerActionsLeft,
    CustomFooter,
    dataHeader,
    specialTradeId
  }
}
```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks/useDetailsFoliosColumns.tsx

```tsx
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid'
import { DefaultComponents } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react'

import {
  AutoCompleteInput,
  MuiSelect
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers/utilities'
import {
  getFolios,
  getSettlementsByTradeAndSide
} from '../../../services/transactionsBank/detailsFolios'
import { ISettlement } from '../interfaces/DetailFolios'

interface OptionType {
  label: number
  id: number
  country?: { name: string; id: number }
  recordDate?: string
  settlementDate?: string
}

interface UseDetailsFoliosColumnsProps {
  specialTradeId: number
  rows: ISettlement[]
  setAlert: (alert: {
    message: string
    severity: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
    open: boolean
  }) => void
}

export const useDetailsFoliosColumns = ({
  specialTradeId,
  rows,
  setAlert
}: UseDetailsFoliosColumnsProps) => {
  const sideOptions = [
    { id: 1, name: 'Compra' },
    { id: 2, name: 'Venta' }
  ]

  const [selectedFolio, setSelectedFolio] = useState<OptionType | null>(null)
  const [sideIdSelect, setSide] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [fractionOptions, setFractionOptions] = useState<
    { id: number; name: number }[]
  >([])
  const [fractionIdSelect, setFraction] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [settlementsRaw, setSettlementsRaw] = useState<ISettlement[]>([])
  const [selectedSettlement, setSelectedSettlement] =
    useState<ISettlement | null>(null)

  const columnsFolios: GridColDef<ISettlement>[] = [
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 112,
      field: 'registrationDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha registro',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row.registrationDate ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </div>
        )
      },
      sortComparator: (a: string, b: string) =>
        new Date(a).getTime() - new Date(b).getTime()
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 150,
      field: 'folio',
      headerName: 'Folio',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        const isManual = row?.isManual
        if (isManual) {
          return (
            <div className="flex h-20 items-center">
              <AutoCompleteInput
                label="Folio"
                fetchOptions={fetchOptionsFolios}
                onChange={handleChangeFolios}
                value={selectedFolio}
                required
                itemsPerPage={10}
                minSearchLength={3}
                debounceTime={300}
                height={24}
                key={`folio-${specialTradeId}`}
                renderOption={(
                  props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
                  option: { id: number; label: string }
                ) => {
                  ;<DefaultComponents.Box
                    component="li"
                    {...props}
                    key={option.id}
                    sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
                  >
                    {option.label}
                  </DefaultComponents.Box>
                }}
                hideIcon
                sx={{
                  width: '100%',
                  '& .MuiInputLabel-root': {
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    transform: `translate(14px, 16%)`,
                    '&.MuiInputLabel-shrink': {
                      transform: 'translate(12px, -10px) scale(0.75)'
                    }
                  }
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )
        }
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row?.folio?.matchId}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 130,
      field: 'sideId',
      headerName: 'Punta',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        const isManual = row?.isManual
        const isFolioSelected = selectedFolio !== null
        if (isManual) {
          return (
            <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
              <MuiSelect
                options={sideOptions}
                onChange={(value: number) => {
                  handleChangeSide(value)
                  fetchOptionsFractions(value)
                }}
                placeholder="Punta"
                value={sideIdSelect}
                height={24}
                disabled={!isFolioSelected}
              />
            </div>
          )
        }
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row?.side?.description}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 125,
      field: 'fraction',
      headerName: 'Fracciones',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        const isManual = row?.isManual
        const isSideSelected = sideIdSelect !== null
        if (isManual) {
          return (
            <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
              <MuiSelect
                options={fractionOptions}
                onChange={(value: number) => {
                  handleChangeFraction(value)
                }}
                placeholder="Fracción"
                value={fractionIdSelect}
                height={24}
                disabled={!isSideSelected}
              />
            </div>
          )
        }
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row.fraction}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 150,
      field: 'settlementDate',
      headerName: 'Fecha Cumplimiento',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row.settlementDate ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </div>
        )
      },
      sortComparator: (a: string, b: string) =>
        new Date(a).getTime() - new Date(b).getTime()
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 135,
      field: 'participant',
      headerName: 'Participante',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">
              {row?.participantAccount?.participant.code ?? '--'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )
      },
      sortComparator: (a: string, b: string) => (a ?? '').localeCompare(b ?? '')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 135,
      field: 'custodian',
      headerName: 'Custodio',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">{row?.custodian?.code ?? '--'}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 135,
      field: 'amount',
      headerName: 'Monto',
      renderCell: ({ row }) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <p className="w-full">
              {formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(row.amount) ?? '--'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )
      },
      sortComparator: (a: number, b: number) => a - b
    }
  ]

  const handleChangeFolios = (option: any) => {
    setSelectedFolio(option)
    if (option === null) {
      setSide(null)
      setFractionOptions([])
    }
  }

  const handleChangeSide = useCallback((value: number) => {
    setSide(value)
  }, [])

  const handleChangeFraction = useCallback(
    (value: number) => {
      console.log('Fraccion', value)
      if (!selectedFolio || sideIdSelect === null) return
      const alreadyExists = rows.some(
        (row) =>
          row.tradeId === selectedFolio.id &&
          Number(row.side?.id) === sideIdSelect &&
          row.fraction === value
      )

      if (alreadyExists) {
        setAlert({
          message:
            'Esta combinación de Folio, Punta y Fracción ya está asociada.',
          severity: 'warning',
          open: true
        })
        setFraction(null)
        return
      }

      setFraction(value)
    },
    [selectedFolio, sideIdSelect, rows]
  )

  const fillRow = useCallback(() => {
    console.log('settlementsRaw', settlementsRaw)
    console.log('selectedFolio fillRow', selectedFolio?.id)
    console.log('fractionIdSelect fillRow', fractionIdSelect)
    console.log('sideIdSelect fillRow', sideIdSelect)

    if (!selectedFolio || sideIdSelect === null || fractionIdSelect === null)
      return

    const match = settlementsRaw.find(
      (item) =>
        item.tradeId === selectedFolio.id &&
        item.side?.id === sideIdSelect.toString() &&
        item.fraction === fractionIdSelect
    )

    if (match) {
      setSelectedSettlement(match)
    } else {
      setSelectedSettlement(null)
      console.warn('No se encontró una coincidencia')
    }
  }, [settlementsRaw, selectedFolio, fractionIdSelect, sideIdSelect])

  const fetchOptionsFolios = useCallback(
    async (query?: number, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        const response = await getFolios(specialTradeId, query, page, size)
        return {
          data: response.content.map(
            (item: { id: number; tradeId: number; matchId: number }) => ({
              ...item,
              id: item.tradeId,
              label: item.matchId
            })
          ),
          total: response.totalElements
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [specialTradeId]
  )

  const fetchOptionsFractions = useCallback(
    async (sideId: number) => {
      try {
        const payload = { tradeId: selectedFolio?.id, sideId: sideId }
        const response = await getSettlementsByTradeAndSide(payload)

        console.log('response', response)

        setSettlementsRaw(response)

        const options = response.map((item: any, index: number) => ({
          id: index,
          name: item.fraction
        }))
        setFractionOptions(options)
        if (options.length === 1) {
          setFraction(null)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching options:', error)
      }
    },
    [selectedFolio]
  )

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedFolio && sideIdSelect !== null && fractionIdSelect !== null) {
      fillRow()
    }
  }, [selectedFolio, sideIdSelect, fractionIdSelect, settlementsRaw])

  const clearSelections = () => {
    setSelectedFolio(null)
    setSide(null)
    setFraction(null)
    setFractionOptions([])
    setSettlementsRaw([])
    setSelectedSettlement(null)
  }

  return {
    columnsFolios,
    selectedSettlement,
    clearSelections
  }
}

```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks/useSettlementBankTransactionTracking.tsx

```tsx
import axios from 'axios'
import { format } from 'date-fns'
import { useState, useEffect, ReactNode, useContext } from 'react'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { getErrorMessage } from '../../../helpers'
import useWebSocket from '../../../hooks/webSocket'
import { SettlementBankTransactionTrackingHistory } from '../../../models'
import { getSettlementBankTransactionHistory } from '../../../services/transactionsBank'

/**
 * Custom hook for tracking and displaying settlement bank transaction history.
 *
 * This hook handles:
 * - Fetching bank transaction history data on mount
 * - WebSocket connection to receive real-time updates on transaction status
 * - Column configuration for displaying transaction data in a table
 *
 * @param {Object} params - Hook parameters
 * @param {number} params.bankTransactionId - The ID of the bank transaction to track
 * @param {() => void} params.handleClose - Callback function to close the tracking modal/component
 *
 * @returns {Object} Result object containing:
 * @returns {SettlementBankTransactionTrackingHistory[]} result.rows - The transaction history data rows
 * @returns {React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<SettlementBankTransactionTrackingHistory[]>>} result.setRows - State setter for the rows
 * @returns {Array<Object>} result.columns - Column definitions for the data grid with renderers
 *
 * @example
 * const { rows, columns } = useSettlementBankTransactionTracking({
 *   bankTransactionId: 123,
 *   handleClose: () => setModalOpen(false)
 * });
 */
export function useSettlementBankTransactionTracking({
  bankTransactionId,
  handleClose
}: {
  bankTransactionId: number
  handleClose: () => void
}) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<SettlementBankTransactionTrackingHistory[]>(
    []
  )
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [hasDataBeenFetched, setHasDataBeenFetched] = useState(false)

  const path = import.meta.env.VITE_SETTLEMENT_BANK_TRANSACTION_SOCKET
  const topic = `/topic/bank-transaction-status-history/${bankTransactionId}`
  const { mensaje } = useWebSocket(path, topic)

  /**
   * Handles API errors consistently across the component
   * @param error - The error object from the catch block
   * @param title - Custom error modal title
   */
  const handleApiError = (error: unknown, title: string) => {
    let message = 'Error desconocido'

    if (axios.isAxiosError(error)) {
      message = getErrorMessage(error.response?.data?.errorCode)
      if (error.response?.data?.httpCode === '500') {
        message = 'Error en el servidor.'
      }
    }

    context?.setModalAlert({
      title,
      variant: 'error',
      message: message,
      textSuccess: 'aceptar',
      textCancel: 'hidden',
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        handleClose()
      }
    })
  }

  const Container = ({
    children,
    className
  }: {
    children: ReactNode
    className?: string
  }) => (
    <div
      className={`flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  )

  const columns = [
    {
      width: 115,
      field: 'date',
      headerName: 'Fecha',
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { dateTime: string } }) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <span>
              {' '}
              {format(new Date(row?.dateTime), 'dd/MM/yyyy') ?? 'N/A'}
            </span>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 71,
      field: 'time',
      headerName: 'Hora',
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { dateTime: string } }) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <span> {format(new Date(row?.dateTime), 'HH:ss')}</span>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 94,
      field: 'status',
      headerName: 'Estado',
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: {
          status: { description: string }
        }
      }) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <span> {row?.status.description}</span>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 161,
      field: 'transactionType',
      headerName: 'Tipo de movimiento',
      renderCell: ({
        row
      }: {
        row: { transactionType: { description: string } }
      }) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <span> {row?.transactionType.description}</span>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 160,
      field: 'fileConsecutive',
      headerName: 'Archivo',
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { fileConsecutive: string } }) => {
        return (
          <Container>
            <span> {row?.fileConsecutive}</span>
          </Container>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      width: 502,
      field: 'detail',
      headerName: 'Detalle',
      renderCell: ({ row }: { row: { details: string } }) => {
        return <p>{row?.details}</p>
      }
    }
  ]

  // Handle WebSocket messages for real-time updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mensaje) {
      try {
        const parsedMessage = JSON.parse(mensaje)
        if (parsedMessage) {
          setRows(parsedMessage)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing WebSocket message:', error)
      }
    }
  }, [mensaje])

  // Fetch transaction history data once on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    // Skip fetching if already fetched data
    if (hasDataBeenFetched) {
      return
    }

    const fetchTransactionHistory = async () => {
      context?.setLoading(true)
      try {
        // Fetch transaction history data from API
        const data = await getSettlementBankTransactionHistory({
          // Use the dynamic bankTransactionId parameter captured from closure
          bankTransactionId
        })

        if (data) {
          setRows(data)
        }
      } catch (error) {
        // Use the reusable error handler
        handleApiError(error, 'Ocurrió un error obteniendo el historial')
      } finally {
        context?.setLoading(false)
        setHasDataBeenFetched(true)
      }
    }

    fetchTransactionHistory()
    // empty dependency array to ensure this runs exactly once on mount
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [])

  return {
    rows,
    setRows,
    columns
  }
}
```

```tsx
import VisibilityOutlinedIcon from '@mui/icons-material/VisibilityOutlined'
import { GridColDef } from '@mui/x-data-grid'
import {
  MaterialIcons,
  DefaultComponents
} from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'

import { formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator } from '../../../helpers/formattedNumber'

interface TransactionsColumnsProps {
  setSettlementBankTransactionTracking: React.Dispatch<
    React.SetStateAction<{
      show: boolean
      bankTransaction: any
    }>
  >
  setModalDetailFolios: (value: boolean) => void
  setCurrentId: (arg: number) => void
}
export const useTransactionColumns = ({
  setSettlementBankTransactionTracking,
  setModalDetailFolios,
  setCurrentId
}: TransactionsColumnsProps) => {
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')

  const columns: GridColDef[] = [
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 97,
      field: 'transactionDateTime',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.FechaMovimiento'),
      valueGetter: (value: string) => {
        const date = new Date(value)
        return date.toLocaleDateString('es-CO', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: '2-digit',
          year: 'numeric'
        })
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'nuboSequence',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Secuencia'),
      valueGetter: (value: string) => value || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'specialTrade',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Folio'),
      renderCell: (params) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <DefaultComponents.Tooltip title="Ver folios" placement="top">
              <span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setModalDetailFolios(true)
                    setCurrentId(params.row.id)
                  }}
                >
                  <MaterialIcons.BorderColorOutlined />
                </button>
              </span>
            </DefaultComponents.Tooltip>
            <p>{params.value?.specialOperationId ?? '--'}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'transactionType',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.TipoMovimiento'),
      valueGetter: (value: { description: string }) => {
        return value?.description || '--'
      }
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'flagManual',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Proceso'),
      valueGetter: (value: boolean) => (value ? 'Manual' : 'Automático')
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'transactionAmount',
      align: 'right',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Valor'),
      valueGetter: (value: number) =>
        formatNumberWithThousandsSeparator(value, true) || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'participant',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Participante'),
      valueGetter: (value: { shortName: string }) => value?.shortName || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'accountOutput',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.CuentaSalida'),
      valueGetter: (value: string) => value || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'accountInput',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.CuentaIngreso'),
      valueGetter: (value: string) => value || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'observation',
      headerName: t('Transacciones.Table.Columnas.Observacion'),
      valueGetter: (value: string) => value || '--'
    },
    {
      flex: 1,
      minWidth: 115,
      field: 'status',
      headerName: 'Estado',

      renderCell: (params) => {
        return (
          <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-start gap-1">
            <button
              onClick={(event) => {
                event.stopPropagation()
                setSettlementBankTransactionTracking({
                  show: true,
                  bankTransaction: params.row
                })
              }}
            >
              <VisibilityOutlinedIcon />
            </button>
            <p>{params.value?.description ?? 'N/A'}</p>
          </div>
        )
      }
    }
  ]
  return {
    columns
  }
}
```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks/useTransactions.tsx

```tsx
import Box from '@mui/material/Box'
import Link from '@mui/material/Link'
import Typography from '@mui/material/Typography'
import { ReactNode, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import {
  AutoCompleteInput,
  DataPicker,
  GenerateLogs,
  InputModal,
  MuiSelect
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { errorManagment, formatNumberWithTwoDecimals } from '../../../helpers'
import {
  CrudTransactionsModel,
  getEmptyCrudTransactions,
  TransactionsPayloadModel
} from '../../../models'
import {
  deleteTransaction,
  getAccountsBVC,
  getTransactionsBankParticipant,
  getTransactionsBankSequence,
  getTransactionType,
  sendTransaction
} from '../../../services/transactionsBank'

interface RowProps {
  label: string
  input: ReactNode
}

interface Selects {
  paymentType: { id: number; name: string }[]
  participantAccount: { id: number; name: string }[]
  bvcAccount: { id: number; name: string }[]
  isPayment: boolean
}

export const useTransactions = (
  deleteRowsState: (rowsIds: number[]) => void,
  payment: { id: number; name: string } | null,
  operation: any,
  addRowStateWithData: (newRow: any) => void,
  editRowStateWithData: (id: number, newRow: any) => void,
  thereAreSelected: any,
  rowsFlagManualTrue: any[],
  infoUserNubo: any,
  client_user: string | null
) => {
  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)
  const [transaction, setTransaction] = useState<CrudTransactionsModel>(
    getEmptyCrudTransactions()
  )
  const [selectedOption, setSelectedOption] = useState<{
    label: string
    id: number
  } | null>(null)
  const [participantSearchQuery, setParticipantSearchQuery] =
    useState<string>('')
  const [isDisabledButton, setIsDisabledButton] = useState<boolean>(true)
  const [typeForm, setTypeForm] = useState<'create' | 'update'>('create')
  const [options, setOptions] = useState<Selects>({
    paymentType: [],
    participantAccount: [],
    bvcAccount: [],
    isPayment: false
  })
  const { participantId, id: id_user_nubo, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  useEffect(() => {
    const {
      transactionDateTime,
      participant,
      transactionType,
      transactionAmount,
      bankSequence,
      nuboSequence
    } = transaction
    const isValid = !(
      transactionDateTime &&
      participant.code &&
      transactionType.description &&
      transactionAmount &&
      bankSequence &&
      nuboSequence
    )
    setIsDisabledButton(isValid)
  }, [transaction])

  const handleGetOptionsPaymentType = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const paymentTypeOptions = await getTransactionType()
      setOptions((prevOptions) => ({
        ...prevOptions,
        paymentType: paymentTypeOptions
      }))
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: errorManagment(error),
        variant: 'error'
      })
    }
  }, [])

  const handleSetTransaction = (name: string, value: any) => {
    setTransaction((prevTransaction) => ({
      ...prevTransaction,
      [name]: value
    }))
  }

  const handleChangeValue = async (name: string, value: any) => {
    if (name === 'transactionAmount') value = parseFloat(value)
    handleSetTransaction(name, value)

    if (name !== 'transactionType') return
    handleChangeValue('accountInput', null)
    handleChangeValue('accountOutput', null)
    const isPayment =
      options.paymentType.find((option) => option.id === value.id)?.name ===
      'PAGO'
    try {
      const response = await getTransactionsBankSequence(
        isPayment ? 'payment' : 'collection'
      )
      handleSetTransaction('nuboSequence', response.nuboSequence)
      await handleSetOptions(value.id, transaction)
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: errorManagment(error),
        variant: 'error'
      })
    }
  }

  const handleOptionChange = useCallback((value: any) => {
    setSelectedOption({ label: value.label, id: value.id })
    handleChangeValue('participant', value)
  }, [])

  const fetchOptionsParticipants = useCallback(
    async (query?: string, page: number = 0, size: number = 10) => {
      try {
        setParticipantSearchQuery(query ?? '')
        const response = await getTransactionsBankParticipant(
          operation.id,
          participantSearchQuery,
          page,
          size
        )

        return {
          data: response.content.map(
            (item: { id: number; shortName: string; code: string }) => ({
              ...item,
              label: `${item.code} - ${item.shortName}`
            })
          ),
          total: response.totalElements
        }
      } catch (error) {
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: errorManagment(error),
          variant: 'error'
        })
        return { data: [], total: 0 }
      }
    },
    [operation]
  )

  const inputSx = {
    height: 28,
    '& .MuiInputBase-root': {
      height: 28,
      fontSize: '0.85rem',
      padding: '0 8px'
    },
    '& .MuiInputBase-input': {
      height: 28,
      padding: 0
    }
  }

  const Row: React.FC<RowProps> = ({ label, input }) => (
    <Box
      sx={{
        display: 'grid',
        gridTemplateColumns: '200px 1fr',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 2
      }}
    >
      <Typography
        sx={{
          height: 28,
          fontSize: '0.85rem',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center'
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </Typography>
      <Box sx={{ height: 28, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        {input}
      </Box>
    </Box>
  )

  const FormTransaction = () => {
    return (
      <Box
        p={3}
        border={1}
        borderRadius={2}
        borderColor="#ddd"
        display="flex"
        flexDirection="column"
        gap={2}
      >
        <Box display="flex" gap={4}>
          <Box flex={1} display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap={2}>
            <Row
              label="Fecha movimiento"
              input={
                <DataPicker
                  value={transaction.transactionDateTime}
                  onChange={(value: string) =>
                    handleChangeValue('transactionDateTime', value)
                  }
                  height={28}
                />
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Tipo Movimiento"
              input={
                <MuiSelect
                  height="28px"
                  options={options.paymentType}
                  value={
                    transaction.transactionType.id === -1
                      ? null
                      : transaction.transactionType.id
                  }
                  disabled={selectedOption === null}
                  onChange={(value: any) =>
                    handleChangeValue('transactionType', {
                      id: value,
                      description: options.paymentType.find(
                        (option) => option.id === value
                      )?.name,
                      category: 'TRANSACCION'
                    })
                  }
                />
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Valor"
              input={
                <InputModal
                  field="transactionAmount"
                  size="small"
                  placeholder="0,00"
                  value={
                    transaction.transactionAmount !== 0
                      ? formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(
                          transaction.transactionAmount.toString(),
                          true
                        )
                      : ''
                  }
                  inputSx={inputSx}
                  onBlur={(event: any) =>
                    handleChangeValue(
                      event.target.name,
                      formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(event.target.value)
                    )
                  }
                  onKeyDown={(_id: number, event: any) =>
                    handleChangeValue(
                      event.target.name,
                      formatNumberWithTwoDecimals(event.target.value)
                    )
                  }
                  validate="numbers"
                  disabled={transaction.transactionType.id === -1}
                />
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Cuenta salida"
              input={
                <MuiSelect
                  height="28px"
                  options={
                    options.isPayment
                      ? options.bvcAccount
                      : options.participantAccount
                  }
                  value={transaction.accountOutput}
                  disabled={transaction.transactionType.id === -1}
                  onChange={(value: any) =>
                    handleSetTransaction('accountOutput', value)
                  }
                  className="w-[250px]"
                />
              }
            />
          </Box>

          <Box flex={1} display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap={2}>
            <Row
              label="Participante"
              input={
                <Box width="100%">
                  <AutoCompleteInput
                    label="Participante"
                    fetchOptions={fetchOptionsParticipants}
                    onChange={(value: any) => {
                      handleOptionChange(value)
                    }}
                    disabled={!transaction.transactionDateTime.trim()}
                    height={28}
                    value={selectedOption}
                    required
                    itemsPerPage={10}
                    minSearchLength={2}
                    debounceTime={300}
                    key={`participant-${selectedOption?.id}`}
                    renderOption={(
                      props: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement>,
                      option: { id: number; label: string }
                    ) => (
                      <Box
                        component="li"
                        {...props}
                        key={option.id}
                        sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 2 }}
                      >
                        {option.label}
                      </Box>
                    )}
                  />
                </Box>
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Folio"
              input={
                <Link
                  href="#"
                  underline="hover"
                  color="error"
                  sx={{
                    height: 28,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    fontSize: '0.85rem'
                  }}
                >
                  Ver folios asociados
                </Link>
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Estado"
              input={
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    height: 28,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center'
                  }}
                >
                  {transaction.status.description}
                </Typography>
              }
            />
            <Row
              label="Cuenta Ingreso"
              input={
                <MuiSelect
                  height="28px"
                  options={
                    options.isPayment
                      ? options.participantAccount
                      : options.bvcAccount
                  }
                  value={transaction.accountInput}
                  disabled={transaction.transactionType.id === -1}
                  onChange={(value: any) =>
                    handleSetTransaction('accountInput', value)
                  }
                  className="w-[250px]"
                />
              }
            />
          </Box>
        </Box>
        <Box display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap={1}>
          <Typography sx={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>Observación</Typography>
          <InputModal
            field="observation"
            multiline
            minRows={2}
            placeholder="Digita una observación"
            size="small"
            onBlur={(event: any) =>
              handleChangeValue(event.target.name, event.target.value)
            }
          />
        </Box>
        <Box display="flex" gap={4}>
          <Box flex={1}>
            <Row
              label="Secuencia Banco"
              input={
                <InputModal
                  field="bankSequence"
                  value={transaction.bankSequence}
                  onBlur={(event: any) =>
                    handleChangeValue(event.target.name, event.target.value)
                  }
                  onKeyDown={(_id: number, event: any) =>
                    handleChangeValue(event.target.name, event.target.value)
                  }
                  size="small"
                  placeholder="Secuencia del Banco"
                  inputSx={inputSx}
                />
              }
            />
          </Box>
          <Box flex={1}>
            <Row
              label="Secuencia nuBO"
              input={
                <Typography
                  sx={{
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    height: 28,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center'
                  }}
                >
                  {transaction.nuboSequence}
                </Typography>
              }
            />
          </Box>
        </Box>
      </Box>
    )
  }

  const handleEditTransaction = async () => {
    context?.clearModalContent()
    context?.setLoading(true)
    try {
      const data: TransactionsPayloadModel = {
        bankTransactionId: transaction.id,
        bankSequence: transaction.bankSequence ?? '',
        nuboSequence: transaction.nuboSequence ?? '',
        transactionAmount: transaction.transactionAmount,
        transactionDateTime: transaction.transactionDateTime,
        observation: transaction.observation ?? '',
        accountOutput: transaction.accountOutput ?? '',
        accountInput: transaction.accountInput ?? '',
        specialTradeId: operation.id,
        participantId: transaction.participant.id,
        paymentTypeId: payment?.id ?? 0
      }
      const response = await sendTransaction(data)
      editRowStateWithData(transaction.id, response)
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: 'Transacción Modificada con éxito.',
        variant: 'success'
      })
      GenerateLogs(client_user ?? '', {
        actionType: `Transacción Modificada`,
        actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/transaction-bank',
        participantId: participantId,
        countryId: country?.id,
        userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
        statusId: status?.id
      })
      setTransaction(getEmptyCrudTransactions())
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: errorManagment(error),
        variant: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      clearData()
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleCreateTransaction = async () => {
    context?.clearModalContent()
    context?.setLoading(true)
    try {
      const data: TransactionsPayloadModel = {
        bankSequence: transaction.bankSequence ?? '',
        nuboSequence: transaction.nuboSequence ?? '',
        transactionAmount: transaction.transactionAmount,
        transactionDateTime: transaction.transactionDateTime,
        observation: transaction.observation ?? '',
        accountOutput: transaction.accountOutput ?? '',
        accountInput: transaction.accountInput ?? '',
        specialTradeId: operation.id,
        participantId: transaction.participant.id,
        paymentTypeId: payment?.id ?? 0
      }
      const response = await sendTransaction(data)
      addRowStateWithData(response)
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: 'Transacción ingresada con éxito.',
        variant: 'success'
      })
      GenerateLogs(client_user ?? '', {
        actionType: `Transacción ingresada`,
        actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/transaction-bank',
        participantId: participantId,
        countryId: country?.id,
        userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
        statusId: status?.id
      })
      setTransaction(getEmptyCrudTransactions())
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setToast({
        show: true,
        text: errorManagment(error),
        variant: 'error'
      })
    } finally {
      clearData()
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDeleteTransaction = async () => {
    context?.clearModalAlert()
    context?.setLoading(true)
    try {
      const ids = thereAreSelected.filter((selectedId: number) =>
        rowsFlagManualTrue.some((row) => row.id === selectedId)
      )
      const response = await deleteTransaction(ids)
      if (response) {
        deleteRowsState(ids)
        setTransaction(getEmptyCrudTransactions())
        context?.setToast({
          show: true,
          text: 'Transacción eliminada con éxito.',
          variant: 'success'
        })
        GenerateLogs(client_user ?? '', {
          actionType: `Transacción eliminada`,
          actionDestination: 'operation-spec-management/transaction-bank',
          participantId: participantId,
          countryId: country?.id,
          userNuboId: id_user_nubo,
          statusId: status?.id
        })
      }
    } catch (error) {
      context?.setModalAlert({
        title: 'Ocurrió un error eliminando la transacción.',
        variant: 'error',
        message: errorManagment(error),
        textSuccess: 'Aceptar',
        textCancel: 'hidden',
        onClick: () => {
          context?.clearModalAlert()
        }
      })
    } finally {
      context?.setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const setModalCreate = () => {
    context?.setModalContent({
      title: `${typeForm === 'create' ? 'Ingreso de' : 'Modificar'} transacción`,
      description: 'Digita los datos a ingresar.',
      handleClose: () => {
        setTransaction(getEmptyCrudTransactions())
        setSelectedOption(null)
        setParticipantSearchQuery('')
        setTypeForm('create')
      },
      handleAccept: () => {
        typeForm === 'create'
          ? handleCreateTransaction()
          : handleEditTransaction()
      },
      btnAceptText: 'Aceptar',
      btnDisabled: isDisabledButton,
      btnCancelText: 'Cancelar',
      children: FormTransaction()
    })
  }

  const setModalEdit = async () => {
    setTypeForm('update')
    const rowSelected = rowsFlagManualTrue.find((row) =>
      thereAreSelected.includes(row.id)
    )
    await handleSetOptions(rowSelected.transactionType.id, rowSelected)
    setTransaction(rowSelected)
    setSelectedOption({
      label: `${rowSelected.participant.code} ${rowSelected.participant.name}`,
      id: rowSelected.participant.id
    })
    setModalCreate()
  }

  const handleSetOptions = async (paymentTypeId: number, data: any) => {
    const isPayment =
      options.paymentType.find((option) => option.id === paymentTypeId)
        ?.name === 'PAGO'
    const bvcAccounts = await getAccountsBVC()
    const bvcAccountsOptions = bvcAccounts.participantBankAccount.map(
      (item: any) => ({
        id: item.bankAccount,
        name: `${item.bankAccount} - ${item.bank.name}`
      })
    )
    const participantAccountOptions =
      data.participant.participantBankAccount.map((item: any) => ({
        id: item.bankAccount,
        name: `${item.bankAccount} - ${item.bank.name}`
      }))
    setOptions((prevOptions) => ({
      ...prevOptions,
      participantAccount: participantAccountOptions,
      bvcAccount: bvcAccountsOptions,
      isPayment
    }))
  }

  const setModalDelete = () => {
    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: '¿Estás seguro de eliminar la transacción?',
      message: 'Esta acción es irreversible.',
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Eliminar',
      textCancel: 'Volver',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: handleDeleteTransaction
    })
  }

  const clearData = () => {
    setOptions((prevOptions) => ({
      ...prevOptions,
      participantAccount: [],
      bvcAccount: []
    }))
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (context!.globalStatus.modalContent.show) {
      if (options.paymentType.length === 0) handleGetOptionsPaymentType()
      setModalCreate()
    }
  }, [transaction, isDisabledButton, thereAreSelected, options])

  return {
    setModalCreate,
    setModalEdit,
    setModalDelete
  }
}

```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks/useTransactionsBankPage.tsx

```tsx
import { Button } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { saveAs } from 'file-saver'
import { unparse } from 'papaparse'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'
import { GenerateLogs } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import {
  deleteTransaction,
  downloadReport
} from '../../../services/transactions/transactions'

export interface MenuOption {
  id: string
  label: string
  icon?: React.ReactNode
  action?: () => void
  textSize?: string
  textColor?: string
  subItems?: MenuOption[]
}

export interface ErrorResponse {
  response?: {
    data?: {
      httpCode?: string
      errorCode?: string
    }
  }
}

export const useTransactionsBankPage = (
  isEditDisabledButton: boolean,
  isDeleteDisabledButton: boolean,
  thereAreSelected: number[],
  setThereAreSelected: (selectedRows: number[]) => void,
  rows: any[],
  setRows: (rows: any[]) => void,
  setModalCreate: () => void,
  setModalEdit: () => void
) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  const { t } = useTranslation('operacionesEspeciales')
  const [modalContent, setModalContent] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const handleBack = () => navigate('/')
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false)
  const [alert, setAlert] = useState<{
    message: string
    open: boolean
    severity: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning'
  } | null>(null)
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem('username')
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const { participantId, id, status, country } = infoUserNubo

  const handleDelete = () => {
    setModalContent({
      title: t('Transacciones.ModalDelete.Titulo'),
      message: t('Transacciones.ModalDelete.Mensaje'),
      variant: 'warning',
      handleCancel: () => {
        setModalContent(null)
      },
      textCancel: t('Transacciones.ModalDelete.BtnCancelar'),
      textSuccess: t('Transacciones.ModalDelete.BtnConfirmar'),
      onClick: () => {
        setModalContent(null)
        deleteTransactionsSelecteds()
      }
    })
  }
  const deleteTransactionsSelecteds = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true)
      await deleteTransaction(thereAreSelected)
      setRows(
        rows.filter((row: { id: never }) => !thereAreSelected.includes(row.id))
      )
      setAlert({
        message: t('Transacciones.Alerta.Mensaje'),
        open: true,
        severity: 'success'
      })

      const username = client_user || 'Usuario desconocido'

      await GenerateLogs(username, {
        actionType: `Eliminación de transacciones banco liquidador (${thereAreSelected.length}): IDs [${thereAreSelected.join(', ')}]`,
        actionDestination: 'Transacciones Banco Liquidador',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as ErrorResponse

      if (err?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'ERROR_FLAG_MANUAL') {
        setAlert({
          message: t('Transacciones.Alerta.MensajeError'),
          open: true,
          severity: 'error'
        })
      }

      if (err?.response?.data?.errorCode === 'ERROR_STATUS_REGISTERED') {
        setAlert({
          message: t('Transacciones.Alerta.ErrorEstado'),
          open: true,
          severity: 'warning'
        })
      }

      if (!err?.response?.data?.errorCode) {
        console.error('Error deleting transaction:', error)
      }
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!rows.length) {
      console.error('No hay datos para descargar.')
      return
    }

    const { specialTrade, paymentType } = rows[0] || {}
    const specialTradeId = specialTrade?.id
    const paymentTypeId = paymentType?.id

    if (!specialTradeId || !paymentTypeId) {
      console.error('No hay datos para descargar.')
      return
    }

    try {
      const currentDate = new Date()
      const formattedDate = currentDate
        .toISOString()
        .split('T')[0]
        .replace(/-/g, '')
      const username = client_user || 'Usuario desconocido'

      const data = await downloadReport(specialTradeId, paymentTypeId)
      if (!data || !data.length) {
        console.error('El reporte está vacío.')
        return
      }

      const flattenedData = data.map((item: any) => ({
        'Fecha Movimiento': item.transactionDateTime,
        Secuencia: item.nuboSequence,
        Folio: item.specialTrade?.specialOperationId,
        'Tipo Movimiento': item.transactionType?.description,
        Proceso: item.flagManual ? 'Manual' : 'Automático',
        Valor: item.transactionAmount,
        Participante: item.participant?.name,
        'Cuenta Salida': item.accountOutput,
        'Cuenta Ingreso': item.accountInput,
        Observación: item.observation,
        Estado: item.status?.description
      }))

      const csv = unparse(flattenedData, { header: true })
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' })
      const fileName = `${formattedDate}_transacciones_${specialTradeId}.csv`

      saveAs(blob, fileName)

      await GenerateLogs(username, {
        actionType: 'Generación de reporte CSV transacciones banco liquidador',
        actionDestination: 'Transacciones Banco Liquidador',
        participantId,
        countryId: country.id,
        userNuboId: id,
        statusId: status.id
      })
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al descargar el reporte:', error)
    }
  }

  // const iconOptions: MenuOption[] = [
  //     { id: "descargar", label: t('Transacciones.Descargar'), textSize: '13px', textColor: '#FF411C', icon: <FileDownloadOutlinedIcon />, action: handleDownload },
  // ];

  const headerActionsLeft = ({
    canViewDeleteBtn,
    canViewEditBtn,
    canViewCreateBtn
  }: {
    canViewDeleteBtn: boolean
    canViewEditBtn: boolean
    canViewCreateBtn: boolean
  }) => (
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      {canViewCreateBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={setModalCreate}
          className="w-[67px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 text-[13px] uppercase outline-none"
        >
          {t('Transacciones.Table.HeaderActionsLeft.Ingresar')}
        </Button>
      )}
      {canViewEditBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={setModalEdit}
          disabled={isEditDisabledButton}
          className={`${isEditDisabledButton ? 'text-[#B8B8B8]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'} w-[71px] gap-0 px-[5px] py-1 font-Roboto text-[13px] font-medium uppercase outline-none`}
        >
          {t('Transacciones.Table.HeaderActionsLeft.Modificar')}
        </Button>
      )}
      {canViewDeleteBtn && (
        <Button
          size="small"
          variant="text"
          onClick={handleDelete}
          disabled={isDeleteDisabledButton}
          className={`w-[71px] px-[5px] py-1 text-[13px] outline-none ${isDeleteDisabledButton ? 'text-[#B8B8B8]' : 'text-[#FF4201]'}`}
        >
          {t('Transacciones.Table.HeaderActionsLeft.Eliminar')}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  )

  return {
    handleBack,
    rows,
    setThereAreSelected,
    headerActionsLeft,
    modalContent,
    alert,
    setAlert,
    t,
    isLoading,
    setRows,
    handleDownload
  }
}
```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/Hooks/useTransactionsStates.ts

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useSelector } from 'react-redux'

import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

import { STRINGS } from '../../../helpers/strings'

export const useTransactionsStates = () => {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<any[]>([])
  console.log('🚀 ~ useTransactionsStates ~ rows:', rows)
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<any>([])
  const [isEditDisabledButton, setIsEditDisabledButton] =
    useState<boolean>(true)
  const [isDeleteDisabledButton, setIsDeleteDisabledButton] =
    useState<boolean>(true)
  const [rowsFlagManualTrue, setRowsFlagManualTrue] = useState<any[]>([])
  const { infoUserNubo } = useSelector((state: RootState) => state.auth)
  const client_user = localStorage.getItem(STRINGS.LOCALSTORAGE.USER_NAME)
  useEffect(() => {
    const flagManualTrue = rows?.filter((row) => row.flagManual === true)
    setRowsFlagManualTrue(flagManualTrue)
    setIsEditDisabledButton(
      thereAreSelected.length !== 1 ||
        !flagManualTrue.some((row) => thereAreSelected.includes(row.id))
    )

    if (thereAreSelected.length === 1) {
      const selectedRow = rows.find((row) => row.id === thereAreSelected[0])
      setIsDeleteDisabledButton(!selectedRow?.flagManual)
    } else {
      setIsDeleteDisabledButton(thereAreSelected.length === 0)
    }
  }, [thereAreSelected, rows])

  const selectedRows = (rows: number[]) => {
    setThereAreSelected(rows)
  }

  const fillStateWithData = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const addRowStateWithData = (newRow: any) => {
    setRows((prevRows) => [...prevRows, newRow])
  }

  const editRowStateWithData = (id: number, newRow: any) => {
    setRows((prevRows) => prevRows.map((row) => (row.id === id ? newRow : row)))
  }

  const deleteRowsState = (rowsIds: number[]) => {
    const rowsFlagManualTrueToDelete = rowsFlagManualTrue.filter((row) =>
      rowsIds.includes(row.id)
    )
    setRows((prevRows) =>
      prevRows.filter(
        (row) =>
          !rowsFlagManualTrueToDelete.some(
            (rowToDelete) => row.id === rowToDelete.id
          )
      )
    )
  }

  return {
    rows,
    setRows,
    fillStateWithData,
    addRowStateWithData,
    editRowStateWithData,
    deleteRowsState,
    thereAreSelected,
    selectedRows,
    isEditDisabledButton,
    isDeleteDisabledButton,
    rowsFlagManualTrue,
    infoUserNubo,
    client_user,
    setThereAreSelected
  }
}
```
