```tsx
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'

import { useScreenActions } from 'remoteShell/mf-shell-useScreenActions'
import {
  AlertMui,
  ContentWrapper,
  ModalAlert,
  NewTable,
  Spinner
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { TRANSACTIONS_ACTIONS } from '@/shared/constants/actionCodes'

import CompensationFilters from '../CompensationsPage/Components/CompensationFilters'
import {
  useTransactionsBankPage,
  useTransactionColumns,
  useTransactions,
  useTransactionsStates
} from './Hooks'
import { DetailsFoliosModel } from './components/DetailsFolios/DetailsFoliosModel'
import { SettlementBankTransactionTracking } from './components/SettlementBankTransactionTracking'

export const TransactionsBankPage = () => {
  const [operation, setOperation] = useState<any | null>(null)
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState<{ id: number; name: string } | null>(
    null
  )
  const [modalDetailFolios, setModalDetailFolios] = useState(false)
  const [currentId, setCurrentId] = useState<number>(0)
  const { hasAction } = useScreenActions()
  const { canViewCreateBtn, canViewEditBtn, canViewDeleteBtn } = useMemo(
    () => ({
      canViewCreateBtn: hasAction(TRANSACTIONS_ACTIONS.REGISTER),
      canViewEditBtn: hasAction(TRANSACTIONS_ACTIONS.EDIT),
      canViewDeleteBtn: hasAction(TRANSACTIONS_ACTIONS.DELETE)
    }),
    [hasAction]
  )
  const [
    settlementBankTransactionTracking,
    setSettlementBankTransactionTracking
  ] = useState({
    show: false,
    bankTransaction: {
      nuboSequence: '',
      transactionDateTime: '',
      id: null
    }
  })
  const { columns } = useTransactionColumns({
    setSettlementBankTransactionTracking,
    setModalDetailFolios,
    setCurrentId
  })
  const {
    rows,
    fillStateWithData,
    addRowStateWithData,
    editRowStateWithData,
    setThereAreSelected,
    setRows,
    thereAreSelected,
    selectedRows,
    isEditDisabledButton,
    rowsFlagManualTrue,
    deleteRowsState,
    infoUserNubo,
    client_user,
    isDeleteDisabledButton
  } = useTransactionsStates()

  const { setModalCreate, setModalEdit } = useTransactions(
    deleteRowsState,
    payment,
    operation,
    addRowStateWithData,
    editRowStateWithData,
    thereAreSelected,
    rowsFlagManualTrue,
    infoUserNubo,
    client_user
  )
  const {
    headerActionsLeft,
    isLoading,
    t,
    modalContent,
    alert,
    setAlert,
    handleDownload
  } = useTransactionsBankPage(
    isEditDisabledButton,
    isDeleteDisabledButton,
    thereAreSelected,
    setThereAreSelected,
    rows,
    setRows,
    setModalCreate,
    setModalEdit
  )

  return (
    <ContentWrapper title={t('Transacciones.Titulo')}>
      {/* <div className="w-full p-4 bg-white h-[calc(100vh-75px)] flex flex-col"> */}
      <CompensationFilters
        onPaymentChange={setPayment}
        onOperationChange={setOperation}
      />
      {operation && payment && (
        <div className="relative">
          {isLoading && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 z-10 flex items-center justify-center bg-white bg-opacity-50">
              <Spinner />
            </div>
          )}
          <NewTable
            columns={columns}
            customToolbar={headerActionsLeft({
              canViewCreateBtn,
              canViewEditBtn,
              canViewDeleteBtn
            })}
            setDataRemote={fillStateWithData}
            rows={rows}
            setThereAreSelected={selectedRows}
            endpoint={`/bank-transaction/special-trade/${operation?.id}/payment-type/${payment.id}`}
            height="700px"
            axiosInstanceKey="httpBankTransactions"
            handleDownload={handleDownload}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {settlementBankTransactionTracking.show && (
        <SettlementBankTransactionTracking
          handleClose={() =>
            setSettlementBankTransactionTracking({
              show: false,
              bankTransaction: {
                nuboSequence: '',
                transactionDateTime: '',
                id: null
              }
            })
          }
          bankTransaction={settlementBankTransactionTracking.bankTransaction}
        />
      )}
      {modalContent && (
        <ModalAlert
          title={modalContent.title}
          message={modalContent.message}
          variant={modalContent.variant}
          onClick={modalContent.onClick}
          handleCancel={modalContent.handleCancel}
          textCancel={modalContent.textCancel}
          textSuccess={modalContent.textSuccess}
          orientation="Horizontal"
        />
      )}
      {alert && alert.open && (
        <AlertMui
          message={alert.message}
          severity={alert.severity}
          onClose={() => setAlert(null)}
          open={alert.open}
        />
      )}
      {modalDetailFolios && (
        <DetailsFoliosModel
          modalDetailFolios={setModalDetailFolios}
          bankTransactionId={currentId}
          setAlert={setAlert}
        />
      )}
      {/* </div> */}
    </ContentWrapper>
  )
}
```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/components/DetailsFolios/DetailsFoliosModel.tsx

```tsx
import { Typography } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useState, useEffect, useContext } from 'react'

import {
  ModalContent,
  NewTable,
  BoxInfo,
  Spinner
} from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { GlobalStatusContext } from '../../../../contex/GlobalStatusContext'
import { updateAssociatedSettlements } from '../../../../services/transactionsBank/detailsFolios'
import { useDetailsFolios } from '../../Hooks/useDetailsFolios'
import { useDetailsFoliosColumns } from '../../Hooks/useDetailsFoliosColumns'
import { ISettlement } from '../../interfaces/DetailFolios'

interface DetailsFoliosModelProps {
  modalDetailFolios: (value: boolean) => void
  bankTransactionId: number
  setAlert: (alert: {
    message: string
    severity: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
    open: boolean
  }) => void
}

export const DetailsFoliosModel = ({
  modalDetailFolios,
  bankTransactionId,
  setAlert
}: DetailsFoliosModelProps) => {
  const [thereAreSelected, setThereAreSelected] = useState<any>([])
  const [isAddingRow, setIsAddingRow] = useState(false)
  const [dissociatedRows, setDissociatedRows] = useState<ISettlement[]>([])
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false)
  const [refreshKey, setRefreshKey] = useState(0)

  const context = useContext(GlobalStatusContext)

  const handleUpdate = async (isAssociate: boolean) => {
    let rowsToUpdate: ISettlement[] = []

    if (isAssociate) {
      rowsToUpdate = rows.filter((row) => row.isNew && row.associated === true)
    } else {
      rowsToUpdate = dissociatedRows.map((row) => ({
        ...row,
        associated: false
      }))
    }

    if (rowsToUpdate.length === 0) {
      return
    }

    setIsSaving(true)
    try {
      const response = await updateAssociatedSettlements(
        rowsToUpdate,
        bankTransactionId
      )

      console.log('Guardado exitosamente:', response)
      if (isAssociate) {
        setRows((prev) =>
          prev.map((row) =>
            row.isNew ? { ...row, isNew: false, isManual: false } : row
          )
        )
      }

      setDissociatedRows([])
      setThereAreSelected([])
      setAlert({
        message: isAssociate
          ? 'Folio/Fracción asociada exitosamente.'
          : 'Folio/Fracción desasociada exitosamente.',
        severity: 'success',
        open: true
      })

      setRefreshKey((prev) => prev + 1)
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al guardar los settlements:', error)
      setAlert({
        message: 'Ocurrió un error al guardar los cambios.',
        severity: 'error',
        open: true
      })
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false)
    }
  }

  const handleAddRow = () => {
    const newId = rows.length > 0 ? Number(rows[rows.length - 1].id) + 1 : 1
    const newRow: ISettlement = {
      id: newId,
      tradeId: 0,
      fraction: 0,
      side: null,
      registrationDate: '-',
      folio: null,
      settlementDate: '-',
      participantAccount: null,
      custodian: null,
      amount: 0,
      associated: false,
      isManual: true,
      isNew: true
    }
    setIsAddingRow(true)
    setRows((prev) => [...prev, newRow])
    setLastAddedId(newId)
    clearSelections()
  }

  const handleDissociate = () => {
    const removed = rows.filter((row) => thereAreSelected.includes(row.id))
    setDissociatedRows((prev) => [...prev, ...removed])
    setRows((prevRows) =>
      prevRows.filter((row) => !thereAreSelected.includes(row.id))
    )
  }

  const setValidateUpdate = () => {
    const hasNewAssociations = rows.some((row) => row.isNew && row.associated)
    const hasDissociations = dissociatedRows.length > 0

    if (!hasNewAssociations && !hasDissociations) {
      setAlert({
        message: 'No hay datos nuevos o cambios para guardar.',
        severity: 'warning',
        open: true
      })
      console.log('No hay datos para guardar')
      return
    }

    if (hasNewAssociations && !hasDissociations) {
      handleUpdate(true)
      return
    }

    context?.setModalAlert({
      title: `¿Estás seguro de desasociar los folios/fracciones marcados de la transacción?`,
      variant: 'warning',
      textSuccess: 'Sí, Continuar',
      textCancel: 'Volver',
      orientation: 'horizontal',
      onClick: () => {
        context?.clearModalAlert()
        handleUpdate(false)
      }
    })
  }

  const { headerActionsLeft, CustomFooter, dataHeader, specialTradeId } =
    useDetailsFolios({
      bankTransactionId,
      onAddRow: handleAddRow,
      onDissociate: handleDissociate,
      isAddingRow,
      refreshKey
    })

  const [rows, setRows] = useState<ISettlement[]>([])
  const [lastAddedId, setLastAddedId] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const setDataRemote = (_page: number, dataTable: []) => {
    setRows(dataTable)
  }

  const { columnsFolios, selectedSettlement, clearSelections } =
    useDetailsFoliosColumns({
      specialTradeId,
      rows,
      setAlert
    })

  useEffect(() => {
    if (lastAddedId !== null && selectedSettlement) {
      setRows((prevRows) =>
        prevRows.map((row) =>
          row.id === lastAddedId
            ? {
                ...selectedSettlement,
                id: lastAddedId,
                associated: true,
                isManual: false,
                isNew: true
              }
            : row
        )
      )
      setIsAddingRow(false)
    }
  }, [selectedSettlement])

  const endpoint = `/special-bank-transaction-trade/find/settlements/${bankTransactionId}`

  return (
    <ModalContent
      handleAccept={setValidateUpdate}
      handleClose={() => modalDetailFolios(false)}
      showBtnCancel={true}
      ItShouldHaveButtons={false}
      className="relative w-full max-w-[1200px]"
      btnCancelText="Cancelar"
      btnAceptText="Guardar"
    >
      <Typography variant="h5" className="text-start">
        Visualización de los folios/fracciones asociados a la transacción
      </Typography>

      <BoxInfo columns={dataHeader} noBorder={false} stacked />

      <Typography variant="caption" className="text-start">
        Selecciona las Folios y/o fracciones que vas a asociar o desasociar a la
        transacción
      </Typography>

      <NewTable
        columns={columnsFolios}
        setDataRemote={setDataRemote}
        rows={rows}
        disableRowSelectionOnClick={true}
        rowsPerPageOptions={[5]}
        customToolbar={headerActionsLeft()}
        checkboxSelection={true}
        endpoint={endpoint}
        axiosInstanceKey="httpOperationsSpecFoliosDetail"
        customFooter={CustomFooter}
        scrollToRowId={lastAddedId}
        setThereAreSelected={setThereAreSelected}
        refresh={refreshKey}
      />

      {isSaving && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-white bg-opacity-50">
          <Spinner />
        </div>
      )}
    </ModalContent>
  )
}

```

## src/pages/TransactionsBankPage/components/SettlementBankTransactionTracking/SettlementBankTransactionTracking.tsx

```tsx
import { format } from 'date-fns'

import { ModalContent, NewTable } from 'remoteUtilities/components-mf-utilities'

import { SettlementBankTransactionTrackingProps } from '../../../../models'
import { useSettlementBankTransactionTracking } from '../../Hooks/useSettlementBankTransactionTracking'

/**
 * Component that displays tracking information for a bank settlement transaction.
 * Shows a modal with transaction details and a table containing the tracking history.
 *
 * @param {Object} props - The component props
 * @param {Object} props.bankTransaction - The bank transaction data to display
 * @param {function} props.handleClose - Function to close the tracking modal
 *
 * @returns A modal displaying transaction tracking information, with a loading spinner
 * while data is being fetched, or transaction details and tracking history table when loaded
 */
export function SettlementBankTransactionTracking({
  bankTransaction,
  handleClose
}: Readonly<SettlementBankTransactionTrackingProps>) {
  const closeHandler = () => {
    handleClose({ show: false, bankTransaction: bankTransaction })
  }

  const { rows, columns } = useSettlementBankTransactionTracking({
    bankTransactionId: bankTransaction?.id ?? 0,
    handleClose: closeHandler
  })

  return (
    <ModalContent
      handleClose={handleClose}
      className="flex min-h-[330px] w-full flex-col gap-4 rounded p-[48px]"
      parentClassName="px-[30px]"
      ItShouldHaveButtons={false}
      showBtnClose={false}
      showBtnAccept={false}
    >
      <>
        <div className="flex text-xl">
          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-x-1">
            <span className="font-bold">Seguimiento transacción:</span>
            <p> {bankTransaction?.nuboSequence}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-x-1">
            <span className="font-bold">Fecha de registro</span>
            <p>
              {format(
                new Date(bankTransaction.transactionDateTime),
                'dd/MM/yyyy'
              ) ?? 'N/A'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="mb-3 text-lg font-bold">Estado de la transacción</p>

          <div className="h-0 min-h-[330px] flex-1">
            <NewTable
              height={320}
              columns={columns}
              rows={rows}
              disableColumnMenu
              disableColumnResize
              disableColumnSorting
              disableRowSelectionOnClick
              hideFooter
              checkboxSelection={false}
              getRowHeight={() => 'auto'}
            />
            {/* <DataGridBasic
                            height={320}
                            columns={columns}
                            rows={rows}
                            disableColumnMenu
                            disableColumnResize
                            disableColumnSorting
                            disableRowSelectionOnClick
                            hideFooter
                            checkboxSelection={false}
                            getRowHeight={() => 'auto'}
                        /> */}
          </div>
        </div>
      </>
    </ModalContent>
  )
}
```

```typescript
export interface IFolioSpecialTrade {
  sequence: string
  transactionDate: Date
  registrationDate: Date
  transactionAmount: number
  settlements: ISettlement[]
  recordCount: number
  totalAmount: string
  specialTradeId: number
  permissionToAssociate: boolean
  permissionToDissociate: boolean
}

export interface ISettlement {
  id: number
  tradeId: number
  fraction: number
  side: Side | null
  registrationDate: string
  folio: Folio | null
  settlementDate: string
  participantAccount: ParticipantAccount | null
  custodian: Custodian | null
  amount: number
  associated: boolean
  isManual?: boolean
  isNew?: boolean
}

interface Side {
```

```tsx
import { Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom'

import pagesData, { RouterType } from './routes'

const Router = () => {
  const pageRoutes = pagesData.map(({ path, title, element }: RouterType) => {
    return <Route key={title} path={`/${path}`} element={element} />
  })

  return <Routes>{pageRoutes}</Routes>
}

export default Router
```

```tsx
import { STRINGS } from '../helpers/strings'
import {
  OperationsPage,
  OperationDetailPage,
  FoliosPage,
  AssignmentValidationPage,
  BeneficiariesPage,

import { ReportSubmodule } from '../pages/ReportSubmodule'

export interface RouterType {
  title: string
  path: string
  element: JSX.Element
}

const createPageData = (
  path: string,
  element: JSX.Element,
  title: string
): RouterType => ({
  path,
  element,
  title
})

const pagesData: RouterType[] = [
  createPageData(
    STRINGS.NAVIGATE.OPERATION.PATH,
```

```typescript
import { getCommonHeaders } from '@/helpers/headerServices'
import axios from 'axios'

import { httpOperationsSpec } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { formatClientDatetime } from '../../helpers'
import {
  BeneficiariesCalculationPayloadModel,
  BeneficiariesCalculationResponseModel,
  BeneficiariesFractionPayloadModel
} from '../../models'
import { AccountValidation } from '../../models/AccountValidation'

export const updateFractions = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  data: BeneficiariesFractionPayloadModel[],
  tradeId: number,
  side: number
) => {
  console.log('🚀 ~ updateFractions ~ data:', data)
  try {
    const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_API_URL
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()
    const response = await axios.post(
      `${apiUrl}/fractionation-pending/create-fractions/trade/${tradeId}/side/${side}`,
      data,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          client_user: client_user,
          client_datetime: client_datetime
        }
      }
    )
    console.log('🚀 ~ updateFractions ~ response:', response)
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching fraction information:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export const accountValidation = async (
  account: string,
  tradeId: number,
  side: number
): Promise<AccountValidation> => {
  try {
    const headers = await getCommonHeaders()
    const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get(
      `/validate/fraction/account/account-number/${account}/trade/${tradeId}/side/${side}`,
      {
        headers
      }
    )
    return data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching account information:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export const calculation = async (
  countryId: number,
  data: BeneficiariesCalculationPayloadModel
): Promise<BeneficiariesCalculationResponseModel> => {
  try {
    const headers = await getCommonHeaders()
    const response = await httpOperationsSpec.post(
      `/calculation/country/${countryId}`,
      data,
      {
        headers
      }
    )
    return response?.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching calculation information:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
export const calculationNoCountry = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  data: BeneficiariesCalculationPayloadModel
): Promise<BeneficiariesCalculationResponseModel> => {
  try {
    const apiUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SPECIAL_OPERATION_API_URL
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()
    const response = await axios.post(`${apiUrl}/calculation`, data, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        client_user: client_user,
        client_datetime: client_datetime
      }
    })
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching calculation information:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
```

```typescript
import {
  httpSpecOperationsCompensationsClose,
  httpSpecOperationsCompensationsPaymentAndCollections
} from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { formatClientDatetime } from '../../helpers'
import { PaymentAndCollectionModel } from '../../models/compensations'

export const sendPaymentAndCollection = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  data: PaymentAndCollectionModel[],
  type: string
): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()
    const response =
      await httpSpecOperationsCompensationsPaymentAndCollections.post(
        `/${type}`,
        data,
        {
          headers: {
            Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
            client_user: client_user,
            client_datetime: client_datetime
          }
        }
      )
    return response.status === 201
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching payments or collections:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export const sendClose = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  specialTradeId: number
): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')

      `/special-trade-closure`,

      {

        }

    throw error
  }
}

  client_user: string | null,

): Promise<boolean> => {
```

```typescript
import { httpConciliation } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { getCommonHeaders } from '../../helpers'

export const findConciliation = async (
  specialTrade: string,
  payment: number
) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  const response = await httpConciliation.get(
    `/conciliation/special-trade/${specialTrade}/payment-type/${payment}`,
    {
      headers
    }
  )

  return response
}

export const getCalculationStatement = async (
  file: File,
  specialTrade: string,
  payment: number
) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  const formData = new FormData()
  formData.append('statement', file)

  const response = await httpConciliation.post(
    `/conciliation/calculation/statement/special-trade/${specialTrade}/payment-type/${payment}`,
    formData,
    {
      headers
    }
  )

  return response
}

export const getCalculationBank = async (
  specialTrade: string,
  payment: number
) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  const response = await httpConciliation.post(
    `/conciliation/calculation/bank/special-trade/${specialTrade}/payment-type/${payment}`,
    null,
    {
      headers
    }
  )

  return response
}

export const getCalculationConfirm = async (
  specialTrade: string,
  payment: number,
  codeOperation: string,
  observations: string = ''
) => {
  const body = {
    codeOperation,
    observations
  }

  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  const response = await httpConciliation.post(
    `/conciliation/confirm/special-trade/${specialTrade}/payment-type/${payment}`,
    body,
    {
      headers
    }
  )

  return response
}
```

```typescript
export const updateSettlementStatus = async ({
  quantityCustodian,
  setViewToast,
  setModalConfirm,
  causalRejection,
  selectedCustodian,
  infoUserNubo,
  username
}: {
  quantityCustodian: InfoSend[]
  setViewToast: (arg: boolean) => void
  setModalConfirm: (arg: boolean) => void
  causalRejection: any
  selectedCustodian: string
  infoUserNubo: any
  username: string
}) => {
  const extractIdGeneric = quantityCustodian.map(({ id, ...rest }) => rest)

  console.log('🚀 ~ extractIdGeneric:', extractIdGeneric)
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()
    const client_user = localStorage.getItem(STRINGS.CLIENT_USER_LOCAL_STORAGE)

    await httpCustodyStatus.patch(`/settlement/status`, extractIdGeneric, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        client_user: client_user,
        client_datetime: client_datetime
      },
      params: causalRejection
    })
    setModalConfirm(false)
    setViewToast(true)

    const { id, status, participantId, country } = infoUserNubo

    await GenerateLogs(username, {
      actionType: `Accion envio a ${selectedCustodian}`,
      actionDestination: selectedCustodian,
      participantId,
      countryId: country.id,
      userNuboId: id,
      statusId: status.id
    })
  } catch (error) {
    console.log('🚀 ~ getFindParticipantCustody ~ error:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { httpOperationsSpec } from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { getCommonHeaders } from '../../helpers'

type Args = {
  temporalDataSettlement?: any
  tradeIdNumber?: number
  currentFraction?: number
  sideIdNumber?: number
  setChangeSettlement?: (value: boolean) => void
}

export const getSettlementData = async ({
  tradeIdNumber,
  sideIdNumber
}: Args) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  try {
    const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.get(
      `/special-settlement?specialTradeId=${tradeIdNumber}&sideId=${sideIdNumber}`,
      {
        headers
      }
    )
    return data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting special trade:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export const updateSpecialSettlement = async ({
  temporalDataSettlement,
  currentFraction,
  tradeIdNumber,
  sideIdNumber,
  setChangeSettlement
}: Args) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  try {
    const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.patch(
      `/special-settlement/${tradeIdNumber}/fraction/${currentFraction}/side/${sideIdNumber}`,
      temporalDataSettlement,
      {
        headers
      }
    )
    if (setChangeSettlement) {
      setChangeSettlement(false)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setChangeSettlement(true)
      }, 1000)
    }
    return data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating special trade:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export const createFractionSpecialSettlement = async ({
  tradeIdNumber,
  temporalDataSettlement
}: Args) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.post(
    `/special-settlement/create-fractions/special-trade/${tradeIdNumber}`,
    temporalDataSettlement,
    {
      headers
    }
  )
  return data
}

type ArgFraction = {
  tradeIdNumber: number
  sideId: number
  body: any[]
}

export const createFractionSettlement = async ({
  tradeIdNumber,
  sideId,
  body
}: ArgFraction) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()
  console.log('🚀 ~ createFractionSettlement ~ headers:', headers)
```

```typescript
import { format } from 'date-fns'

import {
  httpOperationsSpec,
  httpSpecOperationsCompensations
} from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { getCommonHeaders } from '../../helpers'
import { CompensationUpdate } from '../trades/types'

type Args = {
  temporalDataTrade: any
  tradeIdNumber: number
  changeData: boolean
  setChangeData: (value: boolean) => void
}

export const updateSpecialTrade = async ({
  temporalDataTrade,
  tradeIdNumber,
  changeData,
  setChangeData
}: Args) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  try {
    const { data } = await httpOperationsSpec.put(
      `/special-trade/${tradeIdNumber}`,
      temporalDataTrade,
      {
        headers
      }
    )

    setChangeData(!changeData)
    return data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating special trade:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

type SpecialTradeParams = {
  specialOperationIdName?: string
  id?: string
  operationId?: string
  recordDate?: Date
  settlementDate?: Date
  countryId?: number
  payment?: string | number
  options?: { page?: number; size?: number }
  specialTradeId?: string
  validateDate?: boolean
}

export const getSpecialTrade = async ({
  specialOperationIdName,
  id,
  recordDate,
  settlementDate,
  countryId,
  payment,
  options = { page: 0, size: 10 },
  validateDate = false
}: SpecialTradeParams) => {
  const { page, size } = options
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

  try {
    const response = await httpSpecOperationsCompensations.get(
      `/special-trade/all`,
      {
        headers,
        params: {
          ...(id && { id }),
          ...(specialOperationIdName && { specialOperationIdName }),
          ...(recordDate && {
            recordDate: validateDate
              ? recordDate
              : format(recordDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
          }),
          ...(settlementDate && {
            settlementDate: validateDate
              ? settlementDate
              : format(settlementDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
          }),
          ...(countryId && { countryId }),
          ...(payment && { payment }),
          page,
          size
        }
      }
    )

    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error get special trades:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

  specialTradeId: number | undefined,
  participantCodeName: string | undefined,

) => {
  const headers = await getCommonHeaders()

    const response = await httpSpecOperationsCompensations.get(
      `/participant/special-trade/${specialTradeId}`,
      {
        headers,
        params: {
          participantCodeName,
          page,
          size
        }
      }
    )

    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error get special trades:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
```

```typescript
import axios from 'axios'

import {
  httpOperations,
  httpOperationsSpec,
  httpOperationsSpecFolios,
  httpSpecOperationsReceipts
} from 'remoteShell/mf-axiosConfig'

import { formatClientDatetime, getCommonHeaders } from '../../helpers'
import { FolioDetailModel } from '../../models/folioDetail.model'
import {
  StatusHistoryBlockModel,
  StatusHistoryModel,
  StatusHistoryModelV2
} from '../../models/statusHistory.model'
import { BeneficiariesInfoType, IReportOperation } from '../../pages'
import { ITradeEquity, ITrades } from './types'

export const getSelects = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  type: string
): Promise<{ label: string; value: string }[]> => {
  try {
    const masterUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_MASTER_URL
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()
    const response = await axios.get(`${masterUrl}/${type}`, {
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        client_user: client_user,
        client_datetime: client_datetime
      }
    })
    switch (type) {
      case 'country':
        return response.data.map((country: { name: string; id: string }) => ({
          label: country.name,
          value: country.id.toString()
        }))
        break
      case 'status':
        return response.data.map(
          (status: { description: string; id: string }) => ({
            label: status.description,
            value: status.id.toString()
          })
        )
        break
      case 'type':
        return response.data.map(
          (type: { description: string; id: string }) => ({
            label: type.description,
            value: type.id.toString()
          })
        )
        break
      default:
        return []
        break
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching user information:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

          client_datetime: client_datetime
        }
      }
    )

    const mapped: StatusHistoryModel = {
      tradeId,
      matchDate: data.recordDate ?? '',
      matchId: 0,

      assignmentStatusHistory: [],

      custodianStatusHistory: (data.custodianStatusHistory ?? []).map((h) => ({
        tradeId,
        fraction: 0,
        side: { id: h.side ?? '', description: h.side ?? '' },
        date: h.date,
        time: typeof h.time === 'string' ? h.time : '',
        status: {
          id: 0,
          description: h.status ?? '',
          category: '',
          detail: h.detail ?? ''
        },
        beneficiaryId: h.beneficiaryId,
        detail: h.detail
      })),

      complianceStatusHistory: (data.complianceStatusHistory ?? []).map(
        (h) => ({
          date: h.date,
          tradeId,
          fraction: undefined,
          side: undefined,
          time: typeof h.time === 'string' ? h.time : '',
          status: {
            id: 0,
            description: h.status ?? '',
            category: '',
            detail: h.detail ?? ''
          },
          detail: h.detail ?? ''
        })
      )
    }
    return mapped
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching getTradeHistory:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

      sideId,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          client_user: client_user,
          client_datetime: client_datetime
        }
      }
    )
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting report operations:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
export const reportFolioDetailTxtMultiple = async (
  client_user: string | null,
  getTradeId: any,
  userId: string | undefined
) => {
  try {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token')
    const client_datetime = formatClientDatetime()

    const response = await httpSpecOperationsReceipts.post(
      `/receipt-operation/generate/receipt/massive/folios/user/${userId}`,
      getTradeId,
      {
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          client_user: client_user,
          client_datetime: client_datetime
        }
      }
    )
    return response.data
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting report operations:', error)
    throw error
  }
}
```

## src/shared/components/NumericInputField.tsx

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@nuam/common-fe-lib-components'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { onKeyDownNumber } from '../utils/onKeyDownNumber'

interface NumericInputFieldProps {
  value?: number | null
  onChange: (value: number | null) => void
  onBlur?: (value: number | null) => void
  placeholder?: string
  label?: string
  helperText?: string
  className?: string
  size?: 'small' | 'medium'
  locale?: string // default 'es-CO'
  error?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  // nuevos opcionales para edición por fila
  id?: number
  field?: string
  onCommit?: (id: number, field: string, value: number | null) => void
  // nueva callback para enter/tab
  onKeyEnterOrTab?: (id: number, field: string, value: number | null) => void
  inputSx?: any
}

const NumericInputField = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  onBlur,
  placeholder = 'Digite un valor',
  label,
  helperText,
  className = 'w-full h-full rounded-4px',
  size = 'small',
  locale = 'es-CO',
  error = false,
  disabled = false,
  id = -1,
  field = '',
  onCommit,
  onKeyEnterOrTab,
  inputSx
}: NumericInputFieldProps) => {
  const formattedValue =
    value !== undefined && value !== null
      ? new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(Number(value))
      : ''
  const [rawDisplay, setRawDisplay] = useState(formattedValue)

  useEffect(() => {
    // sincroniza cuando cambia valor externo
    const external =
      value !== undefined && value !== null
        ? new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(Number(value))
        : ''
    setRawDisplay(external)
  }, [value, locale])

  const parseValue = (val: string): number | null => {
    const strValFormatted = val.replace(/[.,\s]/g, '')
    if (strValFormatted === '') return null
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(strValFormatted)) return null
    return Number(strValFormatted)
  }

  const formatThousands = (val: string) => {
    const digits = val.replace(/[^\d]/g, '')
    if (!digits) return ''
    return digits.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, '.')
  }

  const handleChange = (val: string) => {
    const masked = formatThousands(val)
    setRawDisplay(masked)
    onChange(parseValue(masked))
  }

  const handleBlur = (val: string) => {
    if (onBlur) onBlur(parseValue(val))
  }

  const commitValue = (raw: string) => {
    if (!onCommit) return
    onCommit(id, field, parseValue(raw))
  }

  const handleEnterOrTab = (e: any) => {
    const raw = e.target.value
    commitValue(raw)
    if (onKeyEnterOrTab) {
      onKeyEnterOrTab(id, field, parseValue(raw))
    }
  }

  return (
    <TextField
      value={rawDisplay}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      label={label}
      helperText={helperText}
      onChange={(val: any) => {
        const newValue = typeof val === 'string' ? val : val.target.value
        handleChange(newValue)
      }}
      onBlur={(e: any) => {
        handleBlur(e.target.value)
        commitValue(e.target.value)
      }}
      onKeyDown={(e: any) => {
        onKeyDownNumber(e)
        if (['Tab'].includes(e.key)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          handleEnterOrTab(e)
        }
        if (['Enter', 'NumpadEnter'].includes(e.key)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          handleEnterOrTab(e)
        }
      }}
      onKeyPress={(e: any) => {
        if (['Enter', 'NumpadEnter'].includes(e.key)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          handleEnterOrTab(e)
        }
      }}
      onKeyUp={(e: any) => {
        if (['Enter', 'NumpadEnter'].includes(e.key)) {
          e.preventDefault()
          e.stopPropagation()
          handleEnterOrTab(e)
        }
      }}
      // detener propagación para que el DataGrid no cierre el input
      onClick={(e: any) => {
        e.stopPropagation()
      }}
      onMouseDown={(e: any) => {
        e.stopPropagation()
      }}
      onPointerDown={(e: any) => {
        e.stopPropagation()
      }}
      type="text"
      className={className}
      size={size}
      error={error}
      disabled={disabled}
      sx={inputSx}
    />
  )
}

export default NumericInputField

```

## src/shared/config/methods.ts

```typescript
import { AxiosResponse } from 'axios'

import STORAGE_KEYS from '../constants/storageKeys'
import { MethodsProps } from '../types/methods'
import getCurrentDateTime from '../utils/getCurrentDateTime'
import { getFromLocalStorage } from '../utils/localStorage'

export const post = async (props: MethodsProps): Promise<AxiosResponse> => {
  const accessToken = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN)
  const client_user = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME)

  const { axiosInstance, data = null, urlWithParams } = props || {}

  return await axiosInstance.post(urlWithParams, data, {
    headers: {
      client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
      client_user,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`
    }
  })
}

export const get = async (props: MethodsProps): Promise<AxiosResponse> => {
  const accessToken = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN)
  const client_user = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME)
  const { axiosInstance, urlWithParams, params } = props || {}

  return await axiosInstance.get(urlWithParams, {
    headers: {
      client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
      client_user,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`
    },
    params
  })
}

export const patch = async (props: MethodsProps): Promise<AxiosResponse> => {
  const accessToken = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN)
  const client_user = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME)
  const { axiosInstance, urlWithParams, data } = props || {}

  return await axiosInstance.patch(urlWithParams, data, {
    headers: {
      client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
      client_user,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`
    }
  })
}

export const put = async (props: MethodsProps): Promise<AxiosResponse> => {
  const accessToken = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.ACCESS_TOKEN)
  const client_user = getFromLocalStorage(STORAGE_KEYS.USERNAME)
  const { axiosInstance, urlWithParams, data } = props || {}

  return await axiosInstance.put(urlWithParams, data, {
    headers: {
      client_datetime: getCurrentDateTime(),
      client_user,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`
    }
  })
}

```

```typescript
export const capitalize = (str: string) => {
  if (!str) return ''
  return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1).toLowerCase()
}

```

## src/shared/utils/formatTime.ts

```typescript
const formatTime = (time: string) => {
  if (typeof time === 'string' && (time.match(/:/g) || []).length === 2) {
    // Ejemplo: "18:00:00" => "18:00"
    const parts = time.split(':')
    // Elimina la última parte (los segundos)
    return parts.slice(0, 2).join(':')
  }
  return time || ''
}

export default formatTime

```

```typescript
import { RootState } from 'remoteShell/mf-store'

type UserInfo = {
  userType: string
  id: number
}

export const getUserInfo = (state: RootState): UserInfo => {
  const userInfo = state.auth.infoUserNubo?.[0] || state.auth.infoUserNubo
  return {
    userType: userInfo?.userType || '',
    id: userInfo?.id
  }
}
```

## vite.config.ts

```typescript
import federation from '@originjs/vite-plugin-federation'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import path from 'path'
import { defineConfig, loadEnv } from 'vite'
import viteCompression from 'vite-plugin-compression'

import packageJson from './package.json'

export default defineConfig(({ mode }) => {
  const env = loadEnv(mode, process.cwd(), '')
  return {
    plugins: [
      react(),
      federation({
        name: 'remote-operation-spec-management',
        remotes: {
          remoteUtilities: env.VITE_REMOTE_UTILITIES,
          remoteShell: env.VITE_REMOTE_PARENT
        },
        exposes: {
          './mf-operation-spec-management': './src/main.tsx'
        },
        shared: packageJson.dependencies
      }),
      // ====================================
      // PRE-COMPRESIÓN GZIP
      // ====================================
      viteCompression({
        verbose: true, // Log de archivos comprimidos
        disable: false,
        threshold: 10240, // Solo comprimir archivos > 10KB
        algorithm: 'gzip',
        ext: '.gz',
        deleteOriginFile: false // Mantener archivo original
      })
    ],
    test: {
      environment: 'happy-dom'
    },
    resolve: {
      alias: {
        '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src')
      }
    },
    build: {
      modulePreload: false,
      target: 'esnext',
      minify: false,
      cssCodeSplit: false,
      rollupOptions: {
        external: ['sockjs-client']
      }
    }
  }
})

```
